tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i thugs sras thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi gsung 'bum bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i thugs sras thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi gsung 'bum bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i thugs sras thams cad mkhyen pa spyan snga grags pa 'byung gnas kyi gsung 'bum bzhugs so//

'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa bco brgyad pa// 01) oṃ swasti/ byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med nam mkha'i rang bzhin sku// lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i ngang*// kun bzang rnam 'phrul dpag med bsam yas brjod las 'das// thabs stobs mtha' yas chos rje'i zhabs la gus pas 'dud/ 'dir 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po/ bla ma dam pa de'i rnam par thar pa ni bsam gyis mi khyab cing brjod pa'i yul thams cad las 'das pa yin la/ bye brag tu bgyis na phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams/ rab 'byams chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa/ nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par 'phrin las kyi sgo mtha' yas pas sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor los/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan| sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par mdzad pa de ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad kyis kyang brjod par mi nus shing*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang mgo rmongs shing mngon sum du bya bar mi nus na/ bdag lta bus lta ci smos par ga la nus/ 'on kyang stong gsum gyi stong chen po mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di'i khongs su gtogs pa/ lho 'dzam bu gling gi byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir 'phrin las kyi sgo cung zad bstan pa/ thams cad kyi mthun snang du gyur cing yongs su grags pa'i rnam par thar pa bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba brjod par bya ste/ ༈ gti mug mun pas 'thoms pa'i 'gro ba rnams// tshad med thugs rje'i stobs kyis skyob mdzad pa// smon lam mthar phyin nam mkha' mnyam par 'jug /skyob mdzad mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni rtag tu 'gro la byams par gnas// snying rje'i stobs kyis gzhan gyi sdug bsngal 'joms// byang chub sems kyis mchog gi lam 'god// thams cad mkhyen pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan tshogs kyis rang gi ngo bo ston// skyon rnams dag par byed pa'i thabs la mkhas// so so'i rigs rnams dus su ngo sprod mdzad// ded dpon chen po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// mgon po phag mo gru pa sku gshegs tshe// 'gyur med gser gyi rdo rje bsnams mdzad nas// thams cad mkhyen pa de yi thugs kar thim// dbyer med gcig tu gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// yon tan 'byung gnas dpal gyi dbye chung du// lhar bcas 'jig rten snying rje chen pos btul// sgrib gsum rab spangs byang chub mchog brnyes pa// dus gsum mngon du gyur la phyag 'tshal lo// klu rgyal byang chub sems dpas chu phul zhing*// rang lus mngon du bstan nas zhabs la gtugs// lha klu gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus btul// tshar gcod rjes bzung mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phrin las du ma'i gzhir gyur gnas der ni// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum gyur 'phags ma bdun// zhal gzigs rten 'brel ma lus mngon du gyur// mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtha' yas khyod phyag 'tshal// spyan ras gzigs dang jo bo'i byin rlabs dang*// rnam 'phrul dpag med chos rje'i byin rlabs gnyis// dbyer med gcig tu gyur pa'i ngo bo yis// grags pas sa steng khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i mchod rten dpal gyi phag mo grur// spyan drangs dbang bskur bzhugs par gyur pa'i tshe// mkhan chen zhang dang skal ldan la sogs pa// zhabs kyi pad mor gtugs la phyag 'tshal lo// dag pa'i dkyil 'khor zla ba lta bu der// snyan pa'i rgya mtsho 'jig rten gsum du grags// gdul bya'i snying po chen po du ma btul// 'gran med rtsod dang bral la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas kyi mchog gyur dpal gyi ri de la// chos kyi rgyal po 'jig rten mgon po des// lo gnyis bzhugs nas 'gro ba ma lus btul// bde gshegs rin chain de la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas der thugs phab bzhugs par gyur pa'i tshe// rmi lam zab chen gdan la bzhugs pa na// ma bzhugs 'di nas song zhes lung bstan mdzad// rin chen bla ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// byang phyogs gshegs pa dbu ru'i sar byon dus// yul de'i dri za sha ba gsum sprul te// gnas po bar lhar bcas pas mdun nas bsu// gdul bya 'dul mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sa gzhi dag cing yul dang phyogs rnams dag

/mkhas dang btsun dang sgrub pa po rnams gnas// chos la gnas pa'i skyes bu rnams kyis gang*// rnam dag phyogs der gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas pa'i slob grwa dpal gyi skyi shod du// mkhas pa'i skye bo slob dpon rtsags la sogs// thos pas dregs pa'i skyes bu du ma btul// rtog ge'i tshogs rnams 'dul mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// zhing khams rnam par dag pa'i phyogs der ni// gdul bya'i rgyal po mkhas pa rnams btul zhing*// glang po'i 'gros kyi gnas kyis mchog der gshegs// mkhyen pa'i zla rgyas de la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bsil gnas gyur ko khyim bzhugs pa'i tshe// sna tshogs gdul bya du ma nyin mtshan du// brtson 'grus chen po thabs kyis 'dul mdzad tshe// rkyen ngan mang po zil gnon khyod phyag 'tshal// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mkha' la gte'u par bzung*// nam phyed bar du nyin mo bzhin du gnas// nyin mtshan gnyis su 'od dang bcas par gyur// 'byung bzhi mnga' brnyes khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dzin pa'i mun pa nam mkha'i dbyings su dag /the tshom drwa ba ye shes ral gris bcad// bdag 'dzin mdud pa sems nyid ngang du grol// lhun gyis grub pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nus pa'i mthar thug phyag na rdo rje bzhin// 'dod na ri rab rdul du rlog par mdzad// byams pa'i dbang gis 'gro ba ma lus skyob// thugs rje mthar thug khyod phyag 'tshal lo// dal zhing rnyog pa med pa gnam mtsho'i do// baiḍūrya dang pad ma ra ga'i mdog /rlabs dang lbu ba 'khrigs pas kun tu mdzes// chos kyi rje de der bzhugs gus phyag 'tshal// 'gro ba rnams la tshad med thugs rjes khyab// nyin mtshan du ni gzigs pa drug gis dgongs// skyabs gnas mthar phyin 'gro ba kun gyi dpal// lus can kun gyi mgon po khyod phyag 'tshal// srod kyi dus na gsang bdag rdo rje can// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma'i zhabs drung byon// dpag med gsang ba'i mdzod rnams du ma phul// rdo rje 'chang chen rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// chags bral dam chos bstan bcos chen po mdzad// nges pa'i mthar thug dam pa'i the tshom bcad// lta dang sgom dang spyod pa gcig tu bstan// chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// yangs shing mnyam pa'i sa ni rnam par dag

/chos kyi rgyal pos srungs pas 'tsho ba bde// rtsi tog rgyal pos bcud len 'gro ba 'tsho// phun sum tshogs pa'i dgon gnas phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mgon po gnas der gshegs pa'i tshe// dri za'i rgyal po zur phud lnga pa sogs// dpag med gnod sbyin du mas mdun nas bsu// snang srid dbang du sdud mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// nyi ma'i gung yol nam phyed bar du ni// 'khor los sgyur rgyal ri dang glang po'i gzugs// stag gi mgo dang gzig dang ne'u le'i mgo// du mar sprul zhing thal sbyar gus phyag 'tshal// kun gyis g.yon nas bskor zhing mchod pas mchod// thang lha'i mgo la nam mkha' khyab pa'i gdugs// gdugs gzhan du mas bar snang mdzes par byas// lha rdzas mchod pas mchod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas kyi dam pa smyo 'brog ma bar du// chos kyi rje de thugs rje'i dbang gis byon// sa dang ri dang phyogs rnams g.yo bar mdzad// ngo mtshar rmad byung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs lta dang lta ngan 'dzin pa'i tshogs// gti mug mun pa'i thibs kyis non pa rnams// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo'i 'khor lo yis// the tshom gcod mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus kyi rgyal po grol tshes bco lnga la// dam chos rgyal po gso sbyong snyems pa'i tshe// tshangs pas zhabs la gtugs nas gsol ba btab// lha yi lha mchog khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam 'phrul dpag med thugs kyi dbus nas bton// nyi ma'i 'od kyis mun pa'i tshogs 'joms ltar// yon tan tshogs kyis gdul bya smin par mdzad// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub snying po dpal gyi 'bri gung du// gzim spyil chos khri rta 'chag 'bri gung thang*// rnam bzhir sku yi bkod pa bzhi bstan nas// bsdu ba bzhis 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rab 'byams chos dbyings rgyal ba'i zhing rnams su// de snyed sku yi bkod pa ston mdzad pa// rnam 'phrul mtha' yas thogs pa mi mnga' ba'i// kun bzang yangs pa'i bdag nyid khyod la 'dud// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par thugs rjes khyab// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam par 'phrin las rgyas// thogs pa med pa'i ye shes kun la 'jug

/btang snyoms rab spangs bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// sgrib gsum rab spangs sku gsum mngon du gyur// nam mkha'i rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag /byin brlabs rmad du byung ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'khor ba 'joms mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// rig pa'i 'byung gnas bal yul thil du ni// rin chen gser gdugs bzhengs par gyur pa'i tshe// spyan ras gzigs dbang 'jig rten mgon du bstan// bkod pa zhal ta ston mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// mkhyen pa'i ye shes mkhas pa'i skyes bu la// gyang dang nyi 'od bzhin du 'char bar mdzad// mkhas pa'i mi la mkhas pa'i rig byed bzhin// legs par ston mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// nyon mongs spangs pas nam yang sgrib pa med// lta ba rnam dag spyod pa'i yul la 'jug /ngo bo nyid sku lhun gyis grub par gnas// rtag brtan zhi ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'khor 'das shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rnams// spros med 'od gsal chen por byang chub cing*// spros pa ma lus rang bzhin nyid kyis dag /stong pa nyid sku khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ma chags pad ma can gyi zhing khams su// 'gro mgon chen po de nyid der gshegs nas// rgyal ba'i mchod rten chen po der brtsigs pa'i// rdzu 'phrul mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rab 'byams chos dbyings rgyal ba'i zhing rnams su// mtha' yas mchod rten ring srel snying po can// chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam par du ma mdzad// 'gro ba'i re ba skong mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// lha yi lus ltar rnam mdzes dag pa'i sku// 'gro bas lta bas ngoms pa med pa dang*// yan lag drug cur ldan pa'i gsung dang thugs// mtha' yas kun khyab khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i snying po byang chub sems gnyis kyi// 'phrin las nam mkha' mnyam par mtha' rgyas pas// 'khor ba'i mtha' dang mnyam par kun tu khyab// mtha' yas spyod mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'og min gnyis pa dpal gyi 'bri gung du// mtha' yas 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs tshe// shākya'i rgyal po byams pa spyan ras gzigs// rgyal ba nyid du bstan gyur phyag 'tshal lo// mtha' med sngon gyi bskal pa dpag med du// bdud btul byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas nas// 'phrin las sna tshogs rnam thar du ma bstan// zhabs la 'khor lo mchog mnga' khyod phyag 'tshal// 'khor 'das chos rnams rang gi sems su bstan// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel las kyi 'bras yin gsungs// skad cig ma ni don gyi snying po mdzad// chos kyi bdag nyid khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dge dang mi dge'i gshis ni 'gyur ba med// so sor nges par chos rnams ston par mdzad// grub mtha'i chos rnams ma lus 'dir 'dus gsungs// chos la mnga' mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa rgya gar du// skad cig nyid gshegs sman gyi rgyal po bzhes// 'gro ba'i nad sel mchog gi rdzu 'phrul mnga'// dri med spyan ldan de la phyag 'tshal lo// drung du bsdad kyang mthong ba med par ston// rgyang du gnas kyang bag la nyal rnams mkhyen// 'gro ba kun gyi khams dang mnyam par 'jug

/brjod med bsam las 'das la phyag 'tshal lo// dag dang ma dag gdul bya'i snang ba la// 'dul byed gnad kyi rten 'brel sna tshogs ston// shin tu phra ba'i chos rnams the tshom gcod// rdo rje lta bu khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs snang ba rang gi sems su bstan// 'khor 'das chos rnams sems kyi cho 'phrul zhes// rang byung chen po'i ngang du sdud par mdzad// snang ba dbang du sdud la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa rdo rje gdan// bstan pa'i dgra bo gar log 'jig byed tshe// rten 'brel mthu dang rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis bzlog /bstan pa'i mnga' bdag khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas der sku ni dge slong nyid du bstan// sdig mdzub mdzad pas dpung gi tshogs rnams bros// dpung chen de yang bred nas phyogs phyogs byer// nus pa'i mthar thug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas phyogs der ni// rmad byung cho 'phrul chen po mchog der bstan// mchod rten chen po de ni brtan par mdzad// mi g.yo ri rab 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo// lus dang sems dang snang ba'i dngos po rnams// skad cig ma ste bsam pa'i rang gzugs yin// rang sems dag na lus dang snang ba dag /chos rnams rten 'brel ston mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan phag mo gru yi nags tshal na// bzhugs tshe u rgyan mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis// spyan drangs gshegs par zhus par gyur pa'i tshe// ting 'dzin stobs kyis bzlog mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas na gnas gyur pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro lhar bcas 'jig rten rnams// ting 'dzin gnad kyis dbang du sdud mdzad pa'i// bde chen rgyal po bcom ldan phyag 'tshal lo// ting 'dzin stobs ni tha dad du ma yis// de las skyes pa'i 'khor 'das du ma rnams// srog gi snying po'i gnad nas bskul bar mdzad// 'khor 'das bdag po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dga' bzhi rol pa'i ting 'dzin stobs mchog gis// mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug gnad nas bskul bar mdzad// gsang sngags theg pa'i chos rnams 'dir 'dus gsungs// sngags mchog sngags bdag de la phyag 'tshal lo// byang gi phyogs su sde gnyis ma mthun nas// spyan drangs byon par zhus pa'i dus kyi tshe// zhal gyis bzhes nas mkha' la chu gdugs byon// rtsod pa zhi mdzad de la phyag 'tshal lo// chags sdang dag gis phan tshun rtsod pa rnams// byams pa'i stobs kyis rab tu zhi bar mdzad// mthun pa'i rgyal po nad la sman bzhin te// 'gro ba kun la snyoms mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// rten 'brel phyin ci log pa'i rgyu 'bras kyis// rtsod dang 'khrug pa 'gro ba rnams la 'byung*// yang dag rten 'brel stobs kyis 'joms mdzad pa// mtha' brgyad skyon med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// spros maid spros bral spros pa kun las 'das// nam mkha'i rang bzhin gdod nas rnam par dag

/ma skyes skye ba med de blo las 'das// rnam dag nam mkha'i ngo bo khyod phyag 'tshal// byang phyogs nas byon se ri rong gshegs tshe// spyan 'dren mang pos mtha' bskor sgug pa na// chas bsgyur rlung gi dkyil 'khor nyid du mdzad// thogs med gzung du med la phyag 'tshal lo// nam mkha' lta bur sus kyang mthong ba med// rlung dmar bzhin du chags pa med par rgyu// yid kyi yul las 'das pas de rnams rengs// bltar med mthong du med la phyag 'tshal lo// chos rnams thams cad nam mkha'i ngo bor bstan// sna tshogs rtog pa rang rig ngang du dag /de la gang gis mthong dang gzung bar nus// nam mkha'i sku mnga' de la phyag 'tshal lo// sa yi phyogs der 'gro rnams ngo mtshar skyes// 'jig rten khams su rgyal ba'i bstan pa bzhag /ngo mtshar rmad byung cho 'phrul mchog der bstan// bde skyid 'byung gnas de la phyag 'tshal lo// sku des 'dul ba'i gdul bya ma lus rnams// dpag med cho 'phrul rnam pa du mas btul// bud shing zad nas me yang zad pa bzhin// rtag pa'i dbyings su gshegs mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// gtsang bdag bde dang rtag pa'i sku thob cing*// mtha' yas dpag med cho 'phrul mchog der bstan// mkha' la dung dang me tog ring bsrel char// lha rnams kyis phab khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// steng gi mkha' la 'ja' yi bla re bres// nyi ma gnyis shar sa yang rnam par g.yos// sku yi rnam 'phrul dpag med kun tu bstan// rtag pa'i sku thob mgon po khyod phyag 'tshal// phyogs bcu'i zhing du rgyal ba'i sras rnams dang*// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma rnams// mchod sprin rgya mtshos kun nas mchod par byed// rtag brtan mi 'gyur sku brnyes khyod phyag 'tshal// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// rmad du byung ba'i rnam thar bco brgyad 'di// 'gro ba gang gis mthong dang thos pa rnams// thams cad mkhyen pa de dang dbyer med shog

rgya mtsho chen po las chu'i thigs pa gcig skra'i rtse mos blangs pa dang 'dra bar brjod pa yi/ rnam par thar pa bco brgyad pa zhes bya ba shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas sbyar ba rdzogs so/// / dad dang thos dang bsags pa yis// bla ma rin chen mnyes par byas// phag mo gru yi nags khrod du// sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs gyur pa'i// a khu ston pa mang kar bas// ldom bu bdag la zhus pa yi// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// 'gro rnams byang chub thob par shog /'phags pa'i dbyangs kyis bsnyad pa/ tshigs su bcad pa bdun cu rtsa gsum pa zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// / 02) ༄// chos rje 'jig rten gsum mgon la bstod pa dus gsum mkha' mnyam ma// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum kun dang nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sku// 'gro bas blta bas mi ngoms tshangs dbyangs ltar// lha lus yid 'ong sdug gu zil du brlag /'gyur med rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zab cing yangs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i gsung*// yan lag drug cur ldan pa'i snyan gsung ba// lha dang mi dang gnod sbyin klu rnams kyi// sgra rnams kun tu chos ston khyod phyag 'tshal// thugs ni spros bral nam mkha' lta bu la// dus gsum 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// dbyer med 'od gsal chen por byang chub pa// lta ba'i mun bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyis// 'khor ba ji srid 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad cing*// nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// yon tan mtha' yas 'jig rten mgon po byon// sku tshad rin po che byon dus su bstod pa'o/// / 03) ༄// bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag med la bstod pa// oṃ swasti// rnam dag smon lam stobs las legs grub sku// yon tan mtha' yas bsod nams mtshan gyis brgyan// bde ldan zhing du mngon par byang chub pa// tshe dang ye shes dpag med phyag 'tshal lo// srid zhi skyon bral rnam dag phun tshogs lnga// khyad 'phags zhing mchog kun gyis bstod pa'i gnas// dri med rgyal ba'i 'od la sgrib mi mnga'// bde gshegs snang ba mtha' yas phyag 'tshal lo// nub phyogs rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor bla med zhing*// gtsang yangs mdzes dang dri zhim bde ba dang*// yid 'ong rin chen sna tshogs ljon pas brgyan// 'dren pa 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo// bde ldan zhing gi rgyan dang yon tan dang*// bkod pa sku tshe'i 'od ni dpag med de// rgyal de chos rje nyid las gzhan ma mchis// drang srong 'od dpag med zhabs spyi bos 'dud// rin chen sna tshogs las grub bde gshegs sku// phyi nang rten dang mchod pa'i bye brag tshogs// 'dis mtshon bsod nams phung pos bde ldan du// pad ma las skyes dge slong gyur nas kyang*// chos rje 'od dpag med pa mthong 'gyur zhing*// myur du byang chub lung bstan thob par shog// /

04) ༄// ston pa'i rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun byams mgon la bstod pa// oṃswasti/ rgyal tshab dbang thob nyon mongs skyon mi mnga'// phyogs bcu'i zhing du rnam thar dpag med kyis// 'gro ba ma lus bla med la 'god pa'i// byams chen rgyal ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// brtse ba'i bdag nyid dus gsum 'gro kun skyob// sems can kun la thugs rje mchog mnga' ba// dug gsum sgrib sel sman pa'i mchog gyur pa// dga' ldan dbang po de la skyabs su mchi// 'jig rten gsum mgon ma pham chos kyi rje// mtshan gyi 'khor los lhar bcas 'jig rten kun// gang gis mi ldog sa la 'god mdzad pa// rnam yangs kun bzang rnam thar khyod phyag 'tshal// gang gis skye 'chi na rga kun bcom zhing*// the tshom drwa ba mtha' gnyis las 'das pa// srid gsum 'brog dgon mun nag thibs po las// snang byed sgron me chen po khyod phyag 'tshal// bskal pa stong du khyod mthong thos dka' ba// mi pham thub dbang yon tan rgya mtsho'i gnas// lus can kun gyi nyon mongs ma lus 'joms// mtha' yas spyod mnga' khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod spyod dpag med rgyal sras nor bzang la// snang mdzad rgyan gyi snying po khang bzang gi// g.ya' bral me long dkyil 'khor rnam dag ltar// ma lus rnam thar kun bstan khyod phyag 'tshal// 'gro kun skyabs gyur thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// 'jig rten gsum mgon dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchog /'gro ba ma lus skyob pa'i skyabs gcig pu// sgrib pa'i bud shing sreg mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// lha yi bla ma bcom ldan thugs rje can// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'phrin las kyis// dmus long lta bu'i mig bral 'gro ba la// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med rtag pa yi// tshul 'di ston mdzad bcom ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// nam mkha' lta bur rab yangs yon tan gter// rgyal ba byams pa zhes byar rab grags pa// byang chub rnam gsum 'byung khungs rin po che// lha mi'i ston pa de la skyabs su mch-i// brten med gnas med chos rnams kun la ni// spros med rnam thar sgo gsum la gnas pa// stong dang mi stong spros pa kun las 'das// sku gsum dbyer med bcom ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// de ltar yon tan mtha' yas byams mgon la// bdag gis deng bstod bsod nams gang yin des// 'gro ba'i nyes tshogs phung po rnams bcom nas// sems can kun gyis byang chub thob par shog

/bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams pa la shākya'i dge slong grags pa 'byung gnas kyis bstod pa/ sho lo ka bcu gcig pa rdzogs so// // 05) ༄// rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid rje btsun 'jam dbyangs la bstod pa// oṃ swasti// nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus kyi// skyabs gcig brtse chen rgyal po chos kyi rje// 'khor 'das yon tan ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// dus gsum bdag nyid skyobs pa 'jam dbyangs la// rab tu bdag gi snying ni rnam g.yos te// de ring nas bzung khyod la skyabs su mchi// skyobs pa bdag cag 'gro ba ma lus rnams// srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las bsgral nas// yon tan rgyal ba'i bang mdzod thob mdzad gsol// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med rtsa ba can// tshad med bzhi yi yal ga sdong pos brgyan// byang chub phyogs kyi chos rnams lo 'dab rgyas// srid gsum nyon mongs rnam dag 'bras bu can// yon tan ljon shing dug gsum tshad pa las// bsdu dngos bzhi yi bsil ba'i grib ma can// 'khor ba'i dgon par dub pa'i 'gro ba la// rab tu dbugs 'byin mdzad pa'i mgon po khyod// dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhing rnams ma lus par// mtshan gyi 'khor los byin gyis rlobs mdzad pas// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid can la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba'i sras mchog sa bcu'i mgon rnams kyis// skyob pa khyod kyi zhabs pad la btud cing*// phyogs bcu'i zhing du rgyal ba rnams kyi ni// gtam gyi skyes bu khyod la gus phyag 'tshal// lha dang mi dang lha min du mas ni// rtag tu bstod cing gus pas phu dud byed// tshangs dbang rgyal po'i cod pan ge sar gyi// myu gus rtag tu zhabs la btud gyur pa// khyod la bdag cag 'gro ba ma lus rnams// gus pa'i yid kyis dus rnams kun tu ni// drang srong chen po khyod la bdag cag rnams// dus rnam kun tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// dus gsum rgyal ba du ma'i bla ma ste// nam mkha' mnyam par khyab pa'i bdag nyid sku// skyob pa khyod dang mnyam med lta ci smos// thub dbang gzhon nu'i cha lugs can la 'dud// sku gsum yon tan 'phrin las rgyun mi chad// thugs rje'i bdag nyid mgon po 'jam dbyangs la// bdag gis de bstod bsod nams gang yin des// 'gro rnams bla med byang chub myur thob shog// /

06) ༄// rje btsun gsang bdag gi bstod pa grags dbang phyug gis zhus pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// tshad med thugs rje chen po las// byung ba'i dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// mnyam med bla ma khyod phyag 'tshal// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa rnam gsum spangs nas kyang*// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas pa'i// dpal ldan phyag na rdo rje la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// bdag gyur dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// 'khor 'das kun gyi skyabs gcig po// gsang ba'i bdag la skyabs su mchi// bdud dang bgegs dang bar chad rnams// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// rdul du gtong bar mdzad pa yi// bgegs 'joms khyed la skyabs su mchi// mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// bgegs rnams thams cad brgyal bar 'gyur// ri rab rdul du brlag par mdzad// sdug bsngal 'joms mdzad skyabs su mchi// hūm̐ rdo rje 'dzin pa chos kyi rje// rkan brdabs 'jig rten skrag par mdzad// gzigs pas rgya mtsho skem mdzad pa'i// drag po'i dbang phyug khyod phyag 'tshal/ hūm̐ zhi rgyas dbang drag rnam bzhi yis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs mdzad pa'i// thugs rje'i bdag nyid skyabs su mchi// hūm̐/ byams dang snying rje byang sems kyi// zhi ba'i las kyis 'dul bar mdzad// 'khrug dang khro dang rngam pa yi// drag pos 'dul mdzad skyabs su mchi/ hūm̐/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar dang*// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// mdzod 'dzin rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod// thugs rje can la skyabs su mchi// hūm̐/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten rnams// tshad med snying rjes dbang du sdud// srog gi snying po 'chang bar mdzad// thabs mkhas thugs rje can phyag 'tshal// hūm̐/ nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'jig rten du// khro dang rngam dang bzhad pa dang*// thugs rje ngo mtshar rmad byung sogs// nyams dgus 'dul mdzad skyabs su mchi// hūm̐/

a la la zhes bzhed pa dang*// hūm̐/ hūm̐ dza dza rab 'bar bas// rnal 'byor gnod pa rdul du rlog /rab 'jigs 'bar la skyabs su mchi// hūm̐/ bdag cag gsol ba 'debs pa yi// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal rnams// ma lus mtha' dag zhi mdzad gsol// skyob mdzad khyod la skyabs su mchi// hūm̐/ 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol// 'jigs med dpa' ba'i gdeng thob ste// srid gsum bdag po khyod la ni// phyag 'tshal gus pas skyabs su mchi// skyobs shig skyobs shig bskyab tu gsol// phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong ni// grags pa'i dbang phyug nye gnas kyis// ldom bu bdag la zhus pa yi// dri med dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// rdo rje 'dzin pa thob par shog// / 07) ༄// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa la bstod pa nor bu rin po che'i phreng ba// oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i ngo bo chos kyi rje// lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i 'phrin las kyis// brtse ba chen pos 'gro rnams 'dren mdzad pa// thub mchog 'phags pa de la gus phyag 'tshal// yang dag ye shes dam pa chos kyi sku// gzung 'dzin 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal ma lus rnams// ngo bo dbyer med nam mkha' lta bur bstan// 'khaur 'das mnyam nyid chos sku khyod phyag 'tshal// 'jug sems sdom pa'i bdag nyid rgyu de las// 'bras bu longs sku nam mkha' dang mnyam brnyes// rnam dag sa bcu'i mgon po thams cad kyis// mthong bas sgro 'dogs gcod mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// smon sems rin chen de bskyed 'bras bu las// thub pa'i sprul sku mtha' med nam mkha' mnyam// gang la gang 'dul de la de ston pa// mtha' med 'gro ba'i don mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// chos kyi sku las gzhan pa med pa'i phyir// gzugs sku gnyis kyis 'khor ba ma stongs par// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod rnams kyis// 'gro ba 'dul mdzad 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// gti mug las byung nyon mongs dug gsum gyis// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtshor 'khyams pa rnams// rten 'brel zab mos ma rig mun sel ba'i// skyob pa nyi ma 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// lhar bcas 'jig rten dmus long 'dra ba la// ye shes chen po'i mig sman thur ma yis// dus gsum 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// mtha' brgyad rten 'brel ston mdzad de la 'dud// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel rkyen las skye bar bstan// phan bsgrub gnod pa spong bar ston mdzad pa// nyi ma lta bur ma rig mun sel ba'i// skyabs kyi dam pa 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// thugs nyid spros bral nam mkha' lta bu la// dus gsum mkhyen pa me long g.ya' bral bzhin// chos dang chos min rnam par 'byed la mkhas// rmongs bral ston pa gnyis pa khyod phyag 'tshal// da nas 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur tshe// thub dbang khyod la bdag cag sems can rnams// gus pa'i yid kyis dus rnam kun tu ni// phyag 'tshal gus pas skyabs su nye bar mchi// rgyal bas mdo rgyud du mar lung bstan cing*// nga yi mtshan can dge slong der 'byung ste// chos kyi rnga chen des ni brdung 'gyur zhes// ston pa gnyis pa 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// ma 'ongs bstan pa'i gnyer chen der gtad pa// tshig dang don dang sngags dang mtshan nyid rnams// ston pas dgongs ltar thugs su legs chud pa// mi yi seng ge 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa'i theg pa yi// dgongs pa ma lus legs par 'grel mdzad pas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa 'jig rten 'jog mdzad pa// thub pas lung bstan 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// phyi nang rgol ba'i tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas// ston pa'i bstan pa rtsod pa med par mdzad// phyi nang kun gyis bstod cing bkur ba'i gnas// mi 'jigs dpa' bo 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// thub pa'i rjes skyes sras mchog dam pa ni// chos dang chos min 'byed la rab tu mkhas// bdag dang bdag med spros pa zhi bar mdzad// lhun po ltar mdzes 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo stong nyid bstan// byas pa'i las dang de yi rgyu 'bras rnams// bslu med nam mkha' lta bur 'byung bar bstan// chos rnams rten 'brel ston mdzad de la 'dud// mtha' brgyad rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung rnams// ngo bo zung 'jug sgyu ma lta bur bstan// sems dang sems byung 'khor ba 'byung ba'i gzhi// sems 'gag skur ston de la phyag 'tshal 'dud// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi sha mdangs legs par phye// chos la mnga' brnyes the tshom gcod mdzad pa// srid pa gsum du 'byung bar dkon pa'i dpal// 'jam dbyangs gnyis pa 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// stong dang mi stong bde dang sdug bsngal rnams// thob pa'i rjes la 'od gsal chen por bstan// 'khor 'das bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// srid gsum sgron me 'phags pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// sbyin pa la sogs pha rol phyin pa drug

/legs spyad dge ba'i tshogs rnams ma lus pa// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bor bstan// mtha' brgyad spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa rgyud chen po lang kar gshegs pa'i mdo// sprin chen stong phrag bcu gnyis mdo dang ni// rnga bo che dang mgon po mngon 'byung rgyud// du mar lung bstan rgyal ba khyod phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho stongs par ma 'gyur tshe// thugs rje 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa yis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// dus gsum sangs rgyas khyod la skyabs mchi'o// dri med chos sku 'phags pa klu sgrub la// shākya'i dge slong ldom bu gdan sa bas// gus shing dad pas rab bstod bsod nams 'dis// 'gro rnams 'jig rten nyi ma sangs rgyas shog//

sho lo ka nyi shu rtsa gsum pa rdzogs so// // 08) ༄// mnyam med bla ma rin po cher gsol ba 'debs pa thugs rje mchog mnga' ma// oṃ swasti/ thugs rje mchog mnga' skyob pa bcom ldan 'das// nyes pa'i tshogs 'joms dge ba'i lo tog skyed// srid pa'i mtsho skems 'dod pa'i ri bo ni// ye shes rdo rje brtan pas 'jig mdzad pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la// rab tu 'phongs shing zhum pa'i blo can bdag /dus 'di nas bzung byang chub snying po'i bar// thal sbyar gus pa'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal skyobs// sdig pa'i blo can chos las gzhan pa'i yid// phyin ci log gi blo gros skad cig kyang*// bdag rgyud rnam dag nam mkha' lta bu la// sdig sems glo bur sprin tshogs thibs po ni// nyid kyi thugs rje'i rlung gis gtor mdzad gsol// nag po'i rtsa lag chags sogs dug gsum 'di// thog med dus nas goms pas spong dka' ste// mdza' ltar byas nas phan bde'i rtsa ba ni// ye shes sdong bu phyogs kyi ge sar can// thar pa'i lo 'dab byang chub sdong po ni// rtsa ba gcod byed srid pa'i khol po las// thugs rje mchog mnga' bla mas bskyab tu gsol// rang bzhin ngan pa bcos su med pa de// rgyal po'i khyi gzhug lta bur ma mdzad par// gnas skabs mthar thug bde legs thams cad kyi// lam de thugs kyis legs par dgongs par zhu/// / 09) ༄// byang chub snying po dpal ldan phag mo gru'i gnas kyi bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ rab 'byams chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthas gtugs par// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyis// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs 'bar ba zhi mdzad pa// skyabs mchog brtse chen bcom ldan rgyal po byon// snyan dang grags dang yon tan phreng bas ni// srid pa gsum na thub dbang rgyal po ltar// gti mug rab rib drwa ba 'joms mdzad pa'i// 'gro ba'i mig gcig dpal ldan bla ma byon// lhar bcas 'jig rten skyabs gcig thugs rje can// skyob pa mnyam med 'gro mgon rin po che// spangs rtogs mthar phyin dri med chos kyi sku// 'gro rnams dbugs 'byin mdzad pa'i mgon po byon// rin chen bdag po klu dbang rgyal po ltar// stobs bcu'i bdag nyid mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// rgyal ba sras bcas 'byung gnas rin po che// srid pa gsum du rnyed par dka' ba byon// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med brtse ba can// 'phrin las 'khor ba ji srid rgyun mi chad// 'gro lnga'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skems mdzad pa// yon tan rgya mtsho 'jig rten mgon po byon// snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'brug sgra seng ge ltar// yan lag drug cur ldan pa'i gsung dbyangs kyis// lha yi skad dang klu dang gnod sbyin skad// so sor tshim byed skyob mdzad bla ma byon// 'dzam bu gling gi gnas mchog 'gran med cing*// 'khor 'das bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// byang chub snying po dpal gyi phag mo grur// khams gsum mgon po chos rje bla ma byon// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ri bo mchog

/dpal las byung ba'i nags khrod me tog mdzes// bya dang ri dwags mdzes pa'i tshogs kyis gang*// g.ya' dang lu ma ne'u gsing bkod pa 'dra// sdug pa'i ljon shing baiḍūrya 'dra ba yis// bsil ba'i grib 'dzin nyon mongs gdung ba sel// kun tu kha ba dung ltar dkar ba yi// rdo rje'i brag ri mchod rten 'dra ba rnams// mtha' rnams legs par bskor zhing 'bar ba 'dra// mngon dga'i zhing dang bde ba can gyis kyang*// gang zhig nam yang 'gran par mi nus pa'i// dpal ldan phag mo gru yi nags tshal du// 'khor ba ji srid stongs par ma gyur tshe// mnyam med 'jig rten mgon po bzhugs par zhu// dbang gi rgyal po nor bu rin chen ni// rgya mtsho chen por brang 'gro'i rgyal po mdzes// 'gro ba'i yid la re ba skong bar byed// gangs can mtsho ni de yi gnas yin ltar// stong gsum snying po dpal gyi phag mo gru// 'og min gnyis pa kun bzang nags tshal 'dir// sa yi lha mo rnams dang klu chen dang*// dri za gnod sbyin bye ba mang pos bsten// pad ma 'dra ba'i sa gzhi nyams dga' ba// 'khor la sngo ba nam mkha'i bla re can// mkha' la spyod pa'i lha dang dri za rnams// dri mchog rin chen spos kyi sprin sdud cing*// yan lag brgyad ldan bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs// 'brug sgra dal gyis sgrog cing ngoms par byed// blta na sdug pa'i dga' tshal zil gyis gnon// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i gnas 'di mdzes/// / 10) ༄// 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi sgrub gnas byin can dbye chung sgom phug la bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ lhun gyis grub cing spros dang bral// dag cing rnam dag brjod las 'das// dri med chos sku rin chen gyis// lhar bcas 'jig rten zil gyis mnan// byang chub snying po rdo rje gdan// lhun grub 'od gsal chen po'i phug /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas khyod phyag 'tshal// dpal ldan sgom phug rin po che// mthong bas ting 'dzin skyed par byed// bltas pas rgyu 'bras rten 'brel rnams// ma lus mngon du gyur mdzad pa// 'dzam gling sgron me rin po che// 'jigs tshogs mun sel snang ba'i mchog

/yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi// dpal ldan sgom phug khyod phyag 'tshal// brag ni mi g.yo rdo rje bzhin// spros med phyag rgya chen po 'dra// brag mtha' bra gus bskor ba ni// gus pa'i slob mas btud pa 'dra// yan lag brgyad ldan dag pa'i chus// 'khor ba'i tshad pa sel ba'i sman// kun rdzob byang sems rin po ches// 'gro ba smin par byed pa bzhin// klu rgyal byang chub sems dpas phul// 'thung pas sgrib gsum rtsad nas 'dag /byang chub ljon shing rtsa ba brtan// yal ga lo mas kun tu khyab// 'khor ba'i tshad pa sel ba'i sman// tshur shog bsil grib byed pa 'dra// maṅga dha dang dpal gyi ri// ti se'i gangs dang tsa ri tra// kun gyi 'gran zla bral ba'i gnas// yon tan 'byung gnas khyod phyag 'tshal// g.ya' dang lu ma ne'u gsing rnams// mkhas pa'i yid kyis bkod pa 'dra// stegs dang stegs pur bcas pa rnams// yid la bcangs pas 'bral mi phod// bsdad nas bltas pas ngoms pa med// lhun po'i rgyal po zil gyis gnon// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// bde ba'i 'byung gnas khyod phyag 'tshal// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// rtag tu bsten nas mchod pas mchod// gang gis gnas der bzhugs pa na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma lus pa// rang byung phyag rgya chen por rtogs// 'khor ba 'joms mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs// // 11) ༄// gdan sa rin po che dpal gyi phag mo gru'i slob dpon la bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ skye med chos sku bde gshegs rin chen gru// byang chub sems gnyis rlung gis mthun bskyod kyis// lus can srid zhi'i mtsho las sgrol ba yi// kha lo sgyur ba gru mchog nang du mdzes// //oṃ swasti/ 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi// ngo bor gyur pa chos kyi rje// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// mthong thos dran pa tsam gyis kyang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// snang zhing srid pa'i chos rnams kun// ma skyes mi skye mi gnas pa'i// 'od gsal chen por rtogs mdzad pa'i// byin rlabs rmad du byung ba des// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// stong par mdzad pa'i mgon po khyed// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyis// bstan pa'i dam chos rin po che// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel gyis// sangs rgyas sku gsum ye shes lnga// sngon du byas nas 'gro ba rnams// byang chub mchog la 'god mdzad pa'i// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'dis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// nam zhig stongs par ma gyur tshe// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad pa'i// rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i pha phogs 'di// bu skyes mchog mi yi seng ge yis// bzung nas 'gro ba ma lus pa// byang chub mchog la 'god pa yi// brtson 'grus chen po brtsams nas ni// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun rnams// lnga ldan dam chos rin chen dang*// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// snga ma bzhin du skyong ba dang*/

gdul bya mchog rnams smin par mdzod// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// dri med rnam thar mchog 'di dang*// bral bar ma mdzad bdag gi bu// yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten du dwags phrug mdo ga ma'i dbu zhwa gsol 'phro gcig dang ci si si du ra'i mdog can gyi sku rgyam gsol 'phro gcig dang*/ gsol zhal dkar yol 'brug rgyab legs pa gcig dang*/ gsol sder kha 'phyangs bzo gnas khyad par du 'phags pa gcig dang*/ dngul gyi gsol thur shin tu legs pa gcig dang*/ gsol ja zi pol sigs gcig dang*/ chibs khyung mdongs dang*/ gsol rgum bre lnga dang de rnams 'bul zhing mchis/ de tsho longs spyad par zhu/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig// / 12) ༄// gdan sa rin po che'i mkhan chen gu ra ba la bstod pa// oṃ swasti// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha'i rang bzhin sku// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med rdo rje'i thugs// brjod med gsung gis zhing rnams kun tu khyab// lhar bcas skyabs gcig rin po che dpal 'dud// rgyal tshab dbang thob mi pham mgon po ltar// snang bar mdzad pa mun sel sgron me'i mchog /'khor ba'i gnas su utpal pad mo bzhin// skyon gyis ma gos 'gro rnams smin par mdzad// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med ngo bo yis// 'phrin las 'khor ba ji srid smon lam can// 'od gsal rgya mtsho lhan skyes chos sku de// 'khrul med ye shes spyan gyis gzigs gyur pas// ma nor thugs su chud pa'i shes rab can// 'khor ba'i sdong po dug gi rtsa ba brtan// srid pa'i yal ga zhe sdang tsher ma ni// gti mug lo mas kun tu khebs pa ste// ye shes sta res rtsad nas gcod mdzad pa// 'jam dbyangs dpa' bos 'jig rten khams rnams su// dpag med 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa ltar// dpa' bo khyod ni 'gro ba'i skyabs gcig ste// stobs bcu'i rtsa ba tshul khrims spos ngad kyis// 'chal pa'i tshul khrims log rtog 'joms mdzad pa// zhing rnams kun tu 'gro ba 'dul mdzad pa'i// kun bzang rnam thar mchog ni rgyun mi chad// rab 'byams chos dbyings nam mkha'i mthar thug par// chos kyi rje dang 'phrin las mnyam 'jug mdzad// mkhas pa'i skyes bu rtsod med gus pas phul// phyi rol rgol ba'i tshogs rnams 'joms par mdzad// 'jig rten mgon po'i byin brlabs las byung ba// lhar bcas 'jig rten kun na khyod 'dra dkon// khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho mtha' med la// skra rtse'i thigs pa tsam zhig 'dir brjod lags// ma lus mtha' dag brjod par ga la nus// bsod nams 'di yis byang chub thob par shog

/dpal sa chen po'i steng du che ba'i yon tan du mas 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i bdag nyid chen po 'bri gung se ba byang chub kyi gling gong du 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhabs kyi pad mo'i rgyan du gyur cing*/ 'phrin las kyi sgo mtha' yas pa bzung nas thugs kyi dgongs pa ma lus pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor sprin dang bral ba'i nam mkha'i dbus su nye bar mdzes pa ltar rdzogs par mdzad pa'i lha chen po sa chen po ltar yon tan gyis yangs pa'i bdag nyid chen po mkhan po rin po che zhes grags pa de la/ dang po'i dus nas chags pa dang bral ba'i lam gyi 'brel pa rnams kyi thog mar gyur pa'i shākya'i dge slong grags pa'i 'byung gnas kyis rdul tsam gyi ngos nas bstod pa/ tshigs su bcad pa dgu pa'o// rdzogs so// // 13) ༄// 'jig rten gsum mgon gyi thugs sras dpal ldan nged phu pa la bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ sgrib gsum rab spangs sku gsum mngon gyur pa// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma rin chen dang*// des gsung dam chos chags bral thub pa'i bka'// gsung bzhin nyams len tshogs mchog dge 'dun bcas// gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'jig rten gsum mgon rin chen gyi// sras gyur bdag nyid chen po mchog /thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// dri med bslab gsum rgyal mtshan gyis// 'gro ba smin mdzad chos rje yi// thugs dgongs stong dang rten cing 'brel// zab mo gnad kyi man ngag gis// skal ldan rgya mtsho lta bu'i tshogs// gser snod bdud rtsis 'gengs mdzad pa// khyod mthong gang yin don dang bcas// bdag kyang ring nas khyod nyid la// gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo// sa steng 'gran bral khyod nyid ni// khron rnying chu 'dra tshig gi tshogs// dus gsum rgyal bas rnam smad cing*// rab tu gdos pa wu ba yi// phung po dang 'drar rnam gzigs nas// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// dam chos rmad byung bdud rtsi'i chus// 'khor ba'i tshad pas nyen gyur cing*// skom zhing dub par gyur rnams la// khyod kyis tshim mdzad bdag gis khums// ston pa nyid dang mtshungs gyur pa// khyod la yid rang bdag 'dud do// sa brgyad 'das pa rgyal ba'i sras// ma 'dres yongs su rdzogs pa'i tshul// so so yang dag rig pa yis// stobs dang mi 'jigs la sogs pa// thub pa'i yon tan ma lus rgyu// rin po che yi dgongs pa'i gter// thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// bla med tshul khrims rin chen gyi// dpag med yon tan dgongs gyur nas// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa yi// dam pa khyod kyis thub pa yi// bstan pa rin chen rgyas par mdzad// bstan pa'i bdag po thams cad mnyes// ji ltar nam mkha' dwangs ba la// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar ba yis// mun pa'i tshogs bcom ji bzhin du// gzung 'dzin gnyis med nam mkha'i khams// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' las// skyabs gsum tshul khrims rin chen dang*// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// skal ldan byang chub lam la 'god// 'di dang bar do skye gzhan du// sangs rgyas nyid 'gyur ngo mtshar che// bla med rdo rje theg pa yi// rgyud dang 'grel pa man ngag gis// blo yi mun pa rab bsal te// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// 'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud 'thungs pas// pha rol phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi// sna gcig bsrung ba'i tshul khrims kyang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i rten 'brel gyi// rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad rnams kyis// nor bu rin chen ji lta bar// tshe 'dir byang chub mchog la 'god// 'khor gsum yongs su dag gyur pa// gsang sngags dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang*// pha la bu skyes grogs mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal rjes yi rang*// thub mgon shākya'i rgyal po yi// bslab gsum nor bu rin po che// 'dod yon chang gis rab myos shing*// rtags tsam 'dzin pa'i gti mug can// log shes nying 'phrul gyur pa la// zab mo sngags su rlom pa yi// mi gtsang 'dam du tshud pa rnams// dri med rnam dag tshul khrims chus// 'khrud par byed pa'i skyes chen gyis// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa la// bdag kyang dga' zhing yid rang bas// shin tu 'os pa chos rje yi// snam sbyar rin chen yun ring tu// gsol gyur bdag la gnang ba 'di// ji ltar thub pa'i dbang po la// 'od srungs chen pos phul ba yi// snam sbyar 'tshams par gyur pa ltar// de bzhin drang srong khyod la ni// 'phags pa'i rgyal mtshan mchog 'di 'os// ji ltar gangs chen klu dag gi// spyi bor nor bu rin chen mdzes// de bzhin 'jig rten mgon po'i sras// tshul khrims gter gyur khyod nyid la// rin chen gos 'di rnam par mdzes// ji ltar nyi ma 'od zer ni// stong gis bskor na mdzes gyur ltar/

de bzhin khrims ldan mchog khyod la// thub pas bsngags pa'i gos 'di mdzes// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dpal ldan rin po che/ 'bri gung se ba byang chub kyi gling na bzhugs pa de'i zhabs kyi rdul la cung zad reg pa/ shākya'i sras kyi dge slong sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyi brtul zhugs 'dzin cing*/ zhabs kyi drung du nye bar gnas pa grags pa'i 'byung gnas kyis dga' ba'i rtags na bza' rin po che phul ba'i yi ge'o// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por red gyur cig /chos gos 'di rje rin po ches lo drug tsam du gsol// do cig chos gos gsar ba gcig bgyis nas 'di ngan bu la gnang ba lags pas khyed kyis rje rin po che'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad pa la bdag kyang shin tu glo ba dga' bas khyed la 'bul ba lags// //

14) ༄// sems dpa' che la bstod pa thams cad sgrol// oṃ swasti/ bhaṅga la yi dgon pa na// sbyin pa dpa' ba'i thams cad sgrol// spyod pa rlabs chen spyod pa yi// sems dpa' che la phyag 'tshal lo// // 15) ༄// chos kyi rje spyan snga rin po ches chos rje sa skya paṇa chen la phul ba'i chab shog/ oṃ swasti/ skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// thos bsam sgom las byung ba yi// shes rab mchog gis rnam par rgyal// lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug mchog /sngags dang mtshan nyid kun gyi bdag /ma lus kun gyi dbang phyug mchog /rdo rje 'chang dang dbyer med pa'i// grub pa thob pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bdag cag gsol ba 'debs pa'i gnas// rje sa skya ba yi gdung las 'khrungs// sa steng 'dzam bu gling gi rgyan// sgra bsgyur lo tsār yongs su grags// khyed la zhu yig 'bul ba'i don// spyir thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che nyams dmas pa'i dus la bab pa'am/ skye dgu thams cad kyang chos dang mi mthun par spyod pa shas che ba'i dbang gis/ mtha'i gdug pa can hor gyi rgyal po'i stobs chen po 'di rgyas/ 'dzam bu gling phal che ba yang kho'i dbang du thal/ de la dam pa'i chos kyi byin rlabs dang*/ kho la bstun pa ma gtogs pa thabs gzhan med par mthong*/ bdag nyid chen po khyed kyi snyan pa'i ba dan gyis phyogs kun tu khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ hor gyi rgyal pos thos nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen chus pa dang*/ bla ma kham ral gyi gser yig pa dang*/ dngul yig pa gsum btang nas/ khyed la 'byon par zhu bya ba'i yi ge de/ ngan bu dang sgom pa dang*/ nged yab sras kyis nye gnas btang nas phyag tu things pa de lags/ 'dir yang khong nye gnas pa dang*/ bang chen pa mar la brdzangs pa dang*/ bka' yig bskur ba de yang nged yab sras dang*/

gser yig pa kun gyi phyag tu legs par thon/ nged kyis kyang legs par go// de la gser yig pa rnams kyis/ rin po che lo tsā ba mar la mi 'byon na zhal kyin gang btang yang nged la rgyal po'i lung med pas spyan 'dren mi phod cing mi 'dren par bya bar gda'/ khyed kyi spyan snga nas/ gshegs bzhud kyang sku nas su byon pa dang*/ ltas dang rten 'brel dang*/ thag ring por bzhugs pa gang gi ngos nas mad par 'dug byab ta yang shin tu dka' bar gda' bas/ 'di'i mdzad lugs ji ltar dgongs/ gser yig pa dang sna mi 'bye ba de lta bu zhig byung na shin tu dga' bar 'dug lar khyed kyi zhabs rtog tu ci 'gro ba rnams ni sngar yang bsgrubs pa lags// da rung yang bsgrub par zhu ba lags/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*/ byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 16) ༄// chos rje sa skya paṇa chen rin po cher gser 'bum gyi things yig/ oṃ swasti/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med jo bo dkon mchog gsum// dus gsum 'phags pa thams cad dang*// brtul zhugs grub pa ma lus la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// bya ba rlabs chen mdzad gyur cing*// sngags dang mtshan nyid kun gyi gter// lung dang rigs pa'i dbang phyug ste// bka' dang bstan bcos ma lus pa// gzhung dang gdams ngag thams cad la// dri med shes rab spyan mchog gis// legs par gzigs shing chos rnams la// rmongs med blo gros rgya mtsho ltar// bla ma'i bla ma bla na med// rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba yi// bla ma dam pa'i gdung las 'khrungs// deng sang dus na sa steng 'dir// rtsod pa kun dang rnam par bral/ byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum dang*// dri med tshul khrims rin chen gyis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir// sdug bsngal nyams thag 'gro ba rnams// thugs rje'i lcags kyus bzung nas kyang*// byang chub mchog la 'god par mdzad// sa steng 'dzam gling rtsod dang bral// sgra sgyur lo tsā rin chen la// gus pa'i yid kyis rab tu 'dud// phyogs nas 'grul pa la smras pa/

rin po che lo tsā ba sku khams bzang zhing*/ 'phrin las rlabs po che mdzad pa la bar chad ma mchis par 'khums/ de bdag cag la sogs pa 'gro ba thams cad la bka' drin che zhing thugs la btags/ 'gro ba mang po bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ bdag nyid chen po khyed rang nyid kyi sku'i rim 'gro la/ yul dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen thos bsam sgom gsum dbang phyug du ma rnams spyan drangs nas/ chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor ba dang*/ 'du 'gyed ngo mtshar can du ma mdzad pa ngo mtshar shin tu che zhing rjes su yi rang*/ de'i gral dpon du bsngos pa'i sku skal 'bri gung gi gling rin po che 'dir/ 'das ma 'ongs dus gsum ma byon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad skyed par byed pa'i yum chen mo/ byang chub sems dpa' dang 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thams cad skyed par byed pa'i yum chen 'byung bar byed pa'i gzhi/ 'gro ba thams cad kyi bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas/ 'phags pa shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa baiḍūrya mthing gi glegs bam chen po la/ yi ge gsal zhing rab tu gsal bas legs par bzhengs pa rin po che gser gyi 'bum gzabs bris ngo mtshar can 'di lta bu phul zhing gnang ba thugs la btags/ bka' drin che/ ngan bu la stag ngo mtshar can gnang ba dang*/ slob dpon gcung rin po che la gzig bzang po dang*// dpon sgom pa shag rin la gzig dang*/ gzhan yang dgos pa rnams la rnam gzhag dang bcas pa rnams/ ston pa dang nye gnas pa dang khong rnam pas legs par things/ lar rgya dkar nag phyogs dang phyogs mtshams thams cad kyi rgyal po bsod nams can rnams kyis bdag nyid chen po spyan 'dren zhing zhabs tog bgyid ces grags/ na ning phyis hor gyi rgyal po 'di mthu rgyas/ spyan snga de nas kyang gdan 'dren pa'i zhu ba byung nas gda'/ de la zhal gyis bzhes par khums/

de la bdag cag yab sras rnams ni sems dga' bar ni ma byung*/ gshegs bzhud mdzad pa'i dus su gsung gleng kho thag chod pa byed rgyu yod pa dang*/ bka' gros gal che ba mang po bgyid rgyu bdog pas/ shul 'di la cis kyang 'byon par zhu/ nged yab sras kyis kyang zhabs tog tu gang 'gro bgyid pa lags/// / 17) ༄// sa skyar ston pa zhang la gdams pa// oṃ swasti// mkhas la bsten pas mkhas pa'i yon tan rnams// ma lus mngon du 'gyur ba chos nyid lags// thos bsam sgom pa'i yon tan ma lus pa// sa steng 'di na rtsod med bla ma yi// chos las skyes pa'i sras mchog khyed nyid kyis// legs smra snyan ngag don ldan bstod pa dang*// bka' yig zhal ta bdud rtsi lta bu rnams// thugs la btags nas bskur ba shin tu legs// dri med rgyal ba phag mo gru pa yi// bu dang slob ma spyi dang bye brag rnams// mos shing gus pa'i gnas gyur bla ma yi// gdan sa rin chen dpal gyi sa skya dang*// der bzhugs yon tan rin chen du ma'i bdag /skyabs gnas rang gi bla ma dam pa la// rtag tu mos shing gus pa'i bdag nyid can// de 'dra'i zhabs drung rkang gnyis mchog gyur pa'i// tshig dang tha snyad phra mo gang lags kyang*// bden 'dzin shes pa skye ba ga la srid// bdag nyid chen po yab sras ma lus pas// sngar bzhin rtag tu thugs la 'dogs par zhu// bdag cag gsol ba 'debs shing mchis pa lags// da nas byang chub snying po'i bar du ni// blo gros phyogs cig skyid sdug dbyer med par// smon lam smon pa rab tu 'debs shing mchis/// / 18) ༄// 'jig rten gsum mgon sras kyi thu bo grub thob seng ge ye shes la gnang ba// oṃ swasti// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi// ngo bor gyur pa chos kyi rje// 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyi// sras kyi thu bo rtsod dang bral// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// gnyis med 'od gsal chen por rtogs// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel dang*// zab mo'i rten 'brel ma lus pa// thams cad mngon du gyur pa yi// slob dpon grub thob chen po yis// 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs dgongs mchog

/ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// ri dwags rgyal po seng ge ltar// rtag tu rgyu zhing bzhugs pa yis// 'gro mgon thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang*// gsung gi bdud rtsi khyed kyis bsgrubs// thugs la btags so bka' drin che/// / 19) ༄// dbon po rin po che bsod nams grags pa la phul ba'i chab shog/ oṃ swasti// dus gsum rgyal ba'i zhing khams 'jig rten 'dir// spangs rtogs phun sum tshogs pa chos kyi rje// 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma rin chen la// gus pa'i phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// 'khor 'das gnyis med rang bzhin chos kyi sku// spros med 'od gsal chen por byang chub pa// rtag chad la sogs lta ba'i tshogs rnams 'joms// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas la gus phyag 'tshal// stobs bcu'i rtsa ba tshul khrims rin chen dang*// kun rdzob smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// ston pa'i bstan pa rin chen rgyas mdzad pa// 'gro mgon rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod ni mthong thos dran par gyur pa yis// yon tan rgya mtsho sems nyid rtogs par gyur// 'khor ba'i me 'di rtsad nas zhi bar mdzad// thams cad mkhyen pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gzung dang 'dzin pa ma rig la sogs rnams// spangs nas byang chub chen por sangs rgyas pa// mkhyen gnyis dus gsum la 'jug gzigs pa can// thar pa'i grong khyer ston mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med ngo bo nyid// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo kun gyi bdag /dus gsum rgyal ba khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// snyan pa'i 'brug sgra 'jig rten gsum du grags// lhar bcas 'jig rten zhabs kyi pad mor 'dud// grags pa'i dbang phyug mi mchog rin po che// thub pa'i dbang po khyod la gus phyag 'tshal// tshangs dbang rgyal po lta bur blta na sdug /klu dbang rgyal po lta bur chos char 'bebs// 'khor lo sgyur rgyal bzhin du chos khrims mdzad// srid gsum mtshungs med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dul ba khri phrag du ma'i dbus bzhugs nas// tshangs dbyangs ka la ping ka 'brug gi sgra// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med rgyu 'bras chos// bden gtam snyan gsung khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub snying po dpal gyi 'bri gung du// snyan pa'i rgya mtsho khyod nyid bzhugs gyur nas// rgyal ba de yi bstan pa rgyas par mdzad// ded dpon khyod nyid la ni phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal mtshan rtse mo dpal gyi 'bri gung du// lhar bcas 'jig rten zil gyis mnan nas su// ri dbang rgyal po lta bur khyod mdzes lags// sku gsum dbyer med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// stong gsum 'jig rten khams 'dir rmad byung ba// srid pa gsum na mthong bar dka' ba'i dpal// 'od gsal chen po sems nyid rdo rje'i sku// smra ba'i dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rigs rus lang tsho thos pas dregs pa rnams// khyod nyid mthong bas thams cad zil gyis mnan// sna tshogs lta bas rnam par dkrugs rnams kyi// the tshom gcod mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gdan sa rdo rje gdan// yon tan 'byung gnas dpal gyi mtha' rtsa nas// nyid kyi 'bangs su gyur pa gdan sa bas// gsol 'debs skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlobs// rje sngon yang bka' drin mi chung che// da rung byin gyis brlab du gsol// 'gro kun dge ba bsags dang yod pa rnams// mnyam med chos rje rin chen sku thob shog

/slad kyi don zhu ba/ bla ma rin po che sku khams bzang zhing 'phrin las kyi sgo mtha' yas pas bdag cag gdul bya sems can rnams/ bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa la skyo ba mi mnga' zhing sku khams rin po che bzang bar khums/ de ngan bu la sogs pa bka' 'bangs rnams shin tu bka' drin che zhing thugs la btags/ da res gdan sa rin po che dang*/ de'i g.yog por gyur pa ngan bu dang bcas pa la lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du sus kyang rnyed par dka' ba'i dngos po khyad par 'phags pa bzang po dpal gyi bkod pa lta bu rnams gnang ba shin tu thugs la btags/ yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i tshems gcig dang*/ rje rin po che'i sku yol 'di nyid rin po che nyid kyi sku yol mdzad par zhu ba dang*/ sku phying sngon por yongs su grags pa dgung lo sum cu rtsa grangs su sku phyi mdzad pa 'di dang*/ mdo mang byang tshags nyi shu rtsa gcig dum gcig dang*/ yang mdo mang bris gsar nyi shu rtsa gnyis dum gcig rgyas pa gzabs bris bcu drug dum tshar bzhi/ bcu bzhi dum tshar gnyis/ bcu gnyis dum tshar bdun/ mdo rgyas tshar bco lngas sna drangs pa'i gsung rab po ti lnga brgya 'bul zhing mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 20) ༄// chos kyi rgyal po chen po jo bo ya tse la gdams pa'i chab shog/ oṃ swasti// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas/ bla ma rin po che spyan snga nas/ sa chen po'i bdag po jo bo ya tse ba'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ jo bo ba'i yab dang mes po'i dus nas/ da ltar jo bo zhal bzhugs pa yan chad du gdung rabs gsum gyi bar gyi bla ma'am bla'i mchod gnas chos rje rin po che zhal bzhugs pa nas da ltar ngan bu yan chad bla ma yab sras bzhi byon pa'i yon bdag gi rtsa ba'am/

bdag po jo bo nyid lags pa dang*/ skye ba dang skye ba thams cad du de sngon phan chad kyang 'bral ma myong ba'i rten 'brel yod la/ da phyin chad kyang skye ba dang skye ba thams cad du 'bral ba med pa dang*/ chos kyi rgyal po jo bo ba'i 'phrin las dang rgyal po'i srid la sogs pa rnams kyang brtan zhing rgyas par 'gyur ba'i steng du sku tshe mthar phyin par 'gyur ba'i rten 'brel ngan bus 'di nas byed cing yod pa lags la/ nam zhig 'chi ba'i dus byed pa'i tshe na yang*/ nub phyogs bde ba can gyi zhing khams su// padma las skyes dge slong gyur nas kyang*// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa mthong gyur te// byang chub lung bstan thob par 'gyur ba yi// rten 'brel 'di nas bdag gis bsgrig par bgyi// dad pa 'gyur med gser gyi sa gzhi la// mos gus ri bo lta bur brtan par mdzod// 'khor 'das bde skyid ma lus de las 'byung*// rgyal srid chos kyis skyong bar mdzad pa dang*// de la bar chad med par spyod pa dang*// pha rol phyogs kyis gnod par mi nus shing*// bsams pa'i don rnams 'grub par 'gyur ba yi// byin rlabs 'di nas ngan bus bgyid pa lags// chos min spangs nas chos kyis rgyal srid skyong*// 'jig rten 'khor los sgyur rgyal 'byung ba rnams// dge bcu'i khrims ni 'cha' bar mdzad pa ltar// de dang mthun par 'bangs kyi skye dgu skyongs// jo bo bas ngan bu la bsams nas 'bul ba rgya chen po bskur nas 'dug kyang*/ hor dang gis rkyen byas pas dus su thon par ma gyur kyang de la thugs khral mdzad mi 'tshal/ thon pa dang 'dra/ jo bo ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo la/ ngan bu'i gsol 'phro pong gu che rdo rje gsang lam gyi sku phyam gcig bskur nas mchis// ༈ //oṃ swasti/ bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la// sgo gsum dad cing dang ba yis// gus pas rtag tu phyag 'tshal 'dud// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// thos dang bsam dang sgom pa yis// bya ba rgya chen mdzad gyur pa// bdag gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen la// gus pa'i shugs kyis zhu 'bul ba// dmag dpung chen po g.yul nyes na// dpa' bo gcig la brten pa yin// thub pa'i bstan pa nyams pa'i tshe// khyed kyis dpa' bo mdzad pa yin// da yang de ltar mdzad par zhu// gnam lcags drag po'i thog chen yang*// rig sngags sbyor bas zlog pa yin// gdug pa gnam lcags thog ser rnams// thub pa brtul zhugs bdag nyid can// mkhas btsun bden pa'i gsang sngags kyis// gdan sa rin chen srung bar zhu// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// gtsug gi nor bu gdan sa yi// rgyan du gyur pa'i skyes chen khyed// rgyal mtshan rtse mo de nyid du// lham me lhan ne lhang nger bzhugs// thugs kyi g.yo 'gul mi mdzad zhu// zhu rten chab tshwa zho gsum 'bul// dal gyis dal gyis legs bsgral nas// nyi ma'i mthong la bzhugs nas kyang*// legs par dgongs shing dgyes par zhu// dmyal pa 'ga' yis mkhan po g.yeng*// khams pa 'ga' yis bla ma g.yeng*// bar ma skabs kyis slob dpon g.yeng*// bdag gi bla ma dam pa yi// gdan sa dmyal khams bar ma yi// 'jig par byed pa'i snying khrag rnams// las kyi gshin rjes nam mkhar gtor/// /

21) ༄// sa bdag rgyal po chen po jo bo mnga' bdag la springs pa'i chab shog/ oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i mchod rten/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas bla ma rin po che dang*/ dpon sgom pa shag rin yab sras gnyis kyis// jo bo rje sa bdag gi rgyal po bka' drin can gyi dbon sras/ byang chub sems dpa'i gdung brgyud/ mgo nag yongs kyi spyi rje/ sa chen po'i bdag po/ chos kyi rgyal po chos kyi rgyal srid skyong bar mdzad pa/ jo bo mnga' bdag gi spyan sngar zhu ba/ 'jig rten du yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gcig byung ba'i dus su de'i bdag po'am zhabs tog pa 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po zhing dag pa rnams su 'byung bar gsungs pa ltar/ chos rje rin po che yab sras yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten du byung ba'i bdag po chen po/ jo bo bla ma rin po che nas da lta jo bo mnga' bdag bzhugs pa yan chad/ dpal 'bri gung ba bla ma dge 'dun 'khor dang bcas pa'i bdag po chen por bzhugs pa bka' drin che zhing thugs la btags pa lags/ sgos su sngon smon lam gyi dbang gis ngan bu 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod du dge 'dun gyi tshogs rgya mtsho chen po lta bu 'di skyong ba dang*/ jo bo mnga' bdag chos kyi rgyal srid skyong ba dang dus gcig tu byung ba 'di/ jo bo dang ngan bu las phyogs gcig tu bsags pa'i rten 'brel lags par dgongs par zhu/ da lan ri khrod pa 'di rnams chos rje rin po che dang jo bo'i zhabs tog tu btang pa yin pas/ thugs la 'dogs pa dang spyan ras kyis btsa' bar zhu// de na bzhugs pa'i ri khrod pa rnying pa thams cad dang*/ 'di nas ngan bu sku 'khor dang bcas pas kyang jo bo ba'i sku'i rim gro la nan tan shin tu che bar bgyid pa lags/ do tsig jo bo bas rin po che gser gyi mdo mangs gzhan pas khyad par du 'phags pa 'dzam bu gling na rnyed par dka' ba thugs dam du phul ba dang*/

phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun la chab tshwa mang bskol bskur ba rnams/ khong sgo mang pa rnams kyis go chod par byas nas phyag tu legs par things/ ti se ba rgyal ba'i tshan pa la na bza' men thang bskur ba sku'i rim gro la sku thang bzos nas yun ring gsol/ nye gnas rgyal bas dbu mdzad dge 'dun rnams spyan ras kyis btsa' ba dang*/ thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ yig rten du jo bo'i sku'i na bza'i rgyu gos chen dmar po gser chu ma khru bco brgyad yod pa zhig bskur nas mchis pas sku la gsol bar zhu/ chab tshwa rgyal mo'i mur ja gdar cig bskur nas mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang po red gyur cig// / 22) ༄// ti se'i sgom chen rnams la bskur ba'i bka' yig/ oṃ swasti/ skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// spyir bka' brgyud rin po che 'di/ sgos 'jig rten mgon po rin po che 'jig rten du byon pa'i thugs kyi dgongs pa ri khrod pa lags pas/ khyed ri khrod pa rnams la ri khrod du gshegs pa'i mdzad pa dang*/ rnam par thar pa bya ba'i tshul 'di ltar du mdzad par zhu// sgom byung gi yon tan rin po che chags sdang med pa'i bsam pa mnyam pa nyid kyi sems las skye ba lags te/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ mnyam nyid rin chen thang la ngal bsos nas// chags sdang khur dang bral bar dbugs kyang phyin// ye shes rgya mtsho'i gting du gnyid log na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan rmi lam rmis// 'gro drug mdza' bo rnams la bshad byas na// zhen med nyi ma shar la brjed nas thal// zhes gsungs pas/ sems can thams cad la chags sdang gi dbye ba byar mi btub pas mi mdzad pa dang*/

sgos su bla ma gcig la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rdo rje mched grogs nang du chags sdang spu'i rtse mo tsam yang mdzad du mi btub pas mi mdzad par zhu/ ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyal po'i mdo las kyang*/ gcig la gcig gis gnod sems byas na ni// de la tshul khrims thos pas skyob mi nus// bsam gtan mi skyob dgon gnas skyob mi nus// sbyin pas mi skyob sangs rgyas mchod pas min// zhes gsungs pa dang*// rdo rje spun la khros pa ni// nyes pa brjod pa gsum pa yin/ zhes gsungs pas/ ri khrod pa thams cad thugs phyogs gcig tu mdzad nas/ 'gro mgon yab sras la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ ri khrod du nyams su blang ba'i chos/ dpal nā ro chen po'i chos drug ltar nyams su blang bar bya ba dang*/ rtsa dang rlung gi khrid dang*/ chos drug so ma dang*/ khrid chung gi sna kha dpag tu med pa dang*/ zab pa'i gdams ngag thams cad skabs skabs su thugs nyams su bzhes pa gal che/ ri khrod du dus thams cad du bsgom par bya ba'i chos ni lnga ldan rtag tu nyams su blang bar bya ba lags te/ byang chub kyi sems/ yi dam gyi lha/ bla ma/ phyag rgya chen po/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang lnga po 'di la rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pas nyin mtshan 'da' bar mdzad par zhu/ lta ba rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ spyod pa rnam par dag pa tshul khrims rin po che lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dang ba 'dren pa dang*/ rnam pa gnyis la gnas par zhu/ sgom pa rnam par dag pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa'i ngo bo dang chos gsum po 'di dang mi 'bral bar zhu/ zhu ba'i rten spyan snga nas gser srang gang gi chab tshwa mang skol gser zho gang gi sdor dang bcas pa dang*/ dge 'dun la phyag rten chab dar ha pu yug cig 'bul/ bdag cag 'bri gung gi gling rin po che na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dge 'dun/

gdan sa rin po che gong ma rnams na bzhugs pa'i bla ma dge 'dun sku 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi sku'i rim gro la dgongs par zhu ba dang*/ mchod rten chen po dpal gyi ti se na gnas pa'i gnas po chen po dang*/ mtsho chen po ma dros pa na bzhugs pa'i klu'i rgyal po chen po ma dros pa sku 'khor dang bcas pas gtso bo byas pa'i ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya ba'i ched dang*/ 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par bya ba'i phyir sgrub pa tshul bzhin du mdzad par zhu// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 23) ༄// dwags po dgon dkar ba la springs pa'i bka' yig oṃ swasti/ rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam zhing khams 'dir// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'phrin las kyis// dus rnams kun tu 'gro rnams skyob mdzad pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gus phyag 'tshal// nam mkha' lta bur rab yangs 'jig rten 'dir// cho 'phrul sna tshogs khyab par ston pa'i mgon// brjod las 'das shing bsam du med pa'i skus// lhar bcas 'jig rten 'dren pa khyod phyag 'tshal// brjod med mtha' bral rgya mtsho lta bu'i gsung*// bden gsung dri med rnam par dag pa ni// tshangs dbyangs ka la ping ka 'brug gi sgra// chos kyi 'khor los bsgyur mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med nam mkha'i thugs// glo bur nyon mongs rnam rtog sprin dang bral// dus gsum mkhyen pa me long g.ya' bral 'dra// rnam dag nam mkha'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun gyi srog /'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs nyid yon tan rgya mtsho la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// dus gsum gdul bar bya ba mang po btul// chos kyi dbang phyug rin chen las byung ba// smra ba'i seng ge rtsod pa kun dang bral// khyod 'dra 'jig rten ma mchis lhag ci mchis// khyod sngon 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// sku dang grib ma bzhin du 'bral med cing*// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du// mnyes gsum bsnyen bkur mchog la 'gran zla bral// khri phrag du ma 'dus pa kun gyi mchog

/de dag kun gyi pha ma lta bur mdzad// chos kyi rje dang dbye ba med pa'i dpal// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan 'bri gung ba'i// sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las las grub cing*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med spros dang bral// ma skyes lhun gyis grub pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'khor 'das chos rnams nam mkha' lta bur rtogs// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ma 'dres so sor snang*// ston pa'i gsung la blo gros rab yangs pa// gang gis mthong nas dran par gyur pa rnams// 'khor ba'i rgyun las bzlog mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// thams cad mkhyen pa dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// sku gsung thugs dang dbye ba med pa'i dpal// dus gsum 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus kun// dbyer med 'od gsal chen por thugs su chud// byams dang snying rje byang sems rin po ches// sdug bsngal nyon mongs gyur pa'i 'gro ba rnams// srid pa'i mtsho las khyed kyis sgrol bar mdzad// 'gro ba'i gnyen gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// lta sgom spyod gsum rnam par dag pa'i mchog /tshad med thugs rje nyi ma lta bu yis// 'gro ba'i mun sel mdzad pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'gro mgon dpal ldan de yi thugs kyi sras// deng sang dus na sngon dus 'gro ba dang*// phebs par smra zhing lhan cig gnas dran tshe// mos gus rgya mtsho gting nas skye bar gyur// chos kyi dbang phyug khyed dang bdag gnyis ni// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba mthun par gyur// da yang rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// zhabs drung kun tu khyod dang 'bral med cing*// sngon dus byang chub gling na ji lta bar// skyid sdug gcig tu gyur pa'i spyod pa yis// 'gro mgon de nyid rtag tu mchod par smon// zla 'od gzhon nu'i pho brang du// sku bltams skye 'gro kun gyi dpal du gyur// byang chub snying po dpal gyi 'bri gung du// dri med thos bsam sgom gsum sgro 'dogs bcad// rta bdun rgyal po shar phyogs khyod lung bstan// yon tan rgya mtsho khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i nags tshal nas// khyed kyi grogs por gyur pa'i ku sā lis// gus pa'i yid dang mos gus dbyer med pas// sman gyi rgyal po gur gum zho bcu 'bul// slad ma 'grul la smras pas/

khyed sku khams bde zhing 'phrin las kyi stobs chen pos rang gzhan gyi don nam mkha' dang mnyam par khums/ de bdag cag la bka' drin che zhing thugs la btags/ yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten du gur gum zho bcu bskur nas bdog sku khrus kyi chab kyi nang du 'debs par zhu/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig // 24) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por zhus pa'i zhus lan brgya rtsa'i mchod brjod// oṃ swa sti/ yon tan rgya mtsho sems nyid rdo rje yis// sgrib gsum ri bo brtan pa 'jig mdzad pa// rang byung lhun gyis grub pa chos kyi sku// dus gsum bdag nyid bla ma'i zhabs pad 'dud/// / 25) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por zhus pa'i zhus lan kun dpyod ma'i mchod brjod// na mo ratna gu ru/ gnyis 'dzin rtog pas ma gos shing*// srid zhi mi gnas sku gsung thugs// 'khor 'das kun dang mnyam par 'jug /'gro mgon thub pa chos rje 'dud/// / 26) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por zhus pa'i zhus lan bzhi ma'i mchod brjod// oṃ swa sti/ dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ston pa rdo rje 'chang*// zag med bde ba chen po'i bdag nyid can// gnyis med yum bcas bde chen bcom ldan 'das// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la 'dud/// / 27) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon por zhus pa'i zhus lan bco brgyad pa'i mchod brjod// oṃ swa sti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi gnyen gcig chos kyi rje// dus gsum bdag nyid bde chen yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// zab zhi spros bral rin chen sems gnyis sku// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad 'dud/// / 28) ༄// sgom pa ba g.yor po nas gdan sar spyan drangs pa'i dus kyi mchod brjod// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi// ngo bor gyur pa chos kyi rje// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/// /

29) ༄// gzhon nu mchog gis zhus pa'i 'bul ba'i mchod brjod// oṃ swasti/ gang zhig sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku// 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// zhing khams rnam dag nub phyogs bde ldan na// bcom ldan 'od dpag med pa thugs rje can// byu ru'i ri ltar lham me lhang nger bzhugs// 'di nas shi 'phos de mthong bya phyir dang*// dngos su byang chub lung bstan thob bya'i phyir// de ring bsod nams tshogs 'di bsag par bya/// / 30) ༄// g.yu 'ba' mo khra dgur phul dus kyi mchod brjod// oṃ swasti/ bkra shis gang zhig bde legs gangs can mtsho// skyabs gsum chos kyi dbang phyug 'gro ba'i dpal// rigs kyi gtso bo 'khor 'das skyabs gcig pu// thub dbang 'gro ba'i bla ma rgyal gyur cig /sems nyid 'od gsal mi g.yo rdo rje yis// bdag 'dzin log lta'i rab rib rnam bcom nas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lor sangs rgyas pa'i// chos kyi rgyal po phag mo gru pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// lhun grub 'gyur med brjod bral blo las 'das// sku gsum ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid can// mkha' mnyam 'gro ba lus can kun gyi skyabs// 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos chos kyi rje// 'khor 'das kun khyab sangs rgyas zhing khams su// mdzad pa sna tshogs ston mdzad 'jig rten sgron// rgyal ba dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// g.yu 'ba' mo khra dgur phul dus kyi mchod brjod do// // 31) ༄// tshul khrims dpal gyi 'bul ba'i mchod brjod// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum bde gshegs chos kyi rje// 'khor 'das bde skyid 'byung ba'i gnas// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// tshul khrims dpal gyi 'bul ba'i mchod brjod rdzogs so/// /
32) ༄// gdan sa rin po che phag mo grur zhabs tog phul ba'i 'bul tshan tho yig gi mchod brjod//

oṃ swasti// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dri med chos kyi sku// lhun grub 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa chos kyi dbyings// rigs kyi bdag po bde gshegs gtsug na mdzes pa'i rgyan// mnyam med bla ma de la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig /ma 'ongs mi bskyod rgyal po sman gyi lha// da ltar shākya'i rgyal po chos kyi rje/ /dus gsum rgyal ba de la gus phyag 'tshal// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// dbu gtsug rgyan gyur dbang gi rgyal po mchog /yon tan rin chen bye ba'i gter gyur pa'i// rgyal ba phag mo gru par gus phyag 'tshal// nam mkha' lta bur rnam dag dri ma med// sku gsum ngo bo lhun gyis grub par gnas// khams gsum skyabs gnas 'gro mgon rin po che// mtshungs med dbang phyug de la gus phyag 'tshal// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchod rten dpal gyi ri// gdan sa rin chen dpal gyi phag mo gru// byang chub snying po rdo rje gdan gyi mchog /gnas kyi dam pa de la skyabs su mchi// ri mchog de la legs par bzhugs pa yi// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs// bla ma dge 'dun chos skyong srung mar bcas// kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/// / 33) ༄// rin po che gser gyi rgya phibs bzhengs dus bstod pa// oṃ swasti/ lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa nam mkha'i thugs// glo bur nyon mongs rnam rtog sprin dang bral// dus gsum mkhyen pa me long g.ya' bral 'dra// rnam dag nam mkha'i rang bzhin khyod phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med ngo bo'i sku// mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dpal 'bar bas// lus can mig gi dbang po tshim mdzad pa// ltar mdzes gzi ldan khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tshangs dbyangs ka la ping ka 'brug gi sgra// yid 'ong ngang pa khu byug tshangs pa'i dbyangs// 'jigs med seng ge'i rgyal po lta bu'i sgras// 'gro rnams kun la chos ston khyod phyag 'tshal// dus gsum 'khor 'das rtag chad ma lus pa// sems nyid 'od gsal chen po rdo rje'i sku// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// mchod rten chen po de la gus phyag 'tshal// 'das dang ma byon da ltar dus gsum gyi// rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa bla ma de'i// sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bo rang byung ba// ratna tsarya gnyis pa khyod phyag 'tshal// chos dbyings rnam dag nam mkha'i rang bzhin la// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa log lta'i tshogs// sems nyid 'od gsal chen por byang chub pa'i// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchod rten khyod phyag 'tshal// thub pa'i dbang po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// mchod rten chen po rnam par mdzes pa 'di// srid pa gsum na mthong bar dkon pa'i dpal// rin chen gser gyi rgya phibs khyod phyag 'tshal// thams cad gser gyi rang bzhin rnam par dag

/mi yul rin chen sna tshogs kun las grub// ling tshe bzhir gnas ngo bo gcig pa'i tshul// sku bzhi ye shes lnga ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// bden pa bzhi yis srid pa'i mtsho chen las// skye ba rnam bzhis 'gro ba grol mdzad phyir// zur bzhi legs par gnas shing dpal 'bar ba// 'phrin las bzhi yi mnga' bdag khyod phyag 'tshal// kun kyang nam mkha'i rang bzhin gcig tu gnas// mtha' brgyad spros pas stong pa'i rten 'brel la// 'di las 'di 'byung rgyu dang 'bras bu rnams// sha mo'i sul bzhin legs gnas khyod phyag 'tshal// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten ma lus pa// dga' zhing yid bde kun kyang tshim par 'gyur// gang gis mthong bas srid pa gsum las sgrol// 'gro ba'i mi shes mun sel khyod phyag 'tshal// lho phyogs rig pa'i 'byung gnas rgya gar lugs// phyogs gsum rnam par phye ba rgya nag gi// ma lus rig byed mkhas rnams kun dang bstun// nyes pa'i skyon bral de la gus phyag 'tshal// 'di la gang gis dga' ba rab skyes dang*// rgyu dang rkyen rnams rab bsgrubs 'gro ba rnams// spang dka' 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las brgal nas// 'jig rten rgyal ba'i nyi ma 'char 'gyur nges// 'og legs dri zhim tsan dan legs grub pa'i// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs tshad pa zhi bar byed// dri yis phyogs bcu'i zhing rnams khyab par gyur// 'phrin las mtha' yas de la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*// 'gro rnams byang chub mchog la 'god phyir dang*// 'gro ba'i mgon po dbon po rin chen dang*// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun ma lus pa'i// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog nyid du 'gyur ba'i phyir// rin chen gser gyi rgya phibs 'di bzhengs lags// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig /gser thog tshar ba'i dus su 'bri gung du byon pa la khong gis bstod pa zhus nas mdzad pa rdzogs so// // 34) ༄// gdan sa rin po che phag mo gru'i slob dpon la gdams pa// oṃ swasti// bsams nas byed pa mkhas pa yin// phyis 'byung 'dun ma bsam pa gces// hab shi hub shi myur drags na// 'dun mas rang gzhan gnyis ka phung*// rkyen ngan drag po langs pa'i tshe// skad cig ma yi zhe sdang yang*// thal thungs chen por gyur pa na// bcos su med pas shin tu 'jigs// gal po che la ngos dga' med// ded dpon chen po sing ga la// zangs gling srin mos bslu ma thub// rgyal po seng ge ral pa can// bslus nas srog dang phral bas na// 'gag dang nya ga mi gtong bar/ /bag dang ldan pa shin tu gces// bag med brlag pa'i 'byung khungs yin// dang po bka' dang tha ma'i gsung*// shes rab zhib mos brtag par bya/// / 35) ༄// man ngag gi bstan bcos dri med phreng ba slob dpon sangs rgyas la gdams pa// oṃ swasti// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med spros dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs// brjod bral sems nyid gdod nas skye med ngo bo ston mdzad rdo rje lta bu'i gsung*// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bu 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// ngar 'dzin nyon mongs yid las skyes// gzhan du 'dzin pa'i log ltas bskyed// sred dang chags pa'i ngo bor smin// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// lha dang lha min 'jig rten du// 'bras bu sdug bsngal dpag med myong*// ngar 'dzin sdug bsngal rgyu 'bras 'di// spong bar byed pa'i brtul zhugs gzung*// 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong nyid nga med bdag med pa// lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo bo yin// rtogs na 'khor ba skye ba'i gzhi// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa de// sems nyid skye med rdo rje yin// thog med dus nas da lta'i bar// ma rtogs 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// rtogs nas 'khor ba'i rgyu bcom pas// sred dang len pa ma rig pa// gting mtha' med pa'i 'khor ba spangs// lhun grub 'od gsal chos kyi sku// dus gsum mnyam nyid ngo bo de// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid yin// nyi ma sprin dang bral ba bzhin// gzung 'dzin rtog pa dag pa de// mthar thug 'od gsal chen po lags// dus gsum 'gyur ba med pa de// rang gi ngo bor rtogs pa yin// bsgom bya sgom byed kun dang bral// spang gnyen gnyis med rang sar grol// mtha' med nam mkha'i rang bzhin dang*// brjod med 'od gsal chen po gnyis// nam mkha' nam mkha' 'dres pa dang*// chu la chu bzhag de bzhin du// rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel 'byung rnams// sprin dang glog dang khug sna ltar// rkyen gyi dbang gis 'byung ba de// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras yin// gling bzhi nam mkhar bcas pa'i chu// rgya mtsho'i ngo bor gcig gyur kyang*// mkhyen pa can gyi sangs rgyas kyis// 'di ni 'dzam gling chu zhes dang*// de bzhin gling gsum nam mkha'i chu// so sor ma 'dres ngo bor mkhyen// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// ma skyes stong par ro gcig kyang*// sems dang las kyi bye brag gis// 'bras bu ma 'dres so sor 'byung*// sgyu ma lta bu'i rten 'brel lags// gzhi med stong pa'i rang bzhin de// las kyi rgyu 'bras ngo bor 'byung*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung yin// rtogs tshod ji ltar mthong gyur kyang*// rgyu 'bras rang gi ngo bo de// las kyi phyag rgyas thebs pa'i phyir// stong dang nam mkha' dbyer med ltar// sems nyid ma skyes spros dang bral// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i las dbyer med// 'byung ba gshis kyi rten 'brel yin// sgrib gsum bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyis// sgra mthar rta chag gsol dang mtshungs// kwa ye skyes bu dam pa rnams// so so skye bo'i dus dang ni// mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis dus dang*// mnyam rjes gnyis med rtogs gyur kyang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las dang rnam smin dang*// gdug pa'i dug ltar spang bar bya// kha tsam tshig tsam ma bsam par// bag med gya tshom spang bar bya// byas pa'i las ngan 'bras bu de// rgyu yi dus su ma spangs na// 'bras bu sdug bsngal myong ba de// da nas 'khor ba ma stongs tshe// rgyal ba'i mthus kyang spang thabs med// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// las kyi rnam smin 'bras bu de// nag po klu yis zin pa ltar// gtong ba med pas ya re nga*// soms dang
