'jigs dang mi 'jigs ltos// ma skyes nam mkha'i ngo bo de// skye med chos sku sems nyid lags// de la chags sdang rmongs gsum gyi// 'jig rten rkyen dang bcas pa spang*// snying rjes zhi la ma chags phyir// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bla med byang chub thob sems bskyed// shes pas srid la mi gnas phyir// bdag ni 'jig rten sangs rgyas su// 'gyur bar bya phyir byang sems bskyed// de ltar kun rdzob byang chub sems// 'gro ba'i don du bskyed par bya// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// byang chub sems dang mthun par spyad// de ltar spyad pa'i 'bras bu la// gnas skabs 'khor ba'i bde 'bras dang*// tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor lo bsgyur// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpar bgrod pa 'byung*// des na byang chub sems gnad che// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyang*// byang chub sems las skyes pas bsag

/so sor thar dang byang chub sems// rigs 'dzin sngags kyi sdom pa rnams// brtse chen byang chub sems kyis bsgrub// lha dang sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// snying po dam tshig ma lus pa// tshad med snying rje las skyes pa'i// byang chub sems kyi bsgrub par bya// lus dang 'dra ba'i rgyu 'bras rnams// byang sems rin chen ngo bor spyad// yan lag 'dra ba'i rten 'brel rnams// byams dang snying rje tshad med bzhis// bde thob sdug bsngal bral bar bsgrub// tshad med snying rje'i rjes 'brangs nas// rang don spangs nas gzhan don bsgrub// tshad med btang snyoms chen po yis// 'gro ba kun la snyoms par blta// byams pa rang gi ngo bo yis// gnod pa bde bar bsgyur bar bya// kun rdzob chos dang zag med chos// rang rgyud brlan pa'i dga' ba yis// 'gro ba ma rnams tshim par bya// chos dang rang sems 'dres pa dang*// chos min bdud kyi las rnams kyang*// chags sdang rmongs gsum las byung pa'i// sems dang las dang rnam smin rnams// gnas skabs mthar thug bde skyid dang*// gtan gyi bde ba 'phrog par byed// gdug pa'i dug dang mtshungs pas 'dir// dus rnams kun tu spang bar mdzod// kwa ye dam chos gang yin na// bdag gzhan gnyis med rol pa'i mtshor// sna tshogs rkyen du byed pa rnams// mtsho la char pa bab pa bzhin// gnyis med gcig tu mnyam par zhog /bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnam gnyis// phun sum tshogs pa rnam pa lnga// thob par byed pa'i rgyu lags pas// btang snyoms med par bsag pa dang*// tho rengs dus na thun bzhi y-i// rnal 'byor la ni mnyam par zhog /yar ngo'i snga dro mar gyi ngor// mtshams gcad mnyam par gzhag par bya/ yar ngo'i phyi dro dam chos dang*// bsdu ba'i dngos po rnam pa bzhis// gdul bya'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba dang*// bla ma'i rnam thar nges par gzung*// nges med rnam thar cal col yang*// bag dang ldan pas 'tsho bar bya// bag med brlag pa'i 'byung khungs spang*// chos dang sems su 'dres pa dang*// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyi// rlan dang 'bral ba med par bya// rnam dag tshul khrims rin chen gyis// rang rgyud spyod pa dag pa dang*// chags sdang rmongs gsum bskyed pa'i gzhi// sdig pa'i grogs po spong ba dang*// ston pa'i mdo rgyud du ma la// 'gal ba med par gzigs rtog mdzod// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag pas// tshe 'di bsam pa'i spros pa bcad// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// sems nyid 'od gsal chen po yin// rtog dang 'dzin pa'i bye brag rnams// chu la chu bur ji bzhin du// de dang dbyer med zung du 'jug

/las kyi rnam smin spu ris 'byung*// ngo bo dbyer med chos kyi sku// kun rdzob don dam byang sems gnyis// de dang tha dad med pa de// nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems yin// dran pa'i rgyal pos bsrung bar bya// mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad rnams// ngo bo gnyis su med par spyod// lus dang sems dang snang ba gsum// chos sku 'od gsal chen por cig /'das dang ma byon da lta gsum// dus gsum dus med ngo bo nyid// de ltar rtag tu mnyam par gzhag /ji ltar nam mkha' dngos por ni// nam yang 'gyur ba med pa ltar// ji ltar nyi ma mun pa dang*// nam yang lhan cig mi gnas ltar// bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum 'di// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// des bskyed las dang rnam smin dang*// nam yang gnas pa med par bya// skyid pas dga' ba med pa dang*// sdug pas sems zhum mi byed cing*// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// byang chub sems kyis spyod par mdzod// nyams len rin chen bdud rtsi 'di// 'khor 'das yon tan 'byung ba'i thabs// 'di dang rtag tu zhu gtug mdzod// bsags pa'i rgyab can rnal 'byor pa// mnyes pa gsum gyi rgyal mtshan 'dzin// slob dpon sangs rgyas rin mgon la// don gyi snying po'i gdams ngag 'di// shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas// nyams su blang phyir legs par bstan// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog /'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog /rtag tu nyams su blang bar bya ba'i man ngag gi bstan chos dri ma med pa'i phreng ba zhes bya slob dpon sangs rgyas la gdams pa rdzogs so/// / 36) ༄// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid ti se ba rnams la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// bdag gi ri khrod pa rnams la// dus rnam rtag tu byin gyis rlobs// bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*// sgrub pa 'phel bar mdzad du gsol// ri khrod rnal 'byor dbang phyug rnams// ri bo'i khrod du mnyam par zhog

/rtsa dang rlung dang thig le dang*// chos drug gsar rnying man ngag rnams// zab cing rab zab shin tu zab// zab pa'i chos lta yin mod kyis// res 'ga' lto 'grangs bya na ltar// skabs su bsgom par bya ba yin// dus rnam kun tu rtag par yang*/ /nyams su blang bar bya ba'i chos// lnga ldan dam chos rin chen lags// gser dang ser po ji bzhin du// dung dang dkar po gnyis med ltar// bsgom par bya ba lnga ldan yin// nyams len kun gyi rtsa ba dang*// srog dang srog gi snying po ni// dam chos lnga ldan yin pas 'dir// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// ting nge 'dzin ni rtag tu bsgom// rjes shes a 'thas sgyu ma dang*// stong pa nyid du skye ba rnams// bcu gsum chos kyis gnad du bsnun// 'khor lo ma dang lnga ma dang*// zab pa'i gdams ngag rtsa rlung ma// mnyam rjes gnyis med spang bya rnams// spong ba'i brtson 'grus brtsam par bya// 'jig rten 'di yi bsam pa dang*// che thabs bya phyir sgom pa min// tshangs dang brgya byin 'khor los sgyur// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kun// thob par bya phyir sgom pa min// dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi rje// 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// thugs kyi dgongs pa byang chub tu// thams cad mkhyen pa thob bya'i phyir// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo ba'i chos kyis nyams su longs// ku su lu yi gsang tshig 'di// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// mang po'i gdams ngag nyams len dang*// khrid kyi sna kha du ma rnams// zhang lcam rjes bzhin song dogs nas// lnga ldan nyams su blang phyir bstan// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs nas kyang*// byang chub dam pa thob par shog /ri pa rnams la gnang ba rdzogs so/// /

37) ༄// 'khor ba spong thabs kyi lam mchog sgom pa rin 'byung la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam zhing khams 'dir// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'phrin las kyis// dus rnam kun tu 'gro rnams skyob mdzad pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gus phyag 'tshal// nam mkha' lta bur rab yangs 'jig rten 'dir// cho 'phrul sna tshogs khyab par ston pa'i mgon// brjod las 'das shing bsam du med pa'i sku// lhar bcas 'jig rten 'dren pa khyod phyag 'tshal// brjod med mtha' bral rgya mtsho lta bu'i gsung*// bden gsung dri med rnam par dag pa ni// tshangs dbyangs ka la ping ka 'brug gi sgra// chos kyi 'khor lo bsgyur mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med nam mkha'i thugs// glo bur rnam rtog nyon mongs sprin dang bral// dus gsum mkhyen pa me long g.ya' bral 'dra// rnam dag nam mkha'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun gyi srog /dus gsum bdag nyid dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// sku gsung thugs nyid yon tan rgya mtsho la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// phan yon med cing nyes dmigs mang*// skye bar sla zhing 'jig par dka'// sdug bsngal nyon mongs sems can rnams// tshad med thugs rje chen po yis// nges par skyob mdzad chos kyi rje// 'jig rten gsum mgon rin chen gyis// 'gro ba ma rnams bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// rtog dang rnam par rtog las byung*// mig gi dbang pos yul la brtags// bzang la chags shing ngan la sdang*// bar pa la ni rab tu rmongs// de yis ngan song gnas gsum bskyed// 'khor ba gting mtha' med par 'khor// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho bgrang las 'das// 'khor ba'i chu bos rgyun du khyer// da rung thon pa'i dus skabs med// de bzhin rna ba'i dbang pos sgra// sna yi dbang pos dri la yang*// lce yi dbang pos ro la ste// lus kyi dbang pos reg bya la// brtags pas rtog pa rab tu skye// bzang po rnams la chags pas brtags// rtog pas yi dwags 'jig rten bskyed// ngan pa rnams la sdang bas brtags// rtog pas dmyal ba'i 'jig rten bskyed// bar ma rnams la rmongs pas brtags// rtog pas dud 'gro'i 'jig rten bskyed// kwa ye sku mched rnam gnyis po// ma chags mi sdang rmongs med pa'i// sems gsum nor bu rin chen 'di// sdug bsngal 'khor ba spong byed sman// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa yi// ye shes ngo bo de nyid de// 'od gsal chen po sems kyi gshis// sku gsum lhun grub dbye ba med// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad kyi// thugs kyi snying po yon tan tshogs// 'di las gzhan pa spu tsam yang*// ma mchis med par thag chod pas// chags med rmongs spangs sdang bral ba'i// sems la rtag tu gnas par zhu// tshogs dang dben pa gar 'dug kyang*// rin chen sems kyi rgyal po de// dran pa'i bdag pos bsrung bar zhu// yul lnga'i dgra bo byung ba'i tshe// stobs chen 'od gsal chen por sba// ro mnyam chen po'i zhags pas bcings// 'grus skyong rtog med kyi ngang la gzhag

/mthon dman sna tshogs thabs yin pas// shes rab bdag med nga med pa'i// ngo bor gnyis su med par bya// bcu gsum chos kyis nyams su blang*// sna tshogs thabs kyi rgyal po de// rgyal ba'i 'phrin las skyon med cing*// rnam dag ngo bo nyid du bsgrub// dug lnga sman gyi rgyal por spyad// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di// mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang yin// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kyi rba rlabs 'di// chos sku spros dang bral ba yin// gsungs te thabs kyis zin na yin// thabs med dug des gsod par byed// dang po rtog pas 'dzin pa'i dug /rtog med stong par rtogs pas bcom// gnyis pa las kyi spu ris rnams/ bcu gsum chos kyi nyams len gyis// bcom nas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las yin// 'di yi nyams len ma shes na// rang srog rang gis gcod par byed// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdams ngag nor bu rin po che// dus dang 'phrod par bsgom par bya// brtson 'grus chen po rtsoms shig dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan dang*// 'khor 'das bde skyid ma lus pa// dbul pos gter ni rnyed pa 'am// 'khor los sgyur rgyal sras mchog de// gling bzhi rin chen sna bdun gyi// 'byor pa chen po thob pa ltar// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// skyabs mchog rgyal bar bdag gyur nas// sangs rgyas ye shes spyod yul yin// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam gnyis kyi// zag med sbyor ba chen po des// dbul zhing sdug bsngal gyis bcings pa'i// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// dbul dang sdug bsngal skyon spangs nas// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po sems nyid du// byang chub dam pa thob par byed// des na rin chen rnam gnyis la// gros 'debs snying nas chags sdang spongs// rmongs pa de yang de bzhin spang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed pa ni mi dge ba// ma chags mi rmongs sdang bral bas// bskyed pa'i las de dge bar 'dod// rtsa ba dug la lo ma dang*// yal ga thams cad dug yin pas// dug gis rang gzhan gsod par byed// de bzhin nyon mongs gsum bskyed las// gdug pas 'khor ba skyed par byed// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i srog

/gcod par byed pa'i gshed ma de// spongs dang 'khor bas ci zhig bya// de lta go ste 'di yis 'dir// sngar yang bdag la gnod pa byas// bdag gi gnyen dang phyogs ris dang*// bdag dang mdza' ba rnams la sdang*// de lta de bzhin byed pa dang*// phyis kyang gnod par 'gyur bas na// da res 'di la bzod thabs med// phyi nas bzod pa rab tu bsgom// snyam du rtog pa skye ba de// 'khrul pa chen po gti mug yin// rang nang gi nyon mongs rnam rtog 'di// gnod skyel skyes bur snang bar byed// sems la zhe sdang spongs shig dang*// gnod pa'i dgra bor snang ba bdag /gzugs dang me long ji bzhin te// lus dang srog la bab gyur kyang*// zhe sdang rnam rtog ma bskyed la// skye na byams pa chen por skyed// tshangs sogs 'khor ba'i bde 'bras rnams// nyams su myong bar byas gyur na// rnyed par dka' ba'i byang chub 'thob// 'on kyang sdang dang byams pa gnyis// 'od gsal rnam dag sems nyid du// ro mnyam chen por khrugs kyis gtang*// byams dang sdang med sems nyid de// rgyal ba rnams kyi sku yin pas// mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin// sdug bsngal 'khor ba 'joms byed yin// chos kyi sku dang mi 'bral zhu// de bzhin gti mug 'dod chags sems// skyes pas phyi rol yul snang gnyis// gzugs dang me long ji bzhin te// sems gnyis spongs dang yul gnyis 'gag /skye na chags med rmongs bral bskyed// gnas skabs rtsa gsum 'jig rten dang*// phra rags rten 'brel mngon du gyur// mthar thug chos rje sangs rgyas 'thob// 'on kyang chags sdang rmongs pa dang*// chags med gti mug med sems gnyis// ma skyes skye med sems nyid du// dbye ba med pas nyams su blang*// tha dad med cing bye brag med// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos sku yin// yon tan skyed pa'i ma ma yin// 'khor ba dug gi sdong po de// gcod par byed pa'i st+wa re yin// kwa ye skyes bu rnam gnyis po// de 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// rtsa ba nas ni spongs la 'dir// ma chags mi sdang rmongs med pa'i// sems gsum blo yis bskyed la bsgom// gnas skabs lha mi'i go 'phang dang*// tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur// ma lus nyams su myong byas nas// mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob// chags med rmongs bral rnam gnyis sems// 'bras bu rtsa gsum rgyu 'bras bcas// ma skyes lhun gyis grub pa yi// spros med chen por nyams su blang*// spros pa med pa'i ngo bo de// rnam dag nam mkha'i rang sems yin// sangs rgyas kun gyi chos kyi sku// 'gag pa med pa'i ngo bor spyod// bu chags sdang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras la// thog med dus nas rtag tu spyad// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med myong*// thugs rje ldan pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*// tshad med thugs rje ldan pa yi// bla ma rnams kyis gso thabs bral// nyon mongs gsum po ma spangs par// 'khor ba rang dgar mi ldog cing*// 'dzad pa'i mu mtha' ma mchis pas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho gang gis spong*// ci yis spong zhes bsams gyur na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// rang gi rgyud la ma bskyed la// dus gsum dus med rang gi sems// rtog dang rnam par rtog dang bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun las 'das// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa yi// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gzugs dang rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos// rnam dag nam mkha'i rang sems su// gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor grol// ma skyes mi skye skye ba med// skyes pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// ma skyes skye med nam mkha' bzhin// chos kun skye med nam mkha' bzhin// nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la// nam mkha' lta bur bsgoms byas na// nam mkha' lta bur byang chub 'thob// byang chub ngo bo sems nyid dang*// skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral bar// bsam med brjod bral ngang la zhog

/'khor ba spangs pa de nyid lags// spang bya spang du med pa dang*// gnyen po bsten du med pa gnyis// gnyis med nam mkha'i ngo bor rtogs// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas// mkhyen pa gnyis ldan chos kyi rje// 'bri gung bzhugs pa'i mgon po dang*// dbyer med gcig tu 'dre bar nges// dogs pa thams cad rab spangs nas// snang grags thams cad chos kyi sku// rab tu zhi zhing nye bar zhi// stong pa kho na'i chos rnams la// stong pa'i chos rnams 'byung ba ste// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras yin// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo de// stong pa nyid dang ma bral bas// zung 'jug lha dang lha mo yin// skye dang rnam par rtog pa rnams// ma skyes mi 'gag gnas pa med// stong pa chen po 'od gsal yin// 'dod 'dun rnam rtog skye ba de// 'dod pa spangs pa'i thar pa yin// 'khor 'das gnyis su 'dzin pa de// rab rib can gyi skra shad yin// bdag gzhan gnyis su dbye ba de// stong pa nam mkha'i mdud pa yin// 'on kyang 'khor ba ma stongs tshe// sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las kyis// 'gro ba ma rnams skyobs pa de// byang chub sems kyi 'phrin las yin// 'khor ba'i mun pa sel ba de// rnam dag rang sems nyi ma yin// de gnyis dbye ba med pa yi// 'phrin las rgyud chad med pa de// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu yin// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dus gsum bdag nyid rin po che// mthong thos dran pas 'gro ba yi// sdug bsngal nyon mongs spongs byed pa'i// bde chen kun bzang yangs pa'i mdzod// bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// 'phrin las ma lus thams cad dang*// rang bzhin dbyer med ngo bo der// lhun gyis grub pa'i mos gus bya// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar gzung*// sku yi rnam thar tshul khrims te// phyi nang gnyis su shes par bya// nang gi tshul khrims srung ba ni// da lta rang gi sems 'di la// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma lus pa// mi skyed bskyed spong brtson 'grus kyi// sdom pas bsdams pa'i brtul zhugs gzung*// dgos pa'i dus su btang snyoms spang*// brtson 'grus chen po brtsam par gyis// phyi yi tshul khrims srung ba ni// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// bya dang byed pa nyung ba dang*// sbyang sdom brtul zhugs spyod pa dang*// bya dang byed pa thams cad kyis// 'gro rnams dang ba 'dren pa dang*// thams cad kun gyi yid 'ong zhing*// chags pa'i yul dang lhan cig tu/

/nam yang gnas par mi byed cing*// sdang ba'i yul la byams pa yi// sman chen bsam pa rab bskyed de// gnod cing 'tshe ba spong ba dang*// tshul khrims bdag gis bsrung bar bya// rmongs pa'i yul dang phrad pa'i tshe// gti mug bsam pa rab bcom nas// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo bsgom// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pa'i phyir// phra dang rags pa'i rgyu 'bras la// brtsi bldab yang dang yang du bya// phyi dang nang gi tshul khrims gnyis// lus dang srog bzhin bsrung bar bya// la ka'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// rkyen gyi dbang du mi gtang zhu// brtan pa ri bo bzhin du mdzod// mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bu yis// nang rtags gzhan gyis ma mthong bar// zab pa rgya mtsho lta bur spyod// rtsi yis lcags rnams gser 'gyur ltar// phar 'gyur tshur bsgyur mi mdzad par// rang tshugs brtan po 'dzin pa gces// zer lo bltas lo ma mang bar// long ba 'on lkugs 'du shes bya// sus kyang skyid du mi 'jug cing*// gzhan gyis gnod pa skyel dogs med// rang spyod gzhu rgan bzhin du bya// phra ma rdzun dang mchu bsnyung spang*// bden pa'i tshig gis 'tsho bar mdzod// bla ma slob dpon grogs rnams la// ma chags mi sdang rang sor gzhag /chags pas ci bya sdang ci bya// rang gzhan thams cad 'chi ba yin// nams kyang 'chi ba'i ro de la// sdang bas gsad pas dgos ci yod// gzhon zhing lang tshor ldan pa dang*// mdzes shing yid du 'ong rnams la// log g.yem chags pas ci zhig bya// bu ga dgu nas mi gtsang 'dzag /phar la mchod kyang tshur la gnod// nams kyang 'chi ba'i ro de la// chags pa'i bsam pa rab spongs la// chags med bdud rtsi dam pa des// lhar bcas 'jig rten chags can rnams// chags bral 'jig rten sangs rgyas su// sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam par bya// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran tsam na// rang snying tshal par ma gas pa// glen pa yin nam smyos sam ci// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal ni// gse gshag gcod dang 'tshed pa dang*// de la sogs pa'i sdug bsngal rnams// dran pas keng shu'i 'dab ma ltar// snying 'di rab tu 'dar gyur kyang*// pad ma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar// bag med 'khor bar spyod pa 'di// gdon gyis brlams sam ci zhig yin// rang la rang snying mi rje 'am// skyabs gnas dam pa chos kyi rje// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// 'joms par mdzad pa'i thu bo che// mya ngan 'das gling rnam dag der// skyel bar mdzad pa'i nus pa can// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// spyi mthun bsod nams las grub pa// de bzhin gshegs pa 'bri gung pas// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol// bdag cag sems can thams cad la// skyabs dang mgon ni gzhan du med// re sa bltos sa gzhan du med// gnas skabs bde zhing 'phral du skyid// byang chub thob par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum bdag nyid chos kyi rje// skyob mdzad mgon po 'bri gung pas/

/nyon mongs dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyis// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams// thugs rje chen po bskyab tu gsol// las ngan rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i// me dbal 'brum bu'i nad kyis zin// bas mtha'i dgon pa 'khor skyong du// srog la re thag chad pa'i blos// mar nang spu ni phyung ba bzhin// lus kun nad kyis gdungs par 'gyur// 'jig rten 'di yi longs spyod dang*// bu slob gnyen 'dun thams cad ni// rmi lam thun cig rmis pa ltar// mthong ba med pa'i phyogs su gnas// de tshe 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// thogs med sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul gyis// der byon spyi bor phyag bzhag pas// phub ma rlung gis gtor ba ltar// sdug bsngal las byung nad de bcom// srog gnang dam chos 'ga' zhig go// phongs shing gcig pur lus pa'i tshe// sdug cing nad kyis gdungs pa yi// bdag gi zhabs tog gus par byas// bu chung a mas 'tsho ba ltar// byams pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyis// bdag gi lus 'di 'tsho bar bya// sdug bsngal chen po sgos su khur// dgos pa'i tshe de gus par byas// bla ma rin chen byin rlabs dang*// sku mched gnyis kyi zhabs tog 'dis// deng sang cung zad bde bar gnas// zab pa'i dam chos don po 'di// sdug bsngal 'khor ba spong ba'i sman// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu// sku yi rnam thar tshul khrims yin// rjes su 'brongs shig rgyal sras gnyis// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi rnam thar zab mo 'di// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// sus kyang go zhing rtogs pa nyung*// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab kyi// dregs pa can gyis ga la go// rang 'dod nam mkha' 'dom gyis 'jal// bskyil ba'i rdzing bu dgra la sman// de dang 'dra bar shes par bya// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i gsung*// rtag tu bden par snyan gsung pa'i// yid 'ong tshangs pa'i gsung dang ni// bden gtam ka la ping ka'i gsung*// mi dge gshis kyis mi dge ba// thog mar mi dge'i las gang de// bar dang tha mar mi dge bas// sdig to ngan song bskyed pa de// nam yang gnang ba'i skabs med par// rtag tu spong ba'i chos su bstan// ston pa'i gsung la mtha' drug gi

/log rtog spangs la rang sor bzhag /dge ba gshis kyis dge bar bstan// thog mar dge ba'i chos de gang*// bar dang tha mar dge ba gsungs// 'di la mi dger 'gyur ba'i skabs// nam yang med par chos rnams gsungs// mtha' drug rdo rje'i tshig rgyas btab// de 'gyur ba med pa'i gtan tshig yin// gsung gi rnam thar zab mo 'di// mi brjed gus dang bcas pa yis// zung dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sras// kha cig dge ba mi dger 'gyur// mi dge dge bar 'gyur bar 'dod// smyon pa bla rdol smra ba ltar// 'brel med mu cor smra rnams kyis// ston pa'i dgongs pa ga la lon// yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma'i thugs// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pas// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing ma lus pa// dus gsum 'khor 'das rtag chad dang*// mtho dman grub mtha' sna tshogs rnams// sems nyid 'od gsal chen po der// byang chub dam par sangs rgyas pa'i// thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de// da lta rtogs pa'i rang sems dang*// dbye ba med cing tha dad med// rtogs pa sems kyi rgyal po la// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dang*// dran pa'i rgyal po ma bral bar// chu bo'i gzhung bzhin nyams su longs// ma g.yengs pa dang mi 'da' ba// bying dang rgod pa gnyis bral bar// nyams dang rtog pa med par bsgom// rtogs pa'i sems nyid gcig pu yis// bar do gsum po bgrod par bya// gegs sel bogs 'don dgos pa'i tshe// skyabs gnas dam pa 'bri gung pa// bla ma mchog de dran par bya// gegs sel bogs rnams thon par 'gyur// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma dang*// dbyer med gcig tu 'dre bar nges// rdo rje 'chang dang tilli dang*// dpal ldan nā ro chen po dang*// chos rje mar pa mi la dang*// 'jig rten mgon po sgam po pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru par bcas// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma rnam bdun dang*// dbyer med gcig tu 'dres pa ngo mtshar che// tshogs dang dben pa gang du 'dug gyur kyang*// nyams len rgyal po gzhung 'di dran par bya// gnyen 'dun tshogs la zhen pa ma bskyed cig

/sdang ba'i dgra la gnod pa spang bar gyis// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems rnam gsum// phan pa'i sman yin nyams su blang bar bya// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// gsung sgros yi ger bris pa'i dam chos 'di// nyams su blang bar bya phyir khyed gnyis la// 'khor ba spong byed thabs kyi lam mchog bstan// 'khor ba spong ba'i lam mchog zhes bya ba dam pa'i chos// sgom pa rin 'byung dang*// rin chen grags gnyis kyis/ bdag gnyal du 'brum nag gi nad chen pos thebs shing shi la thug pa'i dus su/ g.yog legs par byas shing srog bton pa'i gtang rag tu bstan pa'o// bdag dang 'khor 'das dus gsum dge ba 'dis// bskal pa stong du mthong rnyed dka' ba yi// 'gro mgon 'bri gung pa dang mi 'bral zhing*// ma rnams byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas nye gnas sgom pa rin 'byung dang*/ sgom pa rin chen grags gnyis la gdams pa rdzogs so// //

38) ༄// dbang bzhi'i ngo sprod ston brtson la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po ston pa bcom ldan 'das// skyob pa mnyam med chos rje rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs nyid yon tan rgya mtsho la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal gus pas skyabs su mchi// rgyal ba'i zhing 'dir snyigs ma'i dus la bab// chags bral dam chos rin chen nyams len pa'i// skyes bu mchog de u dum wā ra 'dra// chos ltar bcos kyang gti mug drwa bar tshud// mchog gsum nor bu rin chen yon tan rmongs// skyabs gsum thos pa rna ba'i dbang pos spong*// phal cher gti mug log lta'i rdzong la gnas// bslab gsum rin chen 'dod med gus pa spong*// phrag dog dug gi gong ma rnams la skur// bla ma pha ma mkhan po slob dpon la// gus pa spong zhing nyon mongs zil gyis non// zhe sdang gdug pa'i bsam pa rab rgyas pas// bla ma pha ma la sogs kun la yang*// dga' ba med cing 'dun pa rab spong byed// phra ma'i tshig gis phan tshun mdza' ba rnams// 'byed par byed cing tha dad dag tu 'khod// rgyu 'bras mthong med rnam smin 'dzems pa bral// phal cher gnas gsum dag tu gzhol rnams kyi// skyabs cig skyob pa bla ma rin chen gyi// dri med dam chos nor bu rin po che// dgag sgrub bslab pa grub mtha' chen po dang*// sgrub dang spang bya'i chos la gnang bkag rnams// ye nas yin pas 'gyur med a thang chad// mkhyen pa'i ye shes ston pa'i thugs dgongs la// gti mug rab bral shes rab mig mchog gis// 'khrul med lta ba'i mchog gis rab gzigs pas// gong gi nyes kun spong bar the tshom med// mgon po'i chos 'di ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// stong gsum mi mjed rgyal ba'i zhing mchog 'dir// thugs rje rmad byung bde gshegs rin po che// mkhyen gnyis rab rgyas skyob pa 'bri gung pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa ma byon na// bdag cag 'gro ba nyon mongs can rnams la// brtse bral gshin rje'i skyes bu rab 'jigs pas// chags sogs dug gsum lcags kyus rab bzung nas// dbang med rmos glang bzhin du mnar med khrid// lar kha spyang zhe spyang mang na yang*// rang nyid chos dang mi mthun na// byams dang brtse bas bu bzhin bskyangs// spyan dang 'bral ba med par ni// mthe bong tsam nas bskyangs gyur cing*// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho las// phyag gis tsar gyis bton nas ni// rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'god pa'i// bla ma dam pa'i drin brjed dam// ji ltar chos rje ma bslus sam// rang nyid skyabs dang ma bral lam// 'khor ba rang las ngan pa yi// 'og tu gnas sa ma bcas sam// rang nyid smyos par ma gyur tam// kha smras lan gcig byed na yang*// bsam mno rtog dpyod zhag gsum byed// bdag nyid 'khor ba spong 'dod na// bsam zhing dpyod pa cis mi byed// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di// skams shing 'dzad pa'i mu mtha' med// dge bcu bsgrub pa'i mi lus kyang*// thob dka' 'jig par shin tu sla// 'jig rten rgyal ba'i bstan pa ni// yun ring gnas par mi 'gyur la// 'jigs chen du ma 'byung bas nyen// bdag spyod snga mas mi chog pas// rgyu lam 'bras bu thams cad la// cig car dge ba 'ba' zhig bsgrub// de la lha dang tshangs pa dang*// brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur bsgrub min// bdag nyid nyan thos la mos dang*// rang rgyal thob par bya phyir min// sangs rgyas chos rje thob bya'i phyir// rgyu lam 'bras gsum rten 'brel bsgrig

/rgyu yi ngo bo byang chub sems// lam ni pha rol phyin drug la// bskal pa mu mtha' med par ni// 'bad dang rtsol dang brtson 'grus kyis// nam zhig sangs rgyas thob par byed// lam log pa ma yin legs pa'i lam// ngo mtshar rmad byung 'dod pa 'di// theg chen pha rol phyin pa'i lugs// yun ring 'khor bas ma dub pa// snyugs ldan skyes bu'i nyams len yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma yis// rgyal ba thob par 'gyur ba ni// bdag gis srid pa ga la khogs// 'on kyang dka' ba nyid du gnas// theg chen bla med sngags kyi lugs// dgongs te gsungs pa tshe gcig gis// byang chub thob par bzhed pa yin// de yang dbang la rag las te// smin lam grol lam rtogs lam du// 'dod pa tha dad yod pa dang*// dbang 'bras bde gsal mi rtog nyams// dug gsum dang mtshungs rnam gsum la// byed pa tha dad du ma yod// bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med rgyud// rnam bzhi ston pas dkrugs 'di la// phal cher go ba ma skyes pas// sngags kyang dbang la rag las smra// dbang la dbang rtags gtsigs su che// dbang rten thabs dang shes rab ni// sha chang la sogs 'di dgos zhes// sngags las phyin ci log pa 'di// rin chen sngags las go ba med// phal cher ngu 'bod dmyal bar gzhol// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams pa yis// rab bkag rgyud rgyal sdom 'byung las// ha gsum la sogs dang bral ba// ci ste dam tshig can gyis btung*// sngags kyi dngos grub mi 'byung ste// de la dug 'gyur the tshom med// sngags pa chang gis rnam 'gyur ba// 'dod la rkam zhing 'khrig la sred// dgod cing glu yang de bzhin len// 'thab mo la spro rnam par 'khrug /smod cing nyams par gyur nas kyang*// ngu 'bod dmyal bar 'tshed par 'gyur// rnal 'byor ma rnams khros nas ni// de la nad dang mya ngan 'jigs// 'jigs par byed pas rnam gtse nas// sdig can dmyal bar 'khrid par byed// gsungs pa'i don la go ba med// sa stegs tshon dang sha chang la// brten nas rin chen dbang bzhi 'thob// 'dod la rkam pa'i sngags pa smra// 'on kyang ston pa'i gsung dang 'gal// yi ge ha ho hri gsum gyis// chang nyid bdud rtsi mthun snang du// bsgyur bar nus la ston pas gnang*// ha yis kha dog 'o ma nyid// ho yis nus pa chang las gzhan// hri yis nus pa rab bcom nas// bcom ldan rdo rje bsnams pas gnang*// ja dang 'o ma nyid dang mtshungs// de la chang nyid med pa nyid// de yi nus pa med gyur cing*// bza' dang btung ba 'dod pa yis// rang bas ngan pa'i blun rnams la// phyin ci log gi rdzas gsog cing*// sha dang chang dang bud med la// brten nas dbang bzhi bskur ba ni// sngags min sngags las phyin ci log

/be'u sprel g.yang la lhung ba ltar// gong du smos ltar ngu 'bod nyid// ral gri'i so dang sngags nyid mtshungs// der 'dir rdo rje 'dzin pa yis// dpa' bos dang por slob dpon dang*// slob ma'i 'brel pa brtag par gsungs// su dga' rang dgar bag med du// zhugs na gti mug can de phung*// thabs kyi rgyal po pha rgyud dang*// shes rab rgyal mo ma rgyud kyi// bcud dang snying po'i snying po ni// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yis// rtogs lam rin chen dbang bzhi la// brten nas sangs rgyas 'thob par bzhed// rin chen dbang bzhi bskur ba yi// bla ma mchog de shin tu dkon// de 'ang rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// rtogs lam dbang bzhi blang bar bya// de ltar dbang gi 'bras bu ni// dri med lhan skyes ye shes nyid// sems kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// nyams gsum dri mas ma gos pa// bsten nas dbang bzhi thob par bzhed// bzhi pa dbang 'bras nyid du 'dod// dbang gsum 'khor ba 'dzin byed nyams// bzhi pa lhan skyes rang gi sems// bla ma dam pas ngo sprod nas// tshe gcig sangs rgyas de la bya// des 'dir chos sgo dbang la rag /dbang yang bla ma mchog la rag /dbang bskur mkhan po sangs rgyas nyid// 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pa de// dran pa tsam gyis dbang bzhi 'thob// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skems// sngags lugs sngags kyi gzhung lam la// ji ltar gsungs pa'i yon tan rdzogs// rang sems 'od gsal chen po ni// de yi skad cig nyid la rtogs// dbang 'bras rin chen de la bya// des 'dir bla ma mchog de la// dbang dang dbang 'bras kun rag las// sa steng 'dzam gling gang du yang*// gzhan du btsal sa med par go// 'khrul pa med pa rje yi drin// thub pa'i rgyud sde rnams dang mthun// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab la// mgon po bla ma ma gtogs pa// gzhan gyi dring 'jog ga la byed// sems nyid 'od gsal chen po las// 'bras bu gzhan du ga la 'tshol// rtogs lam rin chen dbang bzhi ni// rang gi mngon sum byas gyur na// gzhan du tshol blo ga la skye// rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud ma lus pa// 'khrul pa med pa'i shes rab kyis// rin chen gter la longs spyod na// 'ching bu lta bu'i gang zag la// sngags dang dbang gi man ngag rnams// yod du re ba ga la srid// 'khor ba'i glang bu gti mug can// sngags ltar 'chos pa'i gang zag la// rin chen dbang bzhi ji ltar rnyed// mgon po bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// sa steng 'dzam gling gang du yang*// sngags dang dbang gi cho ga dang*// dbang don tshig dang yi ge dang*// rgyal ba'i mdo rgyud ma lus pa// rang nyid khungs su gyur pa la// gzhan du btsal sa ga la yod// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs pa// zung 'jug rgya mtsho sems nyid la// g.yo med 'od gsal chen por gcig

/rtogs na rin chen dbang bzhi 'thob// rtogs lam dbang du bla ma bzhed// rtogs lam yin pa'i go ba ni// rang nyid gdod nas sangs rgyas nyid// dbang gi de nyid shes par bya// ma rtogs rtogs par byed pa dbang*// bskur nas rtogs pa goms byed pa// bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis bsgom pa ni// skyed rim rang nyid gdod nas lha// sgrib gsum bral bar gnas pa la// kun brtags spros pas stong gyur cing*// rnam 'gyur gsum dang skad cig kyang*// 'bral ba med par nyams su blang*// dag pa he ru ka dpal nyid// sngags dang phyag rgya snying po ni// thams cad de nyid yin pa nyid// sngags nyid rdo rje bzlas pa yin// gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi gang*// dur khrod che ni gnas brgyad dang*// rab brjid shing chen brgyad dang ni// dga' bo la sogs klu brgyad sogs// nang ni bde chen mkha' 'gro bzhi// sgo ba sgo mtshams ma dang bcas// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis// rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba khyab// dga' bzhi rol pas rol mdzad pas// snyoms 'jug ha ha bde ba can// ho ho hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes 'byung*// hūm̐ gis de nyid rab tu 'phen// hūm̐ gis zhing skyong tshim par byed// hūm̐ nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// 'dzin pa chen po hūm̐ la gnas// srid gsum zil gnon yi ge hūm̐// thams cad yul nyid gzhan na med// khrag 'thung rgyal po bcom ldan bzhed// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing rnams dang*// 'du sa nye ba'i 'du sa kun// thams cad lus las gzhan med nyid// mdor na phung po lnga rnams ni// sangs rgyas lngar ni gsungs pa dang*// skye mched la sogs kun kyang de// rgyud rnams kun las gsungs pa yi// dkyil 'khor rgyas bsdus thams cad kun// thams cad rang gi lus 'di nyid// phyi rol yul la ma mchis par// thub pa chen po bla ma bzhed// de ltar rnal 'byor spyod pa yis// sngags ltar nyams su blangs gyur na// sa 'og dang ni mkha' spyod dang*// nyi shu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa'i// dngos grub rgyud du gang gsungs pa// ma lus rig 'dzin bdag gis 'thob// sngags nyid nyams su len pa yi// gang zag mchog de shin tu dkon// rin chen sngags kyang 'byung bar dka'// deng sang sgrub pa shin tu gces// kun kyang dam tshig mchog la gnas// yod na sngags kyi dngos grub 'thob// ston pas kye yi rdo rje las// thub pa sum cu rtsa gnyis mtshan// dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan// khu ba zhes bya rnam par grags// de med pa las bde mi 'byung*// lha yi rnal 'byor las bde 'byung*// gsungs pas 'di la 'di gnad che// lha nyid bde ba nyid la gnas// bde mchog rgyal po rang lha yin// rnal 'byor bdag gis bsgom par bya// rdzogs rim chos kun ma skyes pa// spros bral chen po nam mkha' la// phyogs ris med pa de nyid la// gong gi lha nyid rdzogs rim nyid// bskyed rdzogs gdod nas zung 'jug ste// lha nyid stong pa stong pa lha// stong pa stong pa stong pa nyid// chos rnams gdod nas ma skyes pa// rdzogs pa'i rim pa nyid du 'dod// bskyed rdzogs rnam gnyis gcig pa nyid// dbye ba med par nyams su blang*// de ltar rtag tu mnyam gzhag nyid// 'khor ba gting mtha' med pa 'di// ji srid stongs par ma gyur tshe// yon tan 'phrin las du ma ni// thogs pa med par 'byung ba yis// 'gro rnams byang chub mchog la 'god// rang dbang med pa'i rgyu 'bras yin// nyi ma shar bas mun sel bzhin// kha ba can gyi snying po yul gyi dbus// dpal ldan phag mo gru yi nags khrod du// shākya'i dge slong grags pa 'byung gnas dang*// rtag tu chos bzhin byed pa'i ston brtson gnyis// bla ma'i gsung la phan tshun gleng langs pas// mgon po'i gsung bzhin gsung sgros yi ger bris// de las byung ba'i bsod nams gang yin des// 'gro rnams chos rje'i go 'phang 'thob par shog

/dbang bzhi ma rdzogs so// // 39) ༄// log rtog sel ba'i sman rin chen 'byung gnas la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// bdag cag 'gro drug sems can rnams// thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol// kwa cis kyang mi phan 'chi ni 'chi// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can rnams// mtho la chags shing dma' la sdang*// bzang la phan 'dogs ngan pa la// mi 'dod smod cing 'tshe bar byed// 'di khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgyal po yin// 'gro drug bskyed pa'i ma ma yin// soms dang cis kyang dgos pa med// mtho dman bzang ngan thams cad la// chags dang sdang ba rtsad nas spang*// sems 'di mnyam pa nyid du bsgrub// blo 'di chags sdang med par bya// nga nga nga las che ba med// gzhan gyis bdag la brnyas pa byas// mchod cing bkur bsti byed pa chung*// bye brag 'di yis nga la brnyas// ngas kyang kho la ngas kyang gcig /ngar 'dzin bdud kyi rgyal po 'di// tshe 'di yi bsam pa can la 'khor// srid pa chags pa'i bsam pa de// sdug cing yid du 'ong rnams la// mthong thos dran pas dga' ba skye// phrad pas don chen grub par mthong*// 'grogs pas log g.yem sna tshogs 'grub// rgya shug tshig gur gyur pa ltar// des ji ltar byas kyang dga' ba skye// dad can bla mas gdungs pa'am// rus sbal rgya mtshor snyeg pa ltar// sems de de yi dbang du gyur// log sred chags pa'i 'khor lo 'dis// 'khor ba'i lo 'dab rgyas par byed// yon tan rgya mtsho 'joms par byed// thar pa'i gru chen 'jig par byed// ye shes rgya mtsho rtsad nas skems// deng 'dir chags sdang yul gnyis la// mnyam nyid smon 'jug rnam gnyis kyis// bde ba chen por kad kyis gtang*// da nas byang chub thob kyi bar// 'gro drug bzang ngan 'bring gsum gyi// khol po bdag yin bdag gis 'dir// dman dang bkren dang ngan pa rnams// byang chub snying po rnam mthong nas// de la gus shing dad pa bsgrub// zhe sa bcas pas bsu bar bya// stan gding phyag 'tshal bkur bsti bya// 'di mthon po chen por 'gro ba'i rgyu// dper na jo bo chen po bzhin// bzang ngan 'bring po thams cad la// gus dang zhe sar bcas pa yis// rang nyid 'og mar cag gis bya// phyag dang ldang ba bskur bsti sogs// ji ltar 'dzoms pa bsgrub par bya// byang chub sems dpa' ri bong gis// brgya byin mchod pa'i rjes su 'brangs// med pa btsal bas ga la rnyed// 'jigs so 'jigs so a dzi dzi// gshin rje'i rgyal po rab 'jigs pa// chags dang sdang ba'i bsam pa yin// de skyed par byed pa'i rtsa ba ni// nga nga nga bdag 'dzin pa yin// 'dzin pa nam mkha'i mdud pa yin// 'khrul lo 'khrul lo bdag cag 'khrul// 'dzin pa'i skyes bu mo gsham bus// ri bong rwa la zong du byas// rus sbal spu ni nor yin zhes// smig rgyu'i rgya mtsho snyog pa ltar// rnam dag nam mkha'i sems nyid la// chags sdang glo bur gyi sprin gyis dkrugs// nyon mongs dug gsum gyi 'brug sgra sgrogs// bdag 'dzin rdo rje yi ser ba 'bebs// mnyam nyid rin chen gyi lo thog de// rtsad nas btul te med par byas// 'khrul pas bslus pas bdag cag phung*// skyabs su mchi'o rin po che// bdag cag sems can thams cad la// skyabs gzhan du med do chos kyi rje// rje byin rlabs kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// chags sdang 'khor ba'i dba' klong 'di// mnyam nyid chen por bsgyur du gsol// snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs 'di// spros bral nam mkha' lta bu yin// rnam rtog mtho dman sna tshogs kun// zung 'jug lha dang lha mo yin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' yin// chags sdang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras 'di// gzhi med rten cing 'brel pa yin// bu nam mkha'i me tog ma 'thu mdzod// ku su lu spyan snga bas rin chen 'byung gnas la gdams pa log rtog sel ba'i sman zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// /

40) ༄// rtag tu nyams su blang bar bya ba'i man ngag slob dpon sgom tshul la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam zhing khams 'dir// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'phrin las kyis// dus rnams kun tu 'gro rnams skyob mdzad pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gus phyag 'tshal// nam mkha' lta bu'i rab yangs 'jig rtain 'dir// cho 'phrul sna tshogs khyab par ston pa'i mgon// brjod las 'das shing bsam du med pa'i skus// lhar bcas 'jig rten 'dren pa khyod phyag 'tshal// brjod med mtha' bral rgya mtsho lta bu'i gsung*// bden gsung dri med rnam par dag pa ni// tshang dbyangs ka la ping ka 'brug gi sgra// chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med nam mkha'i thugs// glo bur nyon mongs rnam rtog sprin dang bral// dus gsum mkhyen pa me long g.ya' bral 'dra// rnam dag nam mkha'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun gyi srog /dus gsum bdag nyid dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// sku gsung thugs nyid yon tan rgya mtsho la// rtag tu phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten 'dir// sgron me shākya'i rgyal po byon// zhi ba'i 'khor lo rnam gsum skor// rigs can gsum gyi gdul bya rnams// byang chub rnam pa gsum la bkod// dgung lo brgyad cu rtsa gnyis la// gyad kyi yul du mya ngan 'das// gnas brtan 'od srungs la sogs pa// dgra bcom rnams kyis bka' rnams bsdus// de rjes dgung lo bzhi brgya na// ston pa gnyis pa chos kyi rje// bstan pa'i mnga' bdag klu sgrub byon// ston pa'i bka' dang don 'grel rnams// ma lus thams cad rab tu brtsams// da ltar 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// thams cad mkhyen pa chos kyi rje// mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// de 'dra'i bla ma sngar ma byung*// phyis kyang 'byung ba ga la srid// mgon po de yi bzhed pa ni// dge dang mi dge gshis yin pas// gshis de 'gyur ba med pa yin// gal te mo gsham bu btsa' 'am// sbal pas ral pa thogs srid kyang*// de yi grub mtha' 'gyur ba med// nam mkha' dngos por 'gyur srid kyis// dge ba mi dger mi 'gyur zhing*// mi dge dge bar 'gyur thabs med// grub mtha' chen mo rgya mtsho bzhin// ston pa'i bka' rnams chu bo bzhi// dgra bcom rgyal po 'od srungs sogs// zag zad rnams kyi dam chos dang*// rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub dang*// rgyal tshab thob pa'i byams mgon gyis// legs brtsams mdo 'grel chen po rnams// chu g.yog lnga brgya dag dang mtshungs// chu bo bzhi dang chu g.yog rnams// rgya mtsho chen por gzhol zhing 'bab// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// dam chos grub mtha' chen mo 'dir// ston pa'i bka' dang mdo 'grel rnams// dbyer med gcig tu gzhol zhing 'bab// gang du dbye ba med snyam na// dge ba gshis kyis dge ba 'di// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad du// mi dger 'gyur ba'i skabs med pas// nyi shu lnga dang bdun gnyis la// bsnyen gnas phogs gcig srung ba de// gshis kyis dge ba ngo mtshar che// ston pa'i dgag bsgrub bslab pa gnyis// gshis kyi thog tu 'cha' bar mdzad// dge ba gshis kyis dge ba de// ston pas gshis de mkhyen gyur nas// sgrub pa'i bslab par bcas pa lags// lnga bdun gnyis kyi bsnyen gnas de// gshis kyi dge ba yin pas na// sgrub pa'i bslab pa de nyid yin// ston pas gsungs pa med snyam na// 'dul ba phran tshegs nyid nas ni// nye 'khor khyod kyis da phyin chad// dgag dang mthun pa thams cad kun// dgag pa'i bslab par mthun par smros// sgrub pa dang ni mthun pa rnams// sgrub pa'i bslab par smros ces gsungs// des 'dir lnga bdun bsnyen gnas la// tshes gcig nas ni gnam stong ngam// da nas ma shi'i bar du yang*// bsnyen gnas phogs gcig bsrung gyur na// sgrub pa'i bslab pa nyid dang mthun// des mthun sgrub pa'i bslab par ni// 'dul ba lung nas gsungs pa nyid// gong du smras pa kho nar zad// bcu bzhi dang ni bco lnga dang*// de bzhin zla phyed tshes brgyad dang*// cho 'phrul gyi ni zla ba la// bsnyen gnas yan lag bsrungs gyur na// nga yi bstan la lhags par 'gyur// mi pham mgon gyis gsungs pa dang*// ka ta ya na chen po yis// smad 'tshong ma dang shan pa la// nyin par log g.yem spong ba dang*// mtshan mo srog gcod spong ba yi// tshul khrims sdom pa phogs pa yis// shan pas mtshan mo srog gcod spangs// mtshan mo lha yi longs spyod thob// nyin par dmyal ba'i snang ba 'byung*// nyin par gzhan gyi srog gcod cing*// mtshan mo tshul khrims yon tan ldan// las de'i 'bras bu bzang po des// sdig to de ni myong bar gsungs// smad 'tshong ma yis nyin par ni// tshul khrims bsrungs par gyur pa dang*// mtshan mo chos ma yin pa spyad// nyin par lha yi longs spyod thob// mtshan mo dmyal ba'i snang ba 'byung*// las de'i 'bras bu bzang po dang*// sdig to de ni myong bar gsungs// chos che'o che'o ngo mtshar che// lung med rigs pa ma skyes pa// kha cig smra bar 'gyur ba ni// 'phags pa gnas brtan gang po ltar// bzod dang bzod pa chen po bsgom// glang chen me tog char pa bzhin// ma mthong ma thos ma rig pa'i// thabs la mkhas pa'i zhags pas bcings// gshog brkyang 'jig rten mgon po yi// gdul bya mang po 'dul bar nus// bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen jo bo bsgom// dge tshul dge slong sdom pa yis// 'gro ba mang po smin par mdzod// lhag pa tshul khrims ma gtogs pa// gnas skabs lha mi'i skye gnas dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub kyang*// 'thob par shin tu dka' gyur na// byang chub dam pa ga la 'thob// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// rnam thar mchog la gnas pa dang*// smon sems 'jug pa don dam gyis// skye bo mang po 'dul bar byos// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i bdud// 'khrul pa ye shes rdo rjes choms// bdag med byang chub sems gnyis la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// dgongs pa mya ngan 'da' kar yang*// lhar bcas 'jig rten ma lus kyi// bde dang skyid pa'i yon tan rnams// bsgoms pa'i mthu las 'byung zhes gsungs// phyi rol 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor gsod pa'i dug

/'du 'dzi g.yeng ba rab tu spang*// bdag nyid rnyed dang bkur stir bcas// bdag la mang po dga' 'o zhes// de 'dra'i snyems pas snyem byed na// 'chi ba'i dus su 'jigs pa skye// chos dang rang sems 'dres pa gces// rnam smin phra ba'i phra ba la// 'dzem pa de bas shin tu gces// sgrub pa snying por byed par rigs// sgom rtags nyon mongs chung ba yin// nang gi nyon mongs ma spangs na// sgom chen bzang yang bsgoms pas phung*// lnga brgya lon yang a chu ta// rtsa bzhi bsten yang a rog khya// sgoms shig sgoms shig skyes bu khyed// spongs shig spongs shig g.yeng ba spongs// cis kyang mi phan 'chi ba la// spros pa bcad nas ma bsgoms na// 'khor ba rang dgar ga la ldog /des na thub mgon rgyal ba rnams// byang chub sems dpar spyod pa'i tshe// dben dang nags khrod dgon par bzhugs// 'du 'dzi'i g.yeng ba rab tu bcom// zas gos bde ba rab spangs te// chog shes pa yi thugs kyis gnas// a ka ta yi skyes rabs las// chog shes pa yi bdag nyid can// 'tsho ba gang na'ang rnyed mi dka'// rtsa ba lo ma chu yi gnas// gang na'ang med pa ma yin no// gsungs pa nyid kyis shes par bya// ting 'dzin rnams dang mngon shes rnams// dgon pa dben par gnas pas 'thob// kwa ye slob dpon sgom tshul khyed// lus dang sems ni dben pa yi// dgon par rtag tu bzhugs par zhu// sdug cing phongs par gyur pa'i tshe// mdun gyi nam mkha' 'di nyid la// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// bzhi brtsegs gdan la bzhugs par bsam// skyon med ma 'dal legs phyis te// sdug bsngal 'di las thar pa dang*// skyon dang yon tan rdzogs mdzad gsol// gsol ba lan gsum gdab par bya// spyi bo nas ni lus la bstim// bde ldan gnas mchog dam par bzhugs// gnas der bla ma bzhugs pa la// rtag tu mos gus 'dun pa bya// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa dang*// tshe ring nad med bsod nams 'phel// snyan pa'i rgya mtshos sa steng 'gengs// yum 'gyur mkha' 'gro'i pho brang der// rtag tu rnal 'byor ma rnams bzhugs// sngags kyi ting 'dzin dngos grub ster// nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i gnas rnams dang*// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams kun// rtag tu gnas kyi mchog der bzhugs// dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor la// sngags kyi dngos grub ster bar byed// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la dang*// mkha' 'gro 'bral ba med do skad// nyams myong can gyi zhu yas la// sngags kyi ting 'dzin mnga'o skad// rnam rtog spangs pa'i nag chung la// ma dang mkha' 'gro 'du'o skad// rnal 'byor dbang phyug birwa ba pas// nyi ma gte'u mar bzung ngo skad// de dag kun kyang gnas mchog der// sngags kyi ting 'dzin mthu yis bsgrubs// gsang sngags ting 'dzin 'di las med// thabs kyi rgyal po pha rgyud dang*// shes rab rgyal mo ma rgyud kyi// dgongs pa gnas kyi mchog der ni// mnyam med bla ma dam pa la// rtag tu mos gus mdzad cing bzhugs// ji ltar gyur kyang btub nas mchi// dpal ldan phag mo gru yi nags tshal nas// byang chub thob par 'dod pa'i blo yis gnas gyur pa'i// sbyang sdom brtul zhugs spyod pa'i ku sā lis// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma dam pa'i sras// dad pa'i mchog dang shes rab dbyer med pas// phyogs kyi mun pa sel ba'i rnal 'byor pa// slob dpon sgom tshul nyid la springs pa lags// ji ltar bde gshegs sku gzugs shing las kyang*// bgyis pa ci 'dra rung ste mkhas pas mchod// de bzhin bdag gi snyan ngag 'di ngan yang*// dam chos brjod la brten slad smad mi bgyi// thub pa chen po'i bka' ni snyan dgu zhig

/khyod kyi thugs su lta'ang chud mod kyis// rdo thal las bgyis dgung zla'i 'od kyis ni// ches dkar nyid du ci ste mi 'gyur lags// 'phags pas gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang bar gyis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor gnas pa'i 'gro ba rnams// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol// rgyal bas lung bstan sgam po pa// mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// rgyal tshab thob pa'i byams mgon dang*// 'od dpag med pa bcom ldan gyis// bdag dang sems can ma lus pa// thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol// 'gro ba'i sgron me 'jam dbyangs dang*// thugs rje mchog mnga' 'phags ma dang*// lung bstan thob pa'i klu sgrub kyis// bdag dang sems can ma lus rnams// tshad med thugs rjes bskyab tu gsol// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro rnams// dran pas snying ni 'gas 'gyur zhing*// sdug bsngal bzod par dka' ba las// skyobs shig skyobs shig bskyab tu gsol// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// bla med gdul bya mchog tu ni// byang chub dam pa thob par shog /rtag tu nyams su blang bar bya ba'i man ngag gces pa'i yi ge slob dpon sgom tshul la springs pa rdzogs so/// pa gnyis// rtog dang rnam par mi rtog las// gzhan du med par dgongs par mdzad// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// rnam par rtog pa rnam gsum las// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// ngan song gsum po 'byung bar nges// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// bzang po'i rtog pa rnam gsum las// lha gnas gong ma 'byung bar nges// bzang ngan bar ma'i rtog pa las// lha gnas 'og ma rnams dang ni// mi nyams su myong*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' med 'dir// da phyis 'khor bar mi nus shing*// sdug bsngal bzod par dka' bas na// rtog pa'i rba rlabs rgya mtsho skam// 'phags pa klu sgrub zhal nas kyang*// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// gsungs pa'i don 'di dgongs par mdzod// 'jam dpal mtshan brjod dag las kyang*// rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub// dus gsum sangs rgyas las byed pa// gsungs pa'i don 'di go bar mdzod// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid 'di// rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i phyir// 'gro 'ong med pa'i rin po che// rtag tu byang chub gling na bzhugs// rtog dang rnam rtog ma mchis shing*// lhun grub 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// sems nyid ma skyes skye med la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// mi rtog rtog med lhun gyis grub// nyon mongs rnam rtog mtshan ma dang*// bral bar rtag tu mnyam par zhog

/nam mkha' sprin dang khug sna bral na nyi zla gsal// rgya mtsho chu yi rnyog ma dwangs na gzugs brnyan gsal// sems nyid rtog pa spangs na mkhyen pa gsal// gong mas gsungs pa'i don 'di go bar mdzod// spang bya rnam rtog yin gyis spong ba yi// brtul zhugs zungs shig ri khrod rnal 'byor pa// gnyen po mi rtog 'di las gzhan pa yi// dam chos logs su med par dgongs par mdzod// lar 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa yin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yang*// zung 'jug gnyis su med pa yin// 'di spang blang med pa'i dus tshod yin// phyis nyams su blang ba'i dam chos lags// bu rtag tu nyams su blang bar zhu// nad dang gnod pa sdug bsngal dang*// rkyen mi mthun du ma langs pa na// lam gtong sems bskyed yi dam dang*// bla ma phyag rgya chen po dang*// bsngo ba'i chos kyis nyams su blang*// grib dang sgrib pa nad rnams dang*// gdon dang bar chad thams cad kun// 'og gi 'jig rten mtha' med par// mar bsring ba'i sbyor bas gdon par bya// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// phan pa'i sman yin rtag tu bsgom// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/ ti se bsod nams dpal la gdams pa'o// // 42) ༄// mi rtag dran bskul dge slong tshul khrims rgyal la gdams pa//

oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin chen dang*// rgyal ba byams mgon de nyid phyag 'tshal lo// tshe 'di mi rtag skad cig glog dang 'dra// sdug bsngal mtha' med 'khor ba spang bar dka'// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel soms dang chos kyi bu// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba ma lus rnams// bdag med las byung byang chub sems kyis su// legs par sgrubs pa'i brtson 'grus chen po brtsam// rnam 'gyur gsum dang ma 'bral sngags ltar spyod// tshig ngan mda' de bzod pa'i phub kyis longs// gnod cing gshe ba'i skyes bu gang byung yang*// phan 'dogs bzhin du de la gus par byos// rang byung phyag rgya chen po nyams su longs// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis bsag par bya// shin tu phra ba'i dngos po gang la yang*// bsgrub par bya zhing khyad du ma gsod dang*// dngos pos phongs pa med pa'i rten 'brel yin// phra dang rags pa'i rgyu 'bras sems la zhog /rgyu med 'bras bu 'byung ba ga la srid// skyes bu dam pa la ni bsten pa dang*// tshul khrims g.yag rnga bzhin du bsrung bar bya// ha cang mthun dang 'gras pa'i sems spangs te// mnyam pa nyid du spyod par gnas par bya// ji ltar gyur kyang nyon mongs gsum po la// sems gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bsgom par bya// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod spyod par gyis// phyogs nas byon pa'i 'gron po dge 'dun la// pha ma bla ma bzhin du mdun nas bsu// spyan drangs gdan bting ji ltar 'os pa yi// bsnyen bkur bya zhing dga' ba bsgrub par bya// bzhud pa'i dus su ji ltar 'os par bskyal// snyan pa'i tshig gis bde bar bzhud ces brjod// byang chub sems dpa' ri bong gyur pa'i tshe// brgya byin bram zer sprul par gyur pa las// bsu bskyel bkur sti mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brang*// lar 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yin// mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer de// nga med bdag med stong pa yin// nga bdag med pa'i stong pa de// rang sems rig pa'i rgyal po yin// rig pa'i ye shes rdo rje ni// skye med stong pa bdag dang bral// bdag med stong pa rang sems la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// res 'ga' spros med bse ru ltar// nags kyi nang du bsdad la bsgom// res 'ga' ri khrod nags khrod dang*// dgon pa rnams su bsdad la bsgom// res 'ga' grong khyer tshong 'dus dang*// skye bo mang po'i nang du bsgom// skye shi srid pa rmi lam gyi// bar do gsum po des bgrod byed// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho de// rang sems rtogs dang sgoms pas spong*// sems kyi rgyal po de nyid yin// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnam gnyis// zung du chud pas nyams su longs// dkar po chig thub 'di nyid yin// snying la yod pa'i gsang tshig 'di// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes byas shing*// mnye btul bsgyur bzlog ci byas kyang*// mos gus ltem rkyang med pa dang*// bdag gi drin gyis rang sems rtogs// nyams gsum dri ma spangs pa yi// dgos pa'i rdo rje tshul rgyal la// nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di// bstan pas 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog/

// 43) ༄// slob dpon grags pa la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// bdag gzhan thams cad bskyab pa dang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// tshe 'di dang bar do phyi ma dang*// bla med byang chub bar du ni// nyams len thabs dang shes rab yin// thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa ni// ha cang zhum min thal ba min// mkhas pa'i spyod par gnas par bya// 'khor dang gnyen 'dun phyogs rnams la// ma chags mi sdang spyad pas gnas// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// chos ltar spyod pa shin tu gces// dgra dang gnyen 'dun thams cad kyis// ha cang zhum na rtag tu brnyas// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' ltar// thog mar smra dang ran par smra// zhum med 'jigs pa med par smra// thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa de// ston pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'di// rnam dag 'od gsal chen po yin// tshogs dang dben pa gar 'dug kyang*// 'di dang 'bral ba med par mdzod// lar chos dang sems su 'dres pa gces// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman// phyogs rnams kun tu khyab par bsgom// dgra bgegs bdud dang bar chad rnams// bskyed rim lha yis gzhom par bya// tshe dang dbang phyug bsod nams rnams// bcom ldan 'phags ma sgrol ma la// gsol gdab rtag tu gus pa bskyed// 'gro ba nam mkha' mnyam pa la// spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yis// rtag tu skyob par mdzad par zhu// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa dang*// bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen sdom pa rnams// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyis// nyams thag sdug bsngal can rnams bskyab// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs dang*// snyan pa'i tshig gis 'gro ba rnams// rang dbang med par sdud par zhu// brtson 'grus chen po rtsom pa dang*// btang snyoms rtag tu spong bar byos// tsha ba'i nad la ga bur ltar// dug gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di// thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po yis// byams pa chen pos zhi bar mdzod// chen po'i rigs su sku 'khrungs shing*// glang po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// bag med cal col spyod pa spang*// slob dpon grags pa'i nyams len mdzod// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog

/rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog/ // 44) ༄// ri pa byams sems la gdams pa// khyaud kyis nyon mongs rnam rtog dang*// rgod dang 'gyod dang the tshom dang*// gnyid rmugs bsam gtan sgrib pa rnams// spongs la rang sems tha ba thul// rang byung dri ma med pa'i nyams// lkugs pa bzhin du bskyang bar bya// sems nam mkha'i dkyil ltar 'dug pa de// phyag rgya chen po'i rang nyams yin// rang sems skye ba med pa de// rnam rtog lhad kyis ma bslad cig /rang rgyud byin gyis rlob pa yi// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// the tshom rtog pa ma skyed cig /phyi rol snang ba sna tshogs 'di// lha dang lha mo yin pa la// tha mal zhen pa ma che zhig /mched grogs bla ma yin pa la// log pa'i rtog pa ma skyed cig /yon tan bskyed par byed pa yi// tshul khrims sa gzhi yin pa la// nyes ltung rgyud la med par mdzod/// / 45) ༄// lnga ldan bdud rtsi'-i thigs pa slob dpon sangs rgyas la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ yang dag lta ba bzang po'i rjes 'brangs nas// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// byams dang snying rje byang sems rin po che// 'chi med bdud rtsi rnam gsum nyams su blang*// de las skyes pa'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs// dbyer med rnam gsum rtag tu bsags par bya/ /lha dang bla ma ma skyes stong nyid gsum// rtag tu mi 'bral mnyam par gzhag par bya// bsngo ba smon lam sems nyid skye med gsum// rjes kyi chos kyis nyams su blang bar byos// lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i thigs pa zhes bya ba slob dpon sangs rgyas la gdams pa'o// // 46) ༄// bya ba'i rim pa slob dpon sgom ye la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// mi zad gter chain 'gro ba'i mgon// bde skyid ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas// mnyam med bla mar skyabs su mchi// thub pa chen po chos kyi rje// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po yi// sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// ma lus bsdus pa don gyi mchog

/thabs dang shes rab gnyis su bstan// kun rdzob byang sems rin po ches// khyad par byas pa'i lus ngag yid// rnam gsum rnam par dag par spyad// lus rnam par dag pa'i bya ba yis// bla ma dge 'dun dkon mchog gi /zhabs 'bring zhabs tog bya ba'i phyir// lus ltos pa med pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// shin tu phra dang rags pa yi// lus kyi bya ba sna tshogs kyis// lus rul ba don dang ldan pa dang*// rang don dug ltar spang bya ste// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs tog tu// lus kyi bya dang byed pa yis// dus gsum 'phags pa mchod pa dang*// 'gro dang 'dug dang nyal ba yi// spyod lam rnam bzhi gang byed kyang*// shin tu phra ba'i bya ba nas// rags pa chen por gyur pa rnams// don dang 'bras bur ldan par bya// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// zhe sgom la sogs mkhas pa rnams// med pa'i dus su tshol bar byed// dkon pa'i dus su gtong bar byed// gsungs pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya// dgos pa'i dus su med pa dang*// mi dgos dus su yod pa yi// gti mug spangs la mkhas par spyad// shin tu phra ba'i dngos po rnams// rags par gyur pa'i brtul zhugs zungs// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// snyan pa'i ba dan la tshogs pa'i// skal ldan khri phrag du ma'i tshogs// rnam par dag pa'i dge 'dun la// bre 'u re dang zho 'u re// yod na bla ma dkon mchog dang*// gling rin po che dang 'bral ba med// med na phye ltom snyad btags nas// tsho cig byi bor 'gyur bar 'dug /'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// thub chen sangs rgyas bstan pa 'di// gtong ba dang po med gyur na// bya gshog pa chag pa 'phur mi nus// de dang 'dra bar bdag gis kyang*// ka dang ca dang dngos po la// ma brten gzhan don mi nus pas// lus dang srog la ma lta bar/ lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yis// bdag la dgos pa thams cad zhu// bu dang khams gsum sems can rnams// byang chub thob par ngas khas blang*// brtson 'grus brtsam pa'i dus la bab// phan pa 'gyur na rang gi lus/

/btsongs te thams cad btang gyur na// bla ma dam pa mnyes pa dang*// dul ba'i dpal ldan dge 'dun skyongs// mi lus rin chen thob par dka'// nor bu rin chen lta bu yi// bla ma'i zhabs tog byed pa dkon// shin tu phra ba'i bya ba res// dus gsum 'phags pa mchod pa dang*// khams gsum sems can smin pa de// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// lus kyi bya ba'i rim par bstan// ngag gi spyod pa 'di ltar bsgrub// chags sdang rmongs pa spangs pa'i ngag /bden gtam snyan par smra ba'i ngag /don dam 'jam por smra ba'i ngag /tshur spyon phar gshegs 'di ltar mdzod// thams cad don dang ldan par smra// don med mu cor smra ba spang*// gzhan la gnod cing rtsub pa'i ngag /mi snyan rtsub par smra ba spang*// phan dang bde ba 'byung ba'i ngag /phan dang bde ba 'byung bar smra// grogs dang 'khor dang gnyen 'dun la// 'jam zhing des pa'i ngag gis ni// dbugs dbyung phebs par smra bar bya// snyan tshig springs yig lta bu'i ngag /legs tshig rgyan dang 'dra bar smra// phan par smra zhing gnod bsal ngag /smra bas gzhan don bsgrub par bya// byang chub sems dpa' rang don spang*// gzhan don bsgrub pa chos nyid lags// gzhan phan rang don yin par gsungs// nor dang ka dang ca dang gsum// mkhas pa bdag 'dra rnal 'byor la// yod na zhing bsam dngos po gsum// rten 'brel bsgrig la mkhas phyir dang*// 'phags pa mchod la sems can smin// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel dang*// nam mkha' lta bu'i rten 'brel dang*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel pa la// sgrub la rnal 'byor nga mkhas pas// 'jig rten 'khor lo bsgyur rgyal gyi// bsod nams stobs las byung ba yi// khyim bdag rin chen dgos 'dod sgrubs// chu bo'i gzhung dang ri bo'i sul// gang du rgyal po bzhed pa rnams// med ces bya ba rnam spangs dang*// gang bzhed 'bul bar byed pa ltar// bus kyang de bzhin bsgrub par byos// byed pa de yi rjes su 'brang*// sems can yul la 'phags pa'i zhing*// sgrub pa rten 'brel rdzas la rag

/rkang gnyis mchog gyur rnam gzigs la// lho nas 'ongs pa'i 'bru tshong gis// sran rdog phyed dang lnga phul bas// gling bzhi lha yul la dbang ba'i// 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal por gyur// mthar thug byang chub sangs rgyas pa// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan lags// brtson 'grus chen po rtsom par gyis// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i brtsi bldab bya// phra dang rags pa'i rnam smin la// lus dang srog ltar 'dzem par bya// ngag gi bya ba'i rim pa bstan// sems kyi bya ba bsgrub pa ni// chags sems sdang ba spangs pa'i sems// rmongs sems gdug par 'gyur ba'i sems// sdang sems zhe sdang spangs pa'i sems// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'i sems// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// 'gro la phan dang bde ba rnams// ji ltar byas na 'grub pa'i sems// gzhan gyi gnod pa gang yin pa// bdag gis ji ltar bsal bya'i sems// lhag bsam rnam par dag pa yi// stobs la rtag tu gnas par bya/ chags sems sdang sems rmongs sems kyi// sems la rgyu 'gruul gcad par bya// byams dang snying rje byang sems ky-is// bla ma dge 'dun ma lus pa'i// zhabs tog bdag gis bsgrub par bya// ji ltar byas na 'grub pa dang*// mi 'grub 'gyur ba ma lus bsam// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// bsams nas byed pa mkhas par gsungs// bag med ma bsam bya ba spang*// chog shes khrel yod ngo tsha can// 'dod pa chung zhing chos la dga'// bla ma la gus bya ba brtson// de 'dra'i gang zag bsams nas btsal// 'dod zhen che la ngoms pa med// byis pa'i chos la gnas pa dang*// smyon pa yin phyir bsten mi bya// chog shes khrel yod ngo tsha can// thams cad bsams nas byed pa ni// ston pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsungs// sems kyi bya ba'i rim par bstan// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// nga yi bstan pa'i ngo bo ni// snying rjes rab tu phye bar gsungs// 'phags pa thogs med snying rje che// 'gro la chags pas kun chags mdzad// des na gzhan srog srung ba'i thabs// ston dang dgun stod mi gtong dang*// dpyid dang dbyar stod gtong ba yi// rim pa sngar yang khyod la yod// da rung de ltar mdzad par zhu// lar 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// snying dang 'dra ba'i bu la ni// bdag gis gdams ngag bstan par bya// 'jig rten 'di yi bsam pa thongs// dpal ldan nā ro chen po nas// 'gro ba'i mgon po yan chod kyi// thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes mchog

/kun rdzob byang sems rin chen dang*// gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo ni// nam mkha' rnam par dag pa 'dra// ma skyes mi gnas ngo bo med// nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba'am// rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba ltar// sems rnam dag nam mkha'i ngo bo de// 'gro 'ong gnyis dang bral ba dang*// rtog spyod blo dang bral ba dang*// ngang gis 'gro ba rtsol ba med// de ltar mnyam par gzhag par bya// ji ltar nyi ma nub phyogs su// rtsol ba med par 'gro ba ltar// de ltar mnyam par gzhag par bya// ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po yi// 'dom dgu'i rba rlabs zhi gyur na// g.yo med 'gul ba med pa ltar// de ltar mnyam par gzhag par bya// rang ngang gis 'gro bar rgyun mi chad// lta ba mthar thug de la bya// ngo bo nyid kyis rtsol ba med// sgom pa mthar thug de la bya// gong gi lus ngag yid gsum gyi// bya ba'i rim pa bstan pa dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// byed spyod 'du byed dngos po rnams// rnam par dag pas nam mkhar spyad// skye ba med pa stong par spyad// spyod pa rnam par dag pa yin// lta sgom spyod gsum nam mkha' 'dra// nam mkha' stong pa nyid yin la// nam mkha' nam mkhas stong pa ltar// stong pa stong pas stong pa yin// rnam dag 'od gsal chen po la// mnyam par zhog cig rnal 'byor pa// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis po// rgyun mi chad par nyams su longs// mdor na 'jig rten bsam pa thongs// de ltar shes rab zab mo 'di// rab tu zhi zhing nye bar zhi// thub pa chen po bcom ldan gyis// rgyu 'di 'dra bsgrubs pas byang chub thob// dang po byang chub thugs bskyed nas// grangs med rnam pa gsum du ni// rim pa gong du bstan pa ltar// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa yis// 'gro ba ma rnams smin byas nas// sa bcu lam lnga bgrod nas ni// byang chub snying por gshegs gyur nas// gnyug ma byams chen ting 'dzin gyis// srod la bdud kyi dkyil 'khor btul// rdo rje lta bu'i ting 'dzin gyis// tho rengs byang chub rnam sangs rgyas// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// bu la ji ltar bstan pa ltar// spyad pa'i 'bras bu yin par zungs// rgyu med 'jig rten sangs rgyas su// 'gyur bar srid pa ga la yod// byang chub mchog tu sangs rgyas nas// bdun phrag bdun gyi zhag 'das nas// wā rā ṇa sīr gshegs gyur te// lnga sde lha rnams brgyad khri dang*// byang chub sems dpa' chen po mchog

/sems ni bskyed ma thag tu yang*// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor la sogs// 'khor lo dang pos 'dul rnams la// bden bzhi chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi 'bras// sdug bsngal kun 'byung nyid du ni// 'khor ba bskyed pa spang byar bstan// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med// sems des khyad par byas pa'i las// 'bras bu byang chub thob par gsungs// lam bden 'gog pa'i bden pa ste// bsgrub bya nyid du ston pas bstan// dam chos 'khor lo de bstan pas// lnga sde bzang pos dgra bcom thob// lha rnams brgyad khris bden pa mthong*// sems bskyed chos 'khor bskor la sogs// dpag med du ma 'dul bar mdzad// chos 'khor dang po skor gyur 'dis// ston pa'i thugs dgongs dang po rdzogs// de 'gog pa'i bden par bstan pa yin// de ltar nyams su blang ba'i tshul// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// las dang bcas pa spyod pa ni// kun 'byung rgyu ru bstan pa yin// 'bras bu yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'dir// 'khor ba sdug bsngal bden pa yin// spang bya 'khor ba 'byung bar bstan// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// sdug bsngal kun 'byung 'khor ba ste// 'bras bu ngan song gsum la sogs// kun 'byung bden gnyis chos 'di ni// spang bya nyid du bstan pa yin// spongs shig skyes bu dam pa khyed// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug med// de yis khyad par byas pa'i las// rtag tu spyod par gyis shig dang*// 'bras bu byang chub rnam gsum 'thob// 'gog pa 'phags pa'i bden pa yin// chos kyi 'khor lo dang po 'di// spang bya gnyen po gnyis dang ni// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'byung ba dang*// mya ngan 'das pa thob pa'i chos// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi rtsa bar bstan// thub chen rgyal po'i khab gshegs te// gong gi bden pa bzhi po dang*// spang bya gnyen po rnam gnyis bcas// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos// thams cad stong pa nyid du gsungs// zab pa shes rab snying po las// sdug bsngal kun 'byung lam dang ni// lam dang ye shes stong par gsungs// don gyi dngos por bsdus pa ni// 'phags pa brgyad stong mdo las kyang*// sems de sems ma yin pas na// bstan pas the tshom thams cad bcad// rang bzhin don de 'gyur med cing*// nyon mongs rnam rtog med par bstan// rgyas 'bring gsum dang sde tshan drug

/thams cad 'od gsal stong par bstan// stong pa stong pas stong pa dang*// ma skyes skye ba med par bzhag /chos kyi 'khor lo bar pa 'dis// nyan thos rnams kyis mnyam nyid la// dri ba dri dang lan 'debs pa'i// spobs pa skyes par gyur ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa' bye ba rnams// sems bskyed byang chub lung bstan thob// rang rgyal byang chub 'thob pa yi// rgyu yang legs par thob par mdzad// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// spyod pa spyod ltar nyams blangs pa'i// 'bras bu gnyis pa rim par bstan// chos 'khor bar pa bskor ba 'dis// thub pa'i thugs dgongs gnyis pa rdzogs// gyad yul chu bo gser ldan 'gram// cod pan bcings pa'i mchod rten drung*// ston pas chos kyi 'khor lo ni// gsum pa legs par bskor ba'i don// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub dang*// zhi ba rnam gnyis med par gsungs// theg pa thams cad gcig tu gzhag /byang chub sems dpa'i theg par bstan// nyan thos rang rgyal theg dman rnams// dam chos pad ma dkar la sogs// chos kyi de nyid bstan rnams su// de dag sngar 'dzin las bzlog ste// byang chub dam par lung yang bstan// bla med theg par gcig tu gzhag /mya ngan 'das pa'ang gcig tu gzhag /'jig rten sangs rgyas ma gtogs pa// mya ngan 'das pa med par bstan// gsal dang dag dang 'phro phyir dang*// tha dad med phyir 'od dang zer// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor rnams dang mtshungs// des na sangs rgyas ma thob par// mya ngan 'das pa mi 'thob ste// 'od dang 'od zer spangs pa yi// nyi ma blta bar mi nus bzhin// bla med byang chub ma thob par// nyan thos rang rgyal la sogs la// mya ngan 'da' ba med par gsungs// theg pa thams cad gcig tu gzhag /bla na med pa'i theg pa nyid// sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' zhing*// dam chos nub par mi 'gyur zhes/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i mdo las gsungs// gtsang dang bde dang rtag par ni// ston pas legs par bstan pa 'dis// chos kyi 'khor lo tha ma yi// 'dug lugs lhag ma ma lus par// thub pas gyad kyi yul du bstan// dkon mchog gsum po rtag pa dang*// brjod bya gnyis su shes par bya// chos kyi 'khor lo tha ma 'di// rnam bzhi 'khor dang stong gsum 'dir// gnas pa'i sems can rnams la bskor// 'od srungs ba lang bdag po las// gzhan pa ma 'dus gcig kyang med// bstan pa gnas bstan 'od srungs dang*/

/kun dga' bo la legs par gtad// chos kyi 'khor lo dang po la// bar pa'i sa bon bzhag pa ni// sdug bsngal dag ni spang du med// lam ni rgyud la bsten du med// 'gog pa mngon du byar med gsungs// chos 'khor tha ma'i sa bon 'di// chos 'khor bar pa nyid la gzhag /gang la sems dang yid shes mthong med pa// chos kyi 'khor lo tha ma'i sa bon de// chos kyi 'khor lo bar par bzhag pa ni// chos kyi 'khor lo rnam gsum bskor ba 'di// gang zag dbang po blo yi bye brag dang*// lnga sde la sogs 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor gyi// khrid kyi rim pa nyid du bstan pa yin// 'khor lo gsum pa bskor ba re re yang*// 'khor lo gsum gsum nyid du gnas pa dang*// gzhan yang 'di yi 'dug lugs bye brag rnams// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// 'ong ge ma las shes par bya bar zad// mi rnams 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur ba dang*// dam chos 'khor lo legs par bskor ba rnams// rgyu yi dus kyi lus ngag yid gsum las// rnam par dag par gong ltar spyad gyur pas// 'bras bu 'di 'dra 'thob par nges pas 'dir// 'jig rten sangs rgyas nyi ma 'char 'dod na// chos kyi 'khor lo legs par bskor 'dod na// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba'i rim pa rnams// gong du smras ltar legs par spyod cig dang*// the tshom med par 'jig rten rgyal bar 'gyur// dus gsum rgyal ba'i mchod rten phag mo gru// byang chub snying po dpal gyi 'bri gung dang*// mnyam med bla ma gong ma yab sras dang*// da ltar ngan bur bcas pa'i zhabs tog dang*// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dbye ba med// mnyes pa gsum gyis bla ma mnyes byed pa// brtul zhugs brtson 'grus mchog dang ldan gyur zhing*// dad dang gus pa'i sems dang 'bral ba med// rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i rnal 'byor pa// shākya'i dge sbyong ye shes dpal la gdams// bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// rga nad 'chi ba'i rba klong 'khrug pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba ma lus 'don par shog
/bya ba'i rim pa'i man ngag shākya'i dge slong spyan snga bas ye shes dpal la gdams pa rdzogs so/// /

47) ༄// lnga ldan rin po che'i phreng ba rin ye la gdams pa// om̐ swasti// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen dang*// dri med rgyal ba phag mo gru pa dang*// dus gsum bde gshegs sras dang bcas rnams la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// bu chos dang rang sems 'dres par bya// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel la// brtsi bldab yang dang yang du bya// phan sems rgya mtsho lta bu dang*// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// rtag tu chos ltar spyod pa gces// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnam gnyis// rgyun chad med par gsog pa dang*// thabs dang shes rab rnam gnyis la// bag dang ldan pas gnas par bya// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa ni// lus dang srog bzhin bsrung bar bya// sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi// yon tan tshul khrims rin chen las// 'byung bar thub pas legs par gsungs// lus dang sems dang snang ba gsum// nang gi rten 'brel gcig pu yin// rnam gsum rnam dag byang chub sems// rtag tu bsgom pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam// sems de las skyes pa'i bskyed rim lha// kun brtags spros pa bral ba bsgom// dbang gi rgyal po chos kyi rje// zab pa'i gsang gnas dam par bsgom// dus gsum 'khor 'das ma lus kun// mi rtog 'od gsal chen por gzhag /dge ba byang chub dam par bsngo// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid ni// rtog pa thams cad spangs pa de// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo yin// dri med shes rab mig gis ni// chos dang chos min rab phye nas// dam chos spyod la gnas pa dang*// chos min dug bzhin spang bar bya// lar bag dang ldan par spyod pa gces// bag med spyod pa spang ba dang*// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// mkhas pa'i rjes su 'brang bar bya/ /bag med brlag pa'i 'byung khungs yin// spyir la kha'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// rkyen gyi dbang du mi gtang bar// rang tshugs brtan por gzung bar bya// yang zhing gzhag sa med pa la// yon tan mi skye brnyas pa mang*// gzhan gyi shes lon rtsi tshad chung*// de 'dra mang po bdag gis mthong*// brtan pa ri bo lta bur bya// zab pa rgya mtsho lta bur bya// phan tshun rkyen gyis mi 'gyur bar// rdo rje lta bur gnas par bya// ngag gi smra blag nyung ba dang*// don ldan tshig rnams smra ba las// 'brel med mu cor smra ba spang*// lkugs pa bzhin du gnas par bya// gzhan gyi tshig ngan thos pa dang*// gshe zhing rdeg dang spyo ba la// phan 'dogs sman dang 'dra bar sgoms// khro 'khrug bsam pa rab spang zhing*// bzod la gnas pas yon tan 'thob// thams cad kun la gus pa dang*// mchog dang dman pa ma lus rnams// yi dam lhar bsgom mos gus bya// yul dman gsum po spang ba dang*// shes rab rnam gsum bsten par bya// dge dang bde ba 'byung ba'i gnas// dam pa rnams la bsten par bya// dman pa'i sdig grogs spong ba dang*// dge ba'i bshes la bsten par bya// gser snod dngul snod dang 'dra bar// nyams myong dang rtogs pa zab mo dang*// bla ma'i gdams ngag ma lus pa// kha zags 'thor bur ma shor bar// snod dang ldan par bsrung bar bya// yon tan rin chen ma lus dang*// bde dang skyid pa'i dpal rnams kun// gong ma bkur las 'byung bar gsungs// dman la sdang ba spang zhing brnyas mi bya// mnyam nyid rin chen sems la gnas pa dang*// 'gro ba kun la ma bzhin byams pa yis// skyon rnams mi brjod yon tan smra bar bya// yul dang phyogs kyi spros pa bcad// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod rnams// 'grim pa'i go cha chen po gzung*// dam pa rnams kyi rjes su 'brang*// nyon mongs gsum dang rnam smin rnams// rtag tu spong ba'i brtul zhugs zungs// lar snying dang rus pa 'dzoms pa dang*// chos la gnas pas chos min spang*// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// 'gro mgon rin chen rjes su 'brang*// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// mgon po tshe dpag med la sogs// sangs rgyas rnams la gus pa dang*// dad pa'i sems dang ma bral bar// gtan gyi skyabs gnas nyid du bya// byams mgon 'phags pa klu sgrub sogs// chos kyi mig can gong ma rnams// thub chen bcom ldan la gus ltar// bdag cag rjes su 'brang bar bya// bka' brgyud bla ma gong ma dang*// byams mgon spyan ras gzigs dbang dang*// 'jam dbyangs 'phags ma sgrol ma dang*// gsang bdag rta mgrin gshin rje'i gshed// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon dang ni// 'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa'i// grub thob chen po mchog brgyad la// mos dang gus pa rtag tu sgoms// gsol gdab byin gyis rlobs par nges// rang gi bla ma dam pa ni// 'das ma 'ongs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas yin// 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus pa// phyag rgya chen por rtogs 'dod na// chos kyi sku yi mos gus bya// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan dang*// tshe dang dbang phyug bsod nams rnams// ma lus rgyas par thob 'dod na// bde ldan gnas su bla ma la// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i mos gus bya// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// phan 'dod gnod pa sel gyur cing*// byang chub mchog la 'god 'dod na// sprul pa'i sku yi mos gus bya// sku gsum mos gus byas pa las// 'bras bu rnam gsum 'thob pa de// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs yin// byin rlabs can gyi bla ma la// mos gus chen po rtag tu bsgom// byin rlabs med pa'i bla ma la// zhen pa'i mos gus byas gyur kyang*// rgyud nyon mongs gsum gyis bsregs pa dang*// 'khor ba'i 'dam la zin nas 'chi// des na bla ma bdam pa gces// bla ma bla ma bla ma ni// yon tan bskyed na bla ma yin// yon tan 'dod na mos gus gyis// mos gus che na rtogs pa mtho// mos gus 'bring na rtogs pa 'bring*// mos gus med pa'i gang zag la// rtogs pa gtan nas ga la skye// ri bong mgo la rwa med dang*// mo gsham bu dang 'grogs pa med// sbal pas ral pa mi thogs ltar// mos gus med pa'i gang zag la// rtogs pa skye ba mi srid do// des na bla ma dam pa la// mos gus rgya mtsho gting nas g.yos// mdzad dang rnam par thar pa yi// rjes su 'brang zhing bslab pa dang*// sangs rgyas mdzad pa nyid du blta// phor kha gzar mchu mtho dman rnams// khyad du bsad cing rtag par ni// mi 'gyur mos gus rdo rje bzhin// mi 'bral mos gus rtag tu gnas// bsam rgyu bla ma ma gtogs pa// spu tsam med par byas gyur na// dus gsum sangs rgyas kyi yon tan dang*// 'khor 'das bde skyid ma lus pa// lhun gyis grub par 'byung ba de// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs yin// 'di la 'bad rtsol ga la yod// lar bla ma'i byin rlabs ma zhugs na// ji ltar gyur kyang chen po dang*// ring por 'gyur ba ga la srid// srog dang 'dra bar mos gus bya// rang yul btson ra dug ltar spang*// dben dang ri khrod bdud rtsi ltar// rtag tu gnas shing bsten par bya// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog dang*// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams kyis// thugs kyi bas pa med par spyad// sgrub pa rgyun chad med par bya// dus log chen po 'di byung bas// 'jig rten 'di yi bya sa med// rang yul phyogs dang ris rnams dang*// nye du gnyen 'dun ma lus pa// nges pa med pa'i phyogs su gnas// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyis// rang yul lcags sreg me ltar 'bar gyur cing*// gnod pa'i gzhir gyur ral gri'i nags tshal 'dra// khe grags mi gtsang ro myag 'dam rdzab tu// mi chos gshin rje'i skyes bu 'dra rnams kyi// dpon du gyur na shin tu ma legs pas// rang la snying brtse yod pa nags su song*// gsungs pa'i don 'di legs par nyams su longs// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// 'chi sa brla gang 'dra ba la// yul phyogs la dmigs pa ga la yod// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// gong ma rnams kyis yab yul spangs// rang gi yul du phyin tsam na// chags sdang g.yeng ba'i rkyen rnams kyis// chos dang mthun pa'i shin tu dka'// 'jig rten 'di la snang bar 'jug
