/nyams myong dang rtogs pa brjed nas 'ong*// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang*// gong ma rnams kyis yab yul spangs// rang gis de ltar bsgrub par byos// byang chub sems dang sems kyi gshis// smon lam rnam par dag pas bsgrub// nags na ri dwags bya rnams dang*// shing rnams mi snyan brjod mi byed// chags dang sdang ba'i sems rnams spangs// byams snying rjes rang rgyud rlan par byed// kun rdzob byang sems rin po che// ngang ngam shugs kyis rgyud la skye// dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma rnams dang*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams kyis// bar chad sel zhing dngos grub ster// rnal 'byor dbang phyug mi la dang*// grub thob gong ma thams cad kyang*// ri dang gangs dang nags su bzhugs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// ma lus mtha' dag brnyes gyur pa// glen pa khyod kyis ma go 'am// lar 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na// 'jig rten 'di yi bsam pa gtang*// byang chub dam pa gang gis 'thob// snyam du yang dang yang du bsam// lta ba rnam dag nam mkha' 'dra// nam mkha' rtog dpyod kun dang bral// spyod pa rnam dag skye ba med// bdag gzhan gnyis dang bral bar spyod// sgom pa rnam dag chos kyi sku// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rnams// 'od gsal chen po chos kyi sku// 'di la rtag tu mnyam par gzhag /'gro mgon phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang*// nam mkha' sprin dang khug rna bral na nyi zla gsal// rgya mtsho chu yi rnyog ma dwangs na gzugs brnyan gsal// nor bu rin chen phyis na dgos 'dod 'byung*// sems nyid rtog pa dag na 'bras bu sku gsum 'char// gsungs pa nyid kyis legs par shes par bya// gdams ngag spros pa mang po dang*// zan chos mang po btsal mi bya// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// yig chung lung med dam pa'i chos// zab zab 'dra yang spang bar bya// rtogs ldan sprul pa'i gdams ngag gis// ji ltar byas kyang ma phan na// yig 'khyam chos kyis ga la phan// gdams ngag sna bsdus spang bar bya// gsungs pa'i don ltar nyams su blang*// slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas kyang*// lhag pa tshul khrims lhag pa shes rab dang*// lhag pa'i sems la rtag tu bslab par bgyi// gsungs pa'i don gyis 'di la zhu gtug mdzod// byang chub dam pa thob par bya ba dang*// 'jig rten blo 'di nges par spang phyir dang*// brtul zhugs 'dzin dang ri khrod 'grim pa'i phyir// shākya'i dge slong spyan snga'i mtshan can gyis// mos dang gus pa'i shugs ldan rnal 'byor pa// dge sbyong nye gnas rin chen ye shes la// da nas bzung nas byang chub bar gyi chos// nyams len gnad kyi man ngag zab mo rnams// legs par gdams pa'i dge ba rgya chen 'dis// 'gro rnams bla med byang chub myur thob shog

/rtag tu nyams su blang bar bya ba'i man ngag /lnga ldan rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya'i bstan chos/ spyan snga rin po che phag mo gru pas rin po che ye shes la gdams pa rdzogs so// // 48) ༄// springs yig phan bde'i 'byung gnas slob dpon sprul sku la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che spyan snga ba/ sgom pa shag rin dang yab sras gnyis kyis/ rdo rje 'chang dang 'dra ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sprul sku rin po che dang*/ yum dang*/ jo sras rnam gnyis dang bcas pa'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ slob dpon sangs rgyas tshur byon bya ba'i bang chen gnyis po byung ba'i ngos nas/ slob dpon pa sku na byon pa dang*/ der yang bu slob rnams tshogs nas 'dug pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan du ma'i ngos nas/ slob dpon phar 'byon par dgongs nas 'dug na yang*/ der sku khams bzang nas 'dug zer ba dang*/ jo sras rnam gnyis yum dang bcas pa bu slob mos gus can rnams yod pas zhag gcig mi 'khreng bar 'dug pa dang*/ 'di na yang bla ma rin po che la 'khor dge 'dun khri phrag mang po yod kyang*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas sku dang grib ma bzhin du ma bral bar dgos par byung*/ slob dpon gyi ngos nas 'phrin las dang gzhan don rlabs shin tu che bar yod pas/ da lan nged yab sras kyis ma brdzangs pa lags/ de la thugs mi chad par zhu/ lar 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*// rje 'gro mgon sprul sku rin chen dang*// sras slob dpon sangs rgyas rin mgon gnyis// brtse dang mos gus gdung ba yis// yun ring po mi thogs mjal bar bya// yab sras dbu sngas sprad nas kyang*// zab mo chos kyi gleng langs kyis// thugs dpal gyi be'u tshim par bya// zhag gcig ma mjal bar du yang*// thugs spros med nam mkha' lta bu la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// kun rdzob byang sems rin chen dang*// dbye ba med pa'i ngo bo yis// bu dang slob ma ma lus pa// byang chub mchog la 'god par zhu// yon tan rgya mtsho khyed nyid la// dam chos so ma mi dgos kyang*// bdag gis khyed la gdams pa yi// lnga ldan dam chos rin chen dang*// zab mo bcu chos sum chos kyis// rtag tu nyams su len par zhu// sras slob dpon sangs rgyas dbu mdzad pa'i// bu dang slob ma ma lus rnams// mdang rmi lam thun cig rmis pa ltar// 'dus byas thams cad de dang 'dra// lar 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// stong pa nam mkha' lta bu lags// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo rnams// zung 'jug lha dang lha mo lags// thams cad nam mkha' lta bu yi// rang bzhin de las 'da' ba med// 'on kyang 'dus byas dge ba rnams// rgyun mi 'chad par spyod par mdzod// dag pa chos sku'i rnal 'byor pa// blo gros dri med nam mkha' 'dra// chos spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid la// rmongs pa mi mnga' shes rab can// bdag nyid chen po khyed la springs// bdag dang khyed gnyis mjal bar yang*// gdan sa rin chen phag mo grur// dus btab myur du mjal bar zhu// yig rten chab tshwa zho gang mchis// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub thob par shog// /

49) ༄// dri ma med pa'i phreng ba nye gnas ston seng la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rnam dag nam mkha'i rang bzhin 'od gsal bas// dus gsum mkhyen pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor shar// 'chal ba'i log rtog mun pa 'joms mdzad pa// mgon po 'bri gung pa la skyabs su mchi// skyobs shig skyobs shig skyobs pa chos kyi rje// gang gis mthong thos dran par gyur pas kyang*// 'khor ba'i nyes tshogs rtsad nas 'joms mdzad cing*// yon tan rgyal ba'i sa la 'god par mdzad// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir skyes bu dam pa khyed// tshe 'dir 'dod yon thub pa rnams kyis spangs// drang srong mchog rnams dgon pa rnams la dgyes// yun thung tshe la long med myur du 'chi// rgyal ba rin chen de yi rjes su 'brongs// bdag nyid chen po de yi mdzad pa ni// chags sdang dug gsum gtan nas mi bzhed cing*// sems gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sgrub la mkhas// de yi yan lag dge bcu bsgrub la gdams// 'dod la chags pas 'khor ba 'dzin par byed// 'dod pa spangs pas byang chub rnam gsum 'thob// sha chang ro dang dus min kha zas spang*// sngags spyod yin zhes sha chang tshogs 'khor dang*// log spyod chos las gzhan pa du ma spang*// ston pa'i gsung la sgro bskur ma 'debs mdzod// tshe 'dir lto gos ji ltar byas kyang phyid// gtan gyis so nam 'chor sa 'di na gda'// sdom pa 'byung dang mngon par 'byung ba'i rgyud// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs rgyud rnams su// sngags ltar spyod pa sha chang spang bar gsungs// mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa rnam gsum ni// da nas byang chub bar gyi lam yin pas// ma g.yengs gsung rabs rnams la gzigs rtog mdzod// btang snyoms ma mdzad sgrub pa tshul bzhin gyis// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma dam pa de'i// phyag bzhes g.yon pa kun spyod nyams su longs// de yang sa bcad dmigs ni rnam gsum ste// tho rengs dus kyi byang sems bsgrub pa dang*// de las skyes pa'i rang lha sgom pa ni// kun spyod de yi sngon 'gro nyid du bzhed/

/dngos gzhi rnam 'gyur gsum dang ma bral bar/ /rtag tu gang spyod shes rab phyogs sngon spyad/ /spyod pa de yi dngos gzhi 'di yin no// rjes kyi spyod pa bsgrub pa'i bya ba ni// nyin spyod ma lus kad kyis 'das pa'i tshe// sgo bcad stan gyi steng du rab 'dug ste// de yi nyin par nyes ltung gang byung gis// gtso bo byas nas rang gzhan thams cad kyi// sdig ltung bshags pa'i spyi bshags lan gsum bya// de ltar ma byas nyes pa gang byung yang*// rmi lam 'od gsal mi zin nyes dmigs dang*// mtshan mo lha yis mi srung spong ba dang*// bdud kyi tshogs rnams glags rnyed bar chad byed// chags pa'i stobs rgyas rmi lam byang sems nyams// sdang ba'i stobs 'phel rmi lam gsod gcod rmi// gti mug stobs kyis rmongs pa'i dbang du 'gyur// de ni rjes kyi chos su bstan pa'o// lar na ting 'dzin bsam pa ma dag na// lus ngag yid gsum bya byed spyod pa rnams// ji ltar spyad kyang 'khor ba'i khol po yin// nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// nyams len nang du ting 'dzin bsgom// mgon po bla ma dam pa'i thugs// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pas// shes bya'i sgrib pa spangs pa yin// 'khor ba spong ba'i gnyen po yin// mya ngan 'das pa'i bde gnas yin// nyams dang myong ba ma lus pa// spong bar byed pa'i phyags ma yin// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// rdzogs par byed pa'i rtsa ba yin// sems kyi rgyal po rnam gsum dang*// skad cig tsam yang ma bral dang*// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs su 'gyur ro dam pa khyed// ci byed 'jig rten bsam pa rnams// thongs dang 'jig rten thams cad kyi// skyabs su 'gyur ro dam pa khyed// laug spyod chos ltar ston byed cing*// gzhan mgo ma bskor dam pa khyed// 'gro ba'i skyabs nyid rang yin pas// dri med tshul khrims rin chen dang*// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// gzhan smin par gyis dang dam pa khyed// lar cis kyang mi phan skyes bu rnams// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// stes dbang rang dgar mi ldog cing*// rang la skyabs dang mgon med pas// rang sems rin chen dri med 'di// nyams dang myong bas goms par bya// byang chub sems kyis dbang byas nas// skyabs kyi dam pa de nyid yin// gzhung dang gdams ngag 'di zab ces// tshig dang yi ge mang po la// skyabs gnas btsal na bslu nas mchi// zab pa'i sgrub thabs du ma rnams// khyi sngags rgal sngags mang po rnams// 'khar sel zhing sel ma lus pa// 'ching bu'i phung po 'dra ba rnams// nyams su blangs na bslu nas mchi// spongs dang 'khor bas dgos pa med// da nas byang chub bar gyi chos// 'khor 'das bde skyid ma lus rnams// thob par 'dod na lnga ldan bsgom// nyams len dus la bab pa'i tshe// bcu gsum chos la nan tan mdzod// grags dang gzhan phan 'byung 'dod na// rtags dang rdzu 'phrul du ma yis// 'gro ba smin par byed 'dod na// dam chos dpal gyi chos drug bsgom// tshe dang dbang phyug bsod nams rnams// rgyas pas 'gro rnams 'dul 'dod dang*// grags dang snyan pas sa steng 'dir// rgyas par byed cing 'gro ba rnams// 'dul bar 'dod na bde gnas su// dbang gi rgyal po bsgom par bya// bdud dang bdud kyi dkyil 'khor rnams// 'dul zhing skrag par 'dod gyur na// 'khor lo bzhi yi dbu ma ru// thig le dkar dmar kha sbyar bsgom// nor bu rin chen lta bu yi// rtogs ldan sprul sku'i man ngag la// nges pa'i shes pa ma skyes par// rgyal bu rang tshang du nyal ba'am// mkhas btsun ra snying 'tshol ba'am// gdams chung yig 'khyam gyi slob dpon la// man ngag ra tshang btsal gyur kyang*// bla ma gong ma'i byin rlabs nyams// drag po gsum 'dul gyi rang nyid btul// bu log pa'i slob dpon ma 'tshol mdzod// log spyod khungs su 'gro nyen gda'// kwa ye nye gnas ston seng ba// sang nyi ma shar phyogs su 'gro tsam na// za 'dod 'bog chol gyi bsam pa yis/

/sha chang gi tshogs 'khor mi mdzad zhu// des 'gro mgon gyi bstan pa 'jig par byed// byin rlabs dbang skur du ma yis// zong phran gyi ka cha ma 'tshol mdzod/ /ngu 'bod kyi dmyal ba 'di ya re nga*/ /'jig rten mgon po bla ma des/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /shi rgyu gsos shing rul rgyu bskams// dbugs cung zad 'gul bar byas tsam na// phan pa'i lan du gnod pa bskyal// sha chang tshogs 'khor log spyod kyis// gong ma'i rnam thar sun 'don pa// thub pa chen po bla ma des// gnod pa byas pa ci zhig yod// sdig pa'i bu ltar ma mdzod cig /sdig grogs dug gsum 'phel ba'i gzhi// dam pa rnams kyi thugs kyis bas// snyan pa'i chu rgyun gcod par byed// log spyod 'khor ba'i 'dam 'di las// rgyal bar mdzod dang skyes bu khyed// pha skyabs su mchi'o rin po che// sa steng 'dzam bu'i gling 'di yi// rab sdug dga' ba'i yul rnams kun// ma lus char du bab gyur kyang*// pad ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// mnyam med bla ma rin chen gyi// rjes su 'brongs dang brtul zhugs can// dri med brgyud pa rin chen gyi// bstan pa'i ru dar 'dzugs par zhu// thos bsam sgom las byung ba yi// shes rab mchog gis rnam par rgyal// dam tshig mu tig brgyus pa 'dra// rgyud sdom pa gsum gyis mdzes par byos// rnal 'byor dbang phyug ston seng la// snying gi kha ta byas pa yin// chos dang chos ma yin pa 'byed par byed pa dri ma med pa'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ rin po che spyan snga bas nye gnas ston seng la gdams pa// //

50) ༄// khrab brgya phul ba'i yon bdag la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dpal gyi dpal mchog 'gro ba kun gyi dpal// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yab sras la// gus pas phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi// byang chub snying po dpal gyi gdan sa nas// 'og min gnyis pa dpal gyi 'bri gung du// nyid kyi 'bangs su gyur pa dpon g.yog 'ga'// rnam dag sa yi phyogs 'dir mjal du 'ongs// lhar bcas 'gro ba ma lus thams cad kyi// dpal 'byor yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur pa// bde skyid 'byung gnas sku gdung rin po che// yid bzhin nor bu 'di dang mjal du 'ongs// dga' ldan gnas su rje btsun mi pham ltar// 'og min gnyis pa rgyal tshab rin po che// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku khams zhu ba'i phyir// skyabs kyi dam pa 'di dang mjal du 'ongs// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i spyan snga der// thugs las skyes pa'i skal ldan bsags pa can// chos dang zang zing stabs su longs spyod pa'i// chos rje'i nye gnas rnams dang mnyam du 'ongs// 'dzam gling dad 'dus rgyal sras 'phags pa'i tshogs// mnyes pa gsum gyis rtag tu mnyes gyur cing*// mkhan slob dge ba'i bshes kyis dbu mdzad pa'i// 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang mjal du 'ongs// ma ltar byams shing sring ltar gdung ba yi// bu gces bzhin du bla ma dge 'dun rnams// skyo dub med par rtag tu bskyangs gyur pa// drug tsha ban de 'di dang mjal du 'ongs// mnyam med 'gro ba'i bla ma yab sras kyi// mtshungs pa med pa'i sku la blta ba dang*// zhabs la btud pa'i phyag dang bstod pa dang*// kun tu bzang po'i mchod pas mchod du 'ongs// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams thams cad na// bdag pos bzung med dngos su bshams pa dang*// rang lus rin chen ltos med 'bul ba'i phyir// mchod pa rnams pa bdun dag 'bul du 'ongs// khrab brgya 'bul gyi dus su'o/// /

51) ༄// byin rlabs mchog las 'khrungs pa'i skyes rin chen dpal 'bar la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen dang*// bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad kyi// byin rlabs mchog gi stobs las 'khrungs// thos bsam sgom las byung pa yi// shes rab mchog gis rnam par rgyal// dri med tshul khrims rin chen dang*// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// 'gro rnams smin par mdzad pa'i dpal// 'gro mgon phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// byin rlabs mchog las 'khrungs pa'i rigs// don dang mtshan du mthun pa yi// skyes chen rin chen dpal 'bar la// zhu yig rgyang nas 'bul ba'i don// khyed kyis mi mchog rin po che// nyid kyi dbon po brdzangs pa dang*// yul gru ri ba'i rta mchog dang*// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun la// chab tsha mang skol bskur ba rnams// bdag gi phyag tu legs par things// thugs la btags shing phyag byad bzang*// yi ge mi 'khyam pa yi rten// kha che gur gum tshos byas pa'i// 'dza' ma le yi sku phyam cig /bskur nas mchis pas mnabs par zhu// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// ma rnams byang chub thob par shog // 52) ༄// dpon chen po 'bum pa la gdams pa// oṃ swa sti/ rin po che phag mo gru pas/ dpon chen 'bum pa la zhu ba'i don/ nged kyi dpon bla ma skyabs// nged rang yon mchod thams cad kyi mig gam snying dang 'dra bar gces par bzhugs pa de grongs nas 'dug pa shin tu ma legs/ 'on kyang 'dus byas spyi'i mtshan nyid lags pas thugs ngal mi mdzad par zhu/ dpon chen po nyid rje rin po che la gsol ba 'debs pa dang*/ sngon rje rin po ches ji ltar btab pa'i phyag rgya chen po bsgom pa dang*/ khyed rgyal po lta bu'i bdag nyid lags pas bsod nams kyi tshogs snga ma bzhin du rgyun mi chad par gsog pa dang*/ mdzad pa thams cad chos dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig tu bsgrub par zhu ba dang*/

spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag nged rang yon mchod thams cad kyang 'chi ba'i chos can las spu'i rtse mo tsam yang ma 'das pa lags pas/ 'jig rten 'di'i rgyal po lta bu'i 'khor dang 'bangs phyogs rigs thams cad la yang thugs ma chags par/ mdzad pa dang spyod pa thams cad chos bzhin du mdzad pa dang*/ sems bskyed dang bsngo ba dang ma bral bar mdzad pa dang*/ skyid sdug mtho dman ci byung yang*/ rje rin po che dran par mdzad pa 'ba' zhig la mnyam par 'jog par zhu/ da lan yang dpon bla ma skyabs kyi bsngo ba zhu ba la 'bul ba rgya chen po bskur ba thugs la btags/ yig rten ber cig bskur nas mchis dpon 'bum pa la springs pa'o/// / 53) ༄// sgom chen dbang phyug seng ge la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// gzung dang 'dzin pas rab tu bskyed// chags par 'dzin pas yi dwags skyed// sdang bar 'dzin pas dmyal ba bskyed// rmongs par 'dzin pas dud 'gro bskyed// ma chags mi sdang ma rmongs pa// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba yi// sems gdod nas skye ba med pa 'di// kun rdzob byang sems rin chen dang*// dbye ba med par nyams su blang*// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel chos rnams la// brtsi bldab rtag tu mdzad par zhu// sems rnam dag dngul dkar me long la// 'khrul med ye shes mig gis ni// ma nor gzigs pa'i shes rab can// sgom chen dbang phyug seng ge la// zab pa'i dam chos don po 'di// chos kyi 'brel par bskur ba lags// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog /dngul gyi rna cha bskur ba phyag tu phyin// thugs la btags/// / 54) ༄// nyams su len pa'i rim pa dbon po yon tan 'bar la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// kun rdzob byang sems rin po che// 'gro ba'i don du bskyed pa dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// sems rnam dag nam mkha'i ngo bor spyod// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel kun// bslu ba med par 'byung ba 'di// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung lags// mi bslu ji ltar byas pa'i las// nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba de// sgyu ma lta bu'i rten 'brel yin// stong dang rgyu 'bras dbyer med par// bslu ba med par 'byung ba 'di// sangs rgyas mthus kyang dgag mi spyod// rang gis nyams su myong bar nges// sgrib gsum bral ba'i sangs rgyas kyi// zhabs la seng ldeng tshal pa zug

/shin tu phra ba'i rnam smin la// 'dzem pa dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos// nyon mongs gsum las skyes pa yi// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi las// mngon par 'du ni mi byed pa'i// go cha chen po rtag tu bsgom// ma chags mi sdang ma rmongs pa'i// rin chen sems gsum bskyed pa dang*// de las skyes pa'i las rnam gsum// mngon par 'du ni byed pa gces// 'bras bu bla med byang chub 'thob// 'di bslu ba med pa'i rgyu 'bras yin// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// ma lus ji snyed yod pa kun// ma skyes skye med spros dang bral// sems spros med nam mkha' lta bu la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par gyis// chu bo gzhol phyogs su 'bab pa 'am// nyi ma nub phyogs su 'gro ba ltar// rang ngang gis 'gro ba ma gtogs pa// 'dzin pa'i dri ma bsgo mi bya// nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba'am// rgya mtsho rlabs dang bral ba ltar// ngo bo nyid kyis 'gro ba de// ngo bo gzung ba med pa dang*// 'dzin pa med par mnyam par zhog /gal te gzung 'dzin byung gyur na// chu la chu ni bzhag pa 'am// mar la mar ni bzhag pa ltar// dbyer med ngo bo gcig tu zhog /de ltar spyad cing nyams blangs na// gzung 'dzin thabs kyi rgyal por mchi// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// skyes pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// ma skyes skye med nam mkha' bzhin// ngo bo stong pa chos kyi sku// 'phrin las gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'di// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'byung*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub lam mchog 'god par mdzad// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// rnam gsum 'gro ba'i don du bsgom// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yis// ston pas bcas pa'i tshul khrims la// mig dang srog bzhin bsrung ba dang*// ngar 'dzin bdag 'dzin med pa'i sems// de las skyes pa'i lus ngag gi// las rnams mngon par 'du byed pas// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdul bya mang po smin par gyis// skal ba dang ldan gang zag la// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// rang byung phyag rgya chen po bstan// skye bo'i tshogs ni thams cad la// bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen jo bo'i bsgom// ston par byed pa shin tu gces// bshes gnyen dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// chos dang 'bral ba med pa yi// gzhan don mdzad pa'i rgyal sras la// btang snyoms sdod pa'i skabs ma mchis// brtson 'grus chen po rtsom par gyis// lar chos dang sems su 'dres par bya// lta ba rnam dag phyag rgya che// spyod pa rnam dag tshul khrims ni// ston pas ji ltar bcas pa las// 'da' ba med par srung ba dang*// sgom pa rnam dag 'khor 'das kyi// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// rnam dag 'od gsal chen po la// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// lus ngag yid gsum sdom pa dang*// smra ba mang po spang bar bya// rin chen gser ltar lji ba dang*// lus ngag yid gsum don med pa'i// 'khyal pa mang po spang bar bya// lus sba dben par 'dug pa dang*// sems sba rtog pa spang pa dang*// ngag sba smra ba nyung bar bya// da nas byang chub ma thob par// chos kyis nyin mtshan 'da' ba dang*// 'gro ba dang ba 'dren par bya// rgyun du thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor ltar// nyams su len pa gong ma'i lugs// 'di la nan tan che bar bya// shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas// nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di// dbon po yon tan 'bar la gdams// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog/

// 55) ༄// dge bsnyen rin chen grags la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rgyal ba'i mchod rten dpal gyi 'bri gung nas// bla ma rin chen phag mo gru pa yis// dge bsnyen rin chen grags pa la springs pa ni// tshe 'di mi rtag glog dang chu bur 'dra// 'dus byas thams cad rtswa kha'i zil pa bzhin// 'gyur zhing 'jig rten 'chi ba'i chos can yin// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' med shin tu 'jigs// 'di las thar phyir dam chos bya// sred dang zhe sdang gti mug spang*// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med pa'i las// dge ba dam pa 'di nyid spyad par bya// rang sems gdod nas skye med chos kyi sku// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i sprin gyis ma bsgribs par// lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo bor mnyam par gzhag /skabs skabs dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/// / 56) ༄// spyi dpon rgyal po dbyig ne ba la gdams pa// oṃ swasti// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// bla ma rin chen gdan sa bas// dpon dbyig ne ba la springs pa'i don// tshe la long med myur du 'chi// bsags pa'i rdzas dang yo byad dang*// gnyen 'dun 'khor dang longs spyod rnams// 'chi ba'i dus la bab pa na// mdang rmi lam thun cig rmis pa bzhin// rjes su phyir la gzhag gyur cing*// 'dus byas thams cad de dang 'dra// rtag pa dam pa'i chos las med// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// las dang bcas pa mi dge ba// 'khor ba sdug bsngal 'byung ba'i gzhi// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// las dang bcas pa spyad gyur na// byang chub rnam gsum thob par 'gyur// nyon mongs las dang bcas pa spangs// nyon mongs med pa'i sems nyid 'di// nam mkha' lta bu stong pa yin// nam mkha' 'du byed thams cad dang*// yid la byed pa kun dang bral// rtog bral rtog pa med pa yi// ngo bo de nyid bsgom par bya// ting 'dzin de dang tshul khrims la// rtag tu nyams su len par zhu// khyed kyis rin chen gser gyi 'bum// gzabs bris bsam gyis mi khyab pa// rmad du byung ba bskur ba dang*// rta bzang bsam gyis mi khyab pa// chibs la bskur ba thugs la btags// yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten// kha che gur gum srang gang dang*// ther ma ser po gnyis mchis so// spyi dpon rgyal po lta bu'i bsod nams can gshegs bzhud dka' yang*/

'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho chen po da res spong dgos/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*/ 'jig rten mgon po yab sras kyi gdams ngag dam pa'i chos rin po ches 'khor ba spong ba'i gdams ngag don du gnyer bar bya ba'i phyir/ 'bri gung gi gling rin po che dang*/ ngan bu yang khyed dang mjal skyo bas lan cig yar 'byon par zhu/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 57) ༄// dpon chen po rdo rje rgyal mtshan la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// rgyal po lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes// bdag gi chos las skyes pa'i bu// rdo rje rgyal mtshan la springs pa// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho la// gting mtha' med par go bar zad// phun sum tshogs pa rnam lnga dang*// 'khor dang gnyen 'dun thams cad la// ma chags chags pa med par mdzod// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// rnam gsum rtag tu nyams su longs// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa sems nyid nam mkha' la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// nyon mongs gsum dang ma 'dres par// rnam par dag par spyod par zhu// tho rengs snga dro phyi dro dang*// srod kyi dus la dge sbyor la// nan tan bya zhing btang snyoms spang*// dus la long ni yod gyur kyang*// tshe la long med go bar mdzod// yul dang srid dang phyogs rnams kun// dam pa'i chos kyis skyong bar zhu// lta ba rnam dag phyag rgya che// spyod pa rnam dag tshul khrims ni// nan tan chen po mdzad par zhu// 'jig rten 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba yis// rang mgo bskor zhing gzhan rnams bslu// phal cher sku mtshams mdzad pa dang*// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// chos dang mthun par spyod par zhu// gzhan la phan bde bsgrub pa de// rang don yin par go bar mdzod// 'gro ba mtho dman thams cad la// phan pa bsgrub pa shin tu gces// snying rje chen pos 'gro rnams la// las dang bcas pa bsgrub par bya// thub pa chen po bcom ldan gyis// nga yi bstan pa'i ngo bo ni// snying rjes rab tu phye zhes gsungs// nged rang spad kyi nyams len gyis// 'phral gyi chos spyod bya ba la// gsol 'debs gtor ma cha bcu dang*// spyi bshags bsngo ba la sogs pa'i// lus ngag yid gsum chos spyod la// btang snyoms med par spyod par zhu// phan par smra ba'i dam chos 'di// bu gcig rdo rje rgyal mtshan la// gdams pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'gro rnams byang chub thob par shog
/dpon rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi yum dang*// dpon chos rgyal gnyis la phrug chung byin rlabs mdzad pa gnyis bskur nas mchis// ral gu re mdzad par zhu/// /

58) ༄// rje rin po che'i sras kyi thu bo slob dpon dgon gsar ba la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas/ bla ma rin po ches/ rje rin po che'i sras kyi thu bo/ rtsod pa dang bral ba'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po slob dpon dgon gsar ba la zhu ba/ khyed sku khams bzang zhing*/ 'phrin las rgya chen pos 'gro ba mang po smin par mdzad par khums/ de shin tu thugs la btags/ da rung yang rje rin po che'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzad par zhu/ 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*// ston pa'i bstan pa rin chen kyang*// nub tu nye ba'i dus la bab// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// byin gyis brlabs las grub pa yi// skyes chen mi yi seng ge khyed// byams dang snying rje byang sems kyis// rang rgyud brlan cing gzhan gyi don// mdzad pa'i brtson 'grus rtsam pa dang*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// rnam dag nam mkha' lta bu la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// 'phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro ba rnams// sngar bzhin smin par mdzad par zhu// dus dang skabs la nam bab tshe// lan gcig 'dir yang 'byon par zhu// bdag nyid chen po khyod dang ni// bdag kyang lan cig mjal bar spro// zab mo chos kyi gleng langs byed// khyod kyis dpon thugs rje rgyal mtshan phyir thongs gsungs btang nas bdog yig rten ther ma ser po gcig bskur nas bdog/ byang chub dam pa thob par gyur cig// / 59) ༄// dpal ldan phag mo gru'i dbon po rje btsun bla ma yang zhig la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ pha 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i sras// mes dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i dbon// shākya'i dge slong bdag gi grogs// rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen po mchog /rje btsun bla ma yang zhig la// bdag gis rgyang nas zhu ba'i don// ti ser bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams// snga phyi dus gsum thams cad du// khyed kyis bskyangs shing thugs la btags// da yang de ltar skyong bar zhu// ngan bu la men skyer kha zhud ma rab gcig bskur ba thugs la btags// yig rten ja srang bco lnga bskur nas mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 60) ༄// gdan sa rin po che'i slob dpon la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ spyan snga nas/ slob dpon pa la zhu ba/ sku khams de'i thugs dam mdzad lugs la/ dang po lam du gtang*/ sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms pa'i rang gi lus 'di sha dang rus pa/ rkang dang chu rgyus/ rgyu lto nyal nyil tsag tsog thams cad med par khru ma phus btab pa bzhin du gtsang sangs kyis gyur par bsgom/ de rnams dmigs pa'i sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi lte ba'i 'og khong pa'i nang spu mtshams kyi thad sor gtum mo ye shes kyi me bya mo'i sgo nga tsam pa lcags bsregs pa 'dra ba dmar hril le ba zhig bsgom/ rtag tu de bsgom/ des bzhes pa 'ju ba dang*/ gsol dang la skyed 'ong*// gsol dang la skyed byung pa'i dus su sku khams gzhan rnams rang bzhin gyis dwangs nas 'ong*/ thugs dam dmigs pa 'di la nan tan mdzad par zhu/// / 61) ༄// gdan sar bzhugs pa rnams la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rje rin po che yab sras gdan sa dang bcas pa rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol/ nga rin po che'i zhabs drung du phyin nas ngam shod pas ni shi rgyu gsos/ rul rgyu bskams/ byin pas lus khyag du bcug rje sa bdag gi rgyal po rnams kyis nga mgo ci thon lta ba'i ched du ltad mo chen mo rnams kyis gral dpon la gdan drangs/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dam par bzung*/ ngam shod pa che chung med pa thams cad nga'i slob ma yin pa la/ gdan sa rin po che phag mo gru rdo rje gdan rten gyis ma 'phongs pa yin mod kyis/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang po spyan drangs pas/ sgom chen pa thams cad chos dang bral/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dus gcig tu nub/ rje sa bdag gi rgyal po nyes pa med pa la skur pa dang ngan pa'i glang 'debs/

ngam shod kyi klung du thams cad du khrag gi rgya mtshor 'gyur/ rje rin po che'i zhabs 'dren chen por 'dug pas rten de tsho tshur la spyan drangs pas/ ngam shod pa skyabs bla ma dang dkon mchog dang ma bral/ skyid kyi nyi ma la dpal gyi 'dom skyong ba la bsam nas spyan drangs pa yin/ de la khyed gdan sa ba jo bo phar ka tshur ka dang bcas pa thugs mi chad par zhu/ gdan sa rin po che 'khrug long nyes pa'i gzhi med pas nam mkha' dang mnyam par da gzod mchi ba lags pas/ snga ma kho na bzhin du thugs la gdags par zhu/ de la rje rin po che'i gdan sar mar me zhig 'bul zhing mchis/ gza' mi dge 'dun rnams la ston chos dang dpon mchog gnyis kyis ston chung la mang skol zhig 'bul zhing mchis/ rje phar ka tshur tsha gnyis la dar yung re dang ja zho re 'bul zhing mchis/ gnas brtan dang grags tshul gnyis la dar yug re dang ja zho re 'bul zhing mchis/ pha'i bu mes kyi tsha/ thugs kyi sras gdan sa ba'i bdag po tsa sgom la mdzo mo bzang ba zhig 'bul zhing mchis gsol zhes mdzad par zhu/ slob dpon me sgom la mdzo mo bzang ba zhig 'bul/ gza' mi da ltar gdan sa na bzhugs pa rnams la mdzo mo bzang ba zhig thugs ma bder bcug pa'i sdig bshags yin/ rgya phag mo gru pa spyi la rta gcig 'bul/ thams cad sdum pa'i zhu rten yin/ rkyang pa rnams la khrab cig 'bul/ nga la bka' bkyon mi mdzad par zhu/ gdan sa ngo mtshar can du da gzod 'ong ba yin/ rje rin po che'i thugs dgongs dge ba'i rtsa ba rlabs po che 'dis/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig/ ༈ //oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ slob dpon gdan sa ba'i spyan sngar zhu ba/ gdan sa rin po che 'di'i khur bu slob gang gis kyang ma bsnams nas nga la gtad pa lags/ ngas kyang gzhan gyis khur len du re bas thabs sna tshogs byas kyang nga rang gi thog tu byung*/

de'i ngos nas su la yang gtad sa med/ nga rang gi khur thog tu yod pa lags/ de la de sngon yang slob dpon pas thugs la btags nas khur bsnoms pas gru bzhi log brgyad rtse mo dbal dang dgur song ba lags/ de'i ngos nas nga rgas nus pa zad/ khyed gdan sa 'dir bzhugs nas rang don dang gzhan don mtha' dag mdzad par zhu/ khyed rang bzhugs na dpon g.yog gsum las med kyang des chog pa yin/ mi bzhugs na 'bum tsho gcig yod kyang dgra sha stag yin pas sku nyams su bstar ba lags/ do tsig mu ge chen po byung khar yang su la yang nas med pas/ 'dir yang tshe phyid par ma byung*/ dge 'dun phyed la ster rgyu ma byung bas 'bul du bcug rnying pa thams cad bzhud du bcug gsar pa tshan che la mang grags pas 'gro sa ma rnyed/ sus kyang zong gis nas grub pa med/ 'di nas bskur rgyu ma rnyed/ tug gi thug pa lags pas a na ma snyam du mi dgongs par zhu/ lan cig mjal bzhed par 'dug bgyi ba khums pas/ tshul gong ngam tshul gting ngam thugs kyis dgongs nas ji ltar 'os pa cig la dpon g.yog bcu las mi mang ba zhig 'byon par zhu/ de'i bar du mkhan slob dang byang gzhon dang gzhi la bzhugs pa rnams gzhi la lhan ne bzhugs par zhu/ yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten du chab tshwa zho gcig 'bul zhing mchis// ༈ //oṃ swasti/ dbyer med byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin rtag pa'i sku// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo chos rje rin chen dang*// bla ma dam pa rnams dang yi dam dkon mchog la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// dpa' bo rnal 'byor rdo rje mkha' 'gro dang*// mthu chen chos kyi srung ma thams cad kyis// phan bde 'dod pa bdag gi bsam pa 'di// rdzogs shing grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mgon po phag mo gru pa rdo rje 'chang*// bcom ldan de yi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir// legs par byas shing smra tshig bsgrub pa'i phyir// gdan sar dge 'dun btang ba 'di ltar lags// slob dpon pas dbu mdzad gdan sar btang ba de rnams/

gza' mi dang*/ gnyer dang bya ba bzhag la ma gtang ngo*/ gnya' dang g.yon dang bar la ma gtang ngo*/ kha smras dang gleng gzhi khrag khrug la ma gtang ngo*/ gnyer gtod pa dang*/ len pa dang*/ mtho dman gyi bya bzhag la ma gtang ngo*/ sus 'di 'dra'i bya bzhag byed pa byung na/ nga'i gdan sa rin po che der mi 'jog te/ chen pos byed pa byung na mi bzhugs par nga rang gis zhu/ 'bring pos rtsom pa byung na lag pas 'dzin nas phud/ ngan pas rtsom pa byung na ser mo len/ da rung byung na gnas nas 'byin pa lags so// 'gro ba'i bla mas byang chub sems la gdams// sras dang bcas pas bdag la gnyer kha gtad// khur chen thogs pas kun kyang bde la bkod// rigs pa min zhes bdag la smra ba rnams// gong ma'i thugs dgongs mthong bar ma gyur snyam// nongs par gyur na thams cad bzod par gsol// bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba dri med yangs shing rgya che ba// byas shing bsags pa dpag med gang dag yod pa des// ji srid 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho chen po stongs par ma gyur tshe// rin chen yab sras kun gyi g.yog po nyid du bdag gyur cig/ /oṃ swasti// bde sbyin ting 'dzin mi gnas shing*// lus ngag yid gsum rnam par g.yeng*// gzhan rgyud byin gyis mi rlobs pas// bsgom gsal chab la mi gsol zhu// gzho yi sgang du bskur ba// gnyis med rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bag chags slongs pa rten 'brel yin// slongs shing 'dag pa ma shes na/ phyir la btsal na 'dag pa dka'// des na bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ bsgom la nan tan bskyed par bya/// / 62) ༄// bstan bcos mun sel sgron me slob dpon bsod rgyal la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// sna re tsam la gang gnas pa// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du// de yis sangs rgyas bstan pa dang*/ dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung brgyud 'dzin// lus ngag yid kyi bya ba rnams// 'gro ba smin pa'i thabs la mkhas// dri med rnam thar mchog nyid du// rang 'khris med pa'i spyod pa de// nyams pa med pa'i bstan pa yin// thub mchog rgyal ba'i bstan pa de// lus dang srog dang longs spyod rnams// mi bsrung dam chos srung ba dang*// nyes tshogs rtsod pa spangs pa de// ston pas gsungs pa'i bstan pa yin// 'gro mgon bla ma rin chen gyi// gang gis rjes su 'brang ba rnams// 'phags pas bsngags pa'i tshul khrims la// su zhig gnas pa de yi lag

/dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan pa gnas// gang na tshul khrims can gnas mthong*// de la mchod cing bsngags pa rnams// rang nyid nyes skyon med par spyod// 'chal pa thams cad tshar gcod cing*// gzhan rnams tshul khrims mchog la 'god// de lta bu yi spyod pa de// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na// sus byung ba med pa'i las ka yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras gcig yin// bla ma dam pa'i gces se yin// 'gro ba kun gyi bshes gnyen yin// mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin// dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu yin// yin lugs mang ste brjod mi lang*// mun pa sel ba'i sgron me zhes bya ba'i yi ge// / 63) ༄// thub chen rgyal sras slob dpon bsod rgyal la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ thub pa chen po rgyal ba'i sras// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod dang*// thams cad bsams nas byed pa ni// thub pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes gsungs// bzang ngo zer nas bzang po yang*// snying nas bzang po dka' mor gda'// nges par glo phugs gtad pa'i tshe// 'jig rten 'di yi che thabs dang*// tshe 'di bsgrub pa'i thabs rnams kyis// rang gzhan thams cad mi bslu bar// byang chub mchog la 'god par zhu// nyon mongs gsum dang de yi las// nyes pa'i tshogs la mi sbyor zhing*// skyon dag yon tan rdzogs pa'i thabs// sgrub la nan tan gtsigs su che// nyes pa byung ba'i gzhi rnams ni// 'tsho ba bde yang yang bar gsungs// gcig la chags na kun dang 'bye// khong yang mi mgu phyir la gnod// rang bzhin ngan pa bcos med de// rgyal po'i khyi gzhug ma mdzad par// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad kyi// phan bde'i lam de gang yin pa// khyod kyis legs par dgongs par zhu// thub chen rgyal sras zhes bya ba// shar gling ba la gdams pa yin/// / 64) ༄// yon bdag btsan phyug la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches yon bdag btsan phyug la springs pa/

rtag tu nyams su blang zhing bsgom pa'i chos/ dang po byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed de lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*/ chos rje rin po che 'bri gung pa/ ngan bu dang dpon g.yog gsum dbye ba med pa spyi bor dran tsam bya/ de nas sems ma bcos par gzhag ma bcos pa'i go ba bzang ngan gyi rnam par rtog pa ci yang yid la mi bya bar gzhag yid la byed pa med pa 'di la rtag tu mnyam par 'jog cing bsgom par zhu/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*/ rab 'byor yid la byas na ni khams gsum po gang du yang 'dre bar 'gyur la/ yid la ma byas na ni khams gsum po gang du yang 'dre bar mi 'gyur gsungs pa dang*/ slob dpon bram ze chen po sa ra ha'i zhal nas kyang*/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i sku// 'bras bu gang la'ang re ba ma byed rnal 'byor pa// gsungs pas/ yid la byed pa med pa phyag rgya chen po 'di la rtag tu mnyam par 'jog cing bsgom par zhu/ skabs skabs su bsngo ba mdzad par zhu// //oṃ swasti// bla ma mnyes pa'i mos gus de// shing len rnams la yod pa yin// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub de// shing len rnams la yod pa yin// mi len pa la ga la yod// mos gus can gyi dge 'dun rnams// des na spa shing len pa rigs/// / 65) ༄// a khu ston pa la gnang ba'i 'khor ba spong ba'i gdams pa// oṃ swa sti/ spros med sems nyid skye med ngo bo nyid// lhun grub 'od gsal chen po 'dus ma byas// rang bzhin rnam par dag pa blo las 'das// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gus phyag 'tshal// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i bde skyid rnams// 'byung bar 'dod pas de yi rjes su 'brang*// nyes pa kun gyi rtsa ba gti mug yin// spang bya kun gyi mchog de gti mug yin// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung de gnyen po ste// gcig tu bstan pa'i rten 'brel mi rtag pas// gti mug rtag chad la sogs log lta spong*// gnyis su bstan pa'i rten 'byung rgyu 'bras kyis// dge sdig las la 'bras bu mi 'dod pa'i// rgyu dang 'bras la rmongs pa'i gti mug spong*// gsum du bstan pa'i rten cing 'brel 'byung 'dis// ji ltar skye ba'i sems la las med ces// log ltar 'dzin pa'i gti mug spong bar byed// ma rig nas bzung rga shi'i bar du ni// gsum du 'dzin pa'i nyon mongs ma lus spong*// spang bya gti mug la sogs nyon mongs gsum// spong ba'i gnyen po rten 'brel nyid du zad// bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rabs ma lus kun// rten cing 'brel par 'byung bar 'dus par gsungs// ston pas lung bstan slob dpon 'phags pas kyang*// rten cing 'brel par 'byung 'di rgyal ba yi// gsung gi mdzod kyi gces pa zab mo ste// 'di ni gang gis yang dag mthong ba des// sangs rgyas de nyid rig pa rnam mchog mthong*// de ltar rgyu rkyen las skyes rten 'brel rnams// ma skyes skye med stong nyid kho na ste// til dang til mar bzhin du tha dad med// chos dang chos can yin te dbye ba med// rgyu 'bras kho na stong pa nyid yin la// stong nyid kho na rgyu 'bras nyid du 'byung*// de gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ngo bo la// rkyen las skyes pas 'khor ba'i bde sdug dang*// mya ngan 'das pa byang chub rnam gsum 'byung*// chos rnams thams cad rkyen nyid 'di par gsungs// rkyen nyid 'di pa rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// de ltar ston pas rten 'brel rkyen skyer gsungs// des na bdag gi bu sdug skyes chen khyed// 'jig rten 'di la ma zhen dug bzhin spongs// tshe 'di'i longs spyod 'du 'dzi g.yeng ba rnams// bslu byed chen mo zangs gling srin mo 'dra// gnyen 'dun 'khor la mi zhen gting nas spang*// gser gyi ri la dug gi chu rgyun ltar// rdzas dang yo byad phun sum tshogs pa lnga// bslu brid byis pa mgo bo bskor bar byed// bsod nams lto bas chog shes nor gyis 'tsho// bde dang skyid par 'dod pa'i bdud choms mdzod// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med ting 'dzin la// chu bo'i rgyun bzhin rtag tu mnyam par zhog

/thabs mkhas bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dang*// 'bral bar ma byed rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed// yun thung tshe la long med myur du 'chi// 'chi med bdud rtsi dam pa'i dam chos rnams// brtson 'grus chen pos nyams su blang bar zhu// yon tan rgya mtsho lhun po lta bu'i mi// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab mchog gis brgyan// yon tan rgya mtsho sems nyid rdo rje de// ma nor legs par rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// rigs las skyes pa'i skyes bu dam pa mchog /bdag gi bu gcig a khu ston pa la// 'jig rten spong thabs mgul du gdags phyir bstan// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// /

66) ༄// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed kyi phan yon sgom pa ba la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ skyabs 'gran zla med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas byang chub sems// gcig tu gyur pa'i ngo bo nyid// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// phyogs bcu dus gsum dkon mchog gsum// gang gi skyabs su song ba rnams// byang chub la 'god gus phyag 'tshal// 'dir 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde skyid thams cad bar chad med par 'khor ba'i skye gnas su nyams su myong bar byas nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya ba'i dam pa'i chos ni skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ byang chub kyi sems rin po che lags pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa rnam pa gnyis ni chos thams cad kyi mchog yin/ de ltar yang*/ 'dus pa chen po nyi ma'i snying po'i mdo las/ sangs rgyas skyabs su sems can su 'gro ba// bdud rnams bye bas gsad par mi nus shing*// tshul khrims nyams shing blo ni 'khrugs zin kyang*// de ni nges par skye ba'i pha rol 'gro// zhes pa dang*// phag mo'i rtogs pa brjod pa las kyang*// gang zhig sangs rgyas skyabs 'gro ba// de dag ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// lha yi lus nas shi 'phos nas// lha yi lus su skye bar 'gyur// gang zhig chos la skyabs 'gro ba// de dag ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// lha yi lus nas shi 'phos nas// lha yi lus su skye bar 'gyur// gang zhig dge 'dun skyabs 'gro ba// de dag ngan 'gror mi 'gro ste// lha yi lus nas shi 'phos nas// lha yi lus su skye bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa byang chub tu sangs rgyas nas/ byang chub snying po de nyid du/ tshong pa ga gon dang bzang po gnyis la/ tshong pa dag tshur sangs rgyas la skyabs su song zhig chos la skyabs su song zhig ma 'ongs pa'i dus su 'byung ba'i dge 'dun la skyabs su song zhig

ces thog mar chos gsungs pa yang skyabs su 'gro ba yin te/ de'i rgyu mtshan chos kyi phung po brgyad khri bzhi stong ji snyed cig gsungs pa'i rtsa ba yang skyabs su 'gro ba lags pas/ des na skyabs su 'gro ba ni chos thams cad kyi snying lta bu lags shing gal che bas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya ste/ chos kyi mkhan po seng ge'i khri la bzhugs/ ci 'byor pa'i me tog phul/ thal mo sbyar nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya snyam du bsams la rjes zlos mdzod cig slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum brjod/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin no dang*/ slob mas legs so zhes lan gsum brjod do// 'di skyabs su 'gro ba thun mong ba lags te/ de la thun mong ba'i phan yon ni/ spyir skyabs su 'gro ba'i phan yon thub pa'i gsung rabs nas dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs kyang*/ jo bo chen po rjes mdor bsdus pa brgyad du gsungs pa las/ de yang rang nyid nang pa sangs rgyas par chud pa'i phan yon dang*/ sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa'i gnod pas mi tshugs pa'i phan yon dang*/ shi nas ngan song dang ngan 'gro log par ltung bar mi 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ lam khyad par du 'phags pa rgyud la skye ba'i phan yon dang*/ rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsogs par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad srab cing zad par 'gyur ba'i phan yon dang*/ rang nyid bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba'i phan yon no// de ltar phan yon 'di rnams 'ong ba la bslab bya 'di dag la slob dgos te/

de yang thun mong gi bslab bya rnam pa lnga ni/ srog dang bya dga'i ched du yang lha dkon mchog mi spang ba la bslab pa dang*/ dgos pa gal po che byung nas thabs gzhan du mi btsal ba dang*/ dus dang dus kyi mchod pa la bslab pa dang*/ phyogs gang na gang du 'gro ba de'i lha la skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba spel zhing sbyang bar bya ba la bslab pa dang lnga'o// de la so so'i bslab bya drug ni/ sangs rgyas dkon mchog la skyabs su song bas lha gzhan la phyag mi 'tshal/ chos la skyabs su song nas sems can la 'tshe ba spang*/ dge 'dun la skyabs su song bas mi mu stegs can mi bsten pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang chos dang*/ dge 'dun gsum la gus pa sgrub cing ma gus pa spang pa dang drug go// de yang skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par can brjod par bya ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du dkon mchog rin po che gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ de yang sangs rgyas la ston par bya/ chos la lam du bya/ dge 'dun la lam bsgrub pa'i grogs su bya ste/ jo bo bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya snyam du bsams la rjes bzlos mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas dus 'di nas bzung nas/ ji srid snying po byang chub la mchis kyi bar du/ rkang gnyis rnams kyi mchog sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'dod chags dang bral ba rnams kyi mchog /zhi ba don dam pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi'o// tshogs rnams kyi mchog byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po phyir mi ldog pa'i 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes lan gsum me tog 'thor zhing brjod nas/

tha ma la slob dpon gyis thabs yin no dang*/ slob mas legs so zhes pa brjod pa ni skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par ba lags/ de la skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par ba'i go ba ni/ thun mong ba las khyad par rnam pa bzhis khyad par du 'phags pa lags te/ skyabs gnas yul gyi khyad par dang*/ dus kyi khyad par dang*/ bsam pa'i khyad par dang*/ ched du bya ba'i khyad par ro// de la skyabs gnas yul gyi khyad par ni/ thun mong ba'i yul dkon mchog gsum las sangs rgyas dkon mchog sku gsum ni chos kyi sku las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa ni spangs/ shes bya'i sgrib pa ni ma spangs/ 'gog bden la gnas tsam la skyabs su 'gro ba lags pa las/ 'dir khyad par ni dag pa gnyis ldan chos kyi sku dri ma med pa la skyabs su 'gro bas skyabs su 'gro ba khyad par ba lags pa dang*/ thun mong ba'i longs sku bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya'i rgyal po lta bu sprul pa'i sku la longs skur byas nas skyabs su 'gro ba las/ khyad par ba'i longs sku bcom ldan 'das dpal rnam par snang mdzad lta bu longs sku mtshan nyid pa la skyabs su 'gro bas khyad par ba khyad du 'phags pa lags pa dang*/ thun mong ba'i sprul pa'i sku 'phags pa shā ri'i bu dang*/ mo'u 'gal gyi bu lta bu dgra bcom pa la skyabs su 'gro ba las/ khyad par ba'i sprul pa'i sku bcom ldan 'das rgyal ba shākya'i rgyal po lta bu la skyabs su 'gro ba las/ skyabs 'gro khyad par ba khyad par du 'phags pa lags/ thun mong ba'i chos dkon mchog ji ltar po ti dang glegs bam na bzhugs pa'i lung gi chos la skyabs su 'gro ba las/ khyad par ba ni rtogs pa'i chos la skyabs su 'gro bas khyad par du 'phags pa lags/ thun mong ba'i dge 'dun dkon mchog ni skyes bu zung bzhi gang zag ya brgyad kyi rgyun du zhugs pa dang*/ nyan thos kyi dge 'dun la skyabs su 'gro ba las/ khyad par ba ni byang chub sems dpa' phyir mi ldog pa la skyabs su 'gro bas khyad par du 'phags pa lags te/

de ni yul dge 'dun dkon mchog gi gnas skabs lags/ de ltar skyabs gnas yul dkon mchog gsum thun mong ba las khyad par du 'phags pa lags pas/ skyabs 'gro khyad par ba lags pa dang*/ dus kyi khyad par ni/ thun mong ba'i dus ji srid 'tsho'i bar du skyabs su 'gro ba las/ khyad par ba ni bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du skyabs su 'gro bas khyad par du 'phags pa la lags la/ thun mong ba'i bsam pa 'khor ba'i bde 'bras/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas skyabs su 'gro bas khyad par du 'phags/ thun mong ba'i ched du bya ba 'jig rten 'di'i gnod pa bzlog pa dang*/ nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pa'i bsam pas skyabs su 'gro ba las/ khyad par ba ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'dod pas skyabs su 'gro bas khyad par du 'phags pa lags/ de ltar dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song bas/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde skyid dang yon tan thams cad nyams su myong bar byas nas 'bras bu tha ma bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya bar 'gyur bas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba la/ ched du bya ba dang*/ nan tan du bya'o// de ltar skyabs su song ba'i rjes la bla na med pa'i byang chub kyi rgyu drug po/ byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed par bya ba ni/ de yang smon pa byang chub kyi sems rgyu rnam pa bzhi la brten nas bskyed pa lags pas/ rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po bsags pa dang*/ skyabs 'gro khyad par can byas pa dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi la blo sbyangs pa dang*/ rgyu'i gtso bo bla ma la yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes skyed pa las skye ste/ de dag yang smon pa skye bar byed pa'i rgyu lags pas de legs par bsgrubs te/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/

sdug bsngal dang bral/ myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i rgyu nges pa can byang chub kyi sems bla ma yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'di la bskyed par bya snyam du bsams la/ mdun gyi nam mkha' 'dir sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pas mchod/ lus longs spyod thams cad ltos pa med par sing gis phul la rjes zlos mdzod cig phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ slob dpon bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas tshe thog ma med pa nas tha ma dang da lta la thug gi bar du sbyin pa'i rang bzhin dang*/ tshul khrims kyi rang bzhin dang*/ sgom pa'i rang bzhin gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ ji ltar sngon gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang*/ sa chen po la rab tu bzhugs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis ji ltar thugs rin po che bskyed par mdzad pa de bzhin du/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas kyang sems bskyed par bgyi ste/ sems can ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi'o/ ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi'o// dbugs ma phyung ba rnams dbugs dbyung bar bgyi'o// yongs su mya ngan las ma 'das pa rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bgyi'o/ zhes lan gsum brjod cing*/ slob dpon gyis thabs yin no dang*/ slob mas legs so zhes brjod/ de la smon pa byang chub sems de bskyed nas/ bslab bya rnam pa lnga la slob pa lags te/ de yang rgyud la bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po gsog par bya ba la bslab pa dang*/ phan yon mthong zhing rjes su dran par bya ba la bslab pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems spel zhing sbyang bar bya ba la bslab pa dang*/

sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa dang*/ nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos bzhi bsgrub par bya ba la bslab pa'o// de la bsod nams kyi tshogs ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod pa dang*/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba'i rtsa ba mtha' dag la 'bad pa'o// gnyis pa phan yon mthong zhing rjes su dran par bya ba yang*/ de la phan yon ni/ mtshams med pa lnga la sogs pa'i sdig pa mi dge ba'i tshogs thams cad kyang*/ sems bskyed pa'i skad cig ma de la 'dag par 'gyur ba lags te/ de yang slob dpon chen po zhi ba lha'i zhal nas/ dpa' la brten nas 'jigs pa chen po ltar// gang la brten nas yud kyis sgrol 'gyur ba'i// de la bag can rnams kyis cis mi brten// zhes pa dang*/ gzhan yang rang gi lus sha khrag gi phung po 'di mi gtsang ba'i rdzas sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis gang ba 'di las/ bde bar gshegs pa'i sku mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu dang*/ 'od 'dom gang ba la sogs pa'i yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan pa'i sku 'thob par byed pa yang byang chub kyi sems rin po che lags te/ de ltar yang*/ gser 'gyur rtsi yi rnam pa mchog lta bus// mi gtsang lus 'di bsgyur nas rgyal ba'i sku// rin chen rin thang med par sgyur bas na// byang chub sems zhes bya bar legs brtan gzung*// zhes pa dang*// gzhan yang bcom ldan 'das byams mgon gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' nor bzang la phan yon dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs la/ de dag kyang mdor bsdus na rnam pa gsum du yang 'dus te/ thog mar dge ba tshe 'di'i nad dang gnod pa rkyen dang bar chod thams cad nye bar zhi zhing*/ bde skyid la longs spyod pa dang*/ phyi ma phan chad ngan song du mi skye zhing*/ 'khor ba'i skye gnas su yang bde ba dang skyid dpal phun sum tshogs pa thams cad nyams su myong bar byas nas/ 'bras bu bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'thob par 'gyur bar the tshom thams cad bral ba lags la/

de lta bu'i phan yon mthong zhing rjes su dran par bya ba dang*/ gsum pa de lta bu'i phan yon mthong zhing rjes su dran par byas nas/ spail zhing sbyang ba ni/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu yan lag bdun pa la sogs pa byed pa dang*/ mdor na lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba dang byed pa ci byed pa thams cad dang*/ spyod lam rnam pa bzhir byang chub kyi sems spel zhing sbyang bar bya ba la bslab ste/ de yang 'phel ba rgyun chags su gnas la/ de ltar yang slob dpon chen po zhi ba lhas/ dge ba gzhan kun chu shing bzhin du ni// 'bras bu 'byin nas zad par 'gyur ba nyid// byang chub sems kyi ljon shing rtag par yang*// 'bras bu 'byin pas mi zad 'phel bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// bzhi pa sems can blos mi spang ba la bslab pa lags te/ de yang kha la mi nyan zhing gnod pa skyel bar gyur na yang*/ ci phan ci bsod bya zhing sdig pa mi dge ba'i phyogs las bzlog nas/ dkar po'i phyogs kyi dge ba mtha' dag la gzung bar bya ste/ de skad du yang*// gang la gnod pa byas kyang bde 'brel ba// bde ba'i 'byung gnas de la skyabs su mchi// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ sems can ji lta bu yang rjes su gzung zhing bskyang bar bya'o// lnga pa nag po'i chos bzhi spang zhing dkar po'i chos bzhi sgrub pa yang*/ bla ma dkon mchog rdzun gyis dbu bskor na nag po'i chos yin pas spang*/ dkar po'i chos zhabs 'bring dang zhabs tog ci nus kyis bgyi ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa'i byang chub sems dpa' la zhe sdang gi tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ skur ba 'debs na nag po'i chos yin pas spang*/ dkar po'i chos ni de dag la sangs rgyas kyi 'du shes bskyed cing yon tan phyogs bcur bsgrags/ rang dang gzhan gyi dge ba la 'gyod pa skyes pa dang*/ gzhan dag dge ba spyod pa mthong na 'phya zhing bskur pa 'debs pa dang mi mos par byed na dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung gcod cing nag po'i chos yin pas spang*/

dkar po'i chos rang gzhan gyi dge ba la spro ba rgya chen po dang*/ gzhan gyi dge ba la rjes su yi rang ba dbul ba dang*/ sems can la g.yo dang sgyu'i ngos nas spyod na nag po'i chos yin pas spang ba dang*/ dkar po'i chos ci phan dang ci bsod bsgrub pa yin te/ de ltar bslab bya lnga la bslabs nas/ phan yon rnam pa bcu la sogs pa byang chub kyi sems kyi yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du gyur nas/ 'khor ba'i bde skyid thams cad nyams su myong bar byas nas/ 'bras bu bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya ba la the tshom thams cad dang bral ba lags pas/ byang chub tu sems bskyed pa de la nan tan du bya'o// de ltar bskyed pa'i byang chub kyi sems de rdzogs par byed pa la/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis gsog dgos te/ zhing dang bsam pa dngos po gsum 'tshogs pa'i rten 'brel las skye ste/ de yang spyir lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum zhing dag ste/ 'chi med rnga sgra rgyal po'i mdo las// sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab// dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab// bsam mi khyab la dad byas pas// rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab// ces gsungs pa dang*/ bye brag tu lam nyams su len pa la bla ma zhing dag ste/ dus gsum sangs rgyas kun mchod pas// bla ma'i ba spu gcig mchod pa// de ni bsod nams khyad par 'phags// zhes pa dang*// mchod pa thams cad yongs spangs te// bla ma'i mchod pa brtsam par bya// de mnyes pa las dngos grub ni// ye shes dam pa skye bar 'gyur// zhes pa la sogs pa gsung*// de la bsam pa rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems rin po che lags te/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya bgyi ba'i sems de snying rjes zhi la mi gnas pas/

zhi ba nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas mi 'dod pas rnam par dag pa dang*/ shes pas srid la mi gnas pas srid pa khams gsum gyi 'khor ba'i bde 'bras tshangs pa dang brgya byin 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa thob par mi 'dod pas/ byang chub kyi sems de rnam par dag pa lags/ dngos po rnam par dag pa ni brkus pa dang*/ phrogs pa la sogs pa ston pas ma dag pa'i dngos por gsungs pas/ de lta bu ma yin pa ni dngos po rnam par dag pa lags/ de ltar zhing bsam pa dngos po gsum rnam par dag pa las skyes pa'i bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa shin tu gal che/ de la ye shes kyi tshogs ni snag tsha dang shog gu sbyin pa la sogs pa gsungs mod kyi/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'thob par byed pa'i rgyu tshogs pa gang yin pa de ni ye shes kyi tshogs lags pas/ des na bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis dbye ba med par gsog pa la nan tan shin tu che bar bya ste/ rgyu mtshan nged rang thams cad kyang 'jig rten du yun ring po mi sdod myur du 'chi ba lags la/ de yang 'chi ba'i dus la ni bab/ mal gyi tha ma la nyal/ zas kyi tha ma chu thigs pa gcig 'thung*/ nye du dang gnyen 'brel thams cad kyis mtha' bskor/ dbugs ring thung byed cing 'chi ba'i dus su/ skyabs dang mgon spyir chos rin po che ma gtogs pa med pa lags pa dang*/ bye brag tu chos de nyams su len pa la yang skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ sems bskyed pa dang bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis gsog pa la nan tan shin tu che bar bya zhing*/ mdor bsdus par gyur na lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas sdig pa mi dge mtha' dag spong ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba phra zhing phra ba nas rgya chen po'i bar du bsgrub pa la 'bad pa dang*/ gnyis po 'dir 'jig rten mgon po rin po che dang*/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi chos thams cad ma 'dus pa med pas/

brtson 'grus chen po brtsam par zhu 'tshal/ gzhan yang shin tu phra ba'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las/ rags pa'i rgyu 'bras 'byung ba ni/ rgyal po gser mdog gis 'phags pa rang sangs rgyas la 'bras btsos pa bre chung gang phul ba'i 'bras bus/ thog mar 'dzam bu gling pa srog dang sprad cing*/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub rin po che thob pa ni/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das 'di lta bur gyur pa rags pa'i rgyu 'bras lags pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnam par gzigs la lho nas 'ongs pa'i 'bru 'tshong gis sran rdog phyed dang lnga phul ba ni phra ba'i rgyu 'bras lags la/ de'i rags pa'i rgyu 'bras gnas skabs su 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rgyal po nga las nur gyur nas/ mthar bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgyas pa rags pa'i rgyu 'bras su gsungs pas na/ shin tu phra ba'i bsod nams kyi tshogs nas bzung nas/ rgya chen po'i bar gyi bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa la nan tan bgyid pa gal che/ sngar smras pa dang 'dra ba ye shes kyi tshogs dang zung 'jug pa lags pas/ des mtshon nas dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba gal che bas/ de la bsngo rgyu'i dge ba ni/ rang nyid dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang*/ yod pa'i dge ba lags te/ de yang bdag dang bya ba rang nyid 'khor ba ni phung po bzhis bsdus kyi sems can gyi dge ba lags te/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i dge ba ni 'phags pa nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa dang bzhi la/ 'phags pa'i gang zag rnam pa bzhi'i dge ba/ mdor na bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa ni 'das pa'i dus su byas pa'i dge ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su bya ba'i dge ba dang*/ da ltar byed bzhin pa'i dge ba de ni/ dus gsum du bsags pa lags la yod pa ni rgyan stug po las// bde gshegs snying po khams dge ba// zhes pa dang*/

sangs rgyas phal po che las// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// zhes gsungs pas/ yod pa'i dge ba bsngo ba dang sngar byas pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa'i dus su byed pa'i dge ba bsngo bar gsungs pas na/ bsngo ba ni lung dang ma 'brel ba'i rigs pa rkyang ma lags/ nyi khri las kyang*/ sems kyi sde dang*/ sems kyi phung po chen po gnyis su gsungs pa'i dge ba bsngo bar gsungs la/ de yang 'phags pa'i gang zag bzhi la sems can gyi sde zer la/ phung po bzhis bsdus kyi sems can la sems can gyi phung po zer ba yin/ mdor na 'khor 'das kyi dge ba bsngo bar gsungs shing rgyu mtshan des na/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis/ bdag dang sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /de de kho na bzhin du gyur cig shākya'i dge slong grags rin gyis zhus pa// //

67) ༄// bla ma smar pa'i gdan sa sho dgon du gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dri med chos kyi sku// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen dang*// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje smar pa dang*// yab sras rnams la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams ma lus kun// sems nyid spros dang bral zhing ma skyes par// mngon du gyur pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug mchog /dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i rigs las 'khrungs// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i skyes bu chen po yis// bka' yig chab dar rgun 'brum bskur ba dang*// gsung 'phrin bskur ba shin tu thugs la btags// yig rten ras kyi sku phyam dmar po zhig /bskur nas mchis pas sku la gsol par zhu// dge ba dri med zla 'dra bas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// / 68) ༄// rtag tu nyams su len pa'i chos slob dpon yon tan rgyal po la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas// slob dpon yon tan rgyal po la spring ba// rtag tu nyams su blang ba'i gnad// rdo rje sa 'ong sbyor ba la// dus rnams rtag tu gnas pa yis// bar chad thams cad sel bar byed// 'di la rtag tu gnas par bya// nad brgya sman gcig gi gnas mchog der// dbang gi rgyal po rtag tu bsgom// bde sbyin ting 'dzin dam pa la// rtag tu gnas par mdzad par zhu// lus dang sems dang snang ba rnams// bde ldan 'jig rten khams su ni// 'od dpag med pa bzhugs pa ltar// rtag tu gnas der bzhugs par zhu// thugs dam 'phel bar mdzad par zhu// shākya'i dge slong spyan snga bas// rang gi bu la gdams pa yin// bla med byang chub thob par shog// / 69) ༄// ti se'i rnal 'byor grags pa rin chen la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/

bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas/ ngan bu'i bu ti se ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug grags pa rin chen la springs ba/ brgyud pa rin po che 'di'i chos byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin la rtag tu mnyam par bzhag pas/ sems des lus byin gyis rlob/ lus kyi na tsha dang sdug bsngal zhi nas 'ong*/ lus kyis snang ba byin gyis rlob/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten dbang du 'du/ bar do rnam pa gsum ting nge 'dzin gcig pu des bgrod nas/ bla na med pa'i byang chub tu sangs rgya/ 'phrin las gzugs sku rnam pa gnyis 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'byung bas/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa'i byang chub la 'god pa 'di ni ngo mtshar la rmad du byung ba'i chos yin pas/ 'di gcig pu thugs nyams su bzhes par zhu/ bus na ning sku thang la men ngo mtshar can bskur nas byung ba thugs la btags/ phyag tu things/ gangs kyi rgyal po ti se la// bu rnal 'byor dbang phyug grags rin gyis// sgrub pa snying por mdzad par zhu// skabs su 'gro don mdzad par zhu/// / 70) ༄// bka' yig dgos pa'i rim pa dge bshes g.yu zhu la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// phyag 'tshal byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho yin// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' med 'dir// de sngon mgo bo 'khor zhing 'khyams// bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// nga zhes bya bar rab tu bzung*// 'dzin pa'i bye brag du ma yis// sdug bsngal nyon mongs nyams su myong*// a la la dang a dzi dzi// de sngon rmongs pas mgo bo 'khor// smyon pas dran pa rnyed pa ltar// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal da gzod go// spong ba'i 'dun pa gting nas skyes// spong sems bya lugs 'di ltar bya// ngar 'dzin med pa'i sems nyid la// kun rdzob byang sems rin po che// 'gro ba'i don du bskyed par bya// de las skyes pa'i tshogs gnyis bsag

/'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// lnga ldan dam chos rin chen dang*// dbyer med ngo bor nyams su blang*// dus gsum 'khor 'das ma lus pa// ma skyes skye med sems nyid lags// ma skyes pa la skye ba med// skye ba med pa'i ngo bo de// nam mkha' sprin dang bral ba 'am// rgya mtsho rnyog ma dwangs pa ltar// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis// rtogs pa ngo bo nyid kyis 'char// ngo bo ngo bo bya ba de// ngo bo stong nyid nam mkha' la// gzung 'dzin rnam rtog sprin dang bral// sprin med nam mkha'i nyi ma des// snang ba rgya chen ston pa ltar// dus gsum ma lus mngon du gyur// ma lus rten cing 'brel 'byung rnams// 'khrul med ye shes mig gis mthong*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// ji ltar chu la chu bzhag dang*// ji ltar mar la mar bzhag bzhin// dbye ba med par gcig tu rtogs// rtogs pa'i ngo bo rnam par dag /bsgom pa'i ngo bo dran dang bral// sgom mkhan dmigs pa blo las 'das// bde gsal rnam par mi rtog pa'i// nyams rnams nam mkha'i sprin ltar dengs// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho de// rtogs pa'i ye shes nyi mas bskams// lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las de// rtsol ba med par 'byung ba des// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par byed// rdo rje 'chang nas da lta'i bar// tha snyad tshig gis ma gos shing*// don gyi snying po dam pa ni// thugs nas thugs su brgyud pa yin// thugs brgyud rin chen gter mdzod 'di// dri med ye shes spyan gyis ni// legs par gzigs pa'i skyes chen khyed// mtshams bcad mtho brtsigs spros bcad nas// bzhugs par rigs pa ma lags pas// ji ltar 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo yis// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// 'gro ba mang po 'dul ba ltar// skyes chen mi yi seng ge yis// gdul bya mang po smin par mdzod// dus gsum 'khor 'das ma lus dang*// tshig dang spros pa du ma rnams// ma skyes skye med chos kyi skur// rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyed// ji ltar spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// nyams thag sdug bsngal can skyob ltar// 'gro ba nyon mongs sems can rnams// tshad med thugs rje chen po dang*// rnam dag byang chub sems gnyis kyis// skyob pa'i brtson 'grus rtsom par zhu// tshogs dang dben pa khyad med cing*// mnyam gzhag rjes thob gnyis med na// bse ru lta bur ji ltar gnas// lus dang sems dang snang ba gsum// dbyer med 'od gsal chen por rtogs// bya byed spros pa'i rgya mtsho rnams// spros med spros dang bral rtogs nas// ji ltar spros pa spang bar bya// sems can khams la sangs rgyas su// 'bras bu bsgrub par nus bzhin du// btang snyoms bzhugs par ga la rigs// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po yis// gdul bya mang po smin par mdzad// dge slong dge slong ma rnams dang*// dge bsnyen dge bsnyen ma rnams ni// ston pas rnam bzhi'i 'khor du gsungs// de la spang blang mi mdzad zhu// snying nas dad dang gus pa yis// khyed rang min pa re sa med// snying gtad gtan gyi blo ltos bcas// da nas byang chub ma thob bar// zab mo'i chos kyis smin par mdzod// rnam dag tshul khrims rin chen dang*// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// legs par smin par mdzad pa dang*// dus gsum dus med chos kyi sku// rnam dag 'od gsal chen po yis// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor 'khor ba las// nges par sgrol bar mdzad pa dang*// ma chags mi sdang rmongs bral ba'i// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dang*// 'bral ba med par ston par byos// slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po 'gro ba mang po thar pa'i grong khyer du 'khrid par mdzad pa'i thabs la mkhas pa'i ded dpon chen po g.yu zhu ba la zhu ba'i yi ge springs yig dgos pa'i rim pa zhes bya ba'o// rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas gsungs pa'i bka' yig dgos pa'i rim pa zhes bya/

bla ma rin po che phag mo gru pas dge bshes g.yu zhu ba la springs pa/ ston pa la bskur ba lags so/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig/ ༈ //rdo rje 'chang gis dbu mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /shākya'i rgyal pos dbu mdzad pa'i// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// 'jig rten mgon po sgam po pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /yi dam lha dang dkon mchog gsum// chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog/ ༈ //oṃ swasti/ thog med dus nas dus gsum bsags pa dang*// gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba dri med dang*// bdag gis de la dmigs pa'i dge ba des// dri med rgyal ba'i zhing khams bde ldan du// padma las skyes dge slong gyur nas kyang*// rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa de mthong nas// byang chub lung bstan dam pa thob par shog /dri med rgyal ba phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// yab sras gnyis dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di bskams nas// 'jig rten sangs rgyas nyi ma 'char gyur cig// / 71) ༄// nye gnas rin chen shes rab la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med dkon mchog gsum po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags las// byung ba'i brgyud pa rin po che'i// nyams su blang ba'i dam pa'i chos// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pa dang*// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pa// bla med byang chub bsngo ba yi// lnga ldan dam chos rin chen dang*// da nas byang chub snying po'i bar// 'bral ba med par nyams su longs// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// phyag rgya chen po seng ge ste// lnga ldan ma shes mig med yin// gsungs pa'i don de go bar gyis// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo ni// ma skyes skye med blo las 'das// blo dang bral ba'i ting 'dzin la// da nas byang chub snying po'i bar// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la// legs par bstod pa'i ngo bo ni// rab zhi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor blo las rnam 'das pa// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags pas dpog par mi nus na// blo can 'jig rten gzhan gyis smos kyang ci dgos pa// shin tu zab pa'i bdag nyid rin po che dpal 'dud// zab pa bya ba'i go ba de// gzung dang 'dzin pa nyon mongs dang*// rtog dang rnam par rtog pa rnams// nam mkha' rnam par dag pa la// sprin gyis bsgrib pa med pa ltar// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i sprin tshogs rnams// rnam par dag pa nam mkha' 'dra// dam chos 'di ni ma rtogs par// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor chud// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor// res 'ga' lha dang mi rnams dang*// lha ma yin dang bcas par skyes// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// ma thon gti mug byings su tshud// gang la ji srid blo yod tshe// de srid 'khor ba sdug bsngal yin// nam zhig blo dang bral ba na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos sku yin// chos sku blo dang bral ba la// gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'byung ba des// 'gro ba smin dang grol ba dang*// byang chub mchog la 'god pa de// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras dang*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin// legs par sgrubs dang rnal 'byor pa// gang gis 'grub cing rtogs snyam na// rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// dus mtha'i mos gus chos skur bsgom// rtogs 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// da lta lus ngag yid gsum gyi// bya ba byed pas bla ma yi// zhabs 'bring zhabs tog byed pa 'di// chags sdang rmongs dang ma 'dres par// byang chub sems las skyes par sgrubs// spyod pa rnam par dag pa yi// bla med tshul khrims rin chen dang*// ma bral chos rnams kun gyi gzhi// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis po// khyad du ma gsod gsog par mdzod// rtag tu ri khrod stong pa rer// gnas pa gong ma'i rnam thar yin// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod dang*// rtag tu 'bral bar ma byed cig

/'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen gyis// mi rjes sleb par 'dod na ri la song*// rdo rje'i gsung de snying por gzung bar bya// ji srid bla ma bsten gyi bar// ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub par bya// nam zhig dus la bab pa'i tshe// ri khrod dgon gnas 'gṛm par bya// lar 'khor ba spong ba snying po'i chos// 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs dgongs mchog /skye med blo dang bral ba dang*// 'bral ba med par ri khrod bsten// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// spong bar byed pa dam pa'i chos// shākya'i dge slong spyan snga bas// nye gnas rin chen shes rab la// nyams su blang bar bya phyir gdams// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 72) ༄// phyag rgya chen po lnga ldan gyi khrid rin chen phreng ba shes rab seng ge gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med dkon mchog gsum po dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags las// byung ba'i brgyud pa rin po che'i// nyams su blang ba'i dam pa'i chos// byang chub sems dang yi dam lha// bla ma phyag rgya chen po la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pa dang*// dus gsum bsags dang yod pa yi// dge ba'i rtsa ba ma lus pa// bla med byang chub bsngo ba yi// lnga ldan dam chos rin chen dang*// da nas byang chub snying po'i bar// 'bral ba med par nyams su longs// brtson 'grus can gyi gang zag gis// tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob pa'i thabs// dam chos lnga ldan rin chen lags// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// phyag rgya chen po seng ge ste// lnga ldan ma shes mig med yin// gsungs pa'i don de go bar gyis// phyag rgya chen po'i ngo bo ni// ma skyes skye med blo las 'das// blo dang bral ba'i ting 'dzin la// da nas byang chub snying po'i bar// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// 'jig rten mgon po rin po ches// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la// legs par bstod pa'i ngo bo ni// rab zhi thugs kyi dkyil 'khor blo las rnam 'das pa// blo mig dag pa'i 'phags pas dpog par mi nus na// blo can 'jig rten gzhan gyis smos kyang ci dgos pa// shin tu zab pa'i bdag nyid rin po che dpal 'dud// zab pa bya ba'i go ba de// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i nyon mongs dang*// rtog dang rnam par rtog pa rnams// nam mkha' rnam par dag pa la// sprin gyis bsgribs pa med pa ltar// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i sprin tshogs rnams// rnam par dag pa nam mkha' 'dra// dam chos 'di ni ma rtogs bar// khams gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor tshud// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor 'khor// res 'ga' lha dang mi rnams dang*// lha ma yin dang bcas par skyes// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// ma thon gti mug byings su tshud// gang la ji srid blo yod tshe// de srid 'khor ba sdug bsngal yin// nam zhig blo dang bral ba na// dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos sku yin// chos sku blo dang bral ba la// gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'byung ba des// 'gro ba smin dang grol ba dang*// byang chub mchog la 'god pa de// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras dang*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yin// legs par sgrubs dang rnal 'byor pa// gang gis 'grub cing rtogs snyam na// rnam par dag pa chos kyi sku// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gzugs sku gnyis las 'das pa yi// dus mtha'i mos gus chos skur bsgom// rtogs 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// lar 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*// sang dang 'chi ba gang snga yang*// sus kyang tshod zin mi nus pas// sgrub pa nyams su len par zhu// 'khor dang gnyen 'dun longs spyod rnams// mtha' rgyas phun sum tshogs na yang*// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan te// thar pa'i bar du gcod par byed// sde dang dgon pa yul phyogs rnams// kun gyi brten sa khyed yin yang*// khyed nyid gang la brten pa de// shes par mdzod cig dam pa khyed// da lan 'di bya de rjes la// bdag gis sgrub pa bya snyam ste// dus la long ni yod mod kyang*// tshe la long med shes par mdzod// rlung dmar nang gi mar me de// da lta gsal 'phro kam gyis 'gro// rtag rtag 'dra ba'i phung po 'di// 'chi rkyen mar me de dang mtshungs// 'jig rten 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan thams cad g.yeng g.yeng nas// sgrub pa'i bar du gcod par byed// phal cher sku mtshams mdzad par zhu// rgyu med 'bras bu mi srid pas// byang chub sems las skyes pa yi// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnam gnyis// rgyun chad med par gsog par mdzod// yon tan bskyed par byed pa yi// tshul khrims sa gzhi yin pas na// ston pas ji ltar bcas pa yi// nyes ltung rgyud la ma skye mdzod// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// spong bar byed pa dam pa'i chos// shākya'i dge slong spyan snga bas// bdag gi bu sdug dge ba'i bshes// rgyal po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// lus dang ngag dang yid gsum gyis// bla ma dam pa mnyes mdzad pa'i// dpon shes rab seng ge khyed la springs// bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// rgas nad 'chi ba'i rba klong 'khrug pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba ma lus 'don par shog
/lnga ldan rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba/ dpon shes rab seng ge la gdams pa'o/// /

73) ༄// gdan sa rin po che'i bla ma dge 'dun rnams la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// rgyal ba phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// slob dpon pas dbu mdzad pa'i gdan sa rin po che'i bla ma dge 'dun la zhu ba 'bul ba/ gdan sa rin po che de dam pa'i chos 'ba' zhig gis skyong bar zhu/ de la bar gzu g.yon gsum mi mdzad par zhu ba dang*/ rge ru dang dge bsnyen sgo 'jus dang btsan kar mi len par zhu/ bu lon rnying pa'am 'brel bag tsam re la snyad btags nas sgom chen pa rnams sbran nas mgon po 'od bzhin du mi 'chi bar zhu/ chang 'thung dang khyim btsun byung na gdan sa ba'i khog tu med par de la kha bor la zhog spyir ngam shod pa rje sa bdag gi rgyal po phar ka tshur ka gnas gzhi dang sde dgon yon mchod dang bcas pa'i zhabs tog tu ci 'gro khong mi mnyes pa med pa dang zhabs 'dren du 'gro ba mi mdzad par zhu/ thel la bzhugs pa'i grwa nang gang gis kyang so so'i tshoms byas nas ngan rgyab dang kha mchu kha smras gang gis kyang mi mdzad par zhu/ mdun don dang lab gzhi ci byung yang nang pa la zhus la nang pas phu bsgyur la nang pa ma gtogs pa so so sgo sgor gang gis kyang mi mdzad par zhu/ phyag 'tshal sgang yan chod du chang gi rgyu 'grul sngon nas da lta'i bar la med pa yin pas byung na chad pa che tshad du gcod par zhu// grwa nang med pa'i thel la phyug ma gang gis 'dzin pas shar la 'ded na chu phyar mo nas mang kar sgang la 'ded pa dang*/ nub la 'ded na phyag 'tshal gong ma ma gtogs pa lam gzhan la mi 'don par zhu/ phu rin po che de'i shing la bla ma gong ma rnams dang ngan bu dang bcas pa'i bka' rgya'i khog tu ji ltar bcug pa la mi cog par zhu/ 'jang skyang dang*/ zangs ri/ 'om ka dang nying ra yan chod kyi gzhis ka ba dang she ma rnams kyis chos dang mthun pa 'ba' zhig gyis/
