chos dang mi mthun pa'i rdzas phag dang*/ lug ma 'dzin/ chos dang mi mthun pa spyod zer ba byung na 'brog bod gang du yang mi 'jog par zhu/ yang dgon nang pa'i byab ba rnams kyis kyang*/ slob dpon pa'i spyan snga nas ci gsung sgrub pa dang*/ brtson 'grus 'od zer gyis ji ltar bshams pa dang*/ ji ltar zer ba bzhin bsgrub par zhu/ kho bla ma dge 'dun thams cad kyi zhabs tog par yab sras thams cad kyis bskos pa'i mi yin/ brtsigs pa'i mkhar yin/ khrims rogs med par yon bdag mo'i gnas po mi mdzad par zhu/ spyir skor ba ba dang 'bul ba skyel ba'i yon bdag mo byung ba rnams zhag gsum phan mi 'jog par zhu/ zhag gsum phan gang gis bzhag kyang chad pa gcod par zhu/ thams cad thang sham dang ldan par gyis/ phu der ral gu dang gos dkar po gon pa byung na shus/ dge bshes khams ston 'di gdan sa rin po che'i spyi dpon yin pas/ khos ji ltar bshams pa la thams cad kyis nyan par zhu/ gdan sa rin po che der ngan bus dgung lo nyi shu rtsa bdun bzhugs pa la kha mchu ma byas/ kha smras ma byas/ phyag 'tshal sgang man la kha mchu'i ched du bla ma dge 'dun thams cad kyis zan cig khyer nas 'gro ma myong ba yin pas/ bla ma gong ma rnams dang ngan bu'i rnam thar gyi rjes su 'brang bar zhu/ khyed mda'i phag mo gru'i grong pa rnams kyang khyed rnams dge bsnyen yin pas/ mang dbyes kyi kha mchu kha smras ci byung yang de la gang gis kyang gtogs 'dzin ma byed/ byed pa dang 'gro ba cig byung yang de la phu pas chad pa chod/ bka' shog 'di'i rjes su 'brang ba dang*/ dus bzang dus bzang la tshogs su 'don pa zhu/ 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 74) ༄// dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po dbon po la gdams pa//

oṃ swasti// bla ma rin po ches spyan snga nas/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen dbon po ba'i spyan sngar springs pa/ khyed kyi thugs dgongs rnam par dag pa bzang po de rnams ngo mtshar shin tu che/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs dgongs kyi de kho na lags/ snang la rang bzhin med pa 'dzin pa thams cad dang bral ba de yang dag pa'i bsam pa phyin ci ma log pa lags pas de kho na la thugs dam mdzad par zhu/ ngan bus kyang thugs kyis dgongs nas byin gyis rlob/ khyed kyi rgyud la de rtag tu gnas par byin gyis rlob pa lags/ khyed kyis 'bul ba rgya chen po bskur ba rnams ngan bu'i phyag tu things/ thugs la btags/ yig rten na bza'i rgyu gos chen yug gcig dang*/ zi pol zhog gang bskur nas mchis/ byang chub thob par gyur cig// / 75) ༄// slob dpon lha mgo ba la rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom par gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas/ slob dpon lha mgo ba la springs pa/ khyed lta bu chos kyi bdag nyid bla ma'i mos gus dang*/ chos min pa ni mdzad rgyu med/ sku khams kyis spyod pa'i dus su 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang*/ chos gsungs pa dang*/ mi spyod pa'i dus dang*/ skyo shas che ba'i dus su bde ba can gyi gnas su rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bsgom zhing*/ de la thugs dam mdzad par zhu/ sku khams bde zhing yon tan thams cad de las 'byung ba lags/ ngan bus kyang khyed kyi sku'i rim gro la thugs gtad pa yin/ khyed kyis chab gser srang do bskur ba phyag tu legs par things/ yig rten du chab tsha rtse mo zho gcig dang*/ zi pol zho gcig dang zho do bskur nas mchis/ byang chub thob par gyur cig// / 76) ༄// rnal 'byor bzhi'i khrid 'dzam nyan yon tan rgyal po la gdams pa// oṃ swa sti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// chos kyi 'khor lo gsum gyi de nyid/

nyams su len pa'i tshul lugs/ dam pa'i chos lnga ldan ltar nyams su blangs pa las 'bras bu dang po rtse gcig dang*/ spros bral gnyis kyi ngo bo dbye ba med pa zhig rgyud la skye/ de la mnyam par 'jog pa'i tshul dang*/ rnal 'byor pa'i go lugs chos kyi 'khor lo dang po bden pa bzhi'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang gcig tu mchi// de la bogs thon nas 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad chos kyi sku phyag rgya chen po gcig tu gtogs pa'i ngo bo de chos kyi 'khor lo bar pa dang dbye ba med pa gcig tu mchi/ ngo bo de la mnyam par bzhag pas bogs thon nas phyogs ris med pa chos kyi skur rtogs pa me long g.ya' dag pa la bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor gsal ba ltar chos kyi 'khor lo gsum dbye ba med pa rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ma lus pa gcig tu gyur pa de nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ rjes kyi shes pa gnyis dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos thams cad chos kyi 'khor lo tha ma'i don gtsang ba dang rtag pa dang bde ba dang rtag pa'i ngo bo de nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa ma gtogs pa mi bdog 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig// / 77) ༄// dbon po chos kyi 'byung gnas la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dang*// bde sdug khur gyis dub pa'i tshe// 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang gis// 'gro ba 'dul bar bgyid pa ltar// sems can don las bya rgyu med// snyam pa'i bsam pa bskyed par bya// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// byang chub sems las skyes gyur cing*// nga dang bdag med spyod pa yis// 'gro ba'i don las bya rgyu med// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams ni// theg pa dman la zhugs pa rnams// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal 'khur spangs nas// zhi bar bzhugs pa de ltar min// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' rnams// sems can don du spyod pa ltar// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdul bya mang po smin pa'i phyir// mtho dman bde sdug gang byung yang*// skyo shas thams cad spangs nas ni// chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba yis// 'gro ba mang po smin par bya// skyo shas rgya mtsho'i gting du sba// lus ngag yid gsum ma lus pa// byang chub sems las skyes pa yis// 'gro ba mang po smin par bya// thos bsam sgom las byung ba yi// shes rab mchog gis rnam par rgyal// gces pa'i bu gcig spyan snga ba// sems can don la brtson 'grus brtsam// sprul sku rin chen mal rin gyi// ji ltar gsung ba bzhin du sgrubs// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog/

// 78) ༄// rtsa sar ba gzhon nu dpal la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che spyan snga nas/ dpon la springs pa/ spyir sku khams spyi la phan pa dang*/ bye brag tu zhabs la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ lte ba'i 'og khong pa'i nang du rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma nad kyi 'jigs pa skyob ma sku mdog sngo ljang zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa mkhyid gang tsam zhig bsgom/ de'i sku las 'od zer sngo ljang mar la nar gyis byon nas zhabs kyi bsnyun pa'i nang thams cad 'od zer sngo ljang des mer re khengs par bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas sku khams spyi dang*/ zhabs la sogs pa la phan pa lags/ srung dar mdud pa gsum pa zhig bskur nas yod/ dpung pa g.yon pa la thogs/ byang chub thob par bsngo'o/// / 79) ༄// nyams su len pa'i rim pa zhal slob rdo rje tshul rgyal gdams pa// bu brtan pa ri bo lta bur gyis// sra ba rdo rje lta bur gyis// zab pa rgya mtsho lta bur gyis// oṃ swa sti// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rin chen dang*// rgyal ba byams mgon de nyid phyag 'tshal lo// tshe 'di mi rtag skad cig glog dang 'dra// sdug bsngal mtha' med 'khor ba spang bar dka'// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel soms dang chos kyi bu// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba ma lus rnams// bdag med las byung byang chub sems kyis su// legs par sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus chen po rtsoms// rnam 'gyur gsum dang ma bral sngags ltar spyod// tshig ngan mda' de bzod pa'i phub kyis longs// gnod cing gshe ba'i skyes bu gang byung yang*// phan 'dogs bzhin du de la gus par byos// rang byung phyag rgya chen po nyams su longs// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis bsag par bya// shin tu phra ba'i dngos po gang la yang*// bsgrub par bya zhing khyad du ma gsod dang*// dngos pos phongs pa med pa rten 'brel yin// phra dang rags pa'i rgyu 'bras sems la zhog

/rgyu med 'bras bu 'byung ba ga la srid// skyes bu dam pa la ni brten pa dang*// tshul khrims g.yag rnga bzhin du bsrung bar bya// ha cang mthun dang 'gras ba'i sems spangs te// mnyam pa nyid du spyod par gnas par bya// ji ltar byas kyang nyon mongs gsum po la// sems gsum rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas bsgom par bya// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod spyod par gyis// phyogs nas byon pa'i 'gron po dge 'dun la// pha dang bla ma bzhin du mdun nas bsu// spyan drangs gdan bting ji ltar 'os pa yi// bsnyen bkur bya zhing dga' ba bsgrub par bya// bzhud pa'i dus su ji ltar 'os par skyel// snyan pa'i tshig gis bde bar bzhud ces brjod// byang chub sems dpa' ri bong gyur pa'i tshe// brgya byin bram zer sprul par gyur pa la// bsu skyel bkur bsti mdzad pa'i rjes su 'brangs// lar 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa yin// mya ngan 'das pa'i grong khyer de// nga med bdag med stong pa yin// skye med stong pa bdag dang bral// bdag med stong pa rang sems la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par zhu// res 'ga' spros med bse ru ltar// nags kyi nang du sdod la bsgom// res 'ga' ri khrod nags khrod dang*// dgon pa rnams su bsdad la bsgom// res 'ga' grong khyer tshong 'dus dang*// skye bo mang po'i nang du bsgom// skye shi srid pa rmi lam gyi// bar do gsum pa des bgrod bya// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho de// rang sems rtogs dang sgom pas spongs// sems kyi rgyal po de nyid yin// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnam gnyis// zung du chud par nyams su longs// dkar po chig thub 'di nyid yin// snying la yod pa'i gsang tshig 'di// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes byas shing*// mnye btul bsgyur bzlog ci byas kyang*// mos gus ltem rkyang med pa dang*// bdag gi drin gyis rang sems rtogs// nyams gsum dri ma spangs pa yi// dgos pa'i rdo rje tshul rgyal la// nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'di// bstan pas 'gro kun byang chub mchog thob shog// /

80) ༄// 'khor spong byed kyi lam mchog sgom pa rin 'byung la gdams pa// om̐ swa sti/ rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam zhing khams 'dir// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i 'phrin las kyis// dus rnams kun tu 'gro rnams skyob mdzad pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gus phyag 'tshal// nam mkha' lta bur rab yangs 'jig rten 'dir// cho 'phrul sna tshogs khyab par ston pa'i mgon// brjod med mtha' bral rgya mtsho lta bu'i gsung*// bden gsung dri med rnam par dag pa ni// tshangs dbyangs ka la ping ka 'brug gi sgra// chos kyi 'khor lo sgyur mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med nam mkha'i thugs// glo bur rnam rtog nyon mongs sprin dang bral// dus gsum mkhyen pa me long g.ya' bral 'dra// rnam dag nam mkha'i thugs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun gyi srog /dus gsum bdag nyid dpal ldan 'bri gung ba'i// sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// phan yon med cing nyes dmigs mang*// skye bar sla zhing 'jig pa dka'// sdug bsngal nyon mongs sems can rnams// tshad med thugs rje chen po yis// nges par skyob mdzad chos kyi rje// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// 'gro ba ma rnams bskyab tu gsol// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi mtsho 'di// rtog dang rnam par rtog las byung*// mig gi dbang pos yul la brtag /bzang la chags shing ngan la sdang*// bar ma la ni rab tu rmongs// de yis ngan song gnas gsum bskyed// 'khor ba gting mtha' med par 'khor// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho bgrang las 'das// 'khor ba'i chu bos rgyun du khyer// da rung thon pa'i dus skabs med// de bzhin rna ba'i dbang pos sgra// sna yi dbang pos dri la yang*// lce yi dbang pos ro la ste// lus kyi dbang pos reg bya la// brtags pas rtog pa rab tu skye// bzang po rnams la chags pas brtags// rtog pas dmyal ba'i 'jig rten bskyed// bar ma rnams la rmongs pas brtags// rtog pas dud 'gro'i 'jig rten bskyed// bka' yi sku mched rnam gnyis po// ma chags mi sdang rmongs med pa'i// sems gsum nor bu rin chen 'di// sdug bsngal 'khor ba spong byed sman// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa yi// ye shes ngo bo de nyid de// 'od gsal chen po sems kyi gshis// sku gsum lhun grub dbye ba med// dus gsum rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// bka' brgyud gong ma thams cad kyi// thugs kyi snying po yon tan rdzogs// 'di las gzhan pa spu tsam yang*// ma mchis med par thag chod pas// chags med rmongs med sdang bral ba'i// sems la rtag tu gnas par zhu// tshogs dang dben pa gar 'dug kyang*// rin chen sems kyi rgyal po de// dran pa'i bdag pos srung bar zhu// yul lnga'i dgra bo byung ba'i tshe// stobs chen 'od gsal chen por sba// ro mnyam chen po'i zhags pas bcing*// 'grus skyo rtogs med kyi ngang la bzhag

/mtho dman sna tshogs thabs yin pas// shes rab bdag med nga med pa'i// ngo bor gnyis su med par bya// bcu gsum chos kyis nyams su blang*// sna tshogs thabs kyi rgyal po de// rgyal ba'i 'phrin las skyon med cing*// rnam dag ngo bo nyid du bsgrub// dug lnga sman gyi rgyal por spyad// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di// mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang yin// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs kyi rba rlabs 'di// chos sku spros dang bral ba yin// gsungs te thabs kyis zin na yin// thabs med dug des gsod par byed// dang po rtog pas 'dzin pa'i dug /rtog med stong par rtogs pas bcom// gnyis pa las kyi spu ris dug /bcu gsum chos kyi nyams len gyis// bcom nus rgyal ba'i 'phrin las yin// 'di yi nyams len ma shes na// rang srog rang gis gcod par byed// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdams ngag nor bu rin po che// dus dang 'phrod par bsgom par bya// brtson 'grus chen po rtsoms shig dang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan dang*// 'khor 'das bde skyid ma lus pa// dbul pos gter ni rnyed pa 'am// 'khor lus sgyur rgyal sras mchog de// gling bzhi rin chen sna bdun gyis// 'byor pa chen po thob pa ltar// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// skyabs mchog rgyal bar bdag gyur na// sangs rgyas ye shes spyod yul ni// mkhyen pa'i ye shes rnam gnyis kyi// zag med sbyor ba chen po des// dbul zhing sdug bsngal gyis bcings pa'i// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// dbul dang sdug bsngal skyon spangs nas// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po sems nyid du// byang chub dam pa thob par byed// des na rin chen rnam gnyis la// gros 'debs snying nas chags sdang spongs// rmongs pa de yang de bzhin pas// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags mi rmongs sdang bral ba'i// bskyed pa'i las ni dge bar 'dod// rtsa ba dug las lo ma dang*// yal ga thams cad dug yin pas// dug gis rang gzhan gsod par byed// de bzhin nyon mongs gsum bskyed la// gdug pas 'khor ba gsod par byed// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i srog

/gcod par byed pa'i gshed ma de// spongs dang 'khor bas ci zhig bya// de lta dgos te 'di yis 'dir// sngar yang bdag la gnod pa byas// bdag gi gnyen dang phyogs ris dang*// bdag dang mdza' ba rnams la sdang*// da lta de bzhin byed pa dang*// phyis kyang gnod par 'gyur bas na// da res 'di la bzod thabs med// phyi nas bzod pa rab tu bsgom// snyam pa'i rtog pa skye ba de// 'khrul pa chen po gti mug yin// rang nang gi nyon mongs rnam rtog de// gnod skyel skyes bur snang bar byed// sems la zhe sdang spongs shig dang*// gnod pa'i dgra bor snang ba dag /gzugs dang me tog ji bzhin te// lus dang srog la bab gyur kyang*// zhe sdang rnam rtog ma skyed la// skye na byams pa chen por bskyed// tshangs sogs 'khor ba'i bde 'bras rnams// nyams su myong bar byas gyur na// rnyed par dka' ba'i byang chub 'thob// 'on kyang sdang dang byams pa gnyis// 'od gsal rnam dag sems nyid du// ro mnyam chen por khrug gis btang*// byams dang sdang med sems nyid de// rgyal ba rnams kyi sku yin pas// mun pa sel ba'i sgron me yin// sdug bsngal 'khor ba 'joms byed yin// chos kyi sku dang mi 'bral zhu// de bzhin gti mug 'dod chags sems// skyes pas phyi rol yul snang gnyis// gzugs dang me long ji bzhin te// sems gnyis spongs dang yul gnyis 'gag /skye na chags med rmongs bral bskyed// gnas skabs rtsa gsum 'jig rten dang*// phra rag rten 'brel mngon du 'gyur// mthar thug chos rje sangs rgyas 'thob// 'on kyang chags sdang rmongs pa dang*// chags med gti mug med sems gnyis// ma skyes skye med sems nyid du// dbye ba med pas nyams su blang*// tha dad med cing bye brag med// 'od gsal rnam dag dam mkha' yin// dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos sku yin// yon tan bskyed pa'i ma ma yin// 'khor ba dug gi sdong po de// gcod par byed pa'i sta re yin// bka' yi skyes bu rnam gnyis pos// da 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// rtsa ba nas ni spongs la 'dir// ma chags mi sdang rmongs med pa'i// sems gsum blo yis bskyed la bsgom// gnas skabs lha mi'i go 'phang dang*// tshangs pa brgya byin 'khor los sgyur// ma lus nyams su myong byas nas// mthar thug thams cad mkhyen pa 'thob// chags med rmongs bral rnam gnyis sems// 'bras bu rtsa gsum rgyu 'bras bcas// ma skyes lhun gyis grub pa yi// spros med chen por nyams su blang*// spros pa med pa'i ngo bo de// rnam dag nam mkha'i rang sems yin// sangs rgyas rnams kyi chos kyi sku// 'gag pa med pa'i ngo baur spyod// bu chags sdang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras la// thogs med dus nas rtag tu spyad// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dpag med myong*// thugs rje ldan pa'i sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*// tshad med thugs rje ldan pa yi// bla ma rnams kyis gso thabs bral// nyon mongs gsum po ma spangs par// 'khor ba rang dgar mi ldog cing*// 'dzad pa'i mu mtha' ma mchis pas// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho rang gis spongs// ci yis spong zhes bsam gyur na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// rang gi rgyud la ma bskyed par// dus gsum dus med rang gi sems// rtog dang rnam par rtog dang bral// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun las 'das// nga dang nga yir 'dzin pa dang*// 'khor ba dang ni mya ngan 'das// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos// rnam dag nam mkha'i rang sems su// gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor grol// ma skyes mi skye skye ba med// skyes pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// ma skyes skye med nam mkha' bzhin// chos kun skye med nam mkha' bzhin// nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la// nam mkha' lta bur bsgom byas na// nam mkha' lta bur byang chub 'thob// byang chub ngo bo sems nyid dang*// skad cig tsam yang ma 'bral bar// bsam med brjod bral ngang la zhog

/'khor ba spangs pa de nyid lags// spang bya spang du med pa dang*// gnyen po bsten du med pa gnyis// gnyis med nam mkha'i ngo bor rtogs// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho skam// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i ye shes rgyas// mkhyen pa gnyis ldan chos kyi rje// 'bri gung bzhugs pa'i mgon po dang*// dbyer med gcig tu 'gro bar nges// dogs pa thams cad rab spangs nas// snang grags thams cad chos kyi sku// rab tu zhi zhing nye bar zhi// stong pa kho na'i chos rnams la// stong pa'i chos rnams 'byung ba ste// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras yin// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo de// stong pa nyid dang ma bral bas// zung 'jug lha dang lha mo yin// skye dang rnam par rtog pa rnams// ma skyes mi 'gag gnas pa med// stong pa chen po 'od gsal yin// 'dod 'dun rnam rtog skye ba de// 'dod pa spangs pa'i thar pa yin// 'khor 'das gnyis su 'dzin pa de// rab rib can gyi skra shad yin// bdag gzhan gnyis su dbye ba de// stong pa nam mkha'i mdud pa yin// 'on kyang 'khor ba ma stongs tshe// sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las kyis// 'gro ba ma rnams skyob pa de// byang chub sems kyi 'phrin las yin// 'khor ba'i mun pa sel ba de// rnam dag rang sems nyi ma yin// de gnyis dbye ba med pa yi// 'phrin las rgyun chad med pa de// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// dgos 'dod yid bzhin nor bu yin// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// dus gsum bdag nyid rin po che// mthong thos dran pas 'gro ba yi// sdug bsngal nyon mongs spong byed pa'i// bde chen kun bzang yangs pa'i mdzod// bde skyid thams cad 'byung ba'i gnas// mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan dang*// 'phrin las ma lus thams cad la// rang bzhin dbyer med ngo bo der// lhun gyis grub pa'i mos gus bya// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar gzung*// sku yi rnam thar tshul khrims de// phyi nang gnyis su shes par bya// nang gi tshul khrims bsrung ba ni// da lta rang gi sems 'di la// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// nyon mongs rnam rtog ma lus pa// mi bskyed skyes spong brtson 'grus kyi// sdom pas bsdams pa'i brtul zhugs gzung*// dgos pa'i dus su btang snyoms spang*// brtson 'grus chen po brtsam par gyis// phyi yi tshul khrims bsrung ba ni// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// bya dang byed pa nyung ba dang*// sbyangs sdom brtul zhugs spyod pa dang*// bya dang byed pa thams cad kyis// 'gro rnams dang ba 'dren pa dang*// chags pa'i yul dang lhan cig tu// gnas par nam yang mi byed cing*// sdang ba'i yul la byams pa yi// sman chen bsam pa rab bskyed de// gnod cing 'tshe ba spong ba dang*// tshul khrims bdag gir bsgrub par bya// rmongs pa'i yul dang phrad pa'i tshe// gti mug bsam pa rab bcom nas// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo bsgom// rgyu las 'bras bu nges pa'i phyir// phra dang rags pa'i rgyu 'bras la// brtsi ldab yang dang yang du bya// phyi dang nang gi tshul khrims gnyis// lus dang srog bzhin bsrung bar bya// la ka'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// rkyen gyi dbang du ma gtong zhu// brtan pa ri bo bzhin du mdzod// mi 'gyur rdo rje lta bur gyis// nang rtags gzhan gyis ma mthong bar// zab pa rgya mtsho lta bur spyod// rtsi yis lcags rnams gser 'gyur ltar// phar sgyur tshur sgyur mi mdzad par// rang tshugs brtan po 'dzin pa gces// zer lo ltas lo ma mang bar// long ba 'on lkugs 'du shes bya// sus kyang skyid du mi 'jug cing*// gzhan gyi gnod pa skyel dogs med// rang spyod gzhu rgan bzhin du bya// phra ma rdzun dang mchu bsnyung spang*// bden pa'i tshig gis 'tsho bar mdzod// bla ma slob dpon grogs rnams la// ma chags mi sdang rang sor gzhag

/chags pas ci bya sdang ci bya// rang gzhan thams cad 'chi ba yin// nam yang 'chi ba'i ro de la// sdang bas gsad pas dgos ci yod// gzhon zhing lang tsho ldan pa dang*// mdzes shing yid du 'ong rnams la// log g.yem chags pas ci zhig bya// bu ga dgu nas mi gtsang 'dzag /phar la mchod kyang tshur la gnod// nam yang 'chi ba'i ro de la// chags pa'i bsam pa rab spongs la// chags med bdud rtsi dam pa des// lhar bcas 'jig rten chags can rnams// chags bral 'jig rten sangs rgyas su// bsgrub pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam par zhu// a ma a dzi nga re 'jigs// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dran tsam na// rang snying tshal bar ma gas pa// glen pa yin nam smyos sam ci// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// bzod par dka' ba'i sdug bsngal ni// gse gshag gcod dang 'tshed pa rnams// dran pas keng shu'i 'dab ma ltar// snying 'di rab tu 'dar gyur kyang*// pangma'i mtsho la ngang pa ltar// bag med 'khor bar spyod pa 'di// gdon gyis brlabs sam ci zhig yin// rang la rang snying mi rje'am// skyabs gnas dam pa chos kyi rje// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// 'joms par mdzad pa'i mthu bo che// mya ngan 'das gling rnam dag der// skyel bar mdzad pa'i nus pa can// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// spyi mthun bsod nams las grub de// de bzhin gshegs pa 'bri gung pa// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol// bdag cag sems can thams cad la// skyabs dang mgon rnams gzhan du med// re sa ltos sa gzhan du med// gnas skabs bde zhing 'phral du skyid// byang chub thob par byin gyis rlobs// dus gsum bdag nyid chos kyi rje// skyob mdzad mgon po 'bri gung pas// nyon mongs dug gsum rgyu 'bras kyis// khams gsum 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams// thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol// las ngan rgyu 'bras las byung ba'i// me dbal 'brum bu'i nad kyis zin// bas mtha' dgon pa 'khor skyo bu// srog la re thag chad pa'i blos// mar nang spu ni phyung ba bzhin// lus kun nad kyis gdung par gyur// 'jig rten 'di yi longs spyod dang*// bu slob gnyen 'dun thams cad ni// rmi lam thun gcig rmis pa ltar// mthong ba med pa'i phyogs su gnas// de tshe 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon// thogs med sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul gyis// der byon spyi bor phyag bzhag pas// phub ma rlung gis gtor ba ltar// sdug bsngal las byung nad de bcom// srog gnang dam chos 'ga' zhig go// phongs shing gcig pu lus pa'i tshe// sdug cing nad kyis gdungs pa'i tshe// bdag gi zhabs tog gus par byas// bu chung a mas 'tsho ba ltar// byams pa'i lus ngag yid gsum gyis// bdag gi lus 'di 'tsho bar byas// sdug bsngal chen po sgos su khur// dgos pa'i tshe de gus par byas// bla ma rin chen byin rlabs dang*// sku mched gnyis kyi zhabs tog 'dis// deng sang cung zad bde bar gnas// zab pa'i dam chos don po 'di// sdug bsngal 'khor ba spong ba'i sman// thar dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyu// sku yi rnam thar tshul khrims yin// rjes su 'brongs shig rgyal sras gnyis// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gsung gi rnam thar zab mo 'di// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// sus kyang go zhing rtogs pa nyung*// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab kyis// dregs pa can gyis ga la go// rang 'dod nam mkha' 'dom gyis 'jal// skyi ba'i rdzing bu dgra la sman// de dang 'dra bar shes par bya// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i gsung*// rtag dang bden par snyan gsung ba// yid 'ong tshangs pa'i gsung dag ni// bden gtam ka la ping ka'i gsung*// mi dge gshis kyi mi dge ba// thog mar mi dge'i las gang de// bar dang tha mar mi dge bas// sdig to ngan song bskyed pa de// nam yang gnang ba'i skabs med par// rtag tu spang ba'i chos su bstan// ston pa'i gsung la mtha' drug gi

/log rtog spangs la rang sor bzhag /dge ba gshis kyi dge bar bstan// thog mar dge ba'i chos de gang*// bar dang tha mar dge ba'i gsung*// 'di la mi dger 'gyur ba'i skabs// nam yang med par chos rnams gsungs// mtha' drug rdo rje'i tshig rgyas btab// de 'gyur ba med pa'i gtan tshigs yin// gsung gi rnam thar zab mo 'di// zungs dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i sras// kha cig dge ba mi dger 'gyur// mi dge dge bar 'gyur bar 'dod// smyon pa bla brdol sma ba ltar// 'brel med mu cor smra rnams kyis// ston pa'i dgongs pa ga la lon// yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma'i thugs// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pas// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing ma lus spangs// dus gsum 'khor 'das rtag chad dang*// mtho dman grub mtha' sna tshogs rnams// sems nyid 'od gsal chen po der// byang chub dam par sangs rgyas pa'i// thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes de// da ltar rtogs pa'i rang sems dang*// dbye ba med cing tha dad med// rtogs pa sems kyi rgyal po la// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis dang*// dran pa'i rgyal po ma bral bar// chu bo'i gzhung bzhin nyams su longs// ma g.yengs pa dang mi 'da' ba// bying dang rgod pa gnyis bral bar// nyams dang rtogs pa med par bsgom// rtogs pa'i sems nyid gcig pu yis// bar do gsum po bgrod par bya// gegs sel bogs 'don dgos pa'i tshe// skyabs gnas dam pa 'bri gung pa// bla ma mchog de dran par bya// gegs sel bogs rnams thon par 'gyur// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma dang*// dbyer med gcig tu 'dres par nges// rdo rje 'chang dang tilli dang*// dpal ldan nā ro chen po dang*// chos rje mar pa mi la dang*// 'jig rten mgon po sgam po pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru par bcas// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma rnam bdun dang*// dbyer med gcig tu 'dre ba ngo mtshar che// tshogs dang dben pa gang du 'dug gyur kyang*// nyams len rgyal po gzhung 'di dran par bya// gnyen 'dun tshogs la zhen pa ma skye zhig// sdang ba'i dgra la gnod sems spang bar gyis// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems rnam gsum// phan pa'i sman yin nyams su blang bar gyis// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// gsung sgros yi ger bris pa'i dam chos 'di// nyams su blang bar bya phyir khyed gnyis la// 'khor ba spong byed thabs kyi lam mchog bstan// 'khor ba spong bar byed pa thabs kyi lam mchog ces bya ba dam pa'i chos/

sgom pa rin 'byung dang rin chen grags gnyis kyis bdag dmyal du 'brum nag gi nad chen pos thebs shing*/ shi la thug pa'i dus su g.yog legs par byas shing*/ srog bton pa'i gtang rag tu bstan pa rdzogs so// bdag dang 'khor 'das dus gsum dge ba 'dis// bskal ba stong du bsags shing rnyed dka' ba'i// 'gro mgon 'bri gung pa dang mi 'bral zhing*// ma rnams byang chub mchog la 'god par shog /shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas nye gnas sgom pa rin 'byung dang*/ rin chen grags gnyis la gdams pa rdzogs so// //

81) ༄// gsung rabs kyi babs cung zad smras pa dge bshes rin chen rgyal la gdams pa// oṃ swa sti// bde gshegs rin chen chos kyi rje// thams cad mkhyen pa 'bri gung pa'i// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pas// rgyal po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs zin byin gyis brlabs pa'i sras// dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin rgyal la// zhu ba 'bul ba'i tshig gi don// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces// g.yo ba 'gyur zhing 'jig pa dang*// sang dang 'chi ba gang snga yang*// sus kyang tshod zin mi nus pas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyang*// cis kyang ring du mi gnas par// ston pas mdo rgyud rnams nas gsungs// 'khor dang longs spyod gnyen 'dun rnams// mtha' rgyas bskyed pa phun sum tshogs// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan kun// lhun gyis grub cing bkod pa 'dra// zhag gcig zhag gnyis yid 'ong dang*// lo gcig lo gnyis 'thad na yang*// sgrub pa'i bar chod byed pas na// mchil ma'i thal ba ji bzhin du// spangs nas sgrub pa mdzad pa dang*// phal cher sku mtshams mdzad par zhu// 'jig rten 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan thams cad g.yeng g.yeng nas// rang sems rin chen 'dus ma byas// lhun grub 'od gsal chen po ste// nyi ma sprin gyis sgrib pa ltar// rjes kyi dbang du 'gro nyen gda'// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs dgongs dri ma med pa'i chos// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// 'od gsal rnam dag sems kyi gshis// spros med spros pa kun las 'das// dri med lhan skyes ye shes te// 'khrul med ye shes spyan gyis ni// ma nor gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// btang snyoms bzhugs pa ga la rigs// sde dang dgon pa yul dang phyogs// kun gyi brten sa khyed yin yang*// khyed nyid gang la brten pa de// shes par gyis dang rnal 'byor pa// da 'dir dus ngan chen po byung*// 'khor 'das kun gyi gnyen gcig pu// thams cad mkhyen pa mya ngan 'das// legs kyang ngo so su la gsol// nyes kyang zhe bas khrel mkhan med// des na sgrub pa ma gtogs pas// 'bras bu 'khor ba mi spong zhing*// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma dang*// dbyer med gcig tu mi 'gyur bas// spros pa'i rgya mtsho skems nas ni// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad par zhu// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// bde skyid yon tan ma lus pa// sgom pa'i mthu las 'byung ngo zhes// thams cad mkhyen pas tha mar gsungs// rgyud nyon mongs gsum gyis ma gos shing*// rnam rtog rlung dmar 'tshub ma de// 'od gsal dbyings su gsod pa dang*// dran rtog nam mkha'i skra shad de// rang gi gnas su 'jug par bya// rtog med rtog par skye ba de// bcu dang gsum gyi dam chos kyis// nyams su blangs na 'khor 'das kyi// bde dang sdug pa'i 'bras bu rnams// sgrub pa'i chos la brtson 'grus mdzod// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// dri med dam chos rin chen gyei// gter du khyed nyid bzhugs pa na// gnas skabs mthar thug nyams len kun// dgos pa'i dus su btang snyoms spang*// brtson 'grus chen po rtsom par zhu// deng bya sang bya yul las 'das// 'dir byed btang zhing bsgrub par bya// snyoms las can rnams smra na yang*// bdud kyi dbang du song bar zad// skye rga na 'chi med gyur na// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyang spyod// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang*/

brtul zhugs grub pa ma lus kun// de phyir de la spyod par 'gyur// thub pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*// rga dang na dang 'chi ba ste// gal te 'di gsum med gyur na// shin tu sdug pa'i yul rnams la// nga yang ci phyir spyod mi 'gyur// yab la gsungs par gyur pa dang*// zab pa khye'u bzhi'i mdo las kyang*// 'dod pa khyi dang phag pa dang*// wa dang bong bu 'dod spyod kyis// spyad pa mi spyod nyan thos min// ston pas gsungs par gyur pas na// 'dod yon 'khor ba'i rtsa ba de// 'dod pa spangs pas thar pa 'thob// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// gong ma rnams kyis 'dod yon spangs// bdag cag rjes su 'jug par bya// de ltar bdag cag sems can rnams// mgo btums mun rum ji bzhin du// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mi bsam par// tshe 'di sgrub pa'i khol por 'gyur// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i lta bas bcings// sred pas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bskyur// len pa'i ngo bo zhe sdang gis// 'khor ba'i bye brag mang por 'khor// rtsa ba nga dang bdag gis byas// bdag 'dzin rtsa ba rbad kyis bcad// bdag med byang chub sems gnyis kyi// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag /sems des lus de byin gyis rlobs// lus kyi na tsha thams cad zhi// lus kyis snang ba byin gyis rlobs// lhar bcas 'jig rten dbang du sdud// bcu chos sum chos rnam gnyis dang*// zab pa'i dam chos 'khor lo ma// rtsa rlung ma dang snga ma rnams// de yi bye brag ma gtogs pa// brjod bya gzhan na spu tsam med// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan kun// rmi lam du yang ma rmis na// dam chos byed ces de la bya// thub chen bla ma dam pas gsungs/ */phye gtor ('dir ma dpe ldeb gcig ma tshang )pa'o// 'jug sems sdom pa'i bdag nyid ni// tshad med nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam pa// rgyal ba rnams kyis bskyed pa ste// 'bras bu longs sku bcom ldan de// sku tshe 'khor ba ji srid bar// zhing khams nam mkha'i mthar thug pa// nyams len byang chub sems gnyis yin// 'dus pa dang po mchog brgyad de// sgo lnga'i rnam shes yid shes dang*// nyon yid kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'di// brjod pa rgyu yis bsgrubs pa lags// sde snod mdo sde rin po che// 'jug sems chen po'i sdom pa dang*// mthun par spyod par bslab par bstan// chos kyi 'khor lo chen po ni// bar pa rgyal po'i khab tu gsungs// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam// dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyis chos// thams cad stong pa nyid du bstan// byang chub sems gsum dbyer med pa// longs sku rgyal ba bcom ldan gyi// sku la zhing khams thams cad snang*// zhing khams kun tu sku yis khyab// mthong bas sgro 'dogs gcod par byed// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// thub pa chen po'i rjes 'brangs nas// gong du smras pa brjod pa las// le'u gnyis dag ni brjod pa'o// don dam rin chen byang chub sems// spros med chen po nam mkha' ltar// rgyal ba rnams kyis gang bskyed pa// 'bras bu mthar thug chos kyi sku// dag pa gnyis ldan bcom ldan yin// dam chos sde snod chen po ni// mya ngan 'das dang dam pa'i chos// padma dkar la sogs par ni// bse ru lta bu'i theg pa dang*// dman pa nyan thos theg pa ste// bden bzhi rten 'brel bcu gnyis chos// 'bras bu zhi ba rnam gnyis bcas// don gyis theg dman sun 'byin mdzad// theg pa 'og ma med par bstan// theg pa thams cad gcig tu bzhag

/byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa yin// brjod bya gtsang dag bde dang ni// rtag pa nyid du bstan pa yin// sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' ste// 'jig rten dam chos nub mi 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po rtag par ni// gong gi sku gnyis bstan pa yang*// ri bong rwa dang sbal pa'i spu// mo gsham bu dang 'dra ba ste// sku gnyis log par btags pa nyid// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa// chos sku yon tan 'phrin las dang*// bcas par bla ma dam pa bzhed// gong gi rnam bzhag bdun po ni// brjod bya gsum du bsdus pa yin// tshig nyung don du mang ba'i chos// rgyal ba'i gsung rabs rnams kyi babs// cung zad smras par gyur pa yis// le'u gsum dag ni bstan pa'o// drang srong chen po ye shes dgas// byang chub thob pa'i thabs su ni// ldom bu bdag la zhus pa yin// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo/// / 82) slob dpon yang dgon pa la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje rin po che'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing nges par skyabs su mchi'o// dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i mchod rten chen po gdan sa rin po che dpal gyi phag mo gru nas/ shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi yon tan gyi rgya mtsho slob dpon rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po yang dgon pa'i spyan sngar zhu ba'i don/ khyed sku khams bzang zhing 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin po che'i gdul bya rgya mtsho lta bu rnams thar pa'i grong khyer chen por khrid par mdzad pa la skyo dub mi mnga' zhes thos/ de shin tu bka' drin che zhing thugs la btags/ khyed kyis 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje rin po che yab sras kyi rten khyad par du 'phags pa rnams dang*/ slob dpon dbon po rin po che dang ngan bu dge 'dun phyogs ris dang bcas pa rnams la de bzhin gshegs pa'i bka' shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa rin po che zhun mas bris pa tshar mang po dang*/

'bul ba rgya chen po dpag tu med pa bskur ba rnams gar yang chud zos spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med par phyag tu legs par things/ bye brag tu gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo grur gdung rten rin po che rnam gnyis kyis dbu mdzad pa'i rten rnams kyi spyan sngar mar me btsugs pa dang*/ chibs ngo mtshar can yul ri bas sna drangs nas 'phral du dgos shing nye bar mkho ba'i dngos po ngo mtshar can dang bcas pa rnams dge bshes jo sras kyi phyag tu legs par things// bu skyes mchog mi yi seng ge la// snying nas zhu ba 'bul ba'i don// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems// nga dang bdag dang bral ba yi// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes par// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// 'od gsal chen po chos kyi sku// mngon sum mdzad pa'i skyes bu khyed// gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs su// phan dang bde ba du ma rnams// ngang gis 'byung ba ngo mtshar che// gang du bzhugs pa'i sa phyogs der// rtag tu 'dir bsdad bsam pa dang*// mi bzhugs 'gro zhes bya ba la// yul de na gnas pa'i gzhi bdag la// bdag gi ma yin drin can yin// drin can ma rgan 'di nyid kyis// gtso bo byas pa'i sems can rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub dam pa thob bya'i phyir// cung zad ci khom 'dir bsdad bya// snyam pa'i 'dun pa bsgom par bya// der gnas gzhi bdag spyi dang ni// dgos kyi gzhi bdag de nyid la// skabs su dkar gtor re re bya// bden pa'i byin rlabs bka' bsgo bya// 'khor dang longs spyod gnyen 'dun la// ma zhen ma chags ma yengs pa// dbu ma'i lam la gnas pa dang*// bdag med byang chub sems gnyis kyis// gdul bya rgya mtsho smin par mdzod// da lta sa chen 'di steng na// yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// dam chos rin chen ma lus pa// chos kyi gter mdzod 'chang ba'i mchog

/rang byung lhan skyes ye shes kyi// 'jig rten mgon po'i byin rlabs kyis// 'khrul med ye shes spyan gyis gzigs// dri med rnal 'byor chos kyi sku// 'od srungs chen po gang po ltar// 'bral med chos rje rin chen gyi// bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa'i mchog /skyes bu chen po khyed lta bu// btang snyoms bzhugs par mi 'os pas// thugs stobs chen pos dge 'dun bskyang*// sems can zhing la sangs rgyas kyi// 'bras bu gnas par nges pa lags// de rtogs pa dge ba'i bshes la rag /'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// thugs dgongs dge 'dun lags par ni// skyes chen khyod kyi thugs la mnga'// byams pa'i bdag nyid slob dpon gyis// yab 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i sras// mes dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i dbon// shākya'i ban ldom bdag gi bu// skyes chen mi yi seng ge la// zhu 'bul yi ger bris pa yi// bsod nams phung po mchis pa des// 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// thugs kyi dgongs pa bla med mchog /byang chub dam pa thob par shog /yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten du ras kyi sku phyam ngo mtshar can man 'dzu 'dzi ba ka'i mdog gam/ srog chags lham bu chu gsher gyi mdog ltar dmar ba gcig dang*/ dza ti rdog ma bdun dang*/ kha che gur kum thum po gcig bskur nas mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig/ // 83) ༄// springs yig bdud rtsi thigs pa rin 'bum la gdams pa// oṃ swa sti/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// skyob pa shākya'i rgyal po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// brgyud pa rin chen chos kyi sku// chos sku spros bral nam mkha' ltar// stong dang shin tu stong ba dang*// stong pa chen po nam mkha' ltar// chos rnams gdod nas ma skyes pa// mo gsham bu dang sbal pa'i spu// ri bong rwa dang 'dra bar ni// gzung dang 'dzin pa'i ngo bo dag

/de dang dbyer med de nyid yin// lhag bsam rnam dag las skyes pa'i// kun rdzob smon 'jug rnam gnyis dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// stong pa stong pas stong pa yin// 'on kyang rgyu 'bras rten 'brel rnams// bslu ba med par 'byung ba de// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras yin// de dang de gnyis dbyer med pa// thams cad zung 'jug yangs pa de// 'khor 'das gshis dang gnas lugs lags// de nyams su blang ba'i tshul lugs ni// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' la// chu bo rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ltar// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag gyur na// sems kyis lus de byin gyis rlob// lus kyi na tsha sdug bsngal zhi// lus kyis snang ba byin gyis rlob// lhar bcas 'jig rten dbang du sdud// bar do rnam gsum des bgrod nas// 'jig rten mgon po rgyal bar 'gyur// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'byung*// de lhun gyis grub pa'i 'phrin las dang*// ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i bsod nams yin// khyed nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i sras// shākya'i ban ldom bdag gi bu// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rin 'bum gyi// springs yig bdud rtsi thigs pa 'di// rtag tu nyams su blang bar zhu// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// / 84) ༄// slob dpon se 'phrang ba la gdams pa// oṃ swa sti/ skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// bla ma rin chen spyan snga nas// mes dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i dbon// shākya'i dge slong bdag gi bu// thos bsam sgom las byung ba yi// shes rab mchog gis rnam par rgyal// dri med tshul khrims rin chen dang*// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// 'gro ba mang po smin par mdzod// rang byung lhan skyes ye shes de// thugs su chud pa'i rnal 'byor pas// skal ldan gdul bya mang po la// rtogs pa'i myu gu skyed par mdzod// ji ltar byams mgon 'jam dbyangs kyis// rab 'byams 'jig rten khams rnams su// gdul bya mang po 'dul ba ltar// 'gro ba mang po smin par mdzod// bla ma rin po che spyan snga nas slob dpon se 'phrang ba la zhu ba/

khyed kyis 'bul ba rgya chen po bskur ba dpon pas dbu mdzad kyis phyag tu legs par things/ yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten du sku phyam rdo rje gsang lam gsol 'phro gcig dang*/ gsol ja chab tsha srang bzhi bcu tham pa bskur nas mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*/ byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la/ kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig/ //

85) ༄// dbon po 'phags pa la gdams pa// oṃ swasti// bskal mang dpag med legs par sbyangs pa'i mthus// lung rigs man ngag chos rnams ma lus pa// rmongs med shes rab mchog gis mngon sum mdzad// bsags pa'i stobs kyis shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// mtshan yang don ldan slob dpon 'phags pa yis// snyan ngag don ldan zab mo'i bka' yig gnang*// bdag cag bu slob gus pas 'bul zhing mchis// // 86) ༄// mos gus can gyi slob ma shes rab tshul khrims la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ dpal ldan 'gro mgon rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// ma rtogs pa rtogs par byed pa yang bla ma la chos kyi sku'i mos gus byed pa yin la/ rtogs pa bogs 'don pa la skyon med pa'i maṇḍal la sogs pa phyis nas bla ma la phul nas bdag gi rtogs pa bogs thon par mdzad du gsol zhes gsol ba 'debs shing snang srid thams cad chos kyi sku 'ba' zhig tu bsgom/ mos gus mchog tu byed pa'i thabs ni/ bla ma'i mdzad pa bzang ngan 'bring gsum thams cad la nyes pa'i skyon du mi blta bar bla ma dam pa'i mdzad pa bzang po dang a cang yang ches te/ ngan pa dang 'bring po la yang 'gro ba la phan thogs pa'i rten 'brel 'ba' zhig yin snyam du bsgaum/ de la brten nas mos gus la bogs 'ong*/ dben pa bya ba'i go ba de gcig pur bsdad kyang rtog pa mang po'i dpung gis bskor na g.yeng ba yin pas/ rtog pa rtog med du nyams su blang*/ spyod lam lus ngag yid gsum gyi spyod pa ci byed pa thams cad byed pa dang spyod pa med pa phyag rgya chen po 'ba' zhig du nyams su blang*/ dge sbyor byed cing sdod pa'i gnas// gcig tu chags sdang chung ba dang*// gnyis su 'tsho ba bde ba dang*// bsdad pa'i gnas la zhen pa mi skye ba'i// sar ni bzhugs shing bsgrub par zhu// chags sdang chung zhing nyams rtogs 'phel// rtag tu chos dang 'bral ba med// de 'dra'i gnas su bsdad par bya// mos gus can gyi bdag gi bu// shes rab tshul khrims skyes chen la// zab pa'i gdams ngag 'di bskur ba// rtag tu nyams su len par zhu// rten 'brel bcu gnyis rtags su ni// chab tshwa rtse mo zho bcu gnyis// bdud rtsi bcud kyis bla ma yi// sku lus tshim par byed pa yi// gsol zho'i mdzo mo bzang mo gnyis// bskur ba phyag tu legs par things// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// 'gro rnams byang chub thob par shog// /

87) ༄// rtsod pa zhi ba'i bstan bcos byams chen ting 'dzin ma// oṃ swa sti// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// skyabs cig 'gro mgon rin chen dang*// tshad med thugs rje mchog mnga' ba// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// sa steng 'dzam gling thams cad kyang*// rtsod dang 'khrug pas rnam par khyab// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyang*// sa steng gnas pa dka' bar gda'// phyogs rnams kun kyang mun pas khebs// dam chos rin chen spyod pa nyung*// chos dang mi mthun bdud tshogs 'phel// phyin ci log gi spyod pa las// bdag cag ma lus bskyab tu gsol// rgyal tshab thob pa'i byams mgon dang*// rgyal bas lung bstan sgam po pa// bcom ldan 'phags ma sgrol ma la// gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nyes dang mi mthun 'jigs pa las// bdag cag bskyab par mdzad du gsol// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyis// phyogs rnams byin gyis brlab tu gsol// 'khrug dang rtsod pa kha smras dang*// nyes dang mi mthun phyogs rnams kun// byams chen ting 'dzin byin rlabs kyis// dgra gnyen mnyam pa nyid gyur nas// zhe sdang me 'di zhi mdzad gsol// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal byang sems la// snying nas skyabs gsol 'o dod 'bod// 'dzam gling byin gyis brlab tu gsol// gdug pa mtha' yi dgra bo dang*// bdud dang bdud kyi phyogs rnams kun// zhi zhing nye bar zhi mdzad gsol// spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can// 'gro ba'i skyabs mchog dam pa dang*// 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo'i byin brlabs kyis// nyes pa'i tshogs las rgyal mdzad gsol// sems dang lus dang snang ba gsum// dag pa byang chub sems gnyis kyis// 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad gsol// ston pa'i bstan pa rgyas gyur cing*// dam chos rin chen spyod pa la// chos dang mi mthun phyogs rnams kun// zhi zhing nye bar zhi mdzad gsol// 'gro ba'i nyon mongs khro 'khrug rnams// ston pa'i byams chen ting 'dzin gyis// bde ldan 'jig rten khams su ni// 'od dpag med pa bzhugs pa ltar// zhing de de ltar 'gyur mdzad gsol//

// 88) ༄// dri ma med pa'i rnam thar bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan// oṃ swa sti// dag cing rnam dag brjod las 'das// dri med dri ma kun dang bral// 'khrug dang kha smras kha mchu spangs// rdul bral dri med khyod phyag 'tshal// nyes tshogs 'khor ba skyed pa'i gzhi// nyes dang rtsod pa kha mchu rnams// spangs nas byang chub thob par bstan// rtsod pa zhi mdzad khyod phyag 'tshal// gdan sa rin chen phag mo gru// sku srog nyid dang mtshungs gyur kyang*// dam chos rin chen srung phyir dang*// rjes su 'brang ba'i slob ma rnams// rtsod 'khrug chags sdang skyed dogs pas// sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams kun// dwags lha sgam por spyan drangs pas// thams cad sgrol gyi ming sring ltar// thugs la bzod pa mi mnga' yang*// rjes su 'brang ba'i slob ma dang*// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// nyams par 'gyur bar legs dgongs nas// chos srung 'khrug rtsod spangs pa lags// dgung lo sum cu rtsa lnga nas// bdun cu rtsa lnga'i bar du ni// dpag med tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor bskyangs// dri med rnam thar mchog de la// rtsod dang 'khrugs pa kha smras med// mtshon cha dbyug pa go cha spangs// chos gos gsum dang lhung gzed ni// nyid dang khri khrag du ma'i tshogs// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// rdul bral rnam thar mchog der spyod// drang srong chen po bcom ldan 'das// skyon spangs yon tan kun rdzogs pa// bla ma mchog la skyabs su mchi// gdug pa'i skye bo 'ga' zhig gis// zhabs 'dren chen po byas gyur na// chos kyi 'gro ba 'dul ba'i phyir// chos gos lhung gzed bsil byed bcas// chu dang bcas pa'i sprin bzhin nam// glang chen dregs pa bral ba ltar// tsam pa ka yi tshogs lta bu// dul ba'i dpa' brtan dge 'dun gyis// chos khrims sgos gnon mdzad pa las// nyon mongs gsum gyi rjes 'brangs nas// cha lugs gzhan du bsgyur ba spangs// de ltar gang du bzhugs pa'i sar// byams pas bde dang ldan pa dang*// snying rjes sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub sems kyis mchog la 'god// pha dam pa de yi rnam thar gzung*// dri med tshul khrims rin chen dang*// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// rang dang 'gro ba ma lus pa// thar pa'i lam la gzhug par bya// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnam gnyis// ngoms pa med par bsog par byos// rang las gzhan gces brtul zhugs gzung*// srog dang lus dang longs spyod rnams// mi srung dam chos srung bar bya// phyogs gcig yun ring gnas gyur na// chags dang 'khor ba 'byung ba'i phyir// rgyal khams phyogs med rgyu bar byos// chags sdang nyes skyon chung ba yi// phyogs der brtul zhugs chen po gzung*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// 'od gsal chen po sems kyi gshis// spros bral nam mkha' lta bu la// rtag tu mnyam par 'jog par bya// spros pa'i g.yeng ba mang po yis// rang gzhan thams cad g.yeng g.yeng nas// sems spros med nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor de// chags sdang gza' yis 'dzin par gda'// soms dang skyes bu dam pa kun// kwa cis kyang mi phan 'chi ni 'chi// las kyi gshin rjes spyi bor zin// 'chi ba'i lam du zhugs na yang*// chags sdang spros pa'i rgya mtsho 'di// da rung blo yis mi thengs pa// smyos pa yin nam ci zhig yin// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// ngo re tsha la yi re mug

/lung pa yo ba chu bran gyis// 'gyur bar nus pa dka' mor gda'// rang nyid srung ba shin tu gces// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir gzhan don dka'// ngang pa chu las 'o ma len pa ltar// dang po rang gi 'dod pa bsgrub par bya// ri sul sman ljongs nags rnams su// bya dang ri dwags shing rnams kun// mi snyan chags sdang skyed mi byed// bzang ngan rkyen rnams ma lus pa'i// spros pa ngo bo nyid kyis zhi// dri med bsil ba'i bser bu ldang*// khams dang dbang po ma lus pa// dwangs shel rnyog pa med par byed// spang ljongs nag mthongs me tog rnams// mkhas pas yid kyis bkod pa bzhin// skye med rtag tu gnas par spro// sems dang sems byung chos rnams kun// chu dang dbu ba'i 'phreng ba bzhin// skye med ngo bo nyid kyis ston// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams kun// phra dang rags pa ma lus pa// shes rab chen po'i mig gis mthong*// yul dang rnam rtog mthon dman kun// nam mkha'i sprin ltar dwangs nas mchi// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// ngo bo nyid kyis rgyud la skye// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par byed// zag med sdig dang ltung ba spangs// dge dang bde dang dga' ba'i sems// dri med bdud rtsi'i ro mchog gis// lus ngag yid gsum tshim par byed// stong dang shin tu stong pa dang*// stong pa chen po 'od gsal ba// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// nga dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i sems// 'jig tshogs lta ba 'di bcom nas// sems rnam thar sgo gsum rtogs gyur nas// rab tu zhi zhing nye bar zhi// ma skyes skye med nam mkha' bzhin// skyes pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// spros bral 'od gsal chen po la// mnyam rjes 'dzin pa nga bdag gis// shin tu phra ba'i rten 'brel dang*// nam mkha' lta bu'i rten 'brel dang*// sgyu ma lta bu'i rten 'brel dang*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung rnams// 'khrul med ye shes mig gis mthong*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// skye ba'i rgyu dang gnas pa'i gzhi// 'jig par byed pa'i rkyen la mkhas// chos dang chos min ma lus pa// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// mig rnam par dag pa'i lag mthil du// skyu ru ra ltar mngon sum 'gyur// phyogs bcu rgyal ba'i zhing khams su// rnam dag 'od dpag med la sogs// sangs rgyas thams cad mngon sum mthong*// dbugs 'byin byang chub lung bstan thob// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// spros med chen po 'od gsal gyi// shes rab chen po mdun du bzhug

/ma go ma shes ma mthong ba'i// dngos po spu yi rtse tsam med// chos dang chos min 'byed la mkhas// 'di la chos kyi rje zhes bya// 'di la rin po che zhes bya// 'di la thams cad mkhyen zhes bya// khyung nam 'phang gcod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bya bskon par chud pa ji bzhin du// sems khong du chud par ga la rigs// nam mkha' lta bu'i rnal 'byor la// gzung du med cing bcing du med// phan gdags chad pas gcad du med// rang dgar spyod na byang chub 'thob// chags sdang phyogs su lhung ba med// mnyam nyid byang chub sems gnyis dang*// 'bral ba med pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bar do rnam gsum des bgrod nas// mnyam med 'jig rten mgon po dang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// 'bral ba med pa ngo mtshar che// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// nam zhig stongs par ma gyur bar// mnyam med 'jig rten mgon po yi// gdul bya mang po smin par byed// 'jam dpal dpa' bo mkhyen cing dpa' ba dang*// kun tu bzang po de yang de bzhin te// byams mgon blo dang ldan pa ji bzhin du// bdag gi dge ba thams cad rab tu bsngo// rtsod pa thams cad nye bar zhi gyur cig khro 'khrug thams cad rnam par dag gyur cig /rab tu byung ba nang gi 'khrug long gis// ston pa'i bstan pa nub pa thon gyur cig /bcom ldan rgyal po'i khab tu bzhugs pa'i tshe// lha sbyin ma skyes dgra la brten nas su// dge 'dun khag gnyis bye bar gyur pa'i tshe// zhag bdun bar du ston pa bzhugs bzhin du// bstan pa nub phyir dam chos mi zin cing*// mnyam par bzhag pas 'bras bu ma thob tshe// shes rab mchog ldan 'phags pa shā ri'i bu// rdzu 'phrul mchog ldan mo'u 'gal bu gnyis kyis// dge 'dun gcig tu byas pas sor chud ltar// bdag kyang de ltar nus pa'i mthu ldan shog /rtsod pa 'di yang nye bar zhi gyur cig

/nyi ma mkha' la shar bas mun gsal ltar// gti mug 'khrul pa nyes pa du ma rnams// rab bsal byams la gnas pa nyid du shog /gnyan yod grong khyer chen por klu khros pas// mtshon cha'i char chen rab tu phab pa'i tshe// mo'u 'gal bu yis byams la mnyam bzhag pas// mtshon cha me tog char du bab pa ltar// bdag kyang byams pa'i mthu dang ldan gyur nas// 'dzam gling rtsod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*// gsod pa'i mtshon cha phan pa'i sman gyur nas// phan tshun zhe sdang me dpung 'bar ba rnams// sems gsum bdud rtsi'i chu yis gsod mdzad pas// 'gro ba rnams la phan 'dogs nus par shog /rgya gar rgya nag hor dang sog po'i yul// gdug pa'i zhe sdang can rnams zhi gyur te// byams la gnas pas phan gdags nus par shog /sa bdag 'khor bcas thag ring bzhugs gyur pa// brnyas par bya ba rung min gsungs pa ltar// sa chen 'di bdag hor gyi rgyal po yang*// zhe sdang rab zhi gti mug sgrib bsal nas// byams dang snying rje mchog la gnas gyur te// 'dzam gling sems can nyon mongs rnams la ni// phan bde'i gnas gyur mi 'jigs sbyin par shog /bdag gis smon lam 'di btab grub par ni// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen dang*// dri med rgyal ba phag mo gru pa dang*// zla 'od gzhon nur gyur pa sgam po pas// byin gyis brlabs nas smon lam grub mdzad gsol// thugs rje mchog mnga' shākya'i rgyal po dang*// byams mgon mthu dang ldan dang spyan ras gzigs// 'jam dbyangs dpa' bo 'phags ma sgrol ma yis// bdag gis gsol ba btab de grub par mdzod// bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// bdag gi bla ma dam pa dang*// dus gsum dkon mchog thams cad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// nyes tshogs 'jigs su rung ba las// bdag cag thams cad bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa klu sgrub lha yi lha// mu stegs 'joms mdzad birwa pa// dpal ldan nag po spyod pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'dzam gling bde bar byin gyis rlobs// 'od gsal rnam dag chos kyi sku// bram ze chen po sa ra ha// gdug pa tshar gcod pad ma dang*// sa steng 'dzam gling rgyan drug dang*// grub thob chen po mchog brgyad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal gsol ba 'debs// 'dzam gling rtsod pa zhi mdzad gsol// bstan pa srung mdzad thugs rje can// dpal ldan nag po chen po dang*// dpal gyi lha mo chen mo dang*// mthu ldan chos skyong srung ma rnams// tshad med thugs rje'i mthu bskyed nas// 'dzam gling rtsod pa zhi ba dang*// ston pa'i bstan pa srung mdzad gsol// thos dang bsam dang sgrub pa yi// shes rab mchog gis rnam par rgyal// skyes bu dam pa rnam brgyad kyis// 'dzam gling thams cad bde ba dang*// skyo ba bsang phyir bskul nas bris// 'di bris bsod nams phung po des// shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing khams su// mi 'khrug rgyal po 'khor bcas bzhugs// zhing 'di de ltar 'gyur mdzad gsol// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog
/dri ma med pa'i rnam thar bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas sbyar ba rdzogs so/// /

89) ༄// rang gis rang nyid la gdams pa glang chen me tog char pa// oṃ swa sti/ yon tan rgya mtsho rin chen lhun po dang*// dgos 'dod 'byung ba nor bu rin chen ltar// rin chen bdag po klu dbang rgyal po bzhin// mchog gi bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad 'dud// bskal pa grangs med mang por ni// dbu dang phyag zhabs mang po dang*// yid 'ong rgyal srid du ma sogs// thugs rje can des 'gro don btang*// rnyed par dka' ba'i byang chub de// snyigs dus mi srun skye bo la// thugs rje'i dbang gis zhing 'di bzung*// nyi ma'i gnyen gyur bcom ldan gyi// rjes su 'brang bar khas ni blangs// zhi ba'i go cha chen po yod// go cha so ma du ma skye// 'on kyang rkyen ni sna tshogs kyis// pad ma la n-i dro char ltar// ji ltar mtshon ni sna tshogs kyis// nor bu de dngos min pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs kyis// khyab bdag de dngos min par snang*// yul rkyen sna tshogs byung ba'i tshe// glang chen me tog char pa ltar// rgyan du byed pa ma gtogs pa// yi mug skye ba ga la srid// 'gro ba nyon mongs can yin pas// 'thad par byed pa shin tu dkon// ji ltar mi 'thad gnod mang na// bdag gis 'thad pa bsgrub par rigs// rgyal sras 'phags pa gang po ltar// bzod dang bzod pa chen po ni// rdzogs par byed pa'i dus la bab// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum ni// sngon gyi rgyal ba bzhin du bskyed// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// 'jug pa byang chub sems gnyis kyis// 'ubs kyis bsdus nas byang chub kyi// lam du bar chad med par 'gro /bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa gnyis// dbye ba med par nyams su len// lha dang phyag rgya chen po gcig /stong dang rgyu 'bras dbyer med nyid// nyams len chu bo'i gzhung dang mtshungs// rgyun mi 'chad cing lhun gyis grub// 'on kyang rgyu 'bras rten 'brel ni// mkha' la glog dang chu bur ltar// dpag tu med de 'byung pas 'jigs// a la la dang a dzi dzi// las ni phra mo khyad bsad kyang*// 'bras bu chen pos mdun nas bsu// yod ma myong la khyad par chos// sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i smig rgyu'i chu// skom pa'i phyir na snyog pas ngal// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras ni// dus gsum rgyal ba'i gsang ba yin// sgyu ma'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung gcig

/bslu med nam mkha'i rnam 'phrul 'di// dge sdig 'bras bu so sor smin// rgyal ba'i mthu yang rdugs pas 'jigs// sgrib gsum bral ba'i bcom ldan gyi// zhabs la seng ldeng tshal pa zug /bslu ba med pa'i rgyu 'bras yin// mthon dman sna tshogs bya ba rnams// chags sdang med pa'i sems kyis bsgrub// lus spyod ngag spyod sems spyod gsum// bzod dang dad pa'i rjes 'brangs nas// phan dang bde ba gang byung yang*// lan ldon chags sdang spangs pa dang*// thams cad chos dang ldan pas btul// byang chub thob phyir bya ba bsgrub// rgya mtsho lta bu'i dge 'dun la// mthon dman bzang ngan mang po yod// kun gyi spyod pa khyag pa dang*// thams cad srog bzhin skyong ba ni// nyid kyi spyod pa snga ma yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par byas// phag gru dpal gyi dgon pa 'dir// 'jig rten mgon po 'bri gung pa'i// snyan pa'i ba dan las tshogs pa'i// stong phrag dge 'dun khyod kyis bskyangs// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis ni// chu bo'i gzhung bzhin rgyud la 'bab// dag pa'i tshul khrims spos ngad kyis// ri dwags rgyal po seng ge ltar// gzhan gyis smrar med zil gyis mnan// che khyer rgya mtsho'i gting du sbas// zas gos bde ba sna tshogs ni// dug bzhin spong zhing yon tan gnas// snga nas yo byad phyogs tsam gyi// rang rgyud gong ltar zhu thug mdzod// phye bas ri bo gtor yang 'gam// de ltar rgyu 'bras bslu med pas// 'khor ba khrag gi rgya mtsho 'di// ye shes nyi mas bskams nas kyang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob gyur cig /glang chen me tog char pa zhes bya ba// rang nyid la gdams pa rdzogs so/// / 90) ༄// chos rje'i gsung gi zin bris bstan bcos sems nyid rdo rje ma// oṃ swasti// sems nyid rdo rje 'dus ma byas// skye 'gag spros pa dang bral ba// sku gsum dbyer med he ru kaḥ

/bde chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// rin po che'i zhal nas gal te dge sbyor ni 'phel/ mthun rkyen ni 'dzoms la/ dus ma yin par 'gro dgos pa byung na 'dug pa'i rten 'brel ni gtor ma phugs su bskyal/ bshang lci yang phugs na yar dor/ de nas 'dug pa'i sgo khro bo gcig gis bcad par bsgoms la/ 'dug na yang kha phugs su bltas la rkang pa dkyil krung bcas la/ shes pa ri rab kyi khog seng du gtad/ nyal na mgo phugs su gtad la bla ma la mi 'gro ba'i gsol ba gdab bo/ yang mthun rkyen ni ma 'dzoms/ dge sbyor ni mi 'phel zhing*/ chags sdang ni skye/ yon bdag pas ni 'gror mi ster na 'gro ba'i rten 'brel ni/ bshang lci dang gtor ma 'gro phyogs su dor/ 'dug na yang mos phyogs su bltas la tsog pur bsdad/ nyal na yang shes pa mos phyogs su gtad la 'gro ba'i gsol ba gdab/ sna'i rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su rlung gi dkyil 'khor du bsams la/ de'i steng du bsdad pas mos phyogs su phyin par bsam mo/ gnas der bsod nams che ba'i rten 'brel ni/ gnas der sngon ma byung ba'i rdzas ci yod kyang rung ste/ mi len pa thams cad la mi reg bla ma rin chen 'byung ldan gyi cha byad lte bar bsgom pa yin gsungs/ nang du rlung sems rtsa gnas ma yin par 'dus pa'i dus su phyi rol gyi gza' dang rgyu skar bzang por mi 'ong pa yin te/ nang ma gtogs pa phyi rol du yod pa mi srid pa yin gsung*/ yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ ri la 'gro ba'i dus su gzhan khyad du gsod pa'i bsam pas phyin na bsam pa mi 'grub/ 'dod chags kyi bsam pas phyin na sdom pa 'chor/ zhe sdang gi bsam pas phyin na 'khrug pa dang 'phrad/ gti mug gi bsam pas phyin na lto gos kyis 'phongs/ rang 'dod kyi bsam pas phyin na skur ba yong*/ bza' btung gi bsam pas phyin na dge sbyor mi 'phel/ bar chod mang*/ snyan grags mi 'thob pa yin gsungs/

rtog ngan gyis kun slong byas nas dge sbyor la gnad du bsnun na/ dngos grub kyi sngon du sdug bsngal re 'byung*/ dge sbyor skyes pa la rlom sems skyes na dngos grub kyi rting la sdug bsngal re 'byung ba yin pas/ dge sbyor skyes pa de bla ma la phul na bar chad mi 'byung ba yin/ phyag rgya chen po bsres na slob ma'i rgyud la rtogs pa bskyed nus pa'i rgyur 'gro gsungs/ phung po'i bdud yi dam lhas 'joms/ nyon mongs pa'i bdud sdom pa gsum ldan gyis 'joms/ lha'i bu'i bdud byams pa dang snying rjes 'joms/ 'chi bdag gi bdud phyag rgya chen pos 'joms pa yin gsungs/ rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa la gnad du song bas dbang gi las 'grub/ lha ni lcags kyu ma/ sngags dzaḥbya ba yin/ snying rje la gnad du song bas drag po'i las 'grub/ lha ni lcags sgrogs ma/ sngags ni hūm̐ bya ba yin/ dga' ba la gnad du song bas rgyas pa'i las 'grub/ lha ni zhags pa ma/ sngags ni baṃ bya ba yin/ btang snyoms la gnad du song bas zhi ba'i las 'grub/ lha ni dril bu ma/ sngags ni hoḥbya ba yin gsungs/ yang rje rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ byams pa'i khrid bya ba yod de khyod la bya gsungs/ de yang byams pa skye ba'i yul ni drin gang che ba/ byams pa'i rgyu ni rang la phan btags pa/ byams pa'i ngo bo ni drag po skyes pa'o/ byams pa'i thabs ni snying rje skyes pa/ byams pa'i bogs 'don ni rgya che bar bsgom pa/ byams pa la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs ni dgra dang phrad pa'i dus su bsgom pa/ byams pa'i byed las ni sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan par byed pa/ byams pa'i 'bras bu ni mar la skyes na tshangs pa yar la skyes na tshangs pa 'thob bo gsungs/ snying rje rtsub pa ni snying rje rgyu mtshan lnga la sogs pa bsam pas kho'i mtshang la phog pa yin/ byams pa 'jam pa yin/ de'i rgyu mtshan ni de'i drin bsams pas kho dga' ba yin gsungs/

yang bla ma rin po che'i zhal nas/ gang zag gis gnas byin gyis rlob pa dang*/ gnas kyis gang zag byin gyis rlob pa gnyis yin/ de la dang po yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir lhan skyes dang*/ zhing skyong gi mkha' 'gro ma bzhugs pas des byin gyis rlob cing*/ sngon grub thob rnams bzhugs pa'i byin rlabs kyang 'byung ste/ yul de na rdzas byin rlabs can yod pas bkra shis ngang gis 'byung zhing dge sbyor ngang gis 'phel ba yin/ gnyis pa ni gnas gang yang rung ba'i rdul phra rab snyed thams cad 'byung ba bzhi'i lha mo 'am thugs rje chen po rdul phra rab nyid du byin gyis brlabs cing ye shes sems dpa' yang yang bstims la/ rang nyid lha de'i ba spu'i bu ga'i nang shin tu yangs pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes las grub pa/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes kyi rnam 'phrul las byung ba/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' des ye shes kyi tshogs kyis gang ba zhig tu bsam pa yin te/ de nas gnas der phyin pa'i dus su snying mi dga' ba'am/ 'dug snying mi 'dod pa'am 'tshig pa za ba'am 'dir mi 'dug snyam pa 'am/ de la sogs pa gzhan smra ba'am/ na tsha byung ba dang*/ dgra dang phrad pa'am/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen sna tshogs byung na/ gnas der dge sbyor la sogs pa 'byung ba'i snga ltas yin pas de ma thag tu gtor ma cha gsum bshams la/ gcig bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum la 'bul/ dge sbyor 'phel ba la sogs pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa 'byung ba'i gsol ba gdab/ gcig 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams la phul la/ phyi nang gi bar chad mi 'byung bar bya ba'i las bcol/ gcig gzhi bdag de nyid la sogs pa yul 'khor de dag gi lha 'dre rnams la phul la bden pa brdar/ bka' bsgo bya ste/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis khyod kyi gnas 'dir ci tsam 'dug gi bar du/ khyod kyi bdag la bar chad ma byed par sdong grogs gyis shig

mthun rkyen sgrubs shig khyod kyi chu shing 'di rnams yang bag re zhu ba yin pas phul cig khyod la nus pa ci yod pa thams cad thon cig ces bka' bsgo drag tu bya'o// de nas gzhi bdag de la byams pa dang snying rje thun mong ma yin pa re bsgom/ de nas phyag rgya chen po la sogs pa dge sbyor rim pa ltar bya'o// bsgrub pa la gnad du bsnun pa'i dus su rkyen ngan thams cad dge sbyor du slongs pa yin pas/ 'di'i dus sngon gyi las ngan du shes na rgyu shes pa'i bla ma/ rkyen de sel ba'i thabs la mkhas pa ni lam shes pa'i bla ma/ skyon de dag nas yon tan du gyur pa ni 'bras bu shes pa'i bla ma'o// sems can gcig la mgo lus dang mjug ma mi 'dra ba ni nyon mongs pa cha mnyam du gnas pa las 'byung ba yin la/ gsang sngags kyi mgo brnyan mi 'dra ba rnams nyon mongs pa lam du lhongs pa'i lag rjes yin/ kha nang du lta ba ni nyon mongs pa lam du lhongs pa'i lag rjes yin gsungs/ phyi'i bshags pa spyi bshags tshar gsum bya/ nang gi bshags pa yi ge brgya pa bgrang*/ gsang ba'i bshags pa ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang bskur bya/ de kho na nyid kyi bshags pa phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ des sdig pa ma lus pa rtsa ba nas 'dag go// yang rin po che'i zhal snga nas/ phyi'i srung ba tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ nang gi srung ba gtum po sum brtsegs bsgom/ gsang ba'i srung ba yi dam lha'i go cha'i lha rnams bsgom/ de kho na nyid kyi srung ba stong pa nyid bsgom/ de ltar byas pas bar chod kyis mi tshugs pa yin gsungs/ bshad rgyud rdo rje phreng ba las// dung chen 'phreng ba blangs nas su// yab kyi bzlas pa byed pa na// lag pa g.yas pas bya// yum gyi byed na g.yon pas bya// las thams cad la the bong gnyis kyis grogs bya'o gsungs/ chos rje'i gsung la zin bris su mdzad/// / 91) ༄// rang nyid la gdams pa'i bstan bcos rta bdun rab 'bar//

oṃ swa sti/ 'od gsal rnam dag mkha' ltar sgrib med pa// mkhyen gnyis rta bdun rgyal po rab 'bar ba// dus gsum mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i gnas// yon tan mtha' yas bla ma'i zhabs pad 'dud// smig rgyu rgya mtsho sgyu ma'i skyes bu ltar// mkhas pa'i yid brtan mi rung 'khor bar ni// gzugs sgra dri ro gzugs byad sdug gu rnams// rmongs pa'i byis pa blo chung bslu byed pa// bdag ni ci phyir da ko spang mi byed// 'dis ni dus gsum 'gro kun rab bslus te// shin tu 'jigs gyur gshin rje'i gnas su 'khrid// gzugs lta shin tu mdzes gyur yid 'ong gang*// mi mkhas byis pa lta bu'i chags can rnams// dbang med 'dun pas yid ni btud byed de// shin tu 'jigs gyur yi dwags 'jig rten du// rab 'bar sdug bsngal du ma thob byed kyis// chog ste da ni mkhas pas bzlog bslad du// drang srong chen po rgyal ba'i rjes bslab cing*// 'bad pas 'dod pa gzugs kyi spros pa spong*// sgra ni shin tu yid 'ong rna snyan gang*// bstod pa'i 'phreng bas 'jig rten 'di dag bcings// mi snyan sgra la mi dga' rab sdang ste// dran pas mi bzod dmyal ba'i 'jig rten khrid// chog ste da ko sgra phyir 'brang mi bya// dri ni shin tu zhim par 'dod gyur cing*// rmongs pas rtag tu dri yi rjes 'brang gang*// dud 'gro'i skye gnas rab rmongs thob byed kyis// chog ste da ko dri rnams spang bar bya// ro ni shin tu mngar gyur sbrang rtsi ltar// bag med skye bo bung ba'i tshogs 'dra rnams// 'dod pas ngan song gnas gsum dag tu khrid// mkhas pas da ko ro rnams cis mi spong*// reg bya dag ni shin tu 'jam gyur pas// gting mtha' med pa 'khor ba'i rba klong du// nam yang thon med rtag tu gnas gyur gyis// mkhas pas da ko reg rnams cis mi spong*// de ltar 'dod pa'i yon tan 'di dag gis// 'khor ba'i btson rar 'jig rten 'di dag bcings// 'dod pas rab bslus 'dod pas bdag cag bcom// 'khor ba'i rgyun du 'dod rnams mi spong re// brtse chen bla ma'i rjes su mi 'brang re// thub mchog rgyal ba'i gsung bzhin mi sgrub re// mgon po rin chen skyabs gyur nyi ma'i gnyen// skyob mdzad de yis dpag med bskal par ni// btsun mo 'bangs dang rgyal srid bu dang ni// nyid kyi sha dang rus pa rkang rnams kun// dam chos don du rtag tu btang gyur na// bdag lta da ko srog la ci phyir lta// thub pas bcas pa'i dri med bslab gsum la// srog ltar 'phags pas rtag tu bsrung bya zhing*// dgag dang bsgrub pa'i bslab pa phra ba la// ston pa'i gsung bzhin gus pas bdag gis bsrung*// 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims rin chen gyis// dus gsum rgyal ba'i 'khor du bdag gis ni// rnam dag tshul khrims rin chen spos ngad kyis// khyab par bya ste 'gro rnams smin par bya// dge 'dis 'gro rnams chos rje myur thob shog
/'di ni bdag gi yid la bsgo phyir bris/// /

92) ༄// dge ba dang mi dge ba rab tu 'byed par byed pa gsal byed sgron me// oṃ swasti/ yon tan rin chen bye ba'i tshogs mnga' zhing*// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres yon tan rdzogs// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// zhabs kyi pad mor spyi bo'i gtsug gis 'dud// dge dang mi dge rab tu dbye bar bya// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i 'dug lugs bstan// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gdug pa'i sems// de yis khyad par byas pa'i lus ngag yid// las de gang gis mngon par 'du byas 'bras// ngan song gsum du 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// chags pas bde 'gro thob pa ma yin te// thar pa'i srog gcod gsungs pa ji bzhin du// gnas skabs lha mi'i bde ba rab spangs nas// bde 'gror bde ba spyod pa mi srid de// thar pa byang chub rnam gsum srog gcod byed// chags dang sdang bas yi dwags 'jig rten sogs// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skyed par byed// mi dge'i las kyi 'bras bu dang por bstan// sdang ba'i sems dang las dang rnam smin gsum// 'byung ba'i tshul ni deng 'dir bstan par bya// gdug pa'i zhe sdang tshul ni rnam bskyed nas// lus ngag yid gsum las ni 'dus byas na// 'bras bu rnam smin sems can dmyal ba dang*// yi dwags dud 'gro'i gnas la sogs par ni// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho mtha' med du// 'khor ba las kyi 'bras bu rnam smin lags// mi dge las kyi 'bras bu gnyis par bstan// gti mug gdug pa blun cing rmongs pa'i sems// des bskyed lus ngag yid kyi las rnams kun// mngon par 'dus byas 'bras bu rnam smin ni// rmongs pa gti mug dud 'gro'i lus thob cing*// dmyal ba yi dwags 'khor ba mtha' med du// sdug bsngal dpag med bzod par dka' ba rnams// nyams su myong ba 'bras bu rnam smin lags// mi dge'i las kyi 'bras bu gsum par bstan// sems dang las dang rnam smin gsum// mi dge gshis kyis mi dge bas// gshis de bsgyur du med pa'i phyir// sgrib gsum bral ba'i sangs rgyas dang*// mnyam med bla ma dam pas kyang*// mi dge dge bar sgyur mi spyod// gshis kyi rjes su thub pa 'brang*// thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan des// 'di ni dgag pa'i bslab pa la// ye bkag yin pas gnang skabs med// dam chos 'dul ba lung las kyang*// bkag pa gnang du med par gsungs// sdig to mi dge'i chos 'di la// dge bar bsgyur bar nus pa ni// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan dang*// mnyam med bla ma dam pa dang*// mthu dang nus par ldan pa yi// grub thob rnams kyis bsgyur du med// de bsgyur du med pa dang por bstan// dge ba gshis kyis dge ba la// 'bras bu bde ba 'byung ba ni// ma chags mi chags chags med pa'i// sems de gshis kyis dge ba lags// sems des khyad par byas pa yi// las de mngon par 'du byas pas// 'bras bu rnam par smin pa ni// chags bral nyan thos rang rgyal dang*// bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur// dge ba'i 'bras bu dang por bstan// sdang sems gdug pa'i sems skyes na// sbrul gdug lta bu'i sems de ni// mi dge gshis kyis mi dge ba// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// dge bar bsgyur ba ga la spyod// gshis kyi steng du rgyal ba 'brang*// gdug pa'i sems kyi las dang ni// gdug pa'i sems las skyes pa yi// las de mngon par 'du byas na// 'bras bu sems can dmyal bar skye// gsod dang gcod dang 'tshod pa yi// rnam smin 'jigs su rung ba rnams// 'byung bar the tshom med pa yin// dge ba gshis kyis dge ba yi// sems dang las dang rnam smin gsum// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// mnyam med bla ma dam pa dang*// grub thob chen po thams cad kyis// gshis de mi dger bsgyur mi spyod// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// gshis kyi rjes su 'brang ba yin// dge ba gshis kyis dge ba de// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can gyis// ngang ngam shugs kyis spyad gyur pas// gnas skabs lha mi'i go 'phang 'thob// dge de stobs su gyur pa yis// nyan thos rang rgyal byang chub dang*// bla med byang chub thob par 'gyur// gshis kyi dge ba spyad pa las// gnas skabs lha mi'i go 'phang dang*// mthar thug byang chub 'thob pa 'di// thub pas sgrub pa'i bslab par bcas// sangs rgyas 'jig rten ma byung zhing*// dge dang mi dge mi shes kyang*// ci zhig ltar rab stes dbang gis// dge ba spyad las bde ba 'byung*// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// de 'gro ba rigs drug sems can gyi// 'byung lugs legs par bstan pa yin// des ni skyes bu dam pa rnams// lus ngag yid gsum las rnams kun// gcig tu dge ba bsgrub par bya// byang chub sems las skyes pa yi// dge ba phyogs ris med pa rnams// 'bad pa chen pos bsgrub byas na// yon tan phyogs ris med pa yi// bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob// dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyang*// sngon byang chub sems dpar gyur pa'i tshe// dge ba phyogs ris med par spyad// las de'i las 'bras bu rnam smin gyis// tshangs dang 'khor lo sgyur la sogs// brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os dang*// bya dang ri dwags yan chad kyi// skye bo nam mkha' mnyam pa zhes// gdul bya 'gro drug sems can la// gtong dang yongs su gtong ba dang*// tshad med gtong ba chen po yis// gzhan rnams thar pa'i lam la bkod// des na ma chags mi chags pa'i// sbyin pa rgya chen gtang bar bya// ston pas ji ltar bcas pa yi// lhag pa tshul khrims bslab pa la// 'gal ba med par ba srung ba dang*// srog dang longs spyod shor gyur kyang*// de phyir tshul khrims mi gtong ba'i// brtul zhugs chen po gzung bar bya// rtag tu bzod la gnas byas te// mi bzod khro dang 'tshig pa yang*// des dang dul dang byams la gnas// 'gro ba kun la spyad par bya// mgo dang rkang lag bcad gyur kyang*// mi bzod med par bzod par bya// thub pa'i yon tan ma lus pa// bzod la gnas pas 'thob par gsungs// de ltar rtag tu bzod pa bsgom// btang snyoms le lo nar nur yang*// brtson 'grus chen po brtsam par bya// lus ngag yid gsum dge sbyor dang*// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor rjes 'brangs nas// nyin dang mtshan mo 'da' bar bsgrub// le lo spangs na byang chub thob// sems 'di rnam par ma g.yeng bar// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la// rtag tu mnyam par gzhag par bya// rjes shes g.yeng ba'i skabs mi dbye// mgo la me 'bar gsod pa ltar// rtse gcig bsam gtan bsgom par bya// don dam kun rdzob gnyis shes pa'i// zung 'jug nam mkha' lta bu dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' ltar// mngon sum bya ba'i shes rab kyis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho spang*// de ltar 'phags pa sdud pa las// sbyin pas sdug bsngal gyur pa'i sems can yongs smin byed// khrims kyis dud 'gro 'gro ba du ma'i ngo bo dang*// mi khom brgyad spong de yis dal ba rtag tu rnyed// bzod pas gzugs bzang dam pa rgya chen thob 'gyur te// gser mdog sdug cing 'gro bas blta ba'i 'os su 'gyur// brtson 'grus kyis ni dkar po'i yon tan 'grib mi 'gyur// ye shes mtha' yas rgyal ba'i bang mdzod rnyed par 'gyur// bsam gtan gyis ni 'dod pa'i yon tan smad par 'dor// rig dang mngon par shes dang ting 'dzin mngon par sgrub// shes rab kyis ni chos kyi rang bzhin yongs shes na// khams gsum ma lus pa las yang dag 'da' bar 'gyur// pha rol phyin pa drug ltar nyams blangs na// 'bras bu 'di 'dra thob par legs par gsungs// ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das// sngon byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe// pha rol phyin pa 'di nyid ltar// nyams su bzhes pas 'bras bu drug

/thob nas bla med byang chub brnyes// lus dang srog dang longs spyod la// mi lta pha rol phyin drug spyad// dge las bde ba 'byung ba yi// gshis 'di 'gyur ba med pas na// 'khor ba'i bde 'bras ma lus pa// nyams su myong bar byas nas ni// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes 'thob// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod// 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur tshe// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub mchog la 'god par mdzad// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// soms dang ci phyir bsgrub mi byed// sems dge las dang rnam smin dge// ma nor legs par bsgrub pa la// phra dang rags pa'i rgyu 'bras 'byung*// phra ba'i rgyu la yid ches na// rags pa'i rgyu 'bras mngon sum 'gyur// rgyu yi dus su bsgrub pa yi// shin tu chung ba'i dge ba la// phra ba'i rgyu 'bras nyid du 'dod// 'bras bu'i dus su 'byung ba'i tshul// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du// sbar med mngon du 'gyur ba yin// 'bras bu chen por 'gyur ba ni// rags pa'i rgyu dang 'bras bu yin// rnam gzigs sangs rgyas bcom ldan la// lho nas 'ongs pa'i 'bru tshong gis// sran rdog phyed dang lnga phul bas// phra ba'i rgyu 'bras nyid du gzung*// de y-i rags pa'i rgyu 'bras ni// gling bzhi'i bdag po nga las nu// sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas phyed// dbang byas 'bras bu nyams su myong*// rags pa'i rgyu 'bras dang po yin// mthar thug byang chub sangs rgyas pa// shākya'i rgyal po bcom ldan 'das// bla med byang chub sangs rgyas nas// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo ni// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'khor// 'di mthar thug pa'i rgyu 'bras lags// shin tu phra zhing chung ba yi// dge ba legs par bsgrubs gyur na// 'bras bu rags pa de 'dra 'byung*// dus gsum sangs rgyas 'byung ba'i rgyu// shin tu phra ba'i dge ba rnams// khyad du ma bsad bsgrubs byas na// bla med byang chub 'thob par nges// bsam dang sbyor ba'i dge ba rnams// sdig to med cing ma 'dres par// spyad na 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'gyur// 'khor ba'i gnas su skye ba'i tshe// bzang po'i rgyu 'bras mang po 'thob// sdig med ltung ba med pa yi// dge rnams bdag gis bsgrub par bya// rang don gzhan don dbyer med par// byang chub sems kyis zin par bya// gshis kyis dge ba'i chos rnams la// rtag tu gnas shing spyod pa dang*// dge ba'i bshes la bsten gyur na// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// dge ba'i phung por 'gyur bar nges// sangs rgyas chos rnams dge ba'i bshes// bsten dang bsnyen las 'byung bar gsungs// mi dge ba dang sdig grogs spang*// lus ngag yid gsum nang du gnas// phyi rol yul la dmigs pa yang*// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag

/lkugs pa lta bur mi smra dang*// lus ngag yid gsum dben gnas bsten// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// rgyu zhing rab tu sba bar bya// bskyed dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa dang*// thabs lam dri med bdud rtsi dang*// bsgom bya gzhan rnams zhor la gtang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// ma skyes skye med blo las 'das// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun dang bral// smra dang bsam dang brjod las 'das// ngo bo spros dang bral ba la// nam mkha' lta bur mnyam par gzhag /gzung dang 'dzin pa'i mun pa rnams// nyi ma nam mkhar shar ba yis// mun pa bsal bar gyur pa ltar// spangs nas byang chub dam pa 'thob// gzugs sku gnyis kyi 'phrin las dang*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'byung*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyi// dpal mgon skyabs gnas nyid du 'gyur// khe grags kyi 'dam la ma zin par// nyon mongs kyi drwa bar ma tshud par// ngo srung rtsol bas ma bcings par// tshe 'di'i bde skyid phra mo yis// sbrang ma rtsi la ma 'byar bar// 'khor dang gnyen 'dun ma lus dang*// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan rnams// mang po du ma spyod gyur kyang*// rmi lam bzang po rmi 'gyur ltar// sad nas med par 'gyur ba bzhin// 'chi ba'i dus su 'byung bar nges// rtogs pa nam mkha' 'dra na yang*// spyod pa rnam par ma dag na// rtsa ba sman la lo ma dug /dug gis rang gzhan gsod pa ltar// rang phung gzhan phung skyed pas na// rtogs ldan 'jig rten dang 'dre nas mchi// rje btsun chen po'i zhal nas kyang*// spyod pa glang po thabs su gces// legs par gsungs pa 'di re mad// ji ltar nor bu rin po che// 'dam rdzab dri mas gos gyur na// dgos 'dod re ba mi 'byung ltar// spyod pa rnam par ma dag na// rtogs pa nor bu rin po che// nyon mongs rdzab tu chud pa des// 'gro ba'i re ba skong bar dka'// ji ltar rtogs tshod mtho ba ltar// spyod pa rnam par dag par bya// bla na med pa'i byang chub dang*// gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan rnams// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa gsum// rnam par dag pa 'byung bar nges// spyod pa med pa'i spyod pa des// rnam par dag par spyad gyur na// nam mkha' lta bu'i
