rgyu 'bras dang*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung rnams// rnam par dag pa'i spyod pas bsgrub// de dang rtogs pa dbyer med pa// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ram// dung dang dkar po ji bzhin du// gser dang ser po dbyer med ltar// mnyam gzhag chen po'i ngo bor spyod// dpa' bo gar spyod stong par spyod// khams gsum spangs nas byang chub 'thob// dngos dang dngos med 'khor 'das kun// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos// ma lus stong nyid nam mkha' ltar// spyad na byang chub dam pa yin// dri med tshul khrims rin chen dang*// phra zhing phra ba'i rgyu 'bras rnams// dge las bde ba 'byung bar spyad// sdig to mi dge spong ba dang*// dkar phyogs dge ba bsgrub par spyad// 'gro ba'i don la dpa' ba dang*// rang thed la btang nas gzhan don bya// gzhan phan zhen med kyi snying rje de// thabs kyi mchog tu gzung bar gsungs// dgra gnyen mnyam pa nyid du bskyang*// bzang ngan spang blang med par bya// mchog dang dman la dbyer med par// 'gro la phan 'dogs chen po brtsam// res 'ga' rgyal po lta bur bya// seng ge'i khri la bsdad nas kyang*// gdul bya sems can ma lus pa// chags bral dam chos bstan par bya// res 'ga' rgyal khams phyogs med du// rgyu zhing 'gro ba mang po 'dul// res 'ga' spros pa rab zhi ba'i// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag

/res 'ga' 'bad rtsol sna tshogs kyis// thabs lam dri med bsgom pa dang*// bkod pa lus kyi rdzu 'phrul dang*// rtags dang mtshan ma sna tshogs bstan// 'gro ba 'dul ba'i cho 'phrul yin// res 'ga' 'od gsal rgya mtshor 'jug /snang sems dbang du sdud par bya// rnam dag spyod pa dri med 'dis// thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che// gsal bar byed pa'i sgron mer 'gyur// bdag 'dzin nam mkha'i mdud pa grol// skye med 'od gsal chen po la// rnam dag nam mkha' lta bur spyad// spyod pa rnam par dag pa na// lta ba lha yis ston par gsungs// sngon ded dpon thabs la mkhas pa yis// mi nag mdung thung bsad pa de// srog bcad gshis kyis mi dge ba// dge bar bsgyur du ma btub pas// gnas skabs dmyal ba yi dwags dang*// dud 'gro'i gnas la sogs par ni// sdug bsngal dpag med mang po myong*// byang chub sems dpa' chen po des// spyod pa rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshe// gegs dang sel du gyur par gsungs// bla med byang chub sangs rgyas kyang*// zhabs la seng ldeng tshal pa zug /mi dge gshis kyis mi dge ba// dge bar bsgyur du mi btub cing*// rnam par smin pa gdug pas 'jigs// sa la'i grong du gshegs pa'i tshe// lhung bzed ji ltar bkrus bzhin log /bram ze'i bu mo mdzes ma yis// sgro 'dogs skur pa 'debs par byas// bya rgod phung por sgyogs rdo 'phangs// zhabs la sku mtshal phyung bar gsungs// yul ming dgra mtha' zhes bya bar// zla ba gsum du rta chag bzhes// de 'dra'i las kyi rnam smin de// gnas skabs mthar thug thams cad dang*// bla med byang chub sangs rgyas kyang*// 'byung ba dgag tu med pas 'jigs// sgrib gsum bral ba'i sangs rgyas la// mi dge'i 'bras bu ga la 'byung*// sdug bsngal nyams su myong pa yang*// de bzhin gshegs la ga la mnga'// tshor ba bde sdug btang snyoms gsum// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa'i bud shing bsregs pa la// de bzhin gshegs la sdug bsngal med// de 'dra'i rkyen ni byung ba'i tshe// rnam bzhi'i 'khor dang ston pa la// dad pa'i gang zag mang po rnams// sdug bsngal mang po nyams su myong*// ston pa'i sku srog gdul bya yin// chu bo gser ldan 'gram dang ni// cod pan bcings pa'i mchod rten drung*// sku des 'dul ba'i gdul bya yi// tha ma mi rnams nang na ni// kun tu rgyu ba rab bzang dang*// lha rnams kyi ni gdul bya yang*// rab dga' rnam gnyis btul gyur nas// bud shing zad pa'i me bzhin du// sa la'i tshal du mya ngan 'das// de dang 'dra ba rnam bzhi'i 'khor// sdug bsngal nyams su myong ba de// byang chub spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe// mi dge las kyi 'bras bur gzung*// ston pa'i gsung la mtha' drug med// ji ltar gsungs pa de nyid ni// nges pa'i don las gzhan pa med// mi dge gshis kyis mi dge ba'i// dge bar 'gyur bar ga la srid// shin tu phra zhing phra ba nas// mi dge'i las rnams bsgrub mi bya// 'dus pa chen po tog las ni// sa steng lha sbyin gyis ni nga la sgyogs rdo 'phangs// ngas ni zla ba gsum du rta chag gsol// phyar ka gtong phyir bu mo mdzes ldan btang*// de dag kun gyi rtsa bar bdud khyod yod// gsungs nas bdud la khag chen bkal ba dang*// dkon mchog brtsegs pa chos bcu'i mdo las ni// nga la 'bras bu myong ba ga la yod// dgongs te gsungs pa yin zhes bka' stsal dang*// gsang chen thabs la mkhas pa'i mdo las ni// de bzhin gshegs pas thabs la mkhas par bstan// 'dul ba lung nas rgyu 'bras nyid du gsungs// 'di la 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyis// de dag kun gyi rgyu ni mi dge'i las// thog las bdud kyis byas par gsungs pa dang*// gsang chen thabs la mkhas par thabs su gsungs// dkon mchog brtsegs pa chos bcu'i mdo las ni// dgongs te gsungs pa yin par bstan pa dang*// 'dul ba lung nas rgyu dang 'bras bur bstan// des na de dag rgyu 'bras yin par bzhed// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// sdig to ngan song bskyed pa de// sangs rgyas 'jig rten ma byon zhing*// 'jig rten mun par gnas pa'i tshe// ci zhig ltar ram stes dbang gis// dge las bde bar mi shes kyang*// spyad pas 'khor ba'i bde 'bras 'byung*// dge dang mi dge mi shes kyang*// spyad pas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal myong*// mi dge gshis kyis mi dge bar// mkhyen nas dgag pa'i bslab par ni// ltung ba sde lngar rim gyis bcas// bkag pa de la gnang ba med// mi dge dge bar 'gyur mi btub// des na bkag pa ye bkag lags// nam mkha' dngos por 'gyur ba srid// ri bong mgo la rwa skye srid// bkag pa gnang ba gtan mi srid// lar 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa gnyis// ma skyes skye med spros dang bral// ngo bo nam mkha' lta bu la// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel dang*// dgag dang bsgrub pa'i bslab pa rnams// gshis kyi rjes su 'brang ba 'byung*// chos rnams gdod nas ma skyes pa// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras rnams// gshis kyis rab tu 'byed par byed// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras dang*// sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras dang*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung rnams// bslu ba med par 'byung ba 'di// sgyar bsgyur 'gyar 'gyur mi btub cing*// 'bras bu rnam par smin pa rnams// gong du smos pa ji bzhin du// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// grub thob chen po mchog brgyad kyis// dge ba mi dger bsgyur ba dang*// mi dge dge bar bsgyur ba gnyis// phan tshun 'gyur ba ga la spyod// da nas rnam mkhyen ma thob bar// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// las dang bcas pa spang bar bya// ston pa'i gsung rab ma lus pa// spang bya gnyen po 'di nyid las// gzhan pa spu yi rtse tsam med// lar dge dang sdig pa'i mtshan nyid kyang*// rnam mkhyen ye shes ma thob par// shes par shin tu sla ma yin// shes nas shes rab mig gis ni// sdig pa spang zhing dge ba sgrub// de ltar spyod na dam pa yin// gnya' dang g.yon dang dpang po gsum// sa bdag rgyal po btsan po dang*// gtso rgan rnams kyi bya ba yin// shākya'i rgyal po'i rjes 'brang ba'i// dge sbyong rnams kyi bya ba min// btsan po rgod po dbang chen gsum// dge sbyong rnams kyi spang bya yin// kha smras kha mchu 'khrug pa rnams// byas na shākya'i rgyal po yi// bstan pa rin chen phung 'dre yin// dge sdig gnyis po ma phyed na// dam chos smra la dbang ba min// ting 'dzin rgyal po'i mdo las kyang*// gang la gnas pa de ni 'chad par gyis// legs par gsungs pa'i don 'di dgongs par mdzod// gshis las 'gyur med dam chos ston par mdzod// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med nam mkha' ltar// rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel pa glog dang sprin// bslu med 'byung ba ngo mtshar rmad du byung*// lta dang sgom pa spyod pa rnam gsum po// rnam par dag na 'khor ba spangs pa lags// lta ba dag pa lta ba med pa yin// spyod pa dag pa spyod pa med pa yin// sgom pa dag pa sgom pa med pa yin// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang*// lta sgom spyod gsum gcig na sku gsum rgyun chad med// gsungs par nges pas spros dang bral bar gcig

/'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// sems nyid gdod nas bral zhing ma skyes pa// spros pa med pa'i ngo bo chos kyi sku// nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du// rtsol ba med par lhun gyis grub pa 'byung*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// nam zhig stongs par ma gyur tshe// rtsol ba med par 'byung ba ste// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras dang*// sgyu ma lta bu'i rgyu 'bras dang*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung gsum// tshul cig rtsol ba med pa dang*// lhun gyis grub cing 'dus ma byas// spros bral nam mkha' lta bu 'di// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i tshul du ni// 'khor ba stongs par ma gyur bar// sku gsung thugs nyid mi zad par// rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i mdzod du ni// lhun gyis grub par 'byung ba 'dis// 'gro ba nam mkha' mnyam pa rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par 'gyur// dam chos rin chen 'di nyid kyis// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdul bya mang po smin par mdzod// shākya'i dge slong spyan snga bas// 'jig rten mgon po yab sras kyi// rigs las skyes pa'i rnal 'byor pa// stong nyid nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ba// 'khrul med ye shes mig gis ni// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// gcig tu mthong ba'i skyes bu mchog /sras dang dbon du gyur pa yi// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i skyes chen gyis// rtag tu nyams su blang phyir zhus// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /dge ba dang mi dge ba rab tu 'byed par byed pa gsal byed sgron me zhes bya ba ba rdzogs so/// / 93) ༄// gdams ngag rin po che ji ltar nyams su len pa'i thabs rin po che'i phreng ba//

oṃ swasti/ dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa// thams cad gzigs pa kun mkhyen chos kyi rje// yang dag lam ston 'gro ba'i dpal gyur pa// skyabs gcig thub dbang rin chen phyag 'tshal lo// spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag cing*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa chen po yis// gting nas nges par gtugs gyur cing*// dus dang gnas dang rkyen la sogs// nges pa med par 'chi 'gyur te// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// da nang nyi ma tshur shar ba// 'gred cig 'dzur gnyis yengs la thal// skye dgu rnams kyi tshe 'gro ba'ang*// nyi ma de dang 'dra bar blta// gsungs pa nyid kyis shes par bya// nyon mongs gsum gyi gzhir gyur pa'i// mi dge'i tshogs rnams spyad pa yi// sems dang las dang rnam smin gyis// 'bras bu khams gsum 'khor ba yi// sdug bsngal chen po nyams su myong*// slob dpon 'phags pa'i zhal nas kyang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni mi dge zhes// rgya cher rnam par gsungs pas na// de las skyob pa'i dam chos ni// 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig po// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma yis// tshogs dang dpag rnams thams cad du// nyon mongs gsum gyi sems dang las// ma skyes mi bskyed skyes spong ba'i// brtul zhugs rtag tu 'dzin pa dang*// sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*// dge ba phun sum tshogs spyad zhes// dus dang rnam pa thams cad gsung*// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge ba 'o// zhes pa 'phags pa nyid kyis gsungs// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// dus rnams rtag tu bsgom pa dang*/ /byams pa'i bsnyen bsgrub tshar ba yis// zhe sdang la sogs mi mthun phyogs// byung dus gnad du bsnun par bya// snying rje'i yul ni dman pa rnams// dus rnams rtag tu skyang bar byos// kun rdzob byang sems rin po ches// khyad par byas nas bsod nams tshogs// dus rnams rtag tu gsog pa dang*// de nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// ye shes tshogs su shes par bya// ston pas bcas pa'i tshul khrims ni// mngon du gyur pa rnams bcu las// legs pa bsnyen par rdzogs pa las// bla med byang chub thob sems kyis// g.yo sgyu med par mig 'bras ltar// tshul khrims rin chen srung ba gces// de yang theg chen gsang sngags kyang*// rnam dag tshul khrims ma bsrung na// de ltar ston pa nyid kyis ni// tshul khrims 'chal la sngags 'grub par// rgyal ba rnams kyis ma gsungs te// mya ngan 'das grong 'gro ba ni// yul dang phyogs kyang ma yin gsungs// de la chos rje yab sras kyis// dam chos byang chub sems gnyis te// kun rdzob smon 'jug rnam gnyis ni// bskyed dang sgom dang spyod pa'o// bskyed pa cho ga la brten dang*// spyod pa byang chub sems kyis ni// zin pa'i dge ba byed pa 'o// sgom pa dus rnams thams cad du// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// bde ldan sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// byang chub dam pa thob par bya// snyam pa'i bsam pa sgom pa lags// don dam rin chen byang chub sems// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// mtha' brgyad rten cing 'brel 'byung lags// da nas 'khor ba ma stongs bar// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag

/rjes kyi shes pa dang po'i chos// bcu gsum dag gis nyams su blang*// gegs sel bogs 'don gang byed kyang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// mos gus kyi gdung ba drag po yis// dus rnam kun tu gdung gyur cing*// skyon dag yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// gsol ba yang yang gdab par bya// snyan grags 'dod na gtum mo bsgom// tshe dang bsod nams 'phel 'dod na// sum khrid dmigs pa dang po bsgom// phyi rol gdon sogs byung gyur na// bskyed rim bsgom pa man ngag yin// lar dam chos snying nas byed 'dod na// phyi rol rkyen rnams byung pa'i tshe// bzod pa bzhi la gnas pa gces// lar 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa byung dus su// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med kyi// rtogs pa brtan po'i man ngag gces// bstan chos rin chen phreng ba 'di// dam pa khyod kyi don du byas// de las byung ba'i dge ba dri ma med// bsil zer byed pa'i 'od ltar rab gsal bas// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa phyir bsal nas// ye shes snang bas rab tu rgyas par shog /bstan bcos rin chen phreng ba zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// / 94) ༄// mkhan po brag thog pa la gdams pa snang ba rang sems ma// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum 'khor 'das rtag chad ma lus pa// dkar dmar sna tshogs nyon mongs rnam rtog rnams// dbyer med 'od gsal chen por byang chub pa// yon tan rgya mtsho bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// spyir brgyud pa rin po che 'di'i thun mong ma yin pa'i grub mtha' shing rta chen po'i srol dang 'dra ba'i snang ba rang sems bya ba 'di lags te/ 'di gang gis go zhing mngon sum du byas pa dang*/ phyin ci ma log par rtogs pa'i go ba de yang*/ snang ba phyi rol tu gtan ma mchis pa lags la/ dkar dmar sna tshogs su snang ba rang gi sems snang ba yin/ snang ba bya ba phyi rol tu yod par gyur na snang ba rang sems su mi btub ste/

snang ba med pas rang gi sems lags/ de bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis rtogs pa de nyid snang ba med pa'i shes rab bya bar bzhed pa lags/ de yang dpal phag mo gru pa'i zhal nas kyang*/ snang ba med pa'i shes rab bya ba de mdor na 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pas bsdus pa'i chos ji snyed cig yod pa dang*/ snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs su 'dug pa ma lus pa dang*/ nyon mongs pa dang rnam par rtog pa rtsub reg dang bcas pa thams cad rgyud la skye bzhin pa thams cad/ sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba mngon sum du rtogs pa de la snang ba med pa'i shes rab bya bar bzhed/ mngon par rtogs pa 'di nyid kyi mig gis rgyu 'bras kyi rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba ma lus pa thams cad mthong ba yin te/ 'di ltar shes bya'i dkyil 'khor chen po 'di mdun du bcug nas/ phra ba shing bu'am rde'u re bsgyur bas 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i bde skyid ji snyed cig yod pa sgrub par byed pa dang*/ nyes pa'i skyon thams cad spong bar byed pa la mkhas pa'i rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen por 'gyur ba lags pas/ de ltar thugs la gzhag 'tshal/ dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo// mkhan po brag thog pas zhus pa/ sa ma thā// // 95) ༄// yon tan dpal gyis zhus pa tshigs su bcad pa lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po bla ma rin po che'i zhabs kyi pad mo la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rang 'dod 'dun pa chos la nges// gzhan dag sgyur bar 'dod gyur kyang*// thog med dus nas bsags pa chung*// chos ltar byed pa'i 'dun pa bral// dam pa nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi// gsung rab bdud rtsi'i 'od zer spangs// chags sdang gzhir gyur sdig grogs la// bdud rtsi sman gyi 'du shes skye// dam pa rnams dang bral ba bsgrub// dman pa'i nang na dman pa ste// blun pas rang nyid rang gis 'joms// bla ma rnams dang ston pa dang*// dam pa rnams la dga' ba bral// chags sdang rmongs gsum bskyed pa'i gzhi// 'jig rten kun gyis smod par grags// bslab gsum rin chen rgyan dang bral// chags sogs dug gsum rgyan gyis mdzes// ming thos tsam gyis gnod pa sgrub// phrad pas 'khor ba'i rtsa ba 'dzin// 'grogs pas thar pa'i lo thog 'joms// sems can blos spong ma lags kyang*// gcan gzan rgyal po lta bu yi// skyes bu rnams la gros 'debs spong*// phan tshig rin chen khyad du gsod// dman ngan thal sbyar gus pas len// phan gnod 'byung ba'i shes rab ni// gti mug nam mkha'i dbyings su yal// chos 'dod 'dun pa mkha' ltar dag

/dam pa rnams dang 'grogs pa la// 'jig rten smod pa'i gnas su dgos// bdag 'dzin rdo rje'i ri ltar mkhregs// de 'dra'i skyes bu rnams la ni// tshad med bzhi yi tha ma bsten// skyob mdzad thub dbang rin chen gyi// zhing 'di snyigs ma'i dus la bab// rang rgyud rin chen sbyong ba gces// rang chos dang ldan na 'gro ba la// rtsol sgrub med par phan bde 'byung*// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// thar pa'i lo tog bskyed pa yi// tha ba skyon dang bral ba las// byang chub rin chen sa bon ni// bla ma mchog la gus pa lags// de nyid skrun par byed pa'i rkyen// ston pas bcas pa'i tshul khrims lags// 'bras bu byang chub chen po ni// rang sems ye shes rdo rje lags// de 'joms par byed pa'i ser ba ni// yul lnga 'dzin byed dbang lnga lags// lar gzhan la kha ta byed pa'ang*// rang rgyud nyon mongs ma gos shing*// bdag 'dod 'dres dang ma bral tshe// re zhig lhod kyis slod la gzhag /rang rgyud nyon mongs bral ba bsgrub// rang rgyud nyon mongs bral gyur na// gzhan gyis mthong bas sdig sgrib 'dag /lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten 'dir// dman dang byis pa du ma yod// dam pa rnams ni shin tu dkon// des 'dir rang nyid dam pa bsgrub// thos bsam sgrub dang ldan gyur kyang*// chos bzhin byed dang bral gyur na// bdag rkyen dug gsum bskyed pa'i gzhi// chos bzhin byed pa'i go ba yang*// sdig pa phra zhing phra ba la// gshed ma'i 'du shes rab bskyed cing*// gdug pa'i dug chen lta bur spang*// 'jig rten kun gyis smod pa'i gzhi// kha na ma tho phra rnams la// rang dpang por byas la spang bar bya// nged kyi ston pa thugs rje can// stobs dang mi 'jigs yon tan kun// mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po rnams// nor bu rin chen 'od mdog dang*// dbyibs bzhin dbyer med chos kyi sku// spangs thob 'bras bu mthar phyin cing*// ston pa bcom ldan nyid du ni// sa steng lha yul rtsod med grags// de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das// dpal ldan rin chen 'bri gung pas// chos kyi mchog tu tshul khrims bsngags// rnam dag tshul khrims rin chen la// bdag gi bla ma dam pa dgyes// de yang 'dzam gling sa steng gi// khrims ldan bslab la gus gyur cing*// ston pa shākya seng ge yi// rjes su zhugs gyur brtul zhugs can// khrims ldan ji snyed yod pa dang*// sa steng mu stegs gcer bu pa// rnam 'gyur spong dang dril can sogs// phyi nang gnyis kyi brtul zhugs can// thams cad phyogs gcig bzhag gyur pas// tshe gcig dka' thub spyad pas ni// dpal ldan rin chen 'bri gung pa// bdag gi bla ma mchog de yi// snga dro gcig gi tshul khrims kyi// sor yang skyol ba ma mthong ste// yon tan gzhan lta smos ci dgos// des 'dir ston pas bcas pa yi// tshul khrims rin chen srog bzhin bsrung*// bslab pa mchog la gus pa bskyed// bslab gsum rin chen phreng ba ni// thod bzhin rtag tu spyi bor bkur// don ldan nor bu 'phags chos kyis// rtag tu gnas pa nyid du bsgrub// rgyal ba rnams kyi gzhung lam mchog

/sbyin sogs pha rol phyin drug gis// rtag tu 'tsho ba nyid du mdzod// kun kyang bla ma'i rjes su 'brang*// rnam thar mchog la gnas par bya// ji ltar 'khor los sgyur rgyal gyi// mtshan dang ldan pa'i sras mchog ni// yab dang mthun par spyod pas na// de nyid sras su kun shes nas// rgyal srid mchog la dbang bskur ltar// 'dir yang bla ma dam pa yi// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// slob pa'i spyod pa yod gyur na// mgon po'i gdul bya sems can khams// smin par byed pa'i bdag por 'gyur// lar nyes pa'i gzhir gyur rang yul spang*// legs pa'i 'byung gnas dben par bsdad// ston pas ting 'dzin rgyal po nas// bsam gtan rnams dang mngon shes rnams// dgon pa rnams su thob par gsungs// sngon gyi drang srong chen po rnams// ri sul sman ljongs nags la dgyes// grong ni nyes pa du ma'i gzhi// 'dod dang sred pa'i 'ching ba mang*// de ltar nyes pa kun gyi gzhi// spangs nas dben par gnas pa dang*// dam pa rnams la bsten pa gces// nyin mtshan rtag tu nyams len ni// lnga ldan dam chos rin po che// nyes skyon mi mthun phyogs byung na// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus bya// nyes kun de nyid gcig pus 'joms// bla ma'i mos gus ma gtogs pa// 'jig rten phan bde phran tshegs kyang*// 'byung bar shin tu dka' gyur na// mthar thug sangs rgyas smos ci dgos// rang gi bla ma dam pa la// gus dang dad pa med gyur na// yon tan kun gyi rtsa ba chad// phan bde rin chen gter kha subs// gnas skabs lha mi'i bde skyid spangs// mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni// ji ltar des 'dir ga la thob// 'jig rten ngo tsha shes kun kyang*// rang gi pha ma rgan rabs bkur// thub pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan gyis// yon tan gong ma bkur 'byung gsungs// rang nyid gzhan pas mtho 'dod dam// gzhan don rlabs chen 'dod gyur na// bla ma sprul skur mos gus gyis// 'dun pa dung dung bsten par bya// 'khor 'das longs spyod ma lus pa// chos dang mthun par spyod 'dod pas// longs sku bla ma dam pa la// rang nyid mos gus gnad du bsnun// mos gus bzang po de nyid la// dngos grub snga ma gnyis 'byung yang*// dus mtha'i mos gus ma lags te// gti mug gzhir gyur gus pa nyid// byis pa'i mos gus nyid du gnas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma gtogs pa// 'dod pa thams cad rab tu spang*// byang chub chen po de nyid la// 'khor 'das yon tan ma lus gnas// de thob par byed pa'i mos gus ni// mgon po bla ma mchog de la// the tshom med par chos kyi skur// mthong na chos rje sangs rgyas 'thob// dus mtha'i mos gus de la gnas// 'jig rten gzhan don du ma dang*// 'khor ba'i longs spyod ma lus kyang*// do lo 'gron bu'i rgyan dang mtshungs// 'khor ba'i 'bras bu bzang po ste// mthar thug sangs rgyas ga la 'thob// 'khor ba'i skye gnas thams cad du// rdzogs pa'i byang chub ma gtogs pa// 'dod kun bdag gis spang bar bya// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// rgyal ba rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// ji ltar bdag gis nam zhig 'thob// chags sdang 'khor ba'i rgyu 'bras la// nam zhig bdag blo mi gnas 'gyur// lhung bzed la sogs nyi tshe dang*// dgon pa ri bo rnams su ni// 'jig rten spros pa rab bcad de// nam zhig gnas par gyur cig gu// ri steng bkod ma'i mtsho 'gram du// dur ba sngon po'i gdan nyid la// byang chub 'dun pas 'dug gyur cing*// 'jig rten mthun 'jug rab spangs nas// lkugs pa bzhin du gnas shig gu// dge ba rgya chen du ma ni// rang rgyud nyams su myong byed cing*// byang chub bsngo bar nam zhig 'gyur// thub mgon bla ma'i byin rlabs kyis// yon tan rgya mtsho rang sems la// chags sdang nyon mongs ma lus rnams// snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs kun// spros bral rgya mtsho lta bu la// g.yo ba med pas spang rgyu bral// thams cad 'od gsal chen po nyid// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// dge bcu spyad pas mi lus rin chen 'thob// yon tan 'byung gnas yul gyi dbus su skyes// bsags pa'i rgyab can rin chen bla ma'i sras// shākya'i dge sbyong yon tan dpal gyis zhus// gzhan gyi kha ta byed par bskul nas ni// rang gi sems dang sbyar ba'i gdams ngag 'di// bris pas 'gro ba kun la phan par shog

/tshigs su bcad pa lnga bcu rtsa gnyis pa rdzogs so// // 96) ༄// gros mdun mi nyams pa'i rgyal mtshan sgom chen mi nyag gis zhus pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi pad mor gtsug gis 'dud// dam pa de yi rjes 'brangs nas// sku gsung thugs kyi rnam thar la// snying nas slob pa gtsigs su che// rang ltos pa med pa'i snying rje dang*// dmu rgod mtho dman spyod pa la// bzod pa dam pas zin pa dang*// gsum po 'di la gnas pa gces// rta dang dud 'gro'i bla mchod kyis// thams cad zad cing phung nas kyang*// snyan pa'i rgya mtsho nyams par byed// dman pa'i slob ma re re la// gcig pu de nyid bskyangs na yang*// kho yang mi mgu gzhan yid chad// mnyam pa nyid du skyong ba gces// nang du lum bu gshibs pa 'dra// phyi rol gling gseb stong par bzhag /thun cig sgom mkhan med pa de// rnam thar 'khrugs shing dkrugs pas lan// rje sa bdag rgyal po man chad dang*// sde pa gong 'og ma lus pa// yon bdag pho mo thams cad la// ha cang ngo srung ches pa des// shed lon mos gus mi skye zhing*// je dgye je dgye thal ba de// bdag gi rnam par thar pas lan// spros pa mang po 'dod pa yi// 'jig rten khe grags bsam pa can// dge sbyong tshul las nyams pa 'di// spangs nas bla ma dam pa yi// ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub pa de// skye ba gtan gyi so nam yin// mtho dman gyi bya ba rbad kyis bcad// mnyam med bla ma dam pa'i thugs// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu la// nyin mtshan dus drug thams cad du// mnyam gzhag nam mkha' lta bu yis// rjes shes mo gsham bu dang mtshungs// rnam rtog mtho dman sprin phung dang*// snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs rnams// ma skyes ri bong rwa ltar rtogs// bde gsal mi rtog nyams rnam gsum// nam mkha'i khug sna bzhin du yal// phra zhing phra ba'i rgyu 'bras rnams// me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin// bde sdug 'bras bu thob pa de// nam mkha'i mdud pa yin par nges// chags dang sdang dang rmongs pa yi// yul la phyir la dmigs pa yis// rnyed bkur 'tshol bar byed pa 'di// nang gi rten 'brel 'chugs pa des// lung pa ro skam ji bzhin du// skam khrog gis 'gro bar nges pa yin// rgyal po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// snang ba dbang du 'dus pa dang*// dgos dgu char bzhin 'bab pa dang*// grags pas sa steng 'gengs pa gsum// sgom pa gcig pus 'byung ba yin// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// bde skyid yon tan ma lus pa// sgom pa'i mthu las 'byung bar go// mtho dman mi ngo sna tshogs kyang*// bsgoms pas srung pa gcig pur go// gdan sa rin chen phag mo gru// phun sum tshogs pa'i gnas mchog 'dir// yul gyi spros pa rnam bcad nas// byang chub sems gnyis sgom pa'i gnas// 'jig rten spros pa bcad pa'i sa// byang chub tshe 'dir thob pa'i zhing*// chos dang mi mthun bsam pa ni// skad cig skyes par gyur na yang*// gdug pa'i mkha' 'gro gsod pa'i sa// chang dang bud med 'ban chos kyis// gdan sa rin chen 'jig par byed// thams cad legs par spyod par zhu// rgyal ba'i mchod rten chen po 'dir// dma' phab sngar yang phebs par byas// da de ltar byas na gdan sa med// phyogs ris med pa'i ldom bu nga*// bkur mkhan med pa'i sa phyogs 'dir// rgyu mtshan med par sdod snyam na// grogs che nas sdod pa ma lags kyang*// 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas// shi rgyu gsos shing rul rgyu bskams// khyi mi dang 'dra bar bsgyur ba dang*// glang bres su 'jug par mdzad pa yi// drin can bla ma dam pa yi// bka' stsal gsung don ma chog pas// da ni gnas 'dir sdod pa yin// gzhan du ltos thag bcad pa yin// sgrub pa nyams su len pa yin// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdams ngag nor bu rin po che// don du gnyer ba yod gyur na// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa'i phyir// sgrub pa byed pa'i gang zag la// sba gsang med par ston pa yin// dus ngan chen po 'di mthong nas// rje rin po che yi dam chos rnams// lhag chad med par yod snyam pas// de 'dod par gyur pa'i gang zag rnams// sdug sgur mdzad nas bsten par zhu// gzhan gyi slob ma thams cad kyis// bla ma skyong zhing bkur ba dang*// ci yod 'bul ba srol du 'dug

/nged la ngan gsham chen po yod// 'bul sar ma mthong zhu sar mthong*// med pas zhu ba srid na yang*// yod pa rnams kyis 'bul bar 'os// rtsa na 'dug pa'i bu slob kyis// mos gus 'bul bar mi byed na// phyogs ris yon bdag pho mo yis// 'bul du re na a thang chad// mos gus can gyi bu slob tsho// pha zhing tshongs la nga la phul// pho rog za 'dod ma lags kyang*// skye ba gtan gyi so nam 'dir// bsod nams bsags pas 'thob par nges// 'jig rten mi chos gdong pas kyang*// pha ma bu tsha gso res yin// bdag kyang da ni nyams par gyur// skyabs dang mgon dang re sa bral// phyogs gzhan nas phul gang 'ong ba med// ri khrod dgon par sdug sgur dgos// khyed bu slob yon mchod thams cad kyis// khyor ba'i chu bzhin bskyang bar zhu// ri 'di la bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams// 'gro skad 'dug skad mang po yis// rang gzhan thams cad ma g.yeng bar// thugs lhan gyis phob la sgrub pa mdzod// nged rang pha spad thams cad kyis// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par bya// thugs dgongs gdan sa yin par ni// nged rang kun la go ba yod// chos dang mthun pa thams cad dang*// yod na ci yod mnyam por bza'// med na bsod snyoms mnyam por bya// 'jig rten mgon po chos kyi rje// mnyam med bla ma dam pa la// mya ngan 'da' ba mi mnga' zhing*// byin rlabs rgya mtsho lta bu la// 'phel dang 'grib pa mi mnga' bas// nged nyams par dgos pa'i sdug bsngal med// tshu rol mthong ba'i snang ba la// dgongs pa mya ngan 'da' kha na// gdan sar bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams// sdug la sdug 'jus gyis la sdod// nyams par mi 'gyur nga rang gis// byin gyis rlob zhes zhal bzhes mdzad// sa steng 'dzam bu'i gling 'di na// bsod nams chen po ldan pa rnams// rje rin po che las re sa med// kun gyis bdag cag skyong bar nges// tshangs pa brgya byin rgyal chen bzhi// 'og min 'thab bral lha rnams la// re sa rin po che las med// de dag rnams kyis bdag cag srung*// nyams par 'gyur ba ga la srid// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sems can la// re sa rin po che las med// kun gyis bdag cag skyong bar nges// nyams par 'gyur ba ga la srid// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// thugs dgongs rdzogs par byed pa'i phyir// gros 'dun nyams par mi 'gyur ba'i// thabs su bstan pa'i yi ge 'di// kun gyi thugs la gzhag par zhu// sgom chen mi nyag gsung bzhin bsgrub// kho la gdams ngag chen po byung*// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rin po che// gdan sa dar zhing rgyas par shog

/sgom chen mi nyag gis zhus pa'i gros 'dun mi nyams pa'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba rdzogs so/// / 97) ༄// slob dpon rin rgyal la gdams pa dgos pa'i rim pa// oṃ swasti/ bde gshegs rin chen chos kyi rje// thams cad mkhyen pa 'bri gung pa'i// zhabs kyi rdul la reg pa yi// shākya'i dge slong bsod snyoms pas// rgyal po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs zin byin gyis rlabs pa'i sras// dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin rgyal la// zhu ba 'bul ba tshig gi don// 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag ces// g.yo bar 'gyur zhing 'jig pa dang*// sang dang 'chi ba gang snga yang*// sus kyang tshod zin mi srid pas// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas kyang*// cis kyang ring du mi gnas par// ston pas mdo rgyud rnams su gsungs// 'khor dang longs spyod gnyen 'dun rnams// mtha' rgyas skyid pa phun sum tshogs// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan kun// lhun gyis grub cing bkod pa 'dra// zhag gcig zhag gnyis yid 'ong la// lo gcig lo gnyis 'thad na yang*// sgrub pa'i bar chad byed pas na// mchil ma'i thal ba ji bzhin du// spangs nas sgrub pa mdzad pa dang*// phal cher sku mtshams mdzad par zhu// 'jig rten 'du 'dzi sna tshogs kyis// rang gzhan thams cad g.yengs g.yengs nas// rang sems rin chen 'dus ma byas// lhun grub 'od gsal chen po de// nyi ma sprin gyis sgrib pa ltar// rjes kyi dbang du 'gro nyen gda'// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs dgongs dri ma med pa'i chos// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// 'od gsal rnam dag sems kyi gshis// spros med spros pa kun las 'das// dri med lhan skyes ye shes de// 'khrul med ye shes spyan gyis ni// ma nor gzigs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// btang snyoms bzhugs par ga la rigs// sde dang dgon pa yul dang phyogs// kun gyi bstain sa khyed yin yang*// khyed nyid gang la bsten pa de// shes par gyis dang rnal 'byor pa// da 'dir dus ngan chen po byung*// 'khor 'das kun gyi gnyen gcig pu/

/thams cad mkhyen pa mya ngan 'das// legs kyang ngo so su la gsol// nyes kyang zhe bas khrel mkhan med// des na sgrub pa ma gtogs pas// khams gsum 'khor ba mi spongs shing*// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma dang*// dbyer med gcig tu mi 'gyur bas// spros pa'i rgya mtsho bskams nas ni// sgrub pa tshul bzhin mdzad par zhu// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// bde skyid yon tan ma lus pa// sgom pa'i mthu las 'byung ngo zhes// thams cad mkhyen pas tha mar gsungs// rgyud nyon mongs gsum gyis ma gos shing*// rnam rtog rlung dmar 'tshub ma de// 'od gsal dbyings su gsod pa dang*// dran rtog nam mkha'i skra shad de// rang gi gnas su 'jug par bya// rtog med rtog par skye ba de// bcu dang gsum gyi dam chos kyis// nyams su blangs nas 'khor 'das kyi// bde dang sdug pa'i rgyu 'bras rnams// sgrub pa'i chos la brtson 'grus mdzod// 'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// dri med dam chos rin chen gyi// gter du khyed nyid bzhugs pas na// gnas skabs mthar thug nyams len kun// dgos pa'i dus su btang snyoms spang*// brtson 'grus chen po brtsam par zhu// deng bya sang bya yengs las 'das// 'di bya de rjes bsgrub pa bya// btang snyoms can rnams smra na yang*// bdud kyi dbang du song bar zad// skye rga na 'chi med gyur na// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan la// sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams kyang spyod// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*// brtul zhugs grub pa ma lus kun// de phyir de la spyod par 'gyur// thub pa bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang*// rga dang na dang 'chi ba ste// gal te 'di gsum med gyur na// shin tu sdug pa'i yul rnams la// nga yang ci phyir spyod mi 'gyur// yab la gsungs par gyur pa dang*// zab pa khye'u bzhi'i mdo las kyang*// 'dod pa khyi dang phag pa dang*// wa dang bong bu 'dod spyod kyis// sangs rgyas mi spyod nyan thos min// ston pas gsungs par gyur pas na// 'dod yon 'khor ba'i rtsa ba ste// 'dod pa spangs pas thar pa 'thob// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// gong ma rnams kyis 'dod yon spangs// bdag cag rjes su 'jug par bya// de ltar bdag cag sems can rnams// mgo btum mun stug ji bzhin du// 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs mi bsam par// tshe 'di sgrub pa'i khol por 'gyur// bdag tu 'dzin pa'i lta bas bcings// sred pas 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor bskyur// len pa'i ngo bo zhe sdang gis// 'khor ba'i bye brag mang por 'khor// rtsa ba nga dang bdag gis byas// bdag 'dzin rtsa ba rbad kyis bcad// bdag med byang chub sems gnyis kyis// ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par gzhag

/sems des lus de byin gyis rlobs// lus kyi na tsha thams cad zhi// lus kyis snang ba byin gyis rlobs// lhar bcas 'jig rten dbang du sdud// bcu chos sum chos rnam gnyis dang*// zab pa'i dam chos 'khor lo la// rtsa rlung ma dang lnga ma rnams// de yi bye brag ma gtogs pa// brjod bya gzhan pa spu tsam med// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan kun// rmi lam du yang mi rmi na// dam chos byed ces de la bya// thub chen bla ma dam pas gsungs// phye gtor bkur bsti'i bsod nams kyis// dbu 'khor bar ma mdzad dam pa khyed// spring yig dgos pa'i rim pa 'di// shākya'i dge slong grags 'byung gis// bdag nyid chen po khyed la springs// thugs kyi bas na bzod par bzhes// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig/ //

98) ༄// so nam bla ma'i zhal ras dkar nag blta zhes pa// oṃ swasti/ chos kyi rgyal po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// mnyam med bla ma dam pas byin gyis rlobs// spros bral sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la// chags sdang yul la 'dzin rtog du ma ni// kha dog sna lnga sprin dang 'dra ba nyid// 'thad dang rigs pa'i 'gro ldog mang po yis// rang rang rigs 'dzin 'khor ba sna tshogs su// skye ba mang po gshin rje'i lto bar gnas// 'jigs pas zin pa skyabs mgon dpung gnyen stor// 'khor ba 'byung 'jug gnas pa ma gtogs pa// mya ngan 'das zhes sngon chad thos pa med// dus 'dir 'jig rten mgon po bla ma rnyed// chos rje'i byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag blo 'di// deng sang dus na cung zad chos la 'gro// chags dang sdang la thog med dus nas goms// chags bral chos la 'di gnyis 'gal bar go// blo 'di ji ltar chags sdang zhi mi byed// de ltar na ni babs la gnas pa ste// bya dang byar med shes pa thog mar skye// chags sdang med pa'i mig gis babs mthong 'gyur// babs ltar spyad pas dus gsum 'phags pa mnyes// chos dang chos min 'jig rten bya ba rnams// babs dang bstun zhing 'thad pa'i rjes su 'brang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i bde chen rol mtsho yang*// ring por mi thogs mngon du byed dam snyam// 'jig rten blo gros rtog dpyod du ma yis// rang gzhan nyin mtshan dus ni 'das byas pa'i// 'thad pa de las phan pa 'byung mi 'gyur// chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba spyod byed cing*// khyu mchog yo ba'am drang ba ji bzhin du// tsham tshom med par bla ma'i rjes su 'brang*// rang blo spangs la rtag tu gsung bzhin bsgrub// rmongs med de ni srid pa gsum na mkhas// bdag cag bslu zhing ngan sar ga la gtong*// mgo dang rkang lag dum bur song gyur kyang*// rang blo 'dres med mgon po'i gsung bzhin bsgrub// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yon tan ma lus dang*// 'jig rten che thabs du ma de las 'byung*// thog med dus nas 'khor ba'i skye gnas su// rgyal ba mchod dang dge ba dpag med byas// rgyu 'dis da lta bla ma dam pa rnyed// dbul por gter dang long ba'i glang mjug ltar// rtag tu gsung bzhin bsgrub dang 'bral mi bya// so nam bla ma'i zhal ras dkar nag blta// lan gcig tsam ni mnyes sam thugs bde na// srid pa 'di na bdag skye don dang bcas// sdug bsngal 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med las// mnyam med byang chub snying po mchog la gzhag

/sems spros bral chen po'i me long la// 'das ma 'ongs dus gsum gyi gzugs brnyan bstan// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun nas kun kyang bzang por reg gyur cig /so nam bla ma'i zhal ras dkar nag blta zhes bya ba'o// // 99) ༄// chos 'khor rnam gsum legs par gtan la phab pa 'ong ge ma'i sa gcad// oṃ swasti/ rin chen bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud// sde snod gsum dang bslab pa gsum// sems bskyed gsum dang sku gsum dang*// 'jig rten chos kyi 'khor lo gsum// theg gsum byang chub rnam gsum ston// rgyal ba rnams kyis mdzad pa yi// spyi don lus kyi rnam gzhag ni// cung zad rgyas par brjod par bya// smon dang 'jug pa'i sems gnyis las// rin chen gzugs sku rnam gnyis 'grub// smon sems tshad can zhing khams dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe tshad can la// dman pa nyan thos theg pa ni// 'dus pa dang por 'byung ba'i tshul// chos kyi 'khor lo dang po yis// rgya mtsho lta bu smin par mdzad// brjod bya dgag bsgrub bslab pa ste// 'bras bu khams gsum chags bral ba// dgra bcom chen por brjod pa yin// 'dul ba'i sde snod thog mar byung*// 'jig rten chos kyi 'khor lo ni// lha dang tshangs pa la sogs pas// sngon chad 'jig rten ma bskor ba// thub pas wā rā ṇa sīr bskor// sprul sku sangs rgyas bcom ldan nyid// dam chos dgag bsgrub bslab pa ni// rgyu yi dus su bsgrubs pa yin// bcas pa drug sde rnams la mang*// 'di la rgyu mtshan chen po yod// yul la dbang po bsdams pa dang*// rtsa ba yid shes bkug pas bsgrub// stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten zhing*// chos 'khor gnas dang yangs pa can// sa kar can dang lha yi gnas// byis pa gsod dang ko'u sham bi// 'brog dang mchod rten ri dang ni// 'od ma'i tshal dang sgra gcan dang*// ser skya'i gnas kyi grong khyer te// 'di rnams su ni thub pa yi/

/skyes mchog lo re lo re bzhugs// nyi shu rtsa bzhi mnyan yod du// sman gyi nags su lo bzhi ste// 'bar ba'i phug gi nags su gnyis// rgyal po'i khab kyi grong du lnga// dka' ba spyad pa lo drug ste// nyi shu rtsa dgu khab rnams su// rgyal ba de ltar brgyad cu la// thub mchog dgongs pa mya ngan 'das// sku tshe tshad can nyid du gsungs// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i bcom ldan gyi// mdo dang 'dul ba nyid du snang*// mig ldan skyes bu rnams kyis mthong*// bdag la go ba cung zad yod// rgyal tshab thob pa'i byams mgon dang*// rgyal bas lung bstan klu sgrub kyi// mdo 'grel chen po rnams dang bstun// rtsa ba'i tshig bdun dam bcas pa// brjod pa thog mar bcas pa yi// dang po'i le'u ni bstan pa 'o// 'jug sems sdom pa'i mtshan nyid ni// tshad med nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam par// rgyal ba rnams kyis bskyed pa ste// 'bras bu longs sku bcom ldan de'i// sku tshe 'khor ba ji srid par// zhing khams nam mkha'i mtha' thug pa// nyams len byang chub sems gnyis yin// 'dus pa dang po mchog brgyad de// sgo lnga'i rnam shes yid shes dang*// nyon yid kun gzhi'i rnam shes 'di// brjod pa rgyu yis bsgrub pa lags// sde snod mdo sde rin po che// 'jug sems chen po'i sdom pa dang*// mthun pa'i spyod pa bslab par bstan// chos kyi 'khor lo chen po ni// bar pa rgyal po'i khab tu gsungs// byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi lam// dus gsum rgyal ba bskyed pa'i yum// gzugs nas rnam mkhyen bar gyi chos// thams cad stong pa nyid du bstan// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pas// longs sku rgyal ba bcom ldan gyi// sku la zhing khams thams cad snang*// zhing khams kun tu skus khyab pa'i// mthong bas sgro 'dogs gcod par byed// e ma ngo mtshar mi che 'am// thub pa chen po'i rjes 'brangs nas// gong du smras pa brjod pa nas// le'u gnyis dag ni brjod pa 'o// don dam rin chen byang chub sems// spros med chen po nam mkha' ltar// rgyal ba rnams kyis gang bskyed pa// 'bras bu mthar thug chos kyi sku// dag pa gnyis ldan bcom ldan gyis// dam chos sde snod chen po ni// mya ngan 'das dang dam pa'i chos// pad ma dkar la sogs par ni// bse ru lta bu'i theg pa dang*// dman pa nyan thos theg pa ni// bden bzhi rten 'brel bcu gnyis chos// 'bras bu zhi ba rnam gnyis bcas// don gyis theg dman sun 'byin mdzad// theg pa 'og ma med par bstan// theg pa thams cad gcig tu bstan// byang chub sems pa'i theg pa yin// brjod bya gtsang bdag bde dang ni// rtag pa nyid du bstan pa yin// sangs rgyas mya ngan mi 'da' ste// 'jig rten dam chos nub mi 'gyur// dkon mchog gsum po rtag par ni// gong gi sku gnyis bstan pa yang*// ri bong rwa dang sbal pa'i spu// mo bsham bu dang 'dra ba ste// sku gnyis log par brtags pa nyid// dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus pa// chos sku yon tan 'phrin las dang*// bcas par bla ma dam pas bzhed// gong gi rnam gzhag bdun po ni// brjod bya gsum du bsdus pa yin// tshig nyung don du mang ba'i chos// rgyal ba'i gsung rab rnams kyi babs// cung zad smos par gyur pa yin// le'u gsum ni bstan pa'o// drang srong chen po ye shes dgas// byang chub thob pa'i thabs su ni// ldom bu bdag la zhus pa yi// dge ba byang chub mchog tu bsngo//

// 100) ༄// bla ma rin po che'i phyag bzhes kyi rab gnas bsdus pa// oṃ swasti/ gdung rten gyi rab gnas bya bar 'dod pas// dang por gzungs rnams legs par yang dag par bris la/ ma nor bar skud pa dmar pos bkris la/ gu gul gyis bdugs shing ras dkar po'am snam bu dkar po'i steng du bzhugs la/ gtor ma la sogs pa gzhan dang mthun/ de nas gzungs kyi rab gnas bya ba ni/ gzungs kyi steng du a las zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel bsam la/ de las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs nas jo bo byang chub chen por bsam/ 'od tshur 'dus rten 'brel la thim/ rten 'brel yongs su gyur pa las byang chub chen po mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcu/ 'od 'dom gang pa cig tu bsam/ de'i thugs ka nas a las zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel bsams la/ de las 'od 'phros pas jo bo rang bzhin gyi gnas nas spyan drangs la nam mkhar bsam/ phyag dang mchod pa bya/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bya/ gnyis su med pa'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la mchod pa phul la/ gzungs so so la bstim pas de dag thams cad yig 'bru'i tshul du sil gyis byon par bsam/ so so'i go ba sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i gzungs yin na de nyid du bskyed/ shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i gzungs la yum chen mor bskyed/ sngags la rdo rje chos su bskyed/ mdo sde la snang ba mtha' yas su bskyed/ gzungs de gsum du 'dus pa yin/ de nas me tog dor/ sku khrus gsol/ dri'i thig le la dbul// des gzungs kyi rab gnas tshar ba yin/ de nas gdung rten gyi zhabs bsdam pa ni/ gu gul gyis bdug yungs dkar gyis brab/ bgegs bskrad/ de nas dri bzang nang du blugs la/ sgye'i steng du bzhugs la phar bskor tshur bskor byas pas khugs rnams kyi nang du 'gro ba yin/

de nas nyi ma'am me la bskam de nas gzungs bzhugs pa/ srog shing brten pa nas zangs zhabs kyi steng du nor rgyun ma'i gzungs rnams ma nor ba bzhugs/ phyag bzhes kyis rin po che'i nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel zhig bzhugs/ de nas zhabs bsdam/ de nas mchod rten mi dmigs pa las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du bsam/ bum pa'i nang du paṃ las sna tshogs padma'i steng du rigs lnga bskyed/ de nas sarba bidya swā hā zhes brjod pas bum pa'i nang du sangs rgyas stong byon nas bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ badzra gar bhe swā hā/ zhes brjod pas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mchod rten gyi nang du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas mchod rten stegs kyi steng du bzhugs/ dar dmar po'i cod paṇa ring bar gdags/ de nas rab gnas kyi bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ gnas khang phyag dar bya/ gu gul gyis bdug rten la sku khrus gsol ba'am chus gtor zhing*/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūṃ zhes brjod cing thig gdab/ bum pa tshad dang ldan pa gnyis bca'/ bkrus la gu gul gyis bdug cing yungs dkar gyis brab/ lnga tshan la sogs pa gzhan dang mthun/ de dag thams cad gu gul gyis bdug cing sku khrus gsol ba'i chus bum pa dgang*/ zangs la rten 'brel bris pa zhig dge slong gcig gis bzung la/ gcig gis rten 'brel brjod cing sku khrus lan bdun gsol ba'i chus kyang bum pa dgang*/ rten 'brel de rnam rgyal bum par bzhugs/ bum pa gnyis dkar rtsi dang tsan dan dkar po gnyis bsres pas dkar por bya/ ras dkar po kha tshar ma nyams pa'i 'gul chings srog lnga pa bya/ bal bu'am shug pa 'am bkra shis pa'i shing gis kha rgyan bya/ rdo rje rab gnas byas pa zhig la gzungs thag btags la kha rgyan gyi gseb tu bzhugs/ dri gar mo dung chos nang du blugs la gzhag ma 'dal gnyis kyi bar du nas dang me long dang dri dang*/ de la sogs pa dgos pa rnams gzhag

de dag thams cad la gu gul gyis ma bdug pa mi btub/ bum pa'i mtha' mchod pa rnam pa lngas bskor/ gsol ba 'debs pa'i gtor ma gsum/ gzhan zhig dang bzhi/ 'dzin gtor che ba zhig bshams/ de mi dbul gzung*/ gcig gnod byed la byin la bskrad/ gsum po de dang po bla ma yi dam/ gnyis pa de chos skyong gnyug mar gnas pa la/ gsum pa chos skyong ma lus pa la 'bul/ bkra shis dang bde legs 'byung ba dang*/ bar chad mi 'byung bar gsol gdab/ thun brje dus su brje ba'am bsnan/ 'dzin gtor la yang bsnan/ thun pa gnyis ma gtogs pas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ sems bskyed rang yi dam du bsgom/ de'i thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la mchod pa dbul/ de nas rten so so la thim par bsam/ chos sku la chos sku thim par bsam zhing ngag tu/ 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba/ kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dus gsum du bzhugs pa rnams dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po rnams rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma chen po rnams dang*/ de'i gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyis bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod cing me tog lan gsum gtor/ de nas sangs rgyas rjes dran ku di ri brjod cing dril bu la sogs pa rol mo dkrol lo/ de nas snga dro dang*/ gro rting dang*/ dgong mo dang*/ srod dang dus bzhir gsol ba gdab pa thun gnyis kyis bsnyen pa bya ba ni/ sems bskyed/ bum pa gnyis ka stong pa'i ngang las bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang du bskyed/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i nang du a las zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel dkar sgor re yod par bsgom/

de las 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi las dang nyon mongs pa dang shes bya'i sgrib pa dag nas/ thams cad jo bo byang chub chen por gyur par bsam/ 'od tshur 'dus rten 'brel la thim/ rten 'brel yongs su gyur pa las jo bo byang chub chen po/ mtshan bzang po sum bcu rtsa gnyis/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad bcu/ 'od 'dom gang ba zhig tu bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas jo bo byang chub chen po spyan drangs/ bum pa'i steng gi nam mkha' la bzhugs par bsam/ mchod pa dbul/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bsam/ gnyis su med par gyur pa de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bkug nas bum pa khengs par bsam/ de nas ngag tu rten 'brel brjod pas sngags kyi 'od zer gzungs thag la 'khril nas song bas/ bum pa'i nang gi lnga tshan lnga bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam/ yang 'od zer jo bo'i thugs kar phog pas jo bo yang bdud rtsir zhu bar bsam zhing brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa bzla/ de nas yang bum pa der rigs lnga bskyed de oṃ las rnam snang*/ hūṃ las mi bskyod pa/ traṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan/ hri las snang ba mtha' yas/ a las don yod grub par bskyed/ de nas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs ba dang*/ bdud rtsir bzhu ba la sogs pa sngar dang 'dra/ las bum nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang rdo rje gnod sbyin dang*/ don yod grub pa gsum raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ bsam/ de las 'od 'phros bdud rtsir zhu ba la sogs pa rnam rgyal dang tshul mthun/ de yang dang po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa bskyed/ de'i sngags ni oṃ āḥbīg nan ta kri ta hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod do// rdo rje gnod sbyin gyi sngags ni oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa zhes brjod do// de nas don yod grub pa'i sngags ni/

oṃ khaṃ hūm̐/ de yang gtso bor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa 'ong gsung*/ sta gon de ltar bya/ dngos gzhi chos bcu gsum lta bu la rab gnas byed pa'i dus su/ bcu gnyis kyi nub mo yang bum pa dang gtor ma'i bya ba sta gon ltar bya'o// de'i nub mo rten gtso bo de'i spyi bo dang smin mtshams dang mgrin pa dang*/ thugs ka nas 'od rim pa ltar 'phros nas sku'i rten dang*/ gsung dang thugs kyi rten rnams spyan drangs nas sku gsung thugs la thim pas/ chos sku la chos sku thim par bsams la lag pa g.yon pas me tog sbar gang gtor te/ des rten rten du bsgrub pa yin gsungs/ de ni rab gnas mkhan po'i bya ba yin gsungs/ rab gnas bya ba'i dus la dus tshod bzhi dang bstun nas 'phrin las bzhi bsgrub pa yin la/ phyag bzhes kyis nad dang gnod pa dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs zhi ba'i dus/ srod la phyag bzhes su mdzad pa yin gsungs/ phyag bzhes dang bstun pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa rdzogs so// //

101) ༄// shes rab zab mo'i phreng ba nyes pa rab zad kyi bstan bcos// oṃ swasti// nyes pa thams cad rab zad cing*// yon tan kun gyi gter gyur pa// 'bras bu thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa yi// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gyur med bcad pa chen po yi// shes rab zab mo brtan pa dang*// gcol chung spang spyod rnam spangs nas// gzhan gyi spyod dang bsre mi bya// gang la yang gzhag sa tig tig med// ji ltar byas kyang 'grub par nges// wa dang 'dra ba'i spyod pa yi// bred rngangs tsab tsub rnam par spongs// la ka'i bya sgro ji bzhin du// rkyen gyi dbang du ma gtang mdzod// brtan pa ri bo lta bur mdzod// zab pa rgya mtsho lta bur mdzod// yid bzhin nor bu rin po che// klu dbang rgyal po bzhin du bcang*// bcang ngo bcang ngo lan gsum du// nges pa'i don 'di 'gyur ba med// dgos pa'i dus su gsung gis sleb// chas gnyis mi bya don mi gtong*// 'grub pa'i dus su bsgrub par bya// mi 'grub 'gyod pa chen por 'gro// sems can don la 'bad par bya// tshe gcig chos kyi bar chad dang*// rang gzhan thams cad phung ba yi// dug dang 'dra ba'i bar chad bsal// ma bsal nyes pa sna tshogs 'byung*// gal po che la snying rje spang*// shes rab zab mo'i rjes su 'brang*// bsgrub pas mi 'grub don ma gtang*// shes rab gyis shig chol zangs pa// shes rab zab mo'i 'phreng ba 'di// mi nyams bde skyid 'byung ba yi// rin chen bdun ltar dge ba bsgrub// dam pa rnams kyi byin rlabs kyis// bdag gi chos 'di grub mdzad gsol// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/// / 102) ༄// las dang las kyi 'bras chud mi za bar bstan pa// oṃ swasti/ 'khor 'das las kyi bdag po bcom ldan he ru ka: /bzang ngan las la rnam smin so sor 'byung*// tshur bsnun phyir bsrings las la dbang ba'i phyir// las byas gnyen po med ces bya ba min/// /

103) ༄// rin po che'i phreng ba nye gnas rin chen rdo la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum mgon po chos rje rin chen dang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams dang yi dam lha// bla med dkon mchog gsum dang 'phags rnams la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// lus ngag yid gsum spyod pa rnams// rnam par dag pa bzhi ltar spyad// bsam pa rnam dag byang chub sems// ngag brjod pa rnam dag bden tshig smra// yid rnam par dag pa nyon mongs med// lus rnam par dag pa bskyed rim lha// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba dang*// byed pa ma lus thams cad kun// rin chen byang chub sems las skyes// sems des rab tu phye ba yi// mi dge spang zhing dge ba bsgrub// chags dang sdang dang rmongs pa gsum// dug dang 'dra bas spang bar bya// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// lus ngag yid kyi bya ba rnams// rang don gzhan don kun gyi don// sems mnyam pa nyid kyis bsgrub par bya// ma nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can gyis// pha ma ma byas gcig kyang med// kun gyi drin lan bskang ba'i phyir// gnyis med 'od gsal chen po dang*// kun rdzob byang sems rin po che// gnyis po dbye ba med pa yi// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'ba' zhig bsgrub// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras dang*// gzhi med rten cing 'brel 'byung gis// rang gzhan gnyis dang 'gro kun gyi// don kun rab tu bsgrub par bya// dge las bde ba 'byung ba dang*// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel dbye ba rnams// bzhed pa grub mtha' chen mo yi// rjes su 'brang ba nyid du mdzod// phar bsre tshur bsre'i 'dod pa yis// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// bzhed dang grub mtha' las gzhan pa// ma go rmongs pa'i 'ga' zhig gis// phan gyi lan du gnod skyel ba'i// blun po shes rab mig bral ba// kha cig gnod par smra ba rnams// de dag kun kyang cir 'gyur grang*// ngag brjod pa rnam par dag pa ni// brjod med stong pa nyid yin pas// rkyen gyi dbang gis smra ba rnams// sgra grags stong yin pas brjod par bya// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// bden tshig drang srong 'dra ba yin// gsungs pas de ltar smra bar bya// snyan tshig springs yig 'dra bar smra// legs tshig rgyan dang 'dra bar smra// 'ubs kyis hril gyis dril lags na/

da nas byang chub ma thob par// ngag bden pa'i tshig la gnas par bya// rdzun smras rang gzhan bslu ba 'di// dug dang 'dra bas spang bar mdzod// skye dang 'gag dang gnas pa med// ma skyes skye ba med par spyod// skyes pa skye med nam mkha' bzhin// chos kun spros dang bral ba la// ri bong rwa dang sbal pa'i spu// med la yod par mi lta bar// med pa spros dang bral ba ni// rnam dag nam mkha'i ngo bor spyod// nam mkha' rtog dang dpyod dang bral// ngo bo stong pa 'ba' zhig yin// stong pa stong pas stong pa ni// yid 'du byed kun dang bral ba de// rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin// gzung dang 'dzin pa thams cad ni// ngo bo nyid kyis bral ba de// dus gsum rgyal ba'i chos sku yin// 'dzin pa nam mkha'i mdud pa de// bla ma dam pa'i byin rlabs kyis// bkrol nas nam mkha'i ngo bor spyod// nam mkha' lta bu'i chos rnams la// nam mkha' lta bur bsgom byas na// yid rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo de// bla med byang chub rdzogs sangs rgyas// sku dang gsung dang thugs rnam gsum// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo 'di// 'khor ba ma stongs bar du 'khor// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i ma rgan rnams// bde thob sdug bsngal bral ba dang*// bla med byang chub mchog la 'god// de yid rnam par dag pa'i 'bras bu yin// kun btags spros pas stong gyur cing*// las dang nyon mongs shes bya yi// sgrib pa gsum dang bral ba de// rdo rje lus kyi gnas lugs yin// rang dang gzhan dang 'gro ba rnams// gdod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa yin// rang dang sems can ma lus kun// rang nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// dpa' bo thams cad nyid dang ni// rdo rje 'dzin pa rang nyid yin// gzhan dang 'gro ba ma lus pa'ang*// de dang 'dra bar gnas pa yin// ma rtogs 'khor ba'i 'dam du bying*// rtogs na rang nyid sangs rgyas yin// des na chos sgo dbang la rag

/mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma la// dad dang gus pa'i 'dun pa yis// dbang legs par len pa shin tu gces// tha mal lus su 'dzin pa 'dis// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtshor 'khyams// sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong*// da rdo rje 'dzin pa bla ma yis// dbang legs par bskur ba'i go ba dang*// rdo rje slob ma'i mos gus kyis// dbang legs par thob pa'i rgyu mtshan 'di// gdod nas rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid// dbang gis legs par ngo sprad cing*// rdo rje 'dzin pa rang gis rtogs// 'di la rdo rje 'chang zhes bya// 'di la he ru ka zhes bya// rnal 'byor chen po 'di yis ni// zhi rgyas dbang dang drag po yi// 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi po 'dis// gdul bya rgya mtsho lta bu rnams// rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid la 'god// tha mal lus su 'dzin pa dag /'khrul pa de dang bral bas na// lus rnam par dag pa'i ngo bo yin// ngo bo lha dang stong pa gnyis// sgyu ma lta bu'i lha skur gcig /spre'u mjug g.yugs shing bsgrubs pa yi// log pa'i sgyu ma ma lags la// sgyu mas gzung dang 'dzin pa dang*// rtog dang rnam par rtog pa dang*// 'khrul pa thams cad zad par byas// de lta bu yi bskyed rim lha// lha nyid stong pa stong pa lha// tshe gcig lus gcig 'di nyid la// rdo rje 'dzin pa thob pa de// rnam par dag pa'i lus su bstan// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// spros dang bral ba'i ngo bo yin// snang ba dkar dmar sna tshogs pa// sems las gzhan pa med pa 'di// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams rkyen gyi dbang gis su// sna tshogs su snang ba ngo mtshar che// las sna tshogs su bsgrub pa rgyu 'bras yin// bzang po'i rgyu dang 'bras bu yis// 'khor ba'i bde 'bras mang po dang*// mya ngan 'das pa 'thob pa de// bzang po'i rgyu dang 'bras bu yin// 'di sgrubs dang skyes bu dam pa kun// thog ma bar dang mtha' ma'i bar// dge las bde ba 'byung ba yi// 'bras bu bzang po spyod par gyis// mi dge ba las sdug bsngal 'byung*// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro dang*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho dang*// sdug bsngal mtha' med nyams su myong*// ngan pa'i rgyu 'bras rten 'brel 'dis// 'khor ba'i bde skyid ma lus 'joms// mya ngan 'das pa ga la 'thob// srog la bab kyang spang bar bya// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i khang bzang gnyis// sems las gzhan pa phyi rol gyi// spu tsam med pa ngo mtshar che// des na snang ba rang sems yin// las sna tshogs su bsgrub par byed pa dang*// dge dang mi dge'i lta lugs kyis// 'bras bu spu ris ma 'chol ba// so sor 'byung ba ngo mtshar che// lar sdig pa spongs la dge ba sgrubs// dge sdig gang yin ma shes na// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni mi dge ba// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni dge bar gsungs// bka' sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde bzhi// rgyal ba'i gsung rabs ma lus pas// spang bya gnyen po gnyis su gsungs// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug bcas// des bskyed las ni spang bya'o// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med// des bskyed las ni gnyen po lags// spang bya spong bar byed pa dang*// gnyen po bsten pa'i brtul zhugs zungs// 'das ma 'ongs dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas dang*// byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kun// spang bya 'di dang gnyen po 'di// bsten pas byang chub rnam gsum 'thob// de ltar bsgrubs nas skyes bu khyed// lus ngag yid kyi bya ba yis// bla med byang chub bsgrub pa'i thabs// chags sdang rmongs pa spangs pa'i sems// byang chub sems las skyes par bsgrub// tha mal lus kyi 'du byed spang*// bskyed rim lha dang rnam 'gyur gsum// sgrub pa'i brtul zhugs gzung bar bya// 'di theg chen sngags kyi spyod pa yin// ku su lu yi rnal 'byor pas// spyod dang tshe gcig lus gcig gis// 'gro ba kun gyi re gnas nyid// rang nyid yin par shes par bya// bzang ngan bar ma thams cad la// lus ngag yid gsum byams pa dang*// snyan tshig legs tshig byams tshig gis// chos dang mthun dang yon tan rnams// bskyed pa'i zhal ta smra bar bya// gzhan phan rang don yin par gsungs// mtho dman bzang ngan mang po dang*// 'grogs shing lhan cig spyod pa'i tshe// bzang po spyod la chags pa dang*// ngan pa spyod la sdang ba spang*// bzang ngan spyod pa ma lus pa// bzang po spyod par blta bar bya// stong gsum stong gi pha rol nas// shar phyogs stong gi pha rol na// skye 'gro rtsi shing nags tshal kun// kun kyang badzra he ru kaḥ

/bla ma gong ma'i rjes su 'brang*// snang srid 'di kun chos kyi sku yin pas// ma skyes spros dang bral ba'i ngo bo der// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel ma lus pa// legs par sgrub pa'i brtson 'grus brtsam par bya// 'gro ba rnams la phan par bya phyir dang*// shes rab mig gis chos rnams kun la ni// chags thogs med par 'gyur bar bya ba'i phyir// rtag tu phyi bzhin 'brang ba'i dge sbyong nyid// lus ngag yid gsum byams pa yid 'ong bas// rtag tu bla ma'i zhabs tog byed pa yi// shākya'i dge sbyong rin chen rdo rjes zhus// 'di bris bsod nams phung po mtha' yas des// blo gros mig bral log par smra ba y-i// rmongs rnams rnam par dag pa'i mig gis ni// chos gter rin chen 'di ni mthong gyur nas// 'gro kun bla med byang chub thob par shog /rtag tu nyams su blang ba'i man ngag rin po che'i phreng ba zhes bya ba nye gnas rin chen rdo rjes zhus pa rdzogs so// // 104) ༄// gdan khri phul ba'i yon bsngo// gdan khri chen po 'di phul ba'i// bsod nams phung po bsam yas kyis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub dam pa thob par shog/ /shes rab yod de dad pa chung*/ mos gus can la ngo re tsha// tshig tha snyad yod de don la zhan// rtogs ldan rnams la ngo re tsha// // 105) ༄// phyag tshang phul ba'i yon bsngo// oṃ swa sti// phyag tshang phul ba'i bsod nams 'dis// ngan song sdig pa phyir mnan te// mtho ris gnas su 'gro ba dang*// byang chub rnam gsum brgyud nas kyang*// bla med byang chub thob gyur cig /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas kyang*// mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo yis// 'gro ba ma lus smin gyur cig// / 106) ༄// maṅga dha rdo rje gdan 'bri gung byang chub gling gi bca' khrims// oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// ngan bu na so rgas/

lus kyi nus pa zad pa dang*/ chos rje'i gsung yod pas da lo gdan sa rin po cher 'gro bar brtsams pa yin pa la/ slob dpon gcung pos dbu mdzad pa mkhan slob rnam pa/ sgom pa ba/ chos rje'i nye gnas kyi dbu mdzad/ nye gnas ya gsum/ sgom pa shākya dpal/ dpon byang ye shes/ spyi dpon rnam pa dang bcas pa/ dge 'dun gra nang spyi sgo yon mchod thams cad kyis gnad gcud chen po la blangs nas ji ltar gyur kyang phar la gnang bar ma byung*/ da ci 'os sdod pa'i ngos nas ngan bus ji ltar gsung ba de dge 'dun spyis bsgrub pa dang*/ sgom pa bas dbu mdzad pa dpon las nyi shu po dang bcas pas bsgrub par zhu/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun skyong ba rje rin po che'i thugs dgongs lags pas skyong ba dang*/ spel ba'i thabs dge 'dun gnyug mar thel la bzhugs pa/ rje rin po che'i bu rgan rnams kyis dbu mdzad pa/ yab sras gong ma rnams dge 'dun spyis bkur ba dang*/ mos gus byed par zhu ba dang*/ phal cher sku mtshams su bzhugs nas thugs dam 'ba' zhig mdzad par zhu ba dang*/ khrid ma tshar ba rnams kyis khrid ma chag par mdzad par zhu ba dang*/ mkhan slob rnam pas ban rgyu rab tu 'byin pa'i ngos nas/ dbyar dgun gcig tshun chad kyi brgyags yod pa dang*/ so so las tshan gyis bdag byed pa ma gtogs pa/ ban gnyer bas mkhan slob la zhu ba ma 'bul/ las tshan gyis mis kyang ngos phul nas mkhan slob la zhur ma 'jug zhus kyang de'i rigs de mkhan slob rnam pas kyang rab tu mi 'byin par zhu/ sprang po dang mi log bza' med thams cad rab tu byung bas bstan pa bsnub par 'dug de 'dra ba rnams kyis dbu ru klungs chen 'dir chos dang mi mthun pa sna tshogs byed/ sun 'don/ zhabs 'dren rnams byed par 'dug pas/ de'i rigs rnams da phyin chad rab tu mi 'byin par zhu/ de 'dra ba rnams rab tu byung na 'dir bca' khrims ci byas kyang*/

ba rgan ma shi na snyi slan rgyun mi chad kyi tshul du 'ong bar 'dug bca' khrims byas ma byas mi 'dug rtsa ba 'dir thug nas 'dug slob dpon lha 'dul ba 'dzin pa la ban gsar rnams 'dul ba nyan pa la khyed ban gnyer ba rnams kyis bskul/ bslab bsrung ngo ma shes pas thams cad sun 'don par 'dug slob dpon chos sgo bas ban sar rnams la dam tshig gi chos dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba la sogs pa gsung bar zhu/ ban gnyer bas kyang skul/ gtor ma mtheb kyu re bsngo shes pa yang dka' bar yod par gda'/ gling rin po cher bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams 'dun pa gcig tu mdzad pa dang*/ mdun ma rgyun mig gcig nas 'don pa/ de dang 'dra bar ri khrod dang phyogs thams cad na bzhugs pa'i dge 'dun rnams 'dun pa gcig tu mdzad nas sgrub pa dang*/ chos dang mthun pa mdzad cing chos dang mi mthun pa med pa/ lung thams cad 'bri gung thel nas bla ma dge 'dun rnams kyis ji ltar btang ba bsgrub pa ma gtogs pa bcad pa mi mdzad par zhu/ sgrub pa mi nus pa'i mi rnams rang gi tshe phyid thabs kyi bya byed 'bri gung thel la sha tsha btang ba mang po mi mdzad par zhu/ nang pa'i gzhis ka ba dpon skya dbus khams na yod pa rnams kyis kyang chos dang mthun pas gling rin po che'i zhabs tog mdzad pa dang*/ chos dang mi mthun pa med pa dang*/ kha smras dang kha mchu'i rtsa ba mang pos rang gzhan thams cad phung bar mi mdzad par mkhan po byang mgon pa dang*/ dpon chen po byang she'i mdzad pa 'di la ltos la de'i rjes su 'brongs/ nged yab sras kyis ji ltar gsungs pa'i gong 'og nas ma 'byin/ phyogs thams cad kyi yon bdag sde ris rnams skyongs la byams par gyis/ lar rnam smin la 'dzems/ chos dang mi mthun pa zhabs 'dren yin/ chos dang mthun pa'i bya ba rnams sgrub par zhu/ skyi shod dang g.yor po dang phyogs rnams su tshong dang bsod snyoms la snyad btags pa'i ban sde chang 'thung ba byung na bstan pa'i dgra bo yin pas chad pas chod/

phyis thil la ma gtong*/ dbu ru klung chen na thel pa ltar byed pa'i ser khyim pa rnams sdom pa skyor du chug mi skyor na thel pa'i khog tu ma 'jug thel rin po che 'di 'gro mgon gyi pho brang chen po yin pas/ ban mo dang sgom ma dang nag chags zhag tu longs par thel la ma 'jog mi skyas spyil po nyos nas gza' tshang 'khor bcas sdod pa yod par 'dug pas zhag gsum tshun chad la thams cad phud/ thel la ma 'jog ban dhes ral gu gon pa dang*/ lham nag dang*/ glog pa dang*/ zhwa cho ru mo ru la sogs pa chos dang mi mthun pa'i gos rnams nyi shu bos shus/ phyin chad ma gon/ tsog sna yan chad nas skyer ru 'phrang phyin chad la ban dhes ral gri dang mtshon thogs pa rnams phrogs/ phyis ma 'dzin/ chang gi 'grim 'grul ma byed/ byed pa mthong na chad pas chod/ gling gseb tu 'thab mo dang rkun ma ma byed/ byas na chad pas chod/ sog zhing gi yar pa rnams phyin chad mi 'debs par zhu/ dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs pa dang*/ byang chub dam pa thob par shog /phag mo grur mdzad pa'o// //

107) ༄// spyan 'dren zhu yig don gsal sgron me de shi rin po cher phul ba// oṃ swasti/ dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la/ /gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi/ /dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus thams cad gcig tu gyur pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku/ /'phrin las nam mkha' mnyam pas 'gro ba ma lus bla med la 'god pa'i// skyes mchog mi yi seng ge de shi rin chen mchog de la// lhar bcas 'jig rten ma lus gus pas phyag 'tshal nye bar skyabs su mchi/ dus gsum gyi rgyal ba'i mchod rten chen po/ gdan sa rin po che dpal gyi phag mo gru nas/ 'gro ba'i mgon po de shi rin po che'i spyan sngar/ shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas zhu ba'i don/ khyed sku khams rin po che bzang bar bzhugs shing*/ mi mthun pa'i rkyen ngan du mas zin pa'i 'gro ba mang po phongs pa rnams dbugs 'byin par mdzad cing*/ thar pa'i grong khyer chen por khrid par mdzad pa la skyo dub mi mnga' zhing zla ba sgra gcan las rgyal ba ltar byon pa de bdag cag la sogs pa sems can rnams la bka' drin che/ slad kyi don zhu ba/ bdag nyid chen po khyod kyis mes kyi gdan sa rin po cher/ bdag la sogs pa 'gro ba mang po'i don du 'byon par zhu/ 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor ba 'jig /da ltar shākya'i rgyal po chos kyi rje// ma 'ongs mi bskyod rgyal po sman gyi lha// dus gsum mgon po phag mo gru pa yi// rigs las 'khrungs pa'i skyes chen 'byon par zhu// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med ngo bo'i sku// tshul khrims 'dab mdzes rtogs pa'i 'od rab 'bar// bskal pa stong du legs spyad 'gro ba'i dpal// brtse ba chen po lho yi phyogs su gshegs// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// sras kyi thu bo chos mdzad kun gyi bdag /rten 'brel zab mo'i tshogs la mnga' brnyes pa'i// skyes chen mi yi nyi ma 'byon par zhu// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten nyon mongs rnams// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs snyan tshig gis// legs par sdud cing byang chub la 'god pa// 'jig rten sangs rgyas gnyis pa 'byon par zhu// srid pa'i chu klung chen pos khyer ba yi// skye dgu kun gyi spyi mthun bsod nams las// yid 'ong lhun po lta bu rdo rje'i sku// legs par grub pa'i skyes bu 'byon par zhu// yan lag drug cu ldan pa'i snyan gsung ba// lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin mi rnams kyi// sgra rnams kun tu chos ston the tshom gcod// bden gtam snyan gsung skyes chen 'byon par zhu// thugs ni 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' la// mkhyen gnyis nyi zla lta bu'i stobs shar ba// dus gsum mngon du gyur la sgrib mi mnga'// mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtha' yas 'byon par zhu// chos kyi rgyal po mi nyag rgyal khams su// yid bzhin nor bu lta bu khyod bzhugs nas// sa chen 'di steng dgos 'dod char pa phab// mi mchog klu rgyal gdan sar 'byon par zhu// gdan sa rin chen dpal gyi phag mo gru// shākya'i dge sbyong stong dang bcas pa 'bul// bdag kyang bka' 'bangs khyod kyi g.yog du mchis// khyed la gsol 'debs zhu yig don yod mdzod// zhu rten ras kyi sku phyam me tog man dzu dzi ba ka'i mdog ltar dmar ba legs pa gcig bdog pas sku la gsol bar zhu/

bzhugs gdan rgyu la gzig legs pa gcig dang*/ rta byol song gi rgyal po gsal ba dang gsum 'bul zhing mchis// dge ba 'dis mtshon 'khor 'das kun gyi dge ba des// 'gro rnams 'jig rten gsum mgon dpal ldan 'bri gung ba'i sku thob shog /rdzogs pa'i byang chub mchog thob shog /dge ba dri med zla 'dra des// bdag dang 'gro ba ma lus pa// bla med byang chub mchog thob shog /de shi rin po che la bskur ba'i snyan ngag /don gsal sgron me zhes bya ba'i zhu yig// / 108) ༄// nam mkha'i mdud pa dgrol ba rnal 'byor byang seng gis zhus pa// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus 'dus pa rdo rje 'chang gi sku// gnyis med don ston zab cing yangs pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i gsung*// spros med rang bzhin mtha' bral nam mkha' lta bu'i thugs// yon tan mtha' yas 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po rin chen gus phyag 'tshal// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// ngar 'dzin bdag tu 'dzin las byung*// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs las las skyes// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gro'i gnas// 'gro ba rigs drug sdug bsngal rnams// bdag gis nyams su myong bar byas// bdag 'dzin ngar 'dzin 'dzin pa 'di// nam mkha'i mdud pa dang po yin// de la brten nas gzhan 'dzin skye// nam mkha'i mdud pa gnyis pa yin// bdag 'dzin phyogs dang bcas la chags// nam mkha'i mdud pa gsum pa yin// gzhan 'dzin phyogs dang bcas la sdang*// nam mkha'i mdud pa bzhi pa yin// bar la rmongs pas gti mug skye// nam mkha'i mdud pa lnga pa yin// slob dpon chen po 'phags pa yis// bdag yod na ni gzhan du shes// bdag gzhan cha las 'dzin dang sdang*// de gnyis dang ni 'brel pa las// nyes pa thams cad byung ba yin// nyes kun de yi rtsa ba can// de yang 'jig tshogs lta ba yin// rgya cher gsungs par gyur pa de// nga dang ngar 'dzin bdag 'dzin yin// byang chub seng ger 'dzin pa de// nam mkha'i mdud pa drug pa yin// rnal 'byor dbang phyug skyes bu khyed// bdag 'dzin nyon mongs rba klong de// bdag med sems nyid ma skyes pa// rtogs pa'i ye shes nyi mas bskams// sred pas chags pa'i khol po yang*// bdag med sems nyid nam mkha' yin// nam mkha'i ngo bo stong pa yin// stong pa chen po chags pas stong*// chags med bdud rtsi dam pa yis// lhar bcas 'jig rten chags can rnams// 'dul bar mdzad pa'i mgon por mdzod// nam mkha'i mdud pa dang po grol// grol ba'i ngo bo byang chub yin// byang chub nam mkha'i ngo bo yin// nga zhes bya bar 'dzin pa de// nga med chos skur rtogs pa yis// nam mkha'i mdud pa drug pa grol// nam mkha' rnam par dag pa de// byang chub sems gnyis ngo bo yin// ngo bo de dang 'khor 'das kyi// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// rang byung phyag rgya chen po dang*// dbye ba med par nyams su blang*// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// seng ge'i rgyal po 'grim pa ltar// nyams nga med par rgyu zhing gnas// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs dgongs byang chub sems gnyis kyis// nyin mtshan med par 'da' bar byed// rnal 'byor dbang phyug byang seng la// nyams su blang phyir bstan pa lags// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// 'gro kun byang chub thob par shog

/rnal 'byor byang seng gis zhus pa nam mkha'i mdud pa 'grol ba bgyi lags// // 109) ༄// gnyis su med pa dpa' bo'i gar dge slong grags rin gyis zhus pa// oṃ swasti/ rnam dag nam mkha'i ngo bor byang chub cing*// 'phrin las nam mkha' bzhin du mtha' rgyas pas// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho skem mdzad pa// skyob mdzad mgon po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// dang po gang las byung snyam na// ngar 'dzin dag las byung ba yin// bdag yod pas ni gzhan du mthong*// bdag gzhan gnyis kyi 'dzin pa las// chags sdang rnam gnyis skye ba yin// rmongs pa de yis gzhi bzung nas// gnas gsum ngan song skyed par byed// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho bsam mi khyab// dug gsum chu bos rgyun du khyer// 'khor ba thog ma med par 'khyams// sdug bsngal gzhal du med pa myong*// chog pa'i 'du shes da rung med// lus dang srog dang longs spyod rnams// thog med dus nas don med gyur// nyes tshogs 'khor ba'i ri bo 'di// skad cig da res ma bzlog na// phyis nas spong ba shin tu dka'// thub mgon shākya'i bstan pa la// bsod nams bsags pa'i rnam smin gyis// dal 'byor mi lus rin chen thob// mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma rnyed// gdams ngag bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun yod// zab pa'i man ngag rnam gsum gyis// nyon mongs gsum po gzhom par bya// rnam gsum man ngag gang zhe na// phyi dang nang la chags pa yi// bsam pa skyes par gyur pa'i tshe// ma chags bral ba'i ting 'dzin la// rgyun chad med par mnyam par gzhag /chags pa med pa'i ting 'dzin de// nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems yin// ngo bo nyid sku phyag rgya chen po ni// brjod med tshig dang tha snyad kun las 'das// rang bzhin 'od gsal 'dzin pa'i mun pa med// 'khor 'das gnyis dang gnyis 'dzin thams cad spangs// bla ma'i byin rlabs mos gus rgya mtshos rtogs// rtogs pa'i skad cig nyid la 'khor ba spangs// 'das dang ma 'ongs dus gsum mngon du gyur// rten cing 'brel 'byung rgyu 'bras ma lus rnams// gzugs dang me long ji bzhin mngon sum 'gyur// dus gsum 'khor 'das shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rnams// thogs pa med pa'i ye shes legs par 'thob// lta dang spyod dang sgom pa ro mnyam pas// mnyam gzhag chen po'i ngang la g.yo ba med// rtog pa'i 'phro 'du sna tshogs skye ba rnams// spros med 'od gsal chen por dbye ba med// zung 'jug 'od gsal chen po'i 'phrin las kyis// 'khor 'das dbyer med dpa' bo'i gar mdzad pas// dus gsum rgyal ba rnams dang dbye ba med// khams gsum sems can kun gyi ston pa mchog

/'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i ma gi ta// ye shes nyi ma dus gsum 'gro ba la// shar nub med par kun tu mun sel ba// rang byung phyag rgya chen po de nyid dang*// rnal 'byor dbang phyug khyod nyid dbye ba med// khyod kyis 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho spongs// 'gro ba smin par mdzod cig rnal 'byor pa// rdo rje 'chang dang tilli nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la dwags po rin po che// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa chos rjer bcas// gong ma rnams kyi thugs dgongs 'di las med// nor bu rin chen kun rdzob byang sems kyis// dus gsum byin gyis rlob pa'i man ngag 'dis// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba ma lus rnams// 'phrin las rgya mtshor sgyur cig rnal 'byor pa// bcu chos sum chos zab mo ma lus pas// dug rnams sman du sgyur cig rnal 'byor khyed// dus gsum 'khor 'das shes bya ma lus pa// nor bu rin chen rang sems 'di nyid yin// phyi rol yul snang med par lhun gyis grub// rtog dang 'dzin pa nam mkha'i skra shad de// mig ldan skyes bu rnams la 'khrul pa med// byams pa'i sems la mnyam par zhog cig dang*// nyes dang mi mthun phyogs rnams de yis bsrung*// snying rje'i bsam pa la ni gnas gyis dang*// gnas skabs mthar thug sdug bsngal ma lus 'joms// byang chub sems mchog rab tu bsgoms byas na// dus gsum dge ba ma lus des bsdus nas// 'bras bu thams cad mkhyen pa thob par 'gyur// sems kyis mnyam par gzhag pa'i ting 'dzin gyis// las dang 'bras bu mngon par 'thob par byed// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i mdzod rnams ni// sems dang las dang rnam smin gsum du 'dus// de yang rgyu ni gnyis su nges pas 'dir// bzang ba'i rgyu dang 'bras bu bsgrub par bya// ngan pa'i rgyu 'bras spongs shig rnal 'byor pa// bzang po'i rgyu ni bsam pa bzang po ste// bsam pa ji bzhin 'bras bu thob par nges// 'bras bu de nyid yin zhes rtag tu gsung*// ngan pa'i rgyu ni dug gsum sems yin pas// 'bras bu de dang mthun par gnas gsum 'thob// nyon mongs dug gsum spongs shig rnal 'byor pa// sngon gyi brtul zhugs grub pa rgyal bar bcas// drang srong chen po rnams kyi rjes su slobs// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen dang*// gnyis med gcig tu 'dres pa'i spyod pa spyad// lta ba rnam dag byang chub sems gnyis yin// sgom pa rnam dag de dang ma bral bar// nyams su blangs na chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur// chags pa'i yul ni phyi dang nang gnyis te// yul dang sems can rnams la chags pa 'di// khams gsum 'khor ba'i skye gnas len pa yin// brtul zhugs 'dzin pa khyod kyis rtag tu spongs// zhe sdang gnod sems thams cad mkhyen pa'i dug

/thar pa'i srog gcod byed pa'i dgra 'di las// rgyal bar mdzod dang dpa' bo chos rjer 'gyur// rgyu med 'bras bu mi 'dod log par lta// byas pa'i chos rnams kun kyang don med ces// gti mug mun pa thibs kyis non 'di la// rgyu 'bras snang ba bskyed cig chos kyi bu// dben pa ri bo'i sul du gnas pa'i tshe// 'dod chung bse ru lta bur gnas par bya// sku gsum dbyer med rang sems sgom pa'i tshe// nyon mongs rnam rtog rkyen ngan du ma rnams// ma skyes lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo bo de/ chu la chu bzhag mar la mar bzhag bzhin// ro mnyam chen po'i ngang du spyod par mdzod// de yi dug rnams bcu gsum chos kyis bsdu// rgyal ba'i 'phrin las du mar hrugs kyis bsgrub// tshe dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa lnga// skyon med yon tan ldan pa bsgrub pa'i thabs// 'khor lo la sogs gnad kyi gdams pa rnams// dus dang 'phrod pa'i nyams len bsgrub pa brtsam// tshogs dang dben pa gang du 'dug gyur kyang*// bag dang ldan pa'i 'tsho bas 'tsho bar mdzod// chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba bag yod yin// sbyin dang tshul khrims la sogs phar phyin drug /bag yod pa las byung ba nyid du nges// thub pa'i chos rnams ma lus mdaur bsdus na// bag yod gyis zhes gcig pur 'du bar gsungs// 'gro drug 'khor ba'i sems can ma lus rnams// bag med tsha ba'i gnas der 'khor bar 'khyams// 'dzin rtog skye dang sdang ba ma lus kun// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems su bskyed// ma skyes skye med phyag rgya chen po dang*// dbyer med gcig tu nyams su longs dang kye// 'khor ba'i mun pa sel ba'i sgron mer 'gyur// dri med mnyes pa rnam gsum gyis// mchog gi bla ma mnyes par bya// dad dang tshul khrims ting 'dzin gyis// thub pa'i bstan la gus par spyod// shākya'i dge slong grags rin gyis// ldom bu bdag la zhus pa yi// dge 'dis 'gro ba ma lus pa// srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab bskams nas// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' ltar// spros med spros bral ngo bo der// zung 'jug gnyis su med par shog

/gnyis su med pa dpa' bo'i gar zhes bya ba/ shākya'i dge slong grags pa rin chen gyis zhus pa rdzogs so// // 110) ༄// dge sdig dge lung ma bstan gyi rnam dbye slob dpon ston seng la gnang ba// oṃ swa sti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi pad mor gtsug gis 'dud// mdor na lus ngag bya ba rnams// byed pa lung ma bstan du gnas// bde dang sdug pa'i rgyu 'bras ni// rkyen dang sems kyis bsgrub pa nyid// byas pa thams cad lung du bstan// byed pa'i lus ngag bya ba rnams// dman sems dman pa'i 'bras bu yang*// thob pa rkyen la gnas pa'i phyir// dag dang ma dag nyid la'o// dag phyir dag pas dag pa thob// rkyen yang dag par 'phags pa dang*// dam pa rnams dang bla mar gus// sems gnyis nyams len mchog tu bsngags// lnga gsum bcu tshogs dam pa'i chos// so so'i nyams len bye brag rnams// nan tan bya ba nyid la rag /rkyen rnams ngos gzung spang blang bya// thar pa'i lam drug chos 'di nyid// dman na gang gnod spang ba dang*// 'jig rten grags pa la gnas bya// gang du 'jig rten kun sdang zhing*// rang gi bla ma la smod dang*// bla mas kyang ni de spang nyid// rnal 'byor pa yis de spang gces// sngags dang dam tshig chos rnams su// rang gi bla ma la gus dang*// rtag tu lhan cig gnas pa bsgrub// gnas skabs mthar thug yon tan dang*// grags pas phyogs bcur rgyas par 'gyur// dri med brgyud pa rin po che// till̥ nā ro'i brgyud pa zin// 'jig rten mgon po rin po che'i// gces pa'i bu sdug sras su 'gyur// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten du// kun gyi snying la 'bab pa dang*// rang yang chen po'i chen por 'gyur// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa'i chos// nam mkha' lta bu'i rang sems yin// bde dang 'bras bu bzang po rnams// zung 'jug glog gi phreng ba yin// 'brug sgra chem chem sgrogs par 'gyur// phan bde'i 'byung gnas 'di nyid ni// rtsa ba'i bla ma nyid la gnas// dam tshig can gyi slob ma yis// bla ma mnyes pa gcig pu bsgrub// mnyes pa gsum gyis mnyes byas pa'i// bu gcig ston pa seng rgyal la// zab pa'i gdams ngag dam chos 'di// rang snying dpang du btsugs nas bstan/
/bus kyang khyad du ma gsod par// bdag gi gsung bzhin bsgrub par zhu// dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo/// /

111) ༄// dge bshes a gzhon gyis zhus pa'i lha sku bri thabs// oṃ swasti/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba 'di las 'di 'byung rnams// ma lus mngon du gyur pa rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang*// zab cing shin tu rab zab rgya mtsho lta bu'i thugs// mkhyen pa mtha' yas 'bri gung pa la phyag 'tshal lo// lar lus ngag yid gsum gyi bya ba rnams// ci byed nyon mongs kyis ma bslad pa'i// byams snying rje byang chub sems bskyed de// bdag med skye med dbang byas pa'i// skyon med yon tan rdzogs pa'i 'phrin las su// legs par sgrubs dang skyes bu dam pa khyed// hab shi hub shi ma brtag ma dpyad par// byas na rang
