phung gzhan phung nyes pa bskyed// des 'dir bla ma'i gsung bzhin bsgrub par bya// rgyal ba'i sku dang bla ma'i sku 'bag rnams// bzhengs par gyur na 'di ltar bsgrub par bya// ras kyi dog pa nas bzung 'thag dang 'khal// bkru dang ras chog la sogs byed pa rnams// rab gnas cho gar legs par gsungs pa ltar// ras kyi gzhi de bde ldan 'jig rten nam// mngon dga' dag gi zhing du bskyed par bya// sangs rgyas zhing de spyan drangs ras la bstim// gnyis su med par bsam la me tog gtor// rnam dag rgyal ba'i zhing der legs bsgrubs nas// zhing khams der ni rgyal ba dang 'dra ba'i// ras ris chen po legs par bzhengs par bya// sku yi ngo bo thog mar 'bri ba ni// zhing der thog mar sangs rgyas 'byung ba la// ma mgon glang chen pad mas khyogs pa dang*// rta mgrin khro rgyal ma hā ka la sogs// chos skyong srung ma 'khor du gyur pa'i lha// 'dod lha gzhan las cung zad che bar bri// sgrub pa po de 'khor gyis khyogs par 'ong*// pad ma man chad gdan khri sum char bya// sku yi ngo bo thog mar mtho bar bzhengs// rang nyid tshe ring nad med sgrub par byed// glang chen la sogs rgyan rnams rnam bzhi bri// chags pa spangs pa'i rtags su bya khyung ste// phrag dog spangs phyir chu srin legs par bri// gdug sems zhe sdang spangs phyir ri dwags te// rtsa ba gti mug spangs pas glang po che// nga rgyal dug bcom rtags su seng ge ste// rten 'brel zab mo grub pa'i rgyan rnam bzhi// nyon mongs dug lnga spong rtags rgyan rnam bzhi// sku yi gtso bo legs par bskor bar bya// gal te glang chen seng ge ma bris na// lha des nga rgyal gti mug ma spangs rtags// ri dwags chu srin gnyis po ma bris na// zhe sdang phrag dog gnyis po ma spangs rtags// de bzhin bya khyung legs par ma bris na// 'dod chags dug chen bcom par ma gyur rtags// dug lnga ma spangs lha des ci zhig bya// 'ja' 'od gnyis kyis bkra shis bde legs 'byung*// brgyud pa rnams dang grub chen brgyad bri ste// bkod pa gzhan rnams 'dir brjod mi 'tshal te// mtho dman chen po bskyed par mi nus phyir// de yang ha cang skem dang rgyan med spang*// rnal 'byor ma dang 'phags ma sgron ma ni// khri zur klu rgyal gnyis kyi steng du bri// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon dang sha wa ri// 'phrin las du ma bsgrub phyir bri bar bya// klu rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnam gnyis kyis// gdan khri legs par khyogs par bri bar bya// sna tshogs rdo rje rgya gram bum pa las// rin chen ldum rdzing skyes pa bzhin du bya// de yi 'khyil la lha rnams bzhugs na legs// rtse mo dbu yi thad sor 'dug pa bzhin// yur ring rdzing ba'i nang du lha yi bu// g.yas g.yon gnyis nas me tog char 'beb bri// rab tu gnas pa gzhung bzhin legs par bya// de ltar skyon med yon tan rab rdzogs pa'i// lha de 'jig rten sangs rgyas 'byung ba bzhin// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi yon tan ma lus bskyed// bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa rnams// yid bzhin nor bu bzhin du 'grub par 'gyur// 'jig rten mgon gyi zhal gdams zab mo 'di// dad dang ting 'dzin shes rab stobs mchog gis// thub pa'i bstan la legs par spyod gyur zhing*// 'jig rten mgon la dad pa rdo rje bzhin// shākya'i dge slong gzhon nu rin chen gyis// spyan snga'i mtshan can ldom bu bdag la zhus// dge 'dis 'gro rnams byang chub mchog thob shog/

// 112) ༄// bla ma rin po che'i phyag bzhes gser 'bru'i bya thabs rin po che dpal 'bar// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// zhabs kyi pad mor gtsug gis 'dud// dam pa de yi rjes 'brangs nas// lha rdzas dam pa rin chen rdzas// gser gyi mchod sdong dpal 'bar gyi/ rab gnas nas rdzongs rim pa bris/ de yi byin rlabs mchog gis ni// 'gro rnams bkra shis rgyal gyur cig /'dir 'jig rten gsum gyis mgon po chos rje rin po che'i phyag bzhes/ gser 'bru'i nang rdzongs dang rab gnas bya bar 'dod pas 'di ltar bya ste/ de yang thog mar nang rdzongs kyi rim pa ni gdung khang dang tshul mthun te/ nang rdzongs kyi gzungs kyi mkhan po sdom pa dang ldan pa byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa sngon du song bas/ tshes grangs sam gza' skar bzang po la gtad la/ dang po tog gi nang du de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang*/ brgyud pa'i bla ma'i mtshan 'bum/ rin po che tog gi gzungs/ mthong ba tsam gyis don yod pa'i gzungs rnams bzhugs/ de'i 'og tu 'od zer dri med tshan pa bzhi tshar mang du bris la bzhugs/ de nas yi dam lha tshogs kyi gzungs dang*/ mdzod spu nor bu/ sangs rgyas rab bdun gso sbyong dang*/ rten 'brel gyi snying po bkra shis rten 'bar gnyis la sogs pa tshar ci mang du bris la ming 'jug dang bcas pa rnams bzhugs/ de nas gtsug tor rnam rgyal dang dri med gsang ba ring bsrel byang chub rgyan 'bum dang gzungs chen bzhi/ gzhan yang phan yon can gyi gzungs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa'i snying po rnams bum pa'i stod du bzhugs/ bum pa'i smad du khro bo khro mo rnams kyi gzungs bzhugs/ sa 'dzin gyi nang du dpal mgon po dang dpal ldan ma lha mo la sogs pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma rnams dang*/ phyogs skyong zhing skyong rnams dang*/ 'phags pa dzambha pa la dang tshogs bdag la sogs pa nor bdag rnams kyi gzungs ming spel dang bcas pa phyogs shar dang nub la sogs pa mtshams phyed par byas la bzhugs/

srog shing dri ma med par byas la dri bzang gis byugs la rten 'brel gyi snying po mang du bris la bzhugs/ zhabs sdom zangs sam shing la legs par byas te/ dri bzang byugs/ rdo rje rgya gram bris pas zhabs legs par bsdam/ de yang zhabs sdom pa'i dus su gser 'bru'i nang du sman bzang po'i zhal zhal byas/ gu gul gyis bdug cing slob dpon ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas drag sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/ de nas nang rdzongs kyi rab gnas byas la sngar bzhin rim pa ma 'khrul bar legs par bzhugs/ mtshams dar ram ras dkar po dri ma med pas gcad/ gzungs kyis nang mi khengs na bka' mdo brgyud kyi glegs bam shog dril du byas la dar gyis dkris la che chung dang sbyar/ mang nyung ji ltar rigs pa rnams bzhugs/ de nas nas dkar mo dri ma dang sban sbun med pa dri bzang po'i chu nas bton pas gseng med par nang brdzang*/ gzhan yang dar zab dang rin po che'i gser g.yu la sogs pa sman bzang po dang*/ ja zil pol la sogs pa'i bzang po mdor na dngos po dag pa'i rdzas longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa'i rten 'brel yin pas nang khengs par byed par gal che gsungs/ de nas nang rdzongs rnams zhabs su lug nas mi 'ong ba breng ba dri ma med pa'i bsil sman gyis byugs pas gcud la bor la ga dar tho ba lag len la goms pa mkhas pas bya/ de nas zhabs bsdams la gzer btab ste phan tshun du mi 'chug par bya'o// de zhabs sdom gyi rim pa rnams legs par tshar nas khyad par du byas pa'o// ༈ //da ni rten mchog tu byed pa'i rab gnas bya bar 'dod pas/ lag tu blang ba'i rim pa 'di ltar bya ste/ de yang rab gnas mkhan po mtshan nyid dang ldan pas dus tshod tshes grangs gza' skar bzang po la rten 'brel yo byad 'tshogs par byas la/ zhag bdun nam gsum la sogs pa long yod du byed pa dang*/ zhag gcig la zhugs rdzogs su byed pa lug gnyis yin pa la/

de yang lung ltar byed na zhag gsum du bya bar bshad/ de la nub dang po sta gon gyi cho ga byed pa yin te/ dang po kho na gnas khang byi dor byas la maṇḍal bsham/ re khas 'dab brgyad bris la me tog dgod/ bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bum rdzas kha rgyan la sogs pa gzhung bzhin du bsham/ rnam lnga la sogs pa'i rdzas spyi dang mthun/ dri bzang po'i chus bkang*/ gzungs thag rdo rje dang bcas pa btags la/ dge slong tshul khrims gtsang ma dang ldan pa bzhi'am gsum la sogs pa ci rigs pas bstan pa'i gtso bo bskyed rim gyi sgo nas 'od zer gyi spro bsdu byed cing bzlas pa ye dharmā la bya'o// 'khar gzhong nang dkar mo'i me tog gis bkang la bzlas pa'i rten 'brel snying po la sngags kyi spro bsdu bya'o// de nas dngos gzhi la gong gi rten chas su gzhug rten 'brel rdzas rnams 'tshogs par bsags mchod gtor rgya chen po bsham/ de nas rab gnas mkhan po dgongs pa dang ldan pas/ sems bskyed sngon du song bas/ yi dam gyi nga rgyal gyis bgegs bskrad/ gu gul gyis bdug nyungs dkar gyis brab/ de nas swa bha ba'i sngags kyis stong par byas pa'i ngang las bhruṃ las rin po che'i gzhal yas khang nang lha tshogs kyis gang bar bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gzhal yas khang lha tshogs dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs la/ phyi nang gsang ba'i pu tsas mchod/ bstod pa gang yang rung bas bstod la/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bskyed pa la bstim/ gnyis su med par bsam/ sangs rgyas rjes dran 'don zhing rten 'brel bzlas pa'i me tog gtor/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni brjod cing bum chus khrus gsol/ rang nyid kyis phyag rgya chen po thun cig bsgom/ chos sku la chos sku thim par bsam/ bstod pa bya mchod pa 'bul/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa dbyangs dang bcas pa mang po bya/

me tog gtor/ gtor ma gsum bla ma yi dam dkon mchog la dbul zhing gsol ba gdab/ chos skyong la phul la 'phrin las bcol rten de'i srung mar bsko/ gzhi bdag la sngos la dpal mgon po'i 'khor gyis la rten gyi yon bdag gyis shig par bka' bsgo/ de ma yin pa rigs drug dang bgegs rigs rnams la rim pas dbul la bden pa'i stobs brjod/ de'i rjes la bla ma la yon dbul/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur bya/ lha mi la ston mo yang bya/ lha mi rnams kyis rab gnas legs so zhes lan gsum du zhal g.yar la brjod/ sbrang bur dang dkar gsum phye dang sbol la rtsa ru'i ston mo bya/ rten de mthong thos dran pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig ces bsngo ba bya/ smon lam gdab bo// 'di ltar sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba// zab cing rgya che dam pa'i chos// rang gzhan kun la phan pa'i don// sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las mchog /mi zad rgyan gyi 'khor lo las// mdzod 'dzin rgyal thabs rin chen gyi// phyag bzhes rin chen gser 'bru yi// rab gnas mchog tu byed pa'i thabs// gzhan gyis bskul nas yi ger bris// des mtshon dge ba dri med mchog /'khor 'das dus gsum bsags pa 'dis// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// byang chub myur du thob par shog /bla ma rin po che'i phyag bzhes/ gser 'bru'i nang rdzongs rin po che dpal 'bar zhes bya ba rdzogs so// bkra shis par gyur cig /kun la dge bar gyur cig// / 113) ༄// dpon grags pa rdo rje la springs pa snying gtam tshig tu brjod pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che spyan snga nas dpon grags pa rdo rje la spring ba/ rang gis byas pa'i las rnams la// mi myong ba ni gcig kyang med// rgyu sngon du song ba'i 'bras bu la// bde sdug tha dad 'byung ba de// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'byung ba min// dge ba'i las kyi 'bras bu las// bde skyid phun sum tshogs pa dang*// rgyu ngan song ba'i 'bras bu las// sdug bsngal mtho dman dpag med rnams// tha dad mang po myong ba yin// des na phra ba'i rnam smin la// 'dzems pa shin tu gces pa dang*// dkar phyogs dge ba'i rtsa ba ni// ngoms pa med par gsog par zhu// dge bas bde ba dpag med la// skye ba kun tu spyod pa yin// rgyu sngon dus song ba'i 'bras bu ni// sangs rgyas mthus kyang mi bzlog pa// sgrib gsum spangs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// zhabs la seng ldeng tshal pa ltar// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras su// 'byung ba shin tu 'jigs pa yin// log shes snang ba rang sems su// mi chud nges par bzhed pa 'di// grub mtha' yin par rang nyid kyis// go bar byed pa ma gtogs pa// gzhan dang gleng bar mi bya ste// chags sdang mang po skye ba'i rgyu// lham me lhan ne lhang nge gzhag

/gces pa'i bu gcig grags rdor la// snying nas dam chos bstan pa 'di// sems la zungs shig gces pa'i bu// yig rten ther rgyam legs pa gcig /bskur ba sku la gsol bar zhu// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// / 114) ༄// 'jig rten gsum gyi dngos slob grub thob seṅge ye shes la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// shākya'i dge slong gdan sa bas// pha 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i sras// mes dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i dbon// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs dang dbye ba med// 'dzam gling mdzes pa rgyan gyi mchog /brtul zhugs spyod pa'i rnal 'byor pa// deng sang rtsod pa kun dang bral// khyed la legs par zhu ba'i don// sku khams bzang ba dang thugs dam 'phel zhing rang gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pas 'gro ba'i mgon po'i thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad pa dang*/ sgrub pa rin po che zla ba yar gyi ngo bo bzhin du 'phel bar mdzad pa dang sbyangs pa'i yon tan bcu gnyis ltar spyod cing*/ byang chub kyi sems rnam pa gnyis la mnyam par 'jog pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ spros pa rnam par bcad cing ri khrod la bzhugs pa/ 'phags pa gnas brtan chen po 'od srungs gnyis pa lta bu'i slob dpon seng ye'i spyan sngar zhu ba/// / 115) ༄// sa bdag rgyal po'i gdung rigs dge bshes jo bo la springs pa// oṃ swa sti/ bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// ma rtogs ma go ma shes pas// gting mtha' med par 'khor bar 'khyams// sdug bsngal dpag tu med pa myong*// rtogs na sdug bsngal rgya mtsho spangs// ma rig pa yi log snang dag

/ye shes nyi mas 'khor ba dang*// mya ngan 'das pa'i chos rnams kun// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes par// dang po rang gi ngo bo rtogs// de la mnyam par 'jog pa dang*// bla ma dam pa'i mos gus kyis// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma lus thams cad kun// rang byung phyag rgya chen por rtogs// kun rdzob byang sems rin chen dang*// gnyis su med par nyams su bzhes// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// spros pa rab zhi don dam byang chub sems// snying rjes rab brlan kun rdzob smon 'jug gnyis// til dang til mar bzhin du gcig par gsungs// rtag tu 'di la mnyam gzhag pas// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos rnams dang*// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa kun// thams cad mngon du gyur nas kyang*// byang chub dam pa thob par 'gyur// sa bdag rgyal po'i gdung las 'khrungs// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla ma bsten// yon tan rgya mtshos thugs gtams pa'i// dge ba'i bshes gnyen jo bo la// springs yig yi ge bskur ba'am// yig rten zil po srang bcu 'bul// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// /

116) ༄// dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen gu ru mdo pa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po chos rje rin po che la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas/ 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po lta bu'i dpon dge ba'i bshes gnyen gu ru mdo pa'i spyan sngar springs pa/ chos thos pa dang bsam pa sgom pa rnam pa gsum gyis 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho spong bar byed pa ni/ dngos su spong ba dang*/ brgyud nas spong ba gnyis yin te/ pha rol du phyin pa ltar brgyud nas spong ba 'dir ma smos/ theg pa chen po gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa ltar nyams su len pa'i man ngag dang po byang chub kyi sems ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan/ sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa'i byang chub thob par bya/ de'i ched du bsgom pa 'di bsgom snyam du bsam/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ bla ma dam pa spyi bor dran tsam zhig mdzad/ de nas sems ma bcos par gzhag ma bcos pa'i go ba bzang ngan gyi rnam par rtog pa ci yang yid la mi bya bar gzhag slob dpon chen po bram ze sa ra ha'i zhal nas kyang*/ yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po'i sku// 'bras bu gang la'ang re ba ma byed rnal 'byor pa// gsungs pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang rab 'byor yid la byas na ni khams gsum po gang du yang 'dre bar 'gyur la/ yid la ma byas na ni khams gsum po gang du yang 'dre bar mi 'gyur zhes rgyas pa nas gsungs/ de ltar thugs nyams su blangs pas tshe gcig lus gcig gis byang chub tu sangs rgya ba brgyud pa rin po che 'di'i lugs lags/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang bcas par thugs nyams su bzhes par zhu/// / 117) ༄// slob dpon ti se ba byang chub shes rab kyi spyan sngar springs pa// oṃ swasti// rje rin po che gdan sa bas rje rin po che'i sras rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug slob dpon ti se ba byang chub shes rab kyi spyan sngar zhu ba/

khyed kyis rje rin po che'i zhabs tog du sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs shing sku khams bzang bar khums/ de shin tu thugs la btags/ sgos su ngan bu la/ lo'i rigs la bskur yar dang 'bul ba mang po bskur ba thugs la btags/ na ning gsol ja bskur ba dang*/ da lo yang gsol thud bskur ba phyag tu legs par things/ shin tu thugs la btags/ nga zhes bya bar 'dzin pa'i bdud// nga med bdag dang bral ba yi// sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// rtogs pas 'khor ba rtsad nas bcom// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kun// chu bo'i gzhung bzhin rgyud la 'bab// thabs dang shes rab rnam pa gnyis// zung 'jug rtogs pa'i ngo bor spyod// lta dang spyod dang sgom pa gsum// dbyer med 'od gsal ngo bor gcig /'jig rten mgon po bla ma yi// byin rlabs 'od gsal chen po de// tshogs dang dpag gi chos rnams dang*// thugs las 'khrungs pa'i skyes bu la// gdams ngag so ma ga la 'tshal// sngar bzhin nyams su len par zhu// yi ge mi 'khyam pa yi rten// gur gum thun cig bskur nas mchis// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// / 118) ༄// dge sbyong dpon rdo rje byang chub la springs pa// oṃ swasti// bla ma rin po che phag mo gru pas// rgyal po lta bu'i dge sbyong dpon rdo rje byang chub la springs pa/ khyed kyis brgya byin lta bu'i longs spyod dang rgyal srid thams cad spangs nas shākya'i bstan pa la rab tu gshegs zhes thos/ de thugs la shin tu btags/ spyir 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag bya ba dang byed pa thams cad kyang bya sems kyis 'das nas 'grub par shin tu dka'/ khyed lta bu rab tu gshegs nas btang snyoms su bzhugs pa mi 'thad/ mi rigs pas/ do cig kyang sus ci zer yang yar 'byon par rigs pa la ma byon/ da cis kyang myur du gling rin po che 'dir ngan bu'i zhabs drung 'dir cis kyang 'byon par zhu/

mi rtag 'chi bar nges par the tshom med// 'chi med bdud rtsi 'tshol du 'byon par zhu// dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad gcig gyur pa// mgon po phag mo gru pa chos kyi rje// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// yab sras gnyis kyi gdams ngag rin po che// na rga skye 'chi'i nad las thar mdzad pa// sman mchog dri med bdud rtsi tshol du byon// bdag kyang rgas stobs nus pa zad pas na// khyed kyi bla ma ngan bu yin par nges// skyo med yid ldan nor bzang skyes chen gyis// byams mgon blo dang ldan pa 'tshol ba bzhin// rgyal po lta bu'i dge sbyong chen po khyed// myur du bla ma snyeg pa'i dus la bab// gser gyi ri las dug gi chu rgyun bzhin// yid 'ong gnyen 'dun tshig rnams spang 'tshal lo// legs spyad rgya mtsho dri ma med pa yi// dam chos nor bu rin chen 'tshol du byon/ byang chub sems gnyis dbye ba med pa yi// ting 'dzin rgyal po dri ma med pa 'di/ tshol ba'i dus la babs so myur du spyon// 'od gsal rnam dag nam mkha' lta bu yi// rang sems rdo rje rtogs par bya ba'i phyir// mi yi seng ge myur du 'byon par rigs// nga bdag 'dzin pa gshin rje'i skyes bu yis// 'gro rnams spyi bo nas ni zin gyur na// bdag med skye med brjod las 'das pa'i chos// myur du rtogs par bya phyir 'byon par zhu// 'jig rten 'di yi phun sum tshogs pa lnga// sras dang gnyen 'dun 'khor dang longs spyod rnams// spang bya rmi lam thun gcig rmis pa 'dra// sad pa'i dus su med par 'gyur ba ltar// glen pa mgo bo 'khor zhing nyams par 'gyur// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i bla ma gong ma rnams// da lta mi bzhugs mi rtag ma dgongs sam// 'jig rten 'di yi pha dang mes po dang*// yang mes thams cad shi zhing dus las 'das// da lta dran pa'i yul du gyur pas na// nged rang rnams kyang de dang 'dra bar ltos// tshe 'di gnod mang rlung gis btab pa yi// chu yi chu bur bas kyang mi rtag na// dbugs 'byung dbugs rngub gnyid kyis logs pa las// sad khom gang yin de ni ngo mtshar che// rtag sems spangs nas myur du 'byon par zhu// slad ma khyed kyis rta bzang ngo mtshar can bskur nas byung ba phyag tu phyin/

yig rten ras ngo mtshar can ka ta na dar tshos ma bzhi byin rlabs byas nas na bza'i rgyur bskur nas mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 119) ༄// zhal slob jo sras ngom pa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ dpal gyi 'bri gung nas bla ma rin po ches/ jo sras ngom pa la springs pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos thams cad sems nyid gdod ma nas ma skyes pa 'ba' zhig ma gtogs pa/ phyi rol na spu yi rtse mo tsam yang med la/ 'khor 'das kyi yon tan gyi rgya mtsho chen po de lags te/ bdag nyid chen pos 'khrul pa med pa'i shes rab kyi mig gis legs par gzigs pa de nyid la rtag tu mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems las skyes pa'i bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rnam pa gnyis la sogs pa'i snga ma bzhin du brtson 'grus chen po brtsam par zhu/ dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog/ // 120) ༄// springs yig 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel byed// oṃ swasti/ shākya'i sras kyi dge slong ki'arti a ka ras yon sgom la springs pa/ yon tan dpag med rin chen gter gyur cing*// nam mkha' lta bur rnam dag dri ma med// nyes tshogs mun sel sdang dang rab rib rnams// ma lus 'joms mdzad de la gus phyag 'tshal// thub dbang bstan pa rin chen myur du 'grib 'gyur gyis// dkar phyogs dge ba'i tshogs rnams khyod kyis 'phel bar mdzod// zhe sdang gnod sems chags dang 'tshe ba rnam par spongs// byams dang snying rje stong dang rten cing 'brel 'byung rtsa ba rnams// yongs su rgyas mdzod thar pa'i lam ni gzhan dag yod ma yin// gang zhig tshe 'di'i bde skyid grags dang snyan pa dug dang 'drar mkhyen mdzod// tshe 'di glog dang chu bur dang mtshungs rig par byos// phyi ma'i don chen dam chos rin chen phan dang bde ba rtag tu sgrubs// gso sbyong yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa thub pa'i bka'// rtag tu bsrung mdzod 'di las gzhan pa yi// skyabs mchog gzhan ma mchis par rig par mdzod// khrims ni rgyu dang mi rgyu kun gyi sa gzhi bzhin// yon tan kun gyi gzhi rten lags par thub pas gsungs// gong du bskur ba 'jig rten mgon po'i bka'// lnga ldan dam chos lag pa'i lto rgyab nas// ji ltar gsungs bzhin 'bad pas nyams su longs// tshe 'di yun thung bya ba rnam mang zhing*// sang dang 'chi ba gang snga cha ma mchis// de las skyob pa'i skyabs ni 'di las med// brgya byin 'jig rten mchod 'os gyur nas ni// las kyi dbang gis phyir yang sa steng ltung*// 'khor los sgyur rgyal bdag tu gyur nas kyang*// 'khor ba dag na yang bran nyid du 'gyur// tho ris lha mo'i nu ma sked pa la// reg pa'i bde ba yun rings myong nas slar// dmyal bar thag gcod 'bar ba'i 'khrul 'khor gyis// reg pa shin tu mi bzad bsten 'tshal lo// go'u tam dpa' bo bu ram shing pa'i rigs// mgon po rin chen skyabs gyur nyi ma'i gnyen// zas gtsang sras po chos kyi rgyal po des// gling bzhi rgyas pa rin chen sna bdun dang*// rgya mtshor thug pa'i sa 'di rnam spangs nas// rab byung slong mor phyag dar khrod 'chang zhing*// brtul zhugs mchog spyod nags kyi khrod du bzhugs// de bzhin yab gcig khyod kyis kyang*// 'dod pa dgra dang dug dang ni// sbrul gdug bzhin du rnam par spang*// skyob mdzad shākya seng ges kyang*// 'dod pas phung ba bskyed par gsungs// 'dod pa mkhas pa rnams kyis smad// 'dod med drang srong rnams kyis bsngags// de phyir khyod kyis de ltar sgrubs// springs yig 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba zhes bya ba 'phags pa'i gsung la brten pa'o// yig rten la na bza'i srung dar tho gang ba gcig dang*/

phrug chung shin tu legs pa drag ldan ther ma dmar po la byas pa cig bskur nas mchis// ldom bu ba kīrti a ka ra'i springs yig// / 121) ༄// 'bra gug shi dang bshes gnyen drug la springs pa'i yi ge/ oṃ swasti/ thugs rje mchog mnga' bcom ldan 'das// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// byin rlabs mthar thug chos kyi rje// bka' brgyud bla ma dam pa dang*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// bla ma rin chen sangs rgyas pas// thub pa'i bstan pa rin chen la// thos bsam sgom las byung ba yi// shes rab mchog gis rnam par brgyan// yon tan rin chen mang po'i gter// bshes gnyen dam pa rnam drug la// rgyang nas zhu ba 'bul ba'i don// sa chen 'di yi bdag po mchog /mi yi dbang po'i rgyal khams su// thub pa'i bstan pa gnas par mdzad// sngar yang bka' drin mi chung che// mdo khams dbus gtsang rgyal khams su// 'jigs pa med cing 'tshe med pa'i// rten 'brel khyed kyis mdzad par zhu// yi ge mi 'khyam pa yi rten// khyed chen po rnam pa drug po la// dbu zhu'i rgyu re 'bul zhing mchis// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che// 'jig rten khams 'dir gnas gyur cig /'bra gug shi la sogs pa bshes gnyen rnam pa drug la springs pa'i yi ge// / 122) ༄// slob dpon gcer mtshams pa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ slob dpon rin po che gdan sa bas rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug chen po slob dpon dbon po gcer mtshams pa la springs pa/ khyed kyis 'gro ba mang po 'khor ba'i 'brog dgon pa las brgal bar mdzad cing sku khams bde bar bzhugs zhes 'khums/ de shin tu thugs la btags/ lus rnam par dag pa lha dang mi 'bral ba/ rnam 'gyur gsum dang mi 'bral bar spyod pa dang*/ ngag rnam par dag pa sngags dang mi 'bral bar rdo rje'i bzlas par spyod pa dang*/

sems rnam par dag pa byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyis nyin mtshan 'da' bar spyod pa'i spyod pa rnam pa gsum dang mi 'bral bar gzhan gyi don phun sum tshogs pas 'jig rten mgon po'i thugs dgongs rdzogs par mdzad par zhu/// / 123) ༄// 'dan ma rin chen ye shes la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ spyir theg pa chen po gsang sngags gnyan// sgos bla ma dam pa gnyan pas 'dir// ci gsung sgrub la dngos grub 'byung*// phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun gyis// stag ma blangs pa thugs la btags// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rnams// 'thob 'gyur 'di la the tshom med// rin po che spyan snga nas// pha 'jig rten mgon po bla ma'i sras// mes dpal ldan phag mo gru pa'i dbon// rtsod pa kun dang bral ba yi// mnyam med byang thang ras chen la// chab tshwa rtse mo srang bcu 'bul// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog/ ༈ //oṃ swasti// rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// da nas sangs ma rgyas kyi bar gyi chos lnga ldan 'ba' zhig lags la/ lnga ldan gyi ngo bo byang chub kyi sems gnyis dbye ba med pa de nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa gal che/ rjes kyi shes pa bcu chos dang*/ sum chos kyis nyams su len pa ma gtogs pa gzhan mi bdog pas// 'di kho na ltar nyams su len par zhu// sgom pa rin chen ye shes kyis// gsol thur bskur ba thugs la btags// yig rten a ru ra gsum bdog /dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog// / 124) ༄// byams pa'i khrid tshul khrims blo gros la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ rje rin po che yi bzhed kyis/ 'jig rten pa'i ma bu la byams pa 'am// bu a ma la byams pa'i byams pa de 'phags pa nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa'i byams pa'i ngo bo yang de nyid lags la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zag pa med pa'i byams pa yang de nyid lags par bzhed de/

'jig rten pa'i ma bu la byams pa'am/ bu a ma byams pa'i byams pa de nyid la mnyam par 'jog pa de nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad la de kho na bzhin du bsgom pa ma gtogs pa/ byams pa la gnad gzhan mi bdog sems can nas sangs rgyas kyi bar du byams pa'i ngo bo de kho na ltar nyams su len par zhu/ de ltar byams pa bsgoms pa las// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// yon tan bde skyid ma lus pa// byams pa'i mthu las 'byung bar bzhed// pha rol dmag dpung zlog pa dang*// mi yams phyugs yams zhi ba dang*// yon tan bde skyid ma lus pa// byams pa bsgoms pas 'byung bar gsungs// sgom pa tshul khrims blo gros kyis// phyag bshan gsol thur bskur ba yang*// bdag gi phyag tu legs par things// yig rten a ru ra gsum mchis// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// /

125) ༄// slob dpon yul skyong ba la bskur ba springs yig mdo smad khams gshegs// oṃ swasti// 'khor 'das gnyis kyi dpal gyur chos kyi rje// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma rin chen dang*// dus gsum bdag nyid jo bo dkon mchog gsum// kun la gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// rgyal ba'i mchod rten dpal gyi 'bri gung nas// nyid kyi bla mar gyur pa'i rin po ches// yon tan rgya mtshor gyur pa chos rnams kun gyi gter// 'jig rten mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// thams cad mkhyen pa bla ma rin chen gyi// rigs las 'khrungs pa'i skyes bu dam pa mchog /shākya'i dge slong ldom bu bdag gi bu// thos bsam sgom gsum shes rab mthar thug pa'i// spyi dang rang gi mtshan nyid kun la mkhas// dus gsum 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus kun// gnyis med 'od gsal chen por gcig tu rtogs// rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rten 'brel kun la mkhas// chos las skyes pa'i bu sdug kun gyi mchog /rgyal po lta bu'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ni// slob dpon yul skyong nyid la zhu ba'i don// sku khams bde zhing 'phrin las che bar khums// de la bdag dga' shin tu thugs la btags// slad ma gnyis pa zhu ba'i don 'di mchis// 'jam dbyangs dpa' bos 'jig rten khams rnams su// dpag med 'gro ba mang po 'dul mdzad ltar// skyes mchog mi yi seng ge khyod nyid kyang*// zhing khams rnam dag mdo smad khams gshegs nas// shākya'i rgyal po'i bstan pa rgyas phyir dang*// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// gdul bya rgya mtsho ma lus 'dul ba dang*// chos kyi rgyal mtshan chen po 'dzugs par zhu// gdul bya rigs can rab 'bring tha gsum la// gang zag dbang po'i bye brag ji lta bar// dam chos ston pa de ltar mdzad par zhu// brtson 'grus chen po rtsom pa'i dus la bab// yar ngo mar ngo snga dro phyi dro dang*// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// dri med rnam thar mchog la spyod pa dang*// tshul khrims ting 'dzin pha rol phyin drug la// 'gro ba ma rnams 'god pa nyid du zhu// sems can zhing rnams sangs rgyas nyid du bsgrub// byams mgon blo dang ldan dang thogs med sogs// 'gro la byams shing chags pa snying rje'i stobs// sems can khams la mnyam par 'jug pa dang*// bdag nyid chen pos 'gro ba ma lus rnams// bla med byang chub mchog la 'god par zhu// slob dpon yul skyong la bskur ba'i springs yig mdo smad khams gshegs zhes bya ba'o/// /

126) ༄// dge bshes rin chen grags la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'jig rten mgon po rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// shākya'i dge slong spyan snga bas// rgyal po lta bu dge ba'i bshes// skyob mdzad bla ma dam pa'i sras// 'gran zla kun dang bral ba'i mchog /dge ba'i bshes gnyen rin grags la// zhu ba 'bul ba tshig gi don// dus 'dir bla ma rin chen 'das// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dri med nub// phyogs rnams mun pa chen pos khebs// bdag cag 'phongs shing thug dus 'dir// skyes bu dam pa khyed nyid kyis// rin chen baiḍūr mthing shog la// rin chen zhun mas bris pa'i 'bum// gzhan yang nyi shu lnga pa dang*// mdor sna du mar bcas pa dang*// rin chen yab sras rten rnams dang*// spyi dang bye brag thams cad la// yul gru ri ba'i rta rnams dang*// mdzo dang khyad par 'phags pa yi// dngos po du ma bskur ba rnams// kun kyang byang chub gling du phyin// thams cad phyag tu legs par thon// dbugs phyung shin tu thugs la btags// yig rten sku phyam legs pa cig /mchis pas sku la gsol bar zhu// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// ma rnams byang chub thob par shog// / 127) ༄// dge sbyong gzhon nu nam mkha' la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ spros med nam mkha'i rang bzhin rdo rje'i sku// brjod med rgya mtsho lta bur dri med gsung*// zhi zhing nyer zhi rnam par dag pa'i thugs// sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho 'di// rtog dang rnam par rtog las byung*// byang chub rnam gsum mya ngan 'das// mi rtog rtog pa med las byung*// byang chub nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// rtog pa thams cad spangs pa'i phyir// 'gro 'ong med pa'i rin po che// dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo yin// rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin byed pa med par mngon// rtogs ma rtogs gnyis po ma gtogs pa// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa med// mi rtog rtog med sems nyid dang*// kun rdzob byang sems rin po che// gnyis su med pa'i ngo bor bsgom// dben dang ri khrod nags khrod brten// 'jig rten 'dod pa'i yon tan spang*// lta ba'i mthar thug mi rtog pa// spyod pa mthar thug byed pa med// sgom pa mthar thug rtog pa spang*// dbye ba med par nyams su longs// bla ma gong ma'i zhal nas kyang*// rtog pa spangs na mkhyen pa gsal// sprin dang bral na nyi zla gsal// rnyog pa dwangs na gzugs brnyan gsal// rtog pa bral na sems nyid gsal// lta sgom spyod gsum de la mdzod// dge sbyong gzhon nu nam mkha' la// rtag tu nyams su blang phyir gdams// dge bas byang chub thob par shog// /

128) ༄// yon bdag yon chen khyi gu lod la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po ches/ ngan bu'i chos las skyes pa'i bu/ yon chen khyi gu lod la springs pa/ yon bdag thugs dam mdzad pa la rem bya bar thos/ de shin tu thugs la btags/ bskyed rdzogs gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i gdams ngag byang chub kyi sems/ yi dam gyi lha/ bla ma/ phyag rgya chen po/ rjes dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngo ba dang chos lnga po ltar nyams su len par zhu ba lags la/ phyag rgya chen po rang gi ngo bo ni// yid la mi byed phyag rgya chen po ste// sems nyid ma bcos gnyug ma'i ngang la gzhag /ma bcos sems nyid nam mkha' lta bu la// yengs med ngo bo lhun gyis grub par gzhag /dran pa'i rgyal po rtag tu bsten par bya// tshe 'di mi rtag glog dang chu bur 'dra// yon chen rtag tu thugs dam mdzad par zhu// 'jig rten 'di yi 'dod pa'i yon tan dang*// 'khor dang lo 'dab phun sum tshogs pa rnams// mi rtag rtswa kha'i zil pa nyid dang mtshungs// rtag brtan zhi ba sems nyid ma skyes pa// rtog med rtog pa kun dang rnam par bral// mi rtog nam mkha'i rang bzhin ngo bo nyid// spros med sems nyid gdod nas ma skyes pa// nam mkha' lta bur 'dzin pa kun dang bral// rgya mtsho lta bur g.yo ba med par gnas// rtag tu mnyam par zhog cig rnal 'byor pa// dri med rgyal ba phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje 'bri gung pa'i// thugs kyi dgongs pa yin gyis rtag tu bsgom// thugs rje mchog mnga' shākya'i rgyal po dang*// sangs rgyas 'od dpag med pa bcom ldan la// rtag tu mos gus bya zhing gus pa bskyed// ngan bu'i bu yon chen gyis dus rtag tu 'bul ba rgya chen po bskur ba thugs la btags/ yig rten du kha che gur gum zho nyi shu rtsa gcig bskur nas mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag

/bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun bzang por red gyur cig/ // 129) ༄// 'dan stod bkra shis sgang du skyu ra'i gdung sras la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rigs su skyes pa yi// sras kyi thu bo bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan bsnams// gdung brgyud 'dzin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// dus gsum 'khor 'das chos rnams ma lus kun// zab zhi spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas// sems nyid yon tan rgya mtsho thugs su chud// mi g.yo ri rab 'dra la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu 'bras rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba rnams// 'di las 'di 'byung ma nor thugs su chud// log rtog mun pa'i rnam pa kun dang bral// mkhyen pa mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// chos kyi rgyal po bla ma'i gsang gi mdzod// rten cing 'brel 'byung zab mo'i 'khor lo yis// sna tshogs lta dang lta ngan 'dzin pa'i tshogs// 'jig par mdzad pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa'i// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod 'dzin pa// gdul bya smin par mdzad pa'i thabs la mkhas// 'gro ba'i ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// tshe gcig bla med byang chub sangs rgyas pas// rmad byung gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa la// sangs rgyas dngos kyi brgyud pa ma chad pa// rdo rje 'dzin pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten mgon pos legs par bsngags pa yi// 'phags pa dgyes pa'i tshul khrims rin po ches// thub pa'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad// bstan pa rgyas mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// rigs rus lang tsho thos pas dregs pa rnams// khyod mthong nas ni thams cad zhum par gyur// 'jig rten 'di dag thams cad zil gyis gnon// 'gran med rtsod bral khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// snyigs ma'i dus 'dir bag med log lta can// mi srun gdul dka' dmu rgod sems can gyi// nyes tshogs rlung gis bskyod par mi nus la// mi ldog skyo med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// ser skya'i grong khyer gnyis pa'i sa phyogs der// chos kyi rgyal po chos rje rin chen gyi// bstan pa mi nub rmad byung rgyal mtshan btsugs// bstan pa'i srog shing 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rje rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs mdzad pa// khyod kyi yon tan rgya mtsho'i 'phrin las la// gus pa'i shugs kyis phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// gdan sa dpal gyi phag mo gru nas// 'dan stod bkra shis sgang du bskur ba'o//

130) ༄// bgres po yon seng la springs pa// oṃ swa sti/ dpal gyi 'bri gung nas/ bla ma rin po che phag mo gru pas/ yon seng la springs ba/ bgres po rang yang phyag rgya chen po bsgom/ don med pa'i sems khral chen po ma byed par dge sbyor la 'bungs/ de nas dge sbyor 'phel bar ma byung*/ sdug par byung na gzhi rnams btsongs nas phag mo gru na yar 'ongs pas chog pa yin/ lar ji ltar byas kyang btub nas 'ong ba yin/// / 131) ༄// lam gtong gi dmigs pa slob dpon rong chen pa la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas/ slob dpon rong chen pa la spring ba/ sku khams cung zhig ma bde bar gda' ba de la/ lam gtong dang yi dam dang stong ra gsum po bsgom pa'i rjes la/ sku'i gzer gar yod pa'i ngo bo de/ rje rin po che'i sku gzer de las mi che mi chung ba de tsam pa gcig tu bsgom/ gzer 'pho yin 'pho yin byung na/ gzer gar 'phos pa de rje rin po che'i sku de tsam du bsgom/ dus rgyun du lte ba'i 'og nad brgya sman gcig gi sa der bcom ldan 'das ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mkhyid gang ba zhig bsgom/ de las 'od zer dmar po sin dhu ra'i mdog lta bu 'phros pas khong pa'i nang lus phyi nang med pa thams cad ltems kyis gang bar bsgom/ de yun thung ba zhig bsgoms nas dus rtag tu lte ba'i 'og gi bcom ldan 'das ma de bsgom/ yig rten chab tshwa zi po la srang bco lnga dang*/ rtse mo zho gang dang*/ srung dar mdud pa can gcig bskur nas mchis pas/ mdud pa gar na sar bslan nas/ dpung pa g.yon pa la 'dogs par zhu/// / 132) ༄// dpon rin blo dang grags chen gnyis la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ rje rin po che yab sras la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// rje rin po che'i spyan snga nas/ dpon rgan rin blo dang*/ dpon rgan grags chen gnyis kyis dbu byas/

khyed der bzhugs pa rnams la springs/ kha sang sngar yang ye shes dpal btang nas tshur byon byas pa la ma byon/ de thugs la ma btags/ de la da lan yang sgom pa ye shes dpal btang ba yin pas kho'i zla la tshur 'byon par zhu/ nga yang ka par rgyal po'i sar khyed 'bri gung thel pas kyang nga 'di la cir yang ma mthong bar 'dug ste/ da lan khyed kho dang 'drod nas ma byon na/ nga yang gong du smras pa bzhin du nga'i bya ba sla ba yin/ ngas kyang 'bri gung thel pa'i bla ma ma byung ba yin/ khyed 'bri gung thel pa yang bla mas ma 'phongs pa yin pa srid de/ da lan de 'dra ba yid la ma 'jog par mi khrel gdong pa dang chos khrel dam tshig yin pas tshur spyon/ de ma lags pa grags chen la spring ba/ khyed dpon slob gdan sa rin po cher bzhag pa de kha mchu la ma bzhag 'khrug pa la ma bzhag /ngas lo nyi shu rtsa brgyad phu der bsdad de/ dge 'dun gyi go cha yin zer nas byang bu tser cig gon pa med pa la/ ngas gdan sa de sgong slon btsa' btsa' byas chos kyis bskyangs pa de khyed kyis med par byed par gda'/ de la kha ning dpon rin blo ba 'gro khar phyag la byung ba la/ dpal gyi dgon pa de bkog nas gtod pa'i dus su/ grags chen yang 'dzoms par gyis la dpal la gtod byas pa ma gtogs pa'i khyed gdan sa bas 'khrug pa gyis la dgon pa de khogs la kho la gtod byas pa mi 'dug de tsa na khyed rang gdan sa nas yongs pa dpal dang bcas pa de rnams kyang 'di na tshur la ma yong*/ gdan sa ngos su yang ma 'gro/ gzhan sa gar zad zad du song*/ khyed rnams kyis gdan sa de med par byed par snang*/ nga chos dang ma mthun na nga rang gis nga rang la chad pas gcod pa'i mi yin/ khyed rnams la rgyus yod kyang 'di byas pa yin/ khyed rnams bsnan pas 'bri gung pa mang mi nus/// / 133) ༄// rnal 'byor dbang phyug zhe rtsa ri ba la springs pa// oṃ swasti/ 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas// shākya'i dge slong spyan snga bas// zhe rnal 'byor dbang phyug rtsa ri ba// yab chos kyi rgyal po bla ma'i sras// mes dpal ldan phag mo gru pa yi// rigs las 'khrungs pa'i rnal 'byor pa// ri khrod gangs khrod nags khrod du// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa'i// rang byung phyag rgya chen po dang*// 'bral ba med pa'i skyes chen khyed// sa phyogs gar bzhugs gar gnas kyang*// bla ma rin chen thugs dgongs rdzogs// rtag tu sgrub pa mdzad par zhu// thag ring sa mthar ga la thon// rdzas dang yo byad zhabs tog gis// yab sras rtag tu mnyes par mdzad// da de las lhag pa ga la yod// 'jigs dang 'tshe ba med pa yi// chags dang sdang ba chung ba yi// dben par sgrub pa mdzad par zhu// bsgrub pa lus dang zang zing gi

/dngos po rnam par dag pa yis// dpal phag mo gru pa'i nags khrod dang*// 'bri gung dpal gyi dgon pa gnyis// bla ma dge 'dun thams cad kyang*// rtag tu khyed kyis mnyes par byas// sku khams mtho dman byung na yang*// bde ldan gnas su rin chen bsgom// khyed kyi dben po btsun chung yang*// steng na nye gnas mdzad cing bdog /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba yis// thag ring gshegs bzhud byar mi btub// rin po che yi glegs bam dang*// 'bul ba rgya chen bskur ba rnams// bdag gi phyag tu legs par thon// yi ge mi 'khyam pa yi rten// dbu zhu bzo bzo ba cig 'bul// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// rnal 'byor dbang phyug rtsa ri ba// sku tshe ring zhing sku khams bzang*// rtag tu bsgrub pa 'phel ba dang*// khyed dang bdag cag thams cad rnams// byang chub dam pa thob par shog// /

134) ༄// gces pa'i bu sdug a khu ston pa la springs pa// dus gsum mgon po phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su nye bar mchi// dpal ldan phag mo gru'i nags khrod nas// nyid kyi bla mar gyur pa'i bsod snyoms pas// gces pa'i bu sdug a khu ston pa la// zhu yig yi ger springs pa'i don 'di la// khyed kyi gsung rabs g.yu rdog la sogs pa// snga phyi kun gyi 'bul ba legs par things// da lan ston pa'i yab rgan brdzangs nas mchis// 'dus byas mi rtag tha mal spang bar bya// skye dgu kun gyi lam yin 'chi bar nges// sems gnyis dbyer med nam mkha' lta bu la// nyin mtshan mnyam par 'jog pas 'da' bar mdzod// phan sems kun gyi rtsa ba snying rje lags// ma g.yeng rgyun par mnyam par 'jog par zhu// tho rangs dus gnad legs par zin pa dang*// gnod pa bzlog phyir skabs su byang sems bsgom// phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa ma lus pa// yid kyis mngon sum gyis la gsol ba thob// bdag dang khyed gnyis 'bral med ngo mtshar che// yi ge mi 'khyam pa'i rten du ther ma gnyis bskur nas mchis// 'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 135) ༄// bdud rtsi bum chung slob dpon ston seng gi gser 'bum gyi things yig/ oṃ swasti/ dus gsum bde gshegs chos kyi rje// mnyam med bla ma rin chen dang*// tshad med thugs rje mchog mnga' ba// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor dang mya ngan 'das pa yi// chos rnams ma skyes spros dang bral// sems rnam dag nam mkha' lta bu la// phra dang rags pa'i rgyu 'bras rnams// mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang*// stobs dang mi 'jigs ma 'dres chos// bslu ba med par 'byung ba 'di// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod// nam mkha' lta bu'i rgyu 'bras lags// chos las skyes pa'i bu sdug khyed// sems dang lus dang snang ba gsum// ma skyes skye med spros dang bral// rnam dag rin chen nam mkha' la// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rnam gnyis// dbye ba med par nyams su longs// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// gdul bya mang po smin par byos// yar ngo mar ngo'i rnam thar dang*// snga dro phyi dro mdzad pa yi// rjes su zhugs shig chos kyi bu// lar 'jig rten 'di yi bsam pa dang*// bdag 'dzin thongs shig rnal 'byor pa// bdag med byang chub sems gnyis dang*// chu dang brlan bzhin 'bral med par// rtag tu gnas par gyis shig dang*// bar do gsum po des bgrod de// byang chub snying por bdud btul nas// rdzogs pa'i byang chub sangs rgyas te// lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi// phyag gi gnas su 'gyur bar nges// bdag gi bu sdug yid 'ong zhing*// srog gam snying dang 'dra ba yi// skyes bu dam pa'i thugs la zhog

/'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por reg gyur cig /slob dpon ston seng la springs pa'o// gser 'bum gyi things yig bdud rtsi bum chung zhes bya'o/// / 136) ༄// gsang bdag gi dmigs pa dpon lha gnyer la gdams pa// oṃ swasti// bla ma rin po che spyan snga nas/ dpon lha gnyer ba la springs pa/ sku khams ma bde ba la lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam lha'i thugs kyi dkyil du rje btsun gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku mkhyid gang ba zhig bsgom/ rje btsun gsang bdag gi thugs ka nas bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun rje btsun gsang bdag gi sku mdog lta bur byon nas/ zhabs g.yas g.yon gang snyung ba de khrig gis gang bar bsgom/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog// / 137) ༄// dpon byams rin la gdams pa nad gso'i dmigs pa// oṃ swasti/ spyan snga nas dpon byams pa rin chen la springs pa/ skabs byung na yar la cig byon pa byung na legs/ rje rin po che'i bzhed kyis nad thams cad dmigs pa gcig gis gso ba la lte 'og tu gtum mo'i dmigs pa sgom sar/ rje rin po che'i sku mkhyid gang ba zhig sgom pa 'dis chen por gyur pa'i mdze nad man chad nas/ chung ba cham pa cig yan chad la dmigs pa 'di kho na bsgom pa lags pas de ltar thugs la 'jog par zhu/// / 138) ༄// nad gso'i dmigs pa bya ra ba rin gzhon la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ rje rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo/ sgom pa ba yun ring du bsnyung bar gda'/ da en tsam zhig yar bde bar yod pa der gda' bas/ thugs la btags/ de la snyung gzhi lhag ma de dag cing sos par bya ba dang*/ phyis kyang nad glau bur ba mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir/ dang po kho na lam du gtang*/ sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lha bsgom/ yi dam lha'i spyi bo'i gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yas gcod/

sha dang rus pa rkang dang chu rgyus la sogs pa med par phru ma phus btab pa ltar stong sang nge ba zhig tu bsgom/ de ltar stong par bsgoms pa'i rjes la lte ba'i 'og spu mtshams khong pa'i nang na/ chos rje rin po che'i sku che chung mkhyid gang tsam pa zhig rtse gcig tu bsgom/ thun gyi rjes su bsngo ba bya/// / 139) ༄// nags shod pa dpon tshul khrims seng ge la gdams pa'i dmigs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas dpon la springs ba/ sku khams en zhig ma bde nas yod par 'dug pa de ma legs/ da thugs dam gyi mdzad tshul dang po lam du gtang*/ de nas byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam lha'i khong pa'i nang du rgyu lto nyal nyil/ tsag tsog sha dang rus pa rkang dang chu rgyus la sogs pa gtan med pa bsgom pa ni yi dam lha'i rnam pa phru ma phus btab pa bzhin gtsang sang nge yod par bsgom/ de nas lte ba'i 'og spu mtshams khong pa'i nang du me che chung khu tshur 'bring po tsam lcags bsregs pa 'dra ba dmar hril le ba zhig bsgom/ de la rtse gcig tu thugs gtad la thugs dam nan tan che bar mdzad par zhu/ des gsol dang bde ba dang*/ bags kyis khams je bde je bder 'ong ba yin/ dmigs pa 'di kun gyi thugs rgyus dpon rang la yang yod pa lags/// / 140) ༄// dpon grags pa tshul khrims la gnang ba'i nad gso'i zhal gdams// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas/ ngan bu'i bu mos gus kyi bdag nyid can// dpon grags tshul la springs ba/ nad de lta bu byung ba'i dus su dang po lam du gtang*/ sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam lha'i khong pa'i nang du sha dang rus pa rkang dang chu rgyus rgyu lto nyal nyil tsag tsog spu'i rtse mo tsam yang med pa/ rnam pa ni yi dam lha'i rnam pa khru phus btab pa bzhin du gtsang sang nge yod par bsam/ zhag kha cig nan tan che bar de ltar bsgoms pas rtsa mig dang stod na gnas pa'i nad rnams spu mtshams lte ba'i 'og tu 'tshogs/

de'i rtags su zug lhangs lhangs mi bzod pa 'ong*/ de byung ba'i dus su zug gi ngo bo de bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma zug de tsam zhig tu bsgom/ bcom ldan 'das ma'i sku las me lce ba gzhug tsam zhig bshang lam na mar la na ra ra 'bar/ 'dom pa bco brgyad tsam na 'bar ba'i me lce'i rtse mo la shes pa gtad la bsgom/ me de res gzhug gu thung na mar 'bar nas yang sa'i 'og na mar 'dom bco brgyad tsam na mar la 'bar ba bsgom/ dmigs pa des nang cha dang sha la yod pa'i nad thams cad bshang lam na mar thon pa yin/ de nas yang rje btsun ma'i sku las me lce ba gzhug tsam pa de sked phran ba nas sgal tshigs kyi nang na mar rdol nas 'dom pa bco brgyad tsam na mar 'bar ba'i me lce'i rtse mo la shes pa gtod/ des rus pa dang rkang dang*/ chu rgyus la yod pa'i nad rnams thar thon nas yong*/ de ltar thugs dam la nan tan che bar mdzad par zhu/ dbang po ril bu shin tu bzang ba gnyis bskur nas yod/ bzhes shig 'gro ba'i mgon po rin chen dang*// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po dang*// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyis bzhes/// / 141) ༄// dpon yon tan grags la gnang ba'i nad gso'i zhal gdams// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas// dpon yon tan grags la springs pa/ sku khams drag po'i yun ring bar ma bde bar 'dug pa la da lta legs par yod par thos/ de shin tu thugs la btags/ 'dir khong rnam pa yar la btang nas sku'i rim gro la 'bul ba mang bskol legs par rus su thon par bgyis/ da sku khams kyi gting pa de thugs dam gyis 'don dgos/ de la dmigs pa lam gtong la sogs pa sngon 'gro rnams tshar ba dang*/ dngos gzhi la lte ba'i 'og spu mtshams khong pa'i nang na bcom ldan 'das ma rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku che chung mkhyid gang tsam cig bsgom/

de'i sku las me lce sbom phra lag ngar tsam zhig lhugs kyis 'bar nas gshang lam nas mar 'bar ba de sa'i 'og na mar 'dom pa bco brgyad tsam na mar 'bar bar bsgom/ me de res gzhug gu thung na mar 'bar nas yang sa'i 'og mar 'dom pa bco brgyad tsam na mar 'bar bar bsgom/ de gnyis thugs gang 'gro 'gro res 'jog tu bsgom/ 'dir nged kyis kyang dpon pa'i sku'i rim gro la thugs dam dang*/ thugs gtod pa la 'bung ba lags/ thel du yang hor dong byung ba lags te gnod pa ma byas/ byin rlabs kyis bla ma dge 'dun thams cad sku bzang par bdog da phyin chad kyang hor gyi 'jigs pa gtan mi 'ong bar bdog pas/ thugs mi bde ba mdzad mi 'tshal/ yig rten du srung dar mdud pa can cig dang*/ bu ram rgya gar ma zho gang dang*/ ja bshal zho gang la byin rlabs byas nas bskur nas bdog /'gro kun dge ba ji snyed yod pa dang*// byas dang byed 'gyur de bzhin byed pa dag /bzang po ji bzhin de 'dra'i sa dag la// kun kyang kun nas bzang por red gyur cig// / 142) ༄// sgom chen grags pa la gnang ba'i nad gso'i dmigs pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che spyan snga nas sgom grags la spring ba/ lte ba man chod rkang pa'i sor rtse yan chod stong ra khol bur zhag gcig tsam bsgom/ de nas lte ba'i 'og tu me dmar ling nge ba khu tshur tsam zhig bsgom/ de la me lce 'jam po mar la lhug lhug lhug byon byon byon nas lte ba man chod sor rtse yan chad krig gis gang bar bsgom la de nas res 'ga' sor rtse bcu la me lce sor gsum gsum tsam 'bar bar bsgom/ yig rten du chab tshwa zho cig bskur nas yod/ rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig/ // 143) ༄// grib sel zhal gdams rngod pa rin chen ye shes gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ bkra shis pa dang bde legs thams cad 'byung zhing nad dang gnod pa dang nyes pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis gtan mi tshugs shing tshe ring ba dang*/

yon tan ma lus pa 'byung ba'i nyams len la/ spyod lam rnam bzhi gang gis gnas kyang*/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi dmigs pa de nyid 'ba' zhig bsgom/ 'di dang ma bral na nyes pa'i skyon gyis gtan mi gos shing*/ yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'byung bas nyams len gyi gzhung 'di kho na la bya'o// de nas zla ba byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad dam bcu gang rung dang*/ bco lnga dang nyi shu lnga gnam stong dang dus bzhi la ku su lu'i tshogs gsog re dam bcar bya'o// 'di 'chi ba bslu ba rnams kyi mchog yin/ gzhan yang skabs skabs su bsrung ba'i 'khor lo zhal gdams ma dang*/ rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid bsrung ba'i yi ge gsum gyi srung 'khor ram/ gtum po sum brtsegs gam srung ba'i 'khor lo rnams kyang bsgom/ gzhan yang nub mo nyal nas chos spyod thams cad tshar ba dang*/ sems bskyed lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam lha'i snying gi dbus su rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma nad dang gnod pa'i 'jigs pa las skyob pa/ che chung gang bder wal gyis bsgom/ rje btsun ma'i sku las 'od zer sngo ljang du ba lta bu byon pas rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil yan chad ltems kyis gang bar sgom/ de'i ngang la gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ nang par langs khar mi dang tshig ma 'dres gong du yang de ltar bsgom/ 'dis nad dang grib la sogs pas tshur gtan mi 'jug gsungs/ 'di rnams la spyan snga nas thugs gtsigs shin tu che ba yin pas rtag tu nyams su blang bar bya'o// lar yang rang srung tsam gyi dge sbyor re la nan tan shin tu che bar bya/ de bas lhag na bsam gyis mi khyab/// / 144) ༄// tshad nad gso ba'i dmigs pa slob dpon bla ma la gdams pa// oṃ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas slob dpon bla ma la springs pa/ tshad pa'i dmigs pa dang po lam du gtang*/

sems bskyed lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom/ yi dam lha'i khong pa'i nang du sha dang rus pa rkang dang chu rgyus rgyu lto nyal nyil tsag tsog la sogs pa gang yang med pa/ phru ma phus btab pa ltar gtsang sang nge yod par bsgom/ stong ra de zhag 'ga' bsgoms pas tshad ro rnying pa yin na tshad pa'i nad thams cad rtsa mig tu gram nas yod pa de gnas sa ma rnyed par sa gzhi dang 'dra ba'i lte ba'i 'og tu 'tshogs/ de'i rtags su zug drag po lhangs lhangs pa mi tshugs pa zhig 'ong*/ rtags de byung ba'i dus su myur du dmigs pa mar sring dgos pas/ zug gi ngo bo de rje btsun ma rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku mkhyid gang tsam zhig tu bsgom/ de'i sku las me 'bar nas 'dom gsum bzhi tsam na mar la chu thur du 'bab pa bzhin du 'bar ba'i me lce'i rtse mo la shes pa gtad/ de ltar bsgoms pas mar bshal ba dang*/ 'og rlung dri mi zhim pa la sogs pa 'ong*/ des sha dang nang cha'i nad thams cad mar thon nas 'ong ba yin/ res 'ga' sgal tshigs kyi nang gzhug gu thung na mar gling bu'i bu ga nang bzhin gsal har re yod par bsgoms pa'i nang na mar me lce 'dom gsum bzhi tsam na mar 'bar bar bsgom/ des rus pa dang rkang dang chu rgyus kyi nad thams cad thon nas 'ong*/ de zhag 'ga' srings pas tshad pa'i nad thams cad ma lus par thon pa yin/ rim gyis tshad pa so ma byung na lte ba'i 'og khong pa'i nang du jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku lo sar sgang gi chu ltar shin tu bsil ba zhig bsgom/ spyod lam la gzab/ khyed kyis 'bul ba rgya chen po bskur ba thugs la btags/ yig rten sku sham rgyu ther ma legs pa zhig bskur nas mchis// rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par gyur cig// / 145) ༄// dpon thugs rje 'byung gnas la gdams pa nad gso'i dmigs pa// om̐ swasti/ bla ma rin po che'i spyan snga nas dpon thugs rje 'byung gnas la springs pa/

nad de'i dmigs pa zhabs kyi pus mo'i ltag brla phra mo man chad rkang pa'i sor rtse yan chad sha dang rus pa rkang dang chu rgyus la sogs pa gang yang med pa dbyibs rkang pa'i dbyibs su yod pa phru ma phus btab pa lta bu gtsang sang nge yod par bsgom/ zhag kha cig stong ra de nyid bsgom/ de nas pus mo'i 'phang lo'i 'og tshigs kyi mgo der rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma sku mdog sngo ljang nad kyi 'jigs pa skyob ma zhal 'dzum bag dang bcas pa zhig bsgom/ de'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun lo sar zla ba'i chu ltar shin tu grang ba grang lhang nge byon nas pus mo man chad rkang pa'i sor rtse yan chad khrig gis gang bar bsgom/ nyin zhag phrugs re de ltar bsgom/ de nas yang nyin zhag phrugs gcig tsam song ba dang*/ rkang pa'i sor rtse na phar la bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun de thon nas na ra ra 'bab par bsgom/ de nas yang zhag gnyis gnyis tsam song ba dang*/ yang rje btsun ma'i sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byon nas sor rtse yan chad khengs par bsgom/ de zhag gnyis gnyis su res 'jog tu nan tan shin tu che bar bsgom/ ngan bus kyang thugs gtod pa lags/ byang chub thob par gyur cig// /

146) ༄// bla ma sgang jo la gnang ba'i srung 'khor zhal gdams// oṃ swasti/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bde ba dang ldan sdug bsngal dang bral/ bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis spyir sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di dge ba la bkol/ ma shi'i bar du lus ngag yid gsum dge ba la bkol/ dus de ring nas bzung nas nyi ma sang da tsam gyi bar du lus ngag yid rnam pa gsum po 'di dge ba la bkol snyam du bsam/ de nas yul ris dang rgyal khams jo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku shin tu che ba zhig tu bsgom/ de'i thugs kar rje btsun khro bo'i rgyal po mi g.yo ba'i sku shin tu che ba zhig bsgom/ de'i thugs khar 'khor lo kha dog ser po rtsibs bcu pa mnga' ris bod kyi rgyal khams tsam zhig bsgom/ 'khor lor rtsibs bcu la ye shes kyi khro bo bcu bsam de 'khor lo'i dbus su mi mgo skam po'i ja ril zhig bsgom/ de'i nang du rang nyid yi dam gyi lha keng rus kyi rnam par bsgom/ yi dam lha'i spyi bor dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang chos rje rin po che gnyis dbye ba med par bzhugs par bsam/ de nas pho thams cad rang nyid yi dam gyi lhar bsgoms pa'i g.yas/ mo thams cad g.yon/ rta dang glang po thams cad rang nyid kyi rgyab/ rdzas dang skam nor thams cad rang nyid kyi mdun na yod par bsam/ de nas 'khor lo'i phyi'i log na phar gtsug tor 'khor sgyur gyi dkyil 'khor thams cad bkra lam me yod par bsam/ gtsug tor 'khor lo sgyur bye ba phrag 'bum gyis mtha' bskor bar bsam/ steng na bye ba phrag lnga/ 'og na bye ba phrag lnga bzhugs par bsam/ de'i phyi la ye shes kyi khro bo bcu bye ba phrag 'bum gyis bskor bar bsam/ steng 'og gnyis su bye ba phrag gsum gsum bzhugs par bsam/ de'i phyi la dpal rta mgrin bye ba phrag 'bum gyis bskor bar bsam/

steng du bye ba phrag gcig /'og tu bye ba phrag gcig bzhugs par bsam/// / 147) ༄// sku gshegs kha'i zhal gdams spyan snga ba rnams la gnang ba// oṃ swasti/ dus gsum rgyal ba ma lus gcig pa'i sku// 'gro ba'i bla ma thugs rje'i bdag nyid can// rtsod ldan snyigs ma'i dus 'dir rmad byung ba// rgyal ba rin po che la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas mdzad pa 'phrin las lhun grub cing*// tshangs dbyangs 'brug gi sgra dang seng ge ltar// dpag med 'dus pa tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor du// log rtog the tshom bsal la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs ni 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu la// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa// chags thogs mi mnga' mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis// sgrib gsum mun bral de la phyag 'tshal lo// bral dang rnam smin yon tan dpag med tshogs// mtshan dang dpe byad ma lus mthar phyin cing*// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing du rnam par mdzes// thub mchog rgyal ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// khyod kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las kyis// rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' dang phyogs bcu'i zhing*// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston cing*// 'phrin las bsam mi khyab la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa mchog zhing du zhi ba rab bstan ltar// le lo can rnams bskul bar bya ba'i phyir// sangs rgyas mdzad pa cho 'phrul chen po bstan// rtag brtan zhi bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di ltar 'gro ba'i bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa mtha' dag ni mdzad/ 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos ni bzung*/ sku des 'dul ba'i gdul bya ji snyed cig yod pa thams cad ni smin cing grol bar ni mdzad/ ston pa thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa des mnyan yod du cho 'phrul chen po bstan pa'i dus kyi mchod pa'i dus kyi zla ba yar ngo'i tshes brgyad kyi snga dro'i tshe/

g.yu khang rin po che'i mthil du seng ge'i gzims khri tha ma la bzhugs nas spyan snga ya ta ba dang*/ slob dpon sgom rin dang*/ slob dpon sgom ye gnyis kyis dbu mdzad spyan snga ba rnams dang*/ slob dpon ri pa dang*/ dpon gzhon dang rnams la tha ma'i gsung dang zhal ta byon pa/ spyan snga ya ta ba la khyed 'dir byon pa de dga' ba yin/ skyid pa yin/ gsung gleng mang po bya rgyu yod pa yin pa la sku shed kyis en tsam ma 'tsho/ mdang zhag kyang spyan snga nas zhal ta mdzad nas bka' phyag gi sde dgon rnams la cho 'phrul chen po'i mchod pa la sku'i rim gro la 'bul 'gyed rgya chen po mdzad pa thugs la btags/ bka' drin che/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa gcig tu 'gro ba yin gsungs/ skabs der dpon gzhon pa la yang gdan sa rin po che'i zhabs tog mdzad pa'i mnyes mnyes kyi gsung mang po byon/ spyan snga ya tar slob dpon pa la nga'i gdan khri 'di 'bul ba yin/ cis kyang bzhugs par zhu/ ma bzhugs na thugs la ma btags pa yin gsungs/ gdan sa rin po che dang*/ slob dpon phag mo gru pa dang bcas pa phyag tu 'jug pa yin pas skyong ba dang thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ sgom pa rin 'byung dang*/ ye shes dpal gnyis kyis dbu mdzad nye gnas 'di rnams thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ nga'i mkhan slob rnam pas dbu mdzad dge 'dun 'di rnams skyong ba dang thugs la 'dogs par zhu/ phun sum tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyang thel rin po che 'di la lhan ne bzhugs par zhu gsungs/ bla ma rin po che nyid kyi spyan snga nas gsung 'di rnams la bka' yig cig mdzad bzhed par 'dug pa la sku shed kyis ma spyod/ de nas nged rnam pas skabs der byon pa'i gsung sgros dang tshig gcig kyang ma phri ma bsnan par yi ger bris pa lags/ bdag cag rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyis// sku gsung thugs kyi dgongs pa bsgrub pa dang*// gus pa'i yid kyis zhabs tog ci bgyis pas// mtha' dag yongs su dgongs pa rdzogs par shog

/'di nas bzung ste byang chub snying po'i bar// skad cig tsam yang 'bral ba med pa dang*// 'phrin las rgyun mi 'chad pa ji snyed pa// ji ltar dgongs pa bzhin du sgrub par shog /skad cig tsam yang mi mnyes med pa dang*// mnyes pa mtha' dag kun gyis mnyes byed cing*// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba'i mdzod rnams la// sgrib pa med par mngon du gyur par shog /gzhan yang dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di dag gis// bde ldan 'jig rten khams su zhabs drung du// rin chen padma sna tshogs 'dab stong la// skad cig gcig gis zhabs drung skye bar shog /zhing der skyes nas spyan ras gzigs dbang ltar// sras kyi gtso bo mchog tu gyur nas kyang*// bla med byang chub myur du thob par shog// / 148) ༄// 'bri gung nas rgyal ba rin po la gnang ba'i zhal gdams/ bsam nas byed pa mkhas pa yin// phyis 'byung 'dun ma bsam pa gces// hab shi hub shi myur drags pa'i// 'dun mas rang gzhan gnyis ka phung*// rkyen ngan drag po langs pa'i tshe// skad cig ma yi zhe sdang yang*// 'thab gdung chen por gyur pa na// bcos su med pa shin tu spongs// gal po che la ngo dga' med// ded dpon chen po siṅga la// bzang gling srin mos bslu ma thub// rgyal po seng ge'i ral pa can// bslus te srog dang phral ba na// 'gag nya kha mi lta bar// bag med brlag pa'i rgyu ru gsungs// bag dang ldan pa shin tu gces/// / 149) ༄// phag gru gdan sa thel gyi chos khang gi ka bar bris pa'i spyan snga rin po che'i gsung rtsom/ chos khang gi ka ba g.yas kyi dang po/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dri med chos kyi sku// 'jig rten mgon po chos rje rin chen dang*// yab sras gnyis la phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// khyod kyis nyon mongs rnam rtog dang*// rgod dang 'gyod dang the tshom dang*// gnyid rmug bsam gtan sgrib pa rnams// spongs la rang sems tha ba thul// rang byung dri ma med pa'i nyams// lkug pa bzhin du bskyang bar bya// sems nam mkha'i dkyil ltar 'dug pa de// phyag rgya chen po rang nyams yin//

ka ba g.yon dang po/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// rgyal ba'i sras po rgyal sras spyod pa mdzes// rnam dpyod blo gros rnam dag yul la mkhas// mchog gi don ston mchog la mu mthar gnas// 'khor ba'i mtsho skems 'khor ba'i pha rol song*// bla ma kun 'dus theg chen chos kyi gter// grags pa'i mtshan can nyams dgu rol ba'i dpal// skye med ngang nas 'gag med phrin las can// blo gros bsam yas 'byor pas srid mthar phyin// khyed gus bsten pas dal 'byor don ldan zhing*// gong 'phel rtsal rdzogs mu mthar dbyer med gter// de phyir mtshungs bral bla na med pa zhes// 'jig rten mgon por grags la gus pas bstod// ka ba g.yas gnyis pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// rnam dag zhi ba'i ngang las khro bo'i sku// he ru ka dpal thabs mchog rgyal po che// shes rab ye shes gnyis med dgyes par 'khril// longs spyod dag pa gzi brjid cha byad can// yang dag sems pa'i dbang gis rnam dag sbyor// 'jigs byed rngam pa'i sku yis bgegs rnams 'joms// legs nyes rtags 'dzin ma nor dkar phyogs rnams// yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas mdzad khyod la bstod// khyod bstod mchod dang bsam pa'i byin rlabs kyis// sprul sku sde dang bcas pa yun brtan nas// 'khor dang longs spyod 'dod pa'i 'bras bu dang*// mchog gi dngos grub bde blag stsal du gsol// bde mchog la bstod pa'o// ka ba g.yon gnyis pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi/ ye nas rnam dag dri mas khams stong zhing*// rang bzhin lhun grub 'od gsal chos kyi sku// 'dus ma byas phyir rkyen gyis mi bslu ba// skyabs kyi mthar thug rkang gnyis gtso la 'dud// zab cing chags bral bden pa yongs kyi don// don dam ston pa'i gsung gis rnam dbyer bstan// bstan pa'i slob don zab mo mchog gi gtso// gtso ba'i rang bzhin skyabs gnyis dam chos 'dud// mi mchog dang po'i bstan pa mngon sum byas// lam bden yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i phyir// rgyun du sems nyid spyod pa don la mnga'// skyabs gsum mthar thug tshogs mchog 'phags rnams bstod//

ka ba g.yas gsum pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// rgya chen ye nas lhun gyis grub pa'i sku// mchog dang thun mong ster la mnga' brnyes shing*// yang dag zab mo thugs rje'i phrin las kyis// srid mthar phyin nas sems dpa'i ngang tshul can// mchod bstod brten pa'i dam tshig ma nor bas// 'bras bu bde sbyin 'dod pa'i longs spyod rnams// gang la mos pa char bzhin 'bebs pa dang*// bar du gcod zhi bsam pa'i re ba skongs// skal ldan mos pas spyan 'bras ltar skyong zhing*// dag pa'i las la sbyor mdzad khyod la bstod// phyogs dang dus dang gnas skabs thams cad du// bde legs phun sum tshogs pas khyab par shog /rje btsun ma sgrol ma la bstod pa'o// ka ba g.yon gsum pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi/ tshe 'di mi rtag glog dang chu bur dang*// 'dus byas thams cad nam mkha'i zil pa 'dra// 'gyur zhing 'jig rten 'chi ba'i chos can yin// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal mtha' med shin tu 'jigs// 'di las thar bar bya phyir dam chos bya// sred dang zhe sdang gti mug 'dod chags spang*// ma chags zhe sdang gti mug med par sems// dge ba dam pa 'di nyid spyad par bya// rang sems gdod nas skye med chos kyi sku// gzung 'dzin rtog pa'i sprin gyis ma sgrib par// lhun gyis grub pa'i ngo bor mnyam par bzhag /skabs skabs dge ba byang chub chen por bsngo// ka ba g.yon bzhi pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// bdag gzhan thams cad skyob pa dang*// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// tshe 'di dang phyi ma bar do gsum// bla med byang chub bar gyi ni// nyams len thabs dang shes rab yin// thabs la mkhas pa'i spyod pa ni// ha cang zhum min thal ba min// mkhas pa'i spyod par gnas par bya// 'khor dang gnyen 'dun phyogs rnams la// ma chags mi sdang spyod pa'i gnas// lus ngag yid gsum bya ba rnams// chos ltar spyod pa shin tu gces// dgra dang gnyen 'dun thams cad kyis// ha cang zhum par rtag tu brnyas// sngon gyi byang chub sems dpa' ltar// thog mar smra dang ran par smra// zhum med 'jigs pa med par bya// thogs pa med pa'i spobs pa de// ston pa'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes yin// byang chub sems gnyis dbyer med pa// dus gsum shes bya'i dkyil 'khor 'di// rnam dag 'od gsal chen po yin// tshogs dang dben pa gar 'dug kyang*// 'di dang 'bral ba med par mdzod// las chos dang sems su 'dres pa gces// byams dang snying rje byang chub sems// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal sel ba'i sman// phyogs rnams kun tu khyab par bsgom// dgra bgegs bdud dang bar chad rnams// bskyed rim lha yis gzhom par bya// tshe dang dbang phyug bsod nams rnams// bcom ldan 'phags ma sgrol ma la// gsol btab rtag tu gus pa bskyed// 'gro ba nam mkha' mnyam pa na// spyan ras gzigs dbang spyod pa yis// rtag tu skyob pa mdzad par zhu// smon 'jug don dam rnam gsum gyis// 'gro ba smin par mdzad pa dang*// bsnyen gnas dge bsnyen sdom pa rnams// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis kyis// nyams thag sdug bsngal can rnams skyobs// chos dang zang zing mi 'jigs dang*// snyan pa'i tshig gi 'gro ba rnams// rang dbang med par sdud par zhu// brtson 'grus chen po rtsom pa dang*// btang snyoms rtag tu spang bar byos// tshad pa'i nad la ga bur ltar// dug gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal 'di// thabs mkhas thugs rje chen po yis// byams pa chen pos zhi bar mdzod// chen po'i rigs su sku 'khrungs shing*// glang po lta bu'i rnal 'byor pa// bag med chal col spyod pa spangs// slob dpon grags pa'i nyams len mdzod// dge ba dri med zla 'dra 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog/

ka ba g.yas bzhi pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// yang dag lta ba bzang po'i rjes 'brangs nas// bla ma dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*// byams dang snying rje byang sems rin po che// 'chi med bdud rtsi rnam gsum nyams su blangs// de las skyes pa'i bsod nams ye shes tshogs// dbyer med rnam gsum rtag tu bsags par bya// lha dang bla ma ma skyes stong nyid gsum// rtag tu mi 'bral mnyam par bzhag par bya// bsngo ba smon lam sems bskyed skye med gsum// rjes kyi chos gsum nyams su blang bar byos// ka ba g.yas lnga pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// 'gro ba'i mgon po bla ma rin chen la// gus par phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di// gzung dang 'dzin pas rab tu bskyed// chags par 'dzin pas mi dga' bskyed// sdang bar 'dzin pas dmyal bar bskyed// ma chags mi sdang ma rmongs pa'i// gzung 'dzin gnyis dang bral ba yi// gdod nas skye ba med pa 'di// kun rdzob byang sems rin chen dang*// dbye ba med par nyams su blangs// rgyu 'bras rten 'brel chos rnams la// rtsis gdab rtag tu mdzad par zhu// rnam dag dngul dkar me long la// 'khrul med ye shes mig gis ni// ma nor gzigs pa'i shes rab can// sgom chen dbang phyug seng ge la// zab pa'i dam chos don po 'di// chos kyi 'brel par bskur pa lags// dge ba dri med ldan pa 'dis// byang chub dam pa thob par shog/

ka ba g.yon lnga pa/ oṃ swa sti/ rje rin po che la skyabs su mchi// 'khor 'das las kyi bdag po he ru kaḥ bzang ngan las la rnam smin so sor 'byung*// tshul lhung phyir sring las la dbang ba'i phyir// las byas gnyen po med ces bya ba min// thog med dus nas dus gsum bsags pa dang*// gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba dri med dang*// bdag gis de la dmigs pa'i dge ba des// dri med rgyal ba'i zhing khams bde ldan du// padma las skyes dge slong gyur nas kyang*// rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa de mthong nas// byang chub lung bstan dam pa thob par shog /dri med rgyal ba phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// yab sras gnyis dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// 'khor ba sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di bskam nas// 'jig rten sangs rgyas nyi ma 'char gyur cig / 'di rnams rje spyan snga rin po che'i gsung chos khang gi ka ba'i gser bris kyi ngo bshus so// // 150) ༄// gdan 'dzin rgyal ba rin po che la gnang ba'i zhal gdams kyi man ngag/ oṃ swa sti/ bkra shis dang bde legs thams cad 'byung zhing*/ nad dang gnod pa dang nyes pa dang*/ mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis gtan nas mi tshugs shing*/ tshe ring ba dang yon tan ma lus pa 'byung ba'i nyams len la spyod lam rnam bzhi gang gis gnas kyang*/ dus dang rnam pa thams cad du/ bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi dmigs pa dang po de nyid 'ba' zhig bsgom/ 'di dang ma bral na nyes pa'i skyon gyis gtan mi dgos shing*/ yon tan thams cad zla ba yar gyi ngo bzhin du 'byung bas nyams len gyi gzhung 'di kho na bya'o// gzhan yang zla ba 'byung ngo cog gi tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu gsum gang rung dang*/ bco lnga dang*/ nyi shu lnga dang*/ gnam stong dang*/ dus bzhi la ku sā li bcos min tshogs 'khor re dam bcar bya'o// 'di 'chi ba bslu ba rnams kyi mchog yin/ gzhan yang skabs skabs su srung ba'i 'khor lo zhal gdams ma dang*/

rnal 'byor pa bdag nyid srung ba yi ge gsum gyi srung 'khor ram gtum mo sum rtsegs sam/ srung ba'i 'khor lo rnams kyang bsgom/ gzhan yang nub mo nyal nas chos spyod thams cad tshar ba dang sems bskyed/ lus yi dam gyi lhar bsgom la/ yi dam lha'i snying gi dbus su rje btsun ma sgrol ma nad dang gnod pa'i 'jigs pa skyob ma/ che chung gang bder wal gyis bsgom/ rje btsun ma'i sku las 'od zer sngo ljang du ba lta bu byon nas/ rang yi dam du bsgoms pa'i spyi bo'i gtsug nas/ rkang pa'i mthil yan chad ltems kyis gang bar bsgom/ de'i ngang la gnyid du 'gro bar bya/ nang par langs khar/ mi dang tshig ma 'dres gong du yang de ltar bsgom/ 'dis nad dang grib la sogs pas tshugs gtan mi 'jug gsungs/ 'di rnams la/ spyan snga nas thugasartsis shin tu che ba yin pas rtag tu nyams su blangs bar bya'o// lar yang*/ srung 'khor rang srung tsam gyi dge sbyor la nan tan che bar bya/ de bas lhag na bsam gyis mi khyab/ khyed cag 'gro ba bkra shis pa// ldog pa na yang bkra shis shog /gnyen la blta ba bkra shis shog /gnyen gyis blta ba'ang bkra shis shog /dbang bcas gnod sbyin rgyal chen dang*// dgra bcom pa dag snying brtse bas// thams cad du ni bkra shis dang*// bdud rtsi shis pa thob par shog /tshangs pa dang ni de bzhin nor rgyas dang*// zag pa med dang rnam par grol rnams dang*// klu dang gnod sbyin rtag tu snying rjes srung*// stong brgya mtshungs par tshe ni 'phel bar shog /bkra shis dang bde legs phun sum tshogs par gyur cig / 151) ༄// bde chen zhing du skye ba'i smon lam tshig bzhi ma// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs par shog /'od dpag med pa mthong gyur zhing*// byang chub lung bstan thob par shog// / 152) smon lam dang bkra shis tshigs su bcad pa// oṃ swa sti/ skyob mdzad shākya'i rgyal po// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen la// gus pas phyag 'tshal skyabs su mchi// thog med dus nas dus gsum bsags pa dang*// gdod nas yod pa'i dge ba dri med dang*// bdag gis de la dmigs pa'i dge ba des// dri med rgyal ba'i zhing khams bde ldan du// padma las skyes dge slong gyur nas kyang*// rgyal ba 'od dpag med pa de mthong nas// byang chub lung bstan dam pa thob par shog

/dri med rgyal ba phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po dpal ldan 'bri gung pa// yab sras gnyis dang rtag tu mi 'bral zhing*// 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgya mtsho 'di skams nas// 'jig rten sangs rgyas ma 'char gyur cig /'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs nas kyang*// 'od dpag med pa mthong gyur nas// byang chub lung bstan thob par shog /rdo rje 'chang gis dbu mdzad pa'i// bla ma rnams kyi bkra shis shog /shākya'i rgyal pos dbu mdzad pa'i/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// 'jig rten mgon po sgam po pa// dpal ldan phag mo gru pa dang*// 'jig rten mgon po rin chen gyi/ /bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /yi dam lha dang dkon mchog gsum// chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog/ //smras pa/ rje spyan snga rin po che'i bka' 'bum 'di// sgom pa gzhon nu seng ge'i thugs dam 'di// grogs bdag 'ju pa jo sras kyis bris pa 'di// mos gus dam par mdzod cig kyai// // dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// / 153) ༄// chos rje spyan snga rin po cher chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas phul ba'i spyan 'dren zhu yig/ oṃ swa sti siddhi/ dpal ldan chos kyi rje chen po 'gro ba rnams kyi bla ma 'gran zla med pa'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ gcig tu bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i khur khyer bas bstan pa la de nyid gnyis par gyur pa/ brtse ba'i ma ma dam pa la thugs kyi 'phrin las gzhol bas lus can rnams la phan pa dang*/ bde ba sbyin pa'i rtsa lag chen po/ gangs kyi ri bo'i spor yongs su rdzogs pa'i bsil zer can gyi 'od zer 'phros pas shin tu ches gsal ba'i phun sum tshogs pa ltar dpal kun tu lam me ba/ padma dam pa'i ge sar g.yo ba'i rdul gyi dris kun nas bsdus pa'i bung ba'i 'phrin pa dar dir gyi sgra sgrog pas khyab pa'i chu gter chen po'i chen po ltar/

yon tan gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa'i 'byung khungs/ skye dgu'i sgron me dpal kun tu 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi snang ba shar ri bo'i rtser mngon du shar ba ltar gdul bya'i padma rnam par 'byed cing*/ mi shes pa'i rab rib rnam par sel ba/ nag po'i rtsal gyi rgyu skar zil gyis gnon pa'i ye shes kyi nyi ma chen po/ bskal pa dpag tu med par bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsgrubs pas/ yon tan gyi khyad par mngon du mdzad nas/ lhar bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyi rnam par 'dren pa chen por gyur pa'i dpal chos rje rin po che'i blar/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rabs kyi snang bas blo gros kyi me tog cung zad kha bye ba/ shākya'i dge slong sde snod 'dzin pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes bgyi bas chab shog gi yi ger phul ba/ dpal ldan 'gro ba kun gyi dpag bsam shing*// ring nas dge legs dpag tu med bsgrubs pas// yon tan dpag yas chu gter chen po la// gsol ba 'debs pa'i tshig 'di snyan du 'bul// bdag cag gi bla ma shes bya'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa la ye shes kyi nyi ma shar bas mi shes pa'i mun pa dpyis phyung ba/ mkhyen pa dang brtse ba'i spyan ras rab tu gsal bas gnas dang gnas ma yin pa gzigs pa'i thugs dgongs can/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub pa'i mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu byon zhing*/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rabs dang*/ man ngag rin po che'i gter mdzod chen po/ mngon par mtho ba dang*/ nges par legs pa nor bu'i gling 'tsho ba rnams la yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi rgya mtsho'i spyad kyis bde blag tu phyin par byed pa'i ded dpon/ mi 'phrog pa'i mkhyen rabs dang thugs rjer ldan pa de/ re zhig 'os su gyur pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi 'phrin las bsgrubs nas/ skal ba dang mi ldan pa rnams la thun mong du rnam par 'phrul ba bsdus te/ lha'i tshogs dpag tu med pas zhabs 'bring byas nas/

mchod pa'i khyad par dpag tu med pas bsus te/ bde ba can gyi zhing du gshegs pa lags/ 'di'i rnam thar rgyas pa/ rin po che pa nyid thams cad gzigs pa lags pas mkhyen par gsal bas mi gleng lags/ slad ma skabs kyi zhu don la/ bdag cag bka' drin gyi lan/ mchod pa chos lugs dang mthun pa zhig bgyi bar 'tshal/ de la mchod pa'i yul lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten na/ rin po che kho na mchog tu gyur par mthong nas/ dpal sa skya'i dben gnas su spyan 'dren par 'tshal bas/ thugs rin po che la gdags par zhu/ spyir rin po che pa spyan 'dren pa 'di phyogs mtha' dag nas spobs pa shin tu dka' yang*/ rgyu mtshan gcig tu na ning snga ma'i bka' yig la/ 'byon par zhal gyis bzhes pa yin pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan gnyis par/ rin po che rnyed pa dang bkur bsti la mi gzigs shing*/ sems can gyi don la dgongs pa yin pa dang*/ gsum pa/ rdo rje 'chang chen po'i ngo bor gyur pa'i rje btsun sa skya ba chen po'i gdan sa yin la/ 'gro ba'i mgon po dpal ldan phag mo gru pas yun ring du bzhugs pa'i gnas lags pas/ nges par 'byon snyam pa'i gdeng zhig yod nas zhu ba phul ba lags pas/ ci nas kyang 'byon pa thugs kyis gzung bar zhu/ thugs rje'i char sprin shes bya'i mkha' khyab pa// rnam dpyod glog gi 'phreng ba'i 'od zer can// rgyun du gzhan la phan pa'i char 'beb pas// 'gro ba dge ba'i lo tog 'phel bar smon// zhes pa ni rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gshegs rdzongs gral dbur rje spyan snga rin po cher sa skya paṇḍi tas spyan 'dren zhu yig go/ bdag dang 'khor 'das thams cad kyis dus gsum du bsags pa dang yod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis bdag sogs sems can thams cad myur du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub rin po che thob par gyur cig /
